package com.example.alert_app

import android.app.KeyguardManager
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.media.AudioAttributes
import android.media.MediaPlayer
import android.media.RingtoneManager
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.PowerManager
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.WindowManager
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import io.flutter.embedding.android.FlutterActivity
import io.flutter.embedding.engine.FlutterEngine
import io.flutter.plugin.common.MethodChannel

class MainActivity : FlutterActivity() {
    private val CHANNEL = "com.example.alert_app/alarm"
    private var previewPlayer: MediaPlayer? = null
    private val previewHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var previewRunnable: Runnable? = null

    override fun configureFlutterEngine(flutterEngine: FlutterEngine) {
        super.configureFlutterEngine(flutterEngine)

        // Ensure lock screen display flags are set
        configureLockScreenDisplay()

        // Auto-ensure background service & hardware watchdog are active
        try {
            val serviceIntent = Intent(this, AlertForegroundService::class.java).apply {
                action = AlertForegroundService.ACTION_START
            }
            ContextCompat.startForegroundService(this, serviceIntent)
            AlarmWatchdog.scheduleNextWatchdog(this, 15000L)
        } catch (_: Exception) {}

        MethodChannel(flutterEngine.dartExecutor.binaryMessenger, CHANNEL).setMethodCallHandler { call, result ->
            when (call.method) {
                "getRingtones" -> {
                    try {
                        val ringtones = getAvailableRingtones()
                        result.success(ringtones)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.error("RINGTONE_ERROR", e.localizedMessage, null)
                    }
                }
                "playAlarm" -> {
                    val uriString = call.argument<String>("uri")
                    val looping = call.argument<Boolean>("looping") ?: true
                    try {
                        AlarmPlayer.playAlarm(this, uriString, looping)
                        result.success(true)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.error("PLAY_ERROR", e.localizedMessage, null)
                    }
                }
                "stopAlarm" -> {
                    AlarmPlayer.stopAlarm(this)
                    result.success(true)
                }
                "previewRingtone" -> {
                    val uriString = call.argument<String>("uri")
                    try {
                        previewRingtone(uriString)
                        result.success(true)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.error("PREVIEW_ERROR", e.localizedMessage, null)
                    }
                }
                "stopPreview" -> {
                    stopPreview()
                    result.success(true)
                }
                "syncActiveAlerts" -> {
                    try {
                        val alertsJson = call.argument<String>("alerts") ?: "[]"
                        val prefs = getSharedPreferences(AlertForegroundService.PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                        prefs.edit().putString(AlertForegroundService.KEY_ACTIVE_ALERTS, alertsJson).apply()
                        
                        // Notify running foreground service to evaluate immediately
                        val intent = Intent(this, AlertForegroundService::class.java).apply {
                            action = AlertForegroundService.ACTION_SYNC_ALERTS
                        }
                        startService(intent)
                        AlarmWatchdog.scheduleNextWatchdog(this, 15000L)
                        result.success(true)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.error("SYNC_ERROR", e.localizedMessage, null)
                    }
                }
                "saveStorage" -> {
                    try {
                        val key = call.argument<String>("key") ?: ""
                        val value = call.argument<String>("value") ?: ""
                        val prefs = getSharedPreferences(AlertForegroundService.PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                        prefs.edit().putString(key, value).apply()
                        result.success(true)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.error("STORAGE_ERROR", e.localizedMessage, null)
                    }
                }
                "loadStorage" -> {
                    try {
                        val key = call.argument<String>("key") ?: ""
                        val prefs = getSharedPreferences(AlertForegroundService.PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                        val value = prefs.getString(key, null)
                        result.success(value)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.error("STORAGE_ERROR", e.localizedMessage, null)
                    }
                }
                "removeStorage" -> {
                    try {
                        val key = call.argument<String>("key") ?: ""
                        val prefs = getSharedPreferences(AlertForegroundService.PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                        prefs.edit().remove(key).apply()
                        result.success(true)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.error("STORAGE_ERROR", e.localizedMessage, null)
                    }
                }
                "startForegroundService" -> {
                    try {
                        val intent = Intent(this, AlertForegroundService::class.java).apply {
                            action = AlertForegroundService.ACTION_START
                        }
                        ContextCompat.startForegroundService(this, intent)
                        AlarmWatchdog.scheduleNextWatchdog(this, 15000L)
                        result.success(true)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.error("SERVICE_ERROR", e.localizedMessage, null)
                    }
                }
                "stopForegroundService" -> {
                    try {
                        AlarmWatchdog.cancelWatchdog(this)
                        val intent = Intent(this, AlertForegroundService::class.java).apply {
                            action = AlertForegroundService.ACTION_STOP
                        }
                        startService(intent)
                        result.success(true)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.error("SERVICE_ERROR", e.localizedMessage, null)
                    }
                }
                "isDndOverrideGranted" -> {
                    val nm = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
                    result.success(nm.isNotificationPolicyAccessGranted)
                }
                "requestDndOverride" -> {
                    try {
                        val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_NOTIFICATION_POLICY_ACCESS_SETTINGS)
                        startActivity(intent)
                        result.success(true)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.error("DND_SETTINGS_ERROR", e.localizedMessage, null)
                    }
                }
                "isBatteryOptimizationIgnored" -> {
                    try {
                        val powerManager = getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as PowerManager
                        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
                            result.success(powerManager.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(packageName))
                        } else {
                            result.success(true)
                        }
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        result.success(true)
                    }
                }
                "requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations" -> {
                    try {
                        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
                            val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS).apply {
                                data = Uri.parse("package:$packageName")
                            }
                            startActivity(intent)
                        }
                        result.success(true)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        // Fallback to battery optimization settings list
                        try {
                            val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION_SETTINGS)
                            startActivity(intent)
                            result.success(true)
                        } catch (e2: Exception) {
                            result.error("BATTERY_SETTINGS_ERROR", e2.localizedMessage, null)
                        }
                    }
                }
                else -> result.notImplemented()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun configureLockScreenDisplay() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O_MR1) {
            setShowWhenLocked(true)
            setTurnScreenOn(true)
            val keyguardManager = getSystemService(Context.KEYGUARD_SERVICE) as KeyguardManager
            keyguardManager.requestDismissKeyguard(this, null)
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            window.addFlags(
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SHOW_WHEN_LOCKED or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DISMISS_KEYGUARD or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_TURN_SCREEN_ON or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON
            )
        }
    }

    private fun getAvailableRingtones(): List<Map<String, String>> {
        val list = mutableListOf<Map<String, String>>()
        val manager = RingtoneManager(this)

        // Query alarms first
        try {
            manager.setType(RingtoneManager.TYPE_ALARM)
            val cursor = manager.cursor
            while (cursor != null && cursor.moveToNext()) {
                val title = cursor.getString(RingtoneManager.TITLE_COLUMN_INDEX)
                val uri = manager.getRingtoneUri(cursor.position)?.toString() ?: ""
                if (uri.isNotEmpty()) {
                    list.add(mapOf("title" to title, "uri" to uri, "type" to "alarm"))
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {}

        // Also query standard ringtones
        try {
            manager.setType(RingtoneManager.TYPE_RINGTONE)
            val cursor = manager.cursor
            while (cursor != null && cursor.moveToNext()) {
                val title = cursor.getString(RingtoneManager.TITLE_COLUMN_INDEX)
                val uri = manager.getRingtoneUri(cursor.position)?.toString() ?: ""
                if (uri.isNotEmpty() && list.none { it["uri"] == uri }) {
                    list.add(mapOf("title" to title, "uri" to uri, "type" to "ringtone"))
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {}

        // If list is empty (fallback), add default alarm URI
        if (list.isEmpty()) {
            val defaultUri = RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_ALARM)
                ?: RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_RINGTONE)
            if (defaultUri != null) {
                list.add(mapOf("title" to "Default Alarm", "uri" to defaultUri.toString(), "type" to "alarm"))
            }
        }

        return list
    }

    private fun previewRingtone(uriString: String?) {
        stopPreview()
        if (uriString.isNullOrEmpty()) return

        val uri = Uri.parse(uriString)
        previewPlayer = MediaPlayer().apply {
            setDataSource(applicationContext, uri)
            setAudioAttributes(
                AudioAttributes.Builder()
                    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_NOTIFICATION)
                    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
                    .build()
            )
            isLooping = false
            prepare()
            start()
        }

        // Auto stop after 3 seconds
        previewRunnable = Runnable { stopPreview() }
        previewHandler.postDelayed(previewRunnable!!, 3000)
    }

    private fun stopPreview() {
        previewRunnable?.let { previewHandler.removeCallbacks(it) }
        previewRunnable = null
        try {
            previewPlayer?.let {
                if (it.isPlaying) {
                    it.stop()
                }
                it.release()
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
        previewPlayer = null
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        AlarmPlayer.stopAlarm(this)
        stopPreview()
        super.onDestroy()
    }
}

import lldb

def handle_new_rx_page(frame: lldb.SBFrame, bp_loc, extra_args, intern_dict):
    """Intercept NOTIFY_DEBUGGER_ABOUT_RX_PAGES and touch the pages."""
    base = frame.register["x0"].GetValueAsAddress()
    page_len = frame.register["x1"].GetValueAsUnsigned()

    # Note: NOTIFY_DEBUGGER_ABOUT_RX_PAGES will check contents of the
    # first page to see if handled it correctly. This makes diagnosing
    # misconfiguration (e.g. missing breakpoint) easier.
    data = bytearray(page_len)
    data[0:8] = b'IHELPED!'

    error = lldb.SBError()
    frame.GetThread().GetProcess().WriteMemory(base, data, error)
    if not error.Success():
        print(f'Failed to write into {base}[+{page_len}]', error)
        return

def __lldb_init_module(debugger: lldb.SBDebugger, _):
    target = debugger.GetDummyTarget()
    # Caveat: must use BreakpointCreateByRegEx here and not
    # BreakpointCreateByName. For some reasons callback function does not
    # get carried over from dummy target for the later.
    bp = target.BreakpointCreateByRegex("^NOTIFY_DEBUGGER_ABOUT_RX_PAGES$")
    bp.SetScriptCallbackFunction('{}.handle_new_rx_page'.format(__name__))
    bp.SetAutoContinue(True)
    print("-- LLDB integration loaded --")

# Launch Screen Assets

You can customize the launch screen with your own desired assets by replacing the image files in this directory.

You can also do it by opening your Flutter project's Xcode project with `open ios/Runner.xcworkspace`, selecting `Runner/Assets.xcassets` in the Project Navigator and dropping in the desired images.

================================================================================
Folder: ios\Runner\Base.lproj
================================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'services/alert_manager.dart';
import 'services/biquote_service.dart';
import 'theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'screens/splash_screen.dart';

void main() {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  runApp(const TenXApp());
}

class TenXApp extends StatefulWidget {
  const TenXApp({super.key});

  @override
  State<TenXApp> createState() => _TenXAppState();
}

class _TenXAppState extends State<TenXApp> {
  ThemeMode _themeMode = ThemeMode.dark;
  late final BiquoteService _biquoteService;
  late final AlertManager _alertManager;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _biquoteService = BiquoteService();
    _alertManager = AlertManager();
  }

  void _toggleTheme() {
    setState(() {
      _themeMode = _themeMode == ThemeMode.dark ? ThemeMode.light : ThemeMode.dark;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'TenX',
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      theme: AppTheme.lightTheme,
      darkTheme: AppTheme.darkTheme,
      themeMode: _themeMode,
      home: SplashScreen(
        biquoteService: _biquoteService,
        alertManager: _alertManager,
        isDark: _themeMode == ThemeMode.dark,
        onToggleTheme: _toggleTheme,
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

/// Direction of the trade setup
enum SignalDirection {
  buy('BUY'),
  sell('SELL'),
  wait('WAIT');

  final String label;
  const SignalDirection(this.label);

  static SignalDirection fromString(String? val) {
    if (val == null) return SignalDirection.wait;
    final clean = val.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (clean.contains('BUY') || clean == 'LONG') return SignalDirection.buy;
    if (clean.contains('SELL') || clean == 'SHORT') return SignalDirection.sell;
    return SignalDirection.wait;
  }
}

/// Configuration for a single specialist analysis agent
class SpecialistAgentConfig {
  final String id;
  String name;
  String systemPrompt;

  SpecialistAgentConfig({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.systemPrompt,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'name': name,
        'systemPrompt': systemPrompt,
      };

  factory SpecialistAgentConfig.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      SpecialistAgentConfig(
        id: json['id'] as String? ?? 'specialist_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
        name: json['name'] as String? ?? 'Specialist Agent',
        systemPrompt: json['systemPrompt'] as String? ?? '',
      );

  SpecialistAgentConfig copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? name,
    String? systemPrompt,
  }) =>
      SpecialistAgentConfig(
        id: id ?? this.id,
        name: name ?? this.name,
        systemPrompt: systemPrompt ?? this.systemPrompt,
      );
}

/// User-defined trading strategy comprising 1 to N specialist agents
class TradingStrategy {
  final String id;
  String name;
  String description;
  List<SpecialistAgentConfig> specialists;
  List<String> timeframes;
  final DateTime createdAt;

  TradingStrategy({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    this.description = '',
    required this.specialists,
    this.timeframes = const ['5M', '1H'],
    required this.createdAt,
  });

  bool get isMultiAgent => specialists.length > 1;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'name': name,
        'description': description,
        'specialists': specialists.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList(),
        'timeframes': timeframes,
        'createdAt': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
      };

  factory TradingStrategy.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => TradingStrategy(
        id: json['id'] as String? ?? 'strat_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
        name: json['name'] as String? ?? 'Custom Strategy',
        description: json['description'] as String? ?? '',
        specialists: (json['specialists'] as List<dynamic>?)
                ?.map((s) => SpecialistAgentConfig.fromJson(s as Map<String, dynamic>))
                .toList() ??
            [],
        timeframes: (json['timeframes'] as List<dynamic>?)
                ?.map((e) => e.toString())
                .toList() ??
            ['5M', '1H'],
        createdAt: DateTime.tryParse(json['createdAt'] as String? ?? '') ??
            DateTime.now(),
      );

  TradingStrategy copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? name,
    String? description,
    List<SpecialistAgentConfig>? specialists,
    List<String>? timeframes,
    DateTime? createdAt,
  }) =>
      TradingStrategy(
        id: id ?? this.id,
        name: name ?? this.name,
        description: description ?? this.description,
        specialists: specialists ?? this.specialists.map((s) => s.copyWith()).toList(),
        timeframes: timeframes ?? List<String>.from(this.timeframes),
        createdAt: createdAt ?? this.createdAt,
      );

  /// Default pre-built Aureus SMC + Wyckoff Strategy ported from Python TradingBot
  static TradingStrategy aureusDefault() {
    return TradingStrategy(
      id: 'aureus_default',
      name: 'Aureus SMC + Wyckoff Confluence',
      timeframes: ['5M', '1H'],
      description: 'Dual-specialist parallel pipeline using Smart Money Concepts & Wyckoff methodology with grounding critics and metareasoning.',
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
      specialists: [
        SpecialistAgentConfig(
          id: 'smc_analyst',
          name: 'SMC Structure Specialist',
          systemPrompt: '''Role: You are an elite technical analysis expert specializing in Smart Money Concepts (SMC).
Your analysis focuses on:
1. Identifying recent Market Structure (BOS - Break of Structure, CHoCH - Change of Character).
2. Spotting unmitigated Order Blocks (OB) and Fair Value Gaps (FVG) / Imbalances.
3. Liquidity sweeps (Buy-side and Sell-side liquidity pools taken).
4. Pinpointing high-probability discount/premium entries and precise invalidation levels.

Always formulate your setup with strict adherence to market structure based on the provided 100 candles.''',
        ),
        SpecialistAgentConfig(
          id: 'wyckoff_analyst',
          name: 'Wyckoff Phase Specialist',
          systemPrompt: '''Role: You are an expert Wyckoff Method market cycle analyst.
Your analysis focuses on:
1. Determining the macro and micro market cycle phase: Accumulation, Markup, Distribution, or Markdown.
2. Identifying signature Wyckoff events: Selling/Buying Climax (SC/BC), Automatic Rally/Reaction (AR), Secondary Tests (ST), Springs, Upthrusts After Distribution (UTAD), and Signs of Strength/Weakness (SOS/SOW).
3. Projecting directional continuation or reversal waves with clear cause-and-effect targets.

Always ground your phase evaluation in the supplied 100 candlestick history.''',
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  /// Default single specialist strategy preset
  static TradingStrategy singleAnalystDefault() {
    return TradingStrategy(
      id: 'single_specialist_default',
      name: 'Pure Price Action & Structure',
      description: 'Single specialist workflow with automated Grounding Critic verification.',
      timeframes: ['15M', '1H'],
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
      specialists: [
        SpecialistAgentConfig(
          id: 'pa_analyst',
          name: 'Price Action & Liquidity Specialist',
          systemPrompt: '''Role: You are an expert Price Action and Liquidity Specialist.
Analyze the provided 100 candles to determine:
1. Trend direction and key swing highs / swing lows.

        ),

  }
}

/// Structured JSON response returned by specialists and the metareasoning consolidator
class AgentSignal {
  final SignalDirection direction;
  final String analysis;
  final String theory;
  final double entryPrice;
  final double stopLoss;
  final double takeProfit;
  final int confidence; // 1 to 10
  final String agentName;
  final DateTime timestamp;
  final String? rawJson;

  AgentSignal({
    required this.direction,
    required this.analysis,
    required this.theory,
    required this.entryPrice,
    required this.stopLoss,
    required this.takeProfit,
    required this.confidence,
    required this.agentName,
    required this.timestamp,
    this.rawJson,
  });

  bool get hasValidTradeSetup =>
      direction != SignalDirection.wait &&
      entryPrice > 0 &&
      stopLoss > 0 &&
      takeProfit > 0;

  double get riskRewardRatio {
    final risk = (entryPrice - stopLoss).abs();
    final reward = (takeProfit - entryPrice).abs();
    if (risk <= 0) return 0.0;
    return reward / risk;
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'direction': direction.label.toLowerCase(),
        'analysis': analysis,
        'theory': theory,
        'entry_price': entryPrice,
        'stop_loss': stopLoss,
        'take_profit': takeProfit,
        'confidence': confidence,
        'agent_name': agentName,
        'timestamp': timestamp.toIso8601String(),
        'raw_json': rawJson,
      };

  factory AgentSignal.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json, {String defaultAgentName = 'Agent'}) {
    final dirStr = json['direction']?.toString() ?? 'wait';
    final direction = SignalDirection.fromString(dirStr);

    final analysis = json['analysis']?.toString() ?? '';
    final theory = json['theory']?.toString() ?? '';

    final entryPrice = _extractDouble(json['entry_price'] ?? json['entry'] ?? json['entryPrice']);
    final stopLoss = _extractDouble(json['stop_loss'] ?? json['sl'] ?? json['stopLoss']);
    final takeProfit = _extractDouble(json['take_profit'] ?? json['tp'] ?? json['takeProfit']);

    int confidence = 5;
    final confVal = json['confidence'];
    if (confVal is num) {
      confidence = confVal.toInt().clamp(1, 10);
    } else if (confVal is String) {
      confidence = (int.tryParse(confVal.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '')) ?? 5).clamp(1, 10);
    }

    final agentName = json['agent_name']?.toString() ?? defaultAgentName;
    final timestamp = DateTime.tryParse(json['timestamp']?.toString() ?? '') ?? DateTime.now();

    return AgentSignal(
      direction: direction,
      analysis: analysis,
      theory: theory,
      entryPrice: entryPrice,
      stopLoss: stopLoss,
      takeProfit: takeProfit,
      confidence: confidence,
      agentName: agentName,
      timestamp: timestamp,
      rawJson: jsonEncode(json),
    );
  }

  static double _extractDouble(dynamic value) {
    if (value == null) return 0.0;
    if (value is num) return value.toDouble();
    if (value is String) {
      final clean = value.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9.]'), '');
      return double.tryParse(clean) ?? 0.0;
    }
    return 0.0;
  }
}

/// Pipeline execution state tracking
enum PipelineStage {
  idle,
  fetchingMarketData,
  initialSpecialists,
  groundingCritic,
  refinedSpecialists,
  metareasoningConsolidator,
  completed,
  failed,
}

/// Real-time progress updates sent to the UI
class AnalysisProgress {
  final PipelineStage stage;
  final String message;
  final List<String>? activeAgents;
  final double progressFraction;
  final Map<String, AgentSignal>? currentSignals;
  final String? groundingCritique;

  AnalysisProgress({
    required this.stage,
    required this.message,
    this.activeAgents,
    required this.progressFraction,
    this.currentSignals,
    this.groundingCritique,
  });
}

/// Final result returned by the entire pipeline run
class PipelineRunResult {
  final TradingStrategy strategy;
  final String symbol;
  final String timeframe;
  final List<AgentSignal> initialSpecialistSignals;
  final String groundingCritique;
  final List<AgentSignal> refinedSpecialistSignals;
  final AgentSignal? consolidatedSignal;
  final DateTime timestamp;

  PipelineRunResult({
    required this.strategy,
    required this.symbol,
    required this.timeframe,
    required this.initialSpecialistSignals,
    required this.groundingCritique,
    required this.refinedSpecialistSignals,
    this.consolidatedSignal,
    required this.timestamp,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'strategy': strategy.toJson(),
        'symbol': symbol,
        'timeframe': timeframe,
        'initialSpecialistSignals': initialSpecialistSignals.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList(),
        'groundingCritique': groundingCritique,
        'refinedSpecialistSignals': refinedSpecialistSignals.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList(),
        'consolidatedSignal': consolidatedSignal?.toJson(),
        'timestamp': timestamp.toIso8601String(),
      };

  factory PipelineRunResult.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => PipelineRunResult(
        strategy: TradingStrategy.fromJson(json['strategy'] as Map<String, dynamic>),
        symbol: json['symbol'] as String? ?? 'UNKNOWN',
        timeframe: json['timeframe'] as String? ?? '15M',
        initialSpecialistSignals: (json['initialSpecialistSignals'] as List<dynamic>?)
                ?.map((s) => AgentSignal.fromJson(s as Map<String, dynamic>))
                .toList() ??
            [],
        groundingCritique: json['groundingCritique'] as String? ?? '',
        refinedSpecialistSignals: (json['refinedSpecialistSignals'] as List<dynamic>?)
                ?.map((s) => AgentSignal.fromJson(s as Map<String, dynamic>))
                .toList() ??
            [],
        consolidatedSignal: json['consolidatedSignal'] != null
            ? AgentSignal.fromJson(json['consolidatedSignal'] as Map<String, dynamic>)
            : null,
        timestamp: DateTime.tryParse(json['timestamp'] as String? ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
      );

  /// The active final signal: consolidated signal if multi-agent, or refined specialist if single agent
  AgentSignal get finalSignal =>
      consolidatedSignal ??
      (refinedSpecialistSignals.isNotEmpty
          ? refinedSpecialistSignals.first
          : (initialSpecialistSignals.isNotEmpty
              ? initialSpecialistSignals.first
              : AgentSignal(
                  direction: SignalDirection.wait,
                  analysis: 'No signal generated',
                  theory: '',
                  entryPrice: 0.0,
                  stopLoss: 0.0,
                  takeProfit: 0.0,
                  confidence: 1,
                  agentName: 'System',
                  timestamp: timestamp,
                )));
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum DrawingTool {
  none('Cursor', Icons.pan_tool_alt),
  trendline('Trendline', Icons.show_chart),
  horizontalLine('Horizontal Line', Icons.horizontal_rule),
  fibonacci('Fibonacci', Icons.format_line_spacing),
  rectangle('Zone / Box', Icons.crop_square),
  ruler('Pip Ruler', Icons.straighten);

  final String label;
  final IconData icon;
  const DrawingTool(this.label, this.icon);
}

class ChartPoint {
  final DateTime time;
  final double price;

  const ChartPoint({
    required this.time,
    required this.price,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'time': time.toIso8601String(),
        'price': price,
      };

  factory ChartPoint.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => ChartPoint(
        time: DateTime.parse(json['time'] as String),
        price: (json['price'] as num).toDouble(),
      );

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is ChartPoint &&
          runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
          time == other.time &&
          price == other.price;

  @override
  int get hashCode => time.hashCode ^ price.hashCode;
}

class ChartDrawing {
  final String id;
  final DrawingTool tool;
  final List<ChartPoint> points;
  Color color;
  double strokeWidth;
  bool isLocked;
  bool isSelected;
  String? alertId;

  ChartDrawing({
    required this.id,
    required this.tool,
    required this.points,
    this.color = const Color(0xFF00E5FF), // Default Electric Cyan
    this.strokeWidth = 2.0,
    this.isLocked = false,
    this.isSelected = false,
    this.alertId,
  });

  bool get hasAlert => alertId != null && alertId!.isNotEmpty;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'tool': tool.name,
        'points': points.map((p) => p.toJson()).toList(),
        'color': color.toARGB32(),
        'strokeWidth': strokeWidth,
        'isLocked': isLocked,
        'alertId': alertId,
      };

  factory ChartDrawing.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return ChartDrawing(
      id: json['id'] as String,
      tool: DrawingTool.values.firstWhere(
        (t) => t.name == json['tool'],
        orElse: () => DrawingTool.trendline,
      ),
      points: (json['points'] as List<dynamic>)
          .map((p) => ChartPoint.fromJson(p as Map<String, dynamic>))
          .toList(),
      color: Color((json['color'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0xFF00E5FF),
      strokeWidth: (json['strokeWidth'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 2.0,
      isLocked: json['isLocked'] as bool? ?? false,
      alertId: json['alertId'] as String?,
    );
  }

  ChartDrawing copyWith({
    String? id,
    DrawingTool? tool,
    List<ChartPoint>? points,
    Color? color,
    double? strokeWidth,
    bool? isLocked,
    bool? isSelected,
    String? alertId,
  }) {
    return ChartDrawing(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      tool: tool ?? this.tool,
      points: points ?? List.from(this.points),
      color: color ?? this.color,
      strokeWidth: strokeWidth ?? this.strokeWidth,
      isLocked: isLocked ?? this.isLocked,
      isSelected: isSelected ?? this.isSelected,
      alertId: alertId ?? this.alertId,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum IndicatorType {
  rsi('RSI', 'Relative Strength Index', IndicatorPlacement.subPane),
  macd('MACD', 'Moving Average Convergence Divergence', IndicatorPlacement.subPane),
  stochastic('Stoch', 'Stochastic Oscillator', IndicatorPlacement.subPane),
  ema('EMA', 'Exponential Moving Average', IndicatorPlacement.overlay),
  sma('SMA', 'Simple Moving Average', IndicatorPlacement.overlay),
  bollingerBands('BB', 'Bollinger Bands', IndicatorPlacement.overlay);

  final String shortName;
  final String fullName;
  final IndicatorPlacement placement;

  const IndicatorType(this.shortName, this.fullName, this.placement);
}

enum IndicatorPlacement {
  overlay,
  subPane,
}

class IndicatorConfig {
  final String id;
  final IndicatorType type;
  bool isVisible;
  Map<String, dynamic> inputs;
  Map<String, int> colors;
  double lineWidth;

  IndicatorConfig({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    this.isVisible = true,
    required this.inputs,
    required this.colors,
    this.lineWidth = 1.8,
  });

  // Default initializers for each indicator
  factory IndicatorConfig.defaultFor(IndicatorType type) {
    final id = '${type.name}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}';
    switch (type) {
      case IndicatorType.rsi:
        return IndicatorConfig(
          id: id,
          type: type,
          inputs: {
            'period': 14,
            'overbought': 70.0,
            'oversold': 30.0,
          },
          colors: {
            'main': const Color(0xFFAB47BC).toARGB32(), // Purple
            'upper': const Color(0xFFEF5350).toARGB32(), // Red dashed
            'lower': const Color(0xFF26A69A).toARGB32(), // Teal dashed
            'bandFill': const Color(0x1F7E57C2).toARGB32(), // Soft purple fill
          },
          lineWidth: 2.0,
        );

      case IndicatorType.macd:
        return IndicatorConfig(
          id: id,
          type: type,
          inputs: {
            'fastPeriod': 12,
            'slowPeriod': 26,
            'signalPeriod': 9,
          },
          colors: {
            'macd': const Color(0xFF2962FF).toARGB32(), // Blue
            'signal': const Color(0xFFFF6D00).toARGB32(), // Orange
            'histUp': const Color(0xFF26A69A).toARGB32(), // Teal
            'histDown': const Color(0xFFEF5350).toARGB32(), // Red
          },
          lineWidth: 1.8,
        );

      case IndicatorType.stochastic:
        return IndicatorConfig(
          id: id,
          type: type,
          inputs: {
            'kPeriod': 14,
            'dPeriod': 3,
            'smooth': 3,
            'overbought': 80.0,
            'oversold': 20.0,
          },
          colors: {
            'k': const Color(0xFF2196F3).toARGB32(), // Blue %K
            'd': const Color(0xFFFF9800).toARGB32(), // Orange %D
            'bandFill': const Color(0x152196F3).toARGB32(),
          },
          lineWidth: 1.8,
        );

      case IndicatorType.ema:
        return IndicatorConfig(
          id: id,
          type: type,
          inputs: {
            'period': 20,
          },
          colors: {
            'main': const Color(0xFF00E5FF).toARGB32(), // Electric Cyan
          },
          lineWidth: 2.0,
        );

      case IndicatorType.sma:
        return IndicatorConfig(
          id: id,
          type: type,
          inputs: {
            'period': 50,
          },
          colors: {
            'main': const Color(0xFFFFEB3B).toARGB32(), // Yellow
          },
          lineWidth: 2.0,
        );

      case IndicatorType.bollingerBands:
        return IndicatorConfig(
          id: id,
          type: type,
          inputs: {
            'period': 20,
            'stdDev': 2.0,
          },
          colors: {
            'basis': const Color(0xFFFF9800).toARGB32(), // Orange
            'upper': const Color(0xFF00E5FF).toARGB32(), // Cyan
            'lower': const Color(0xFF00E5FF).toARGB32(), // Cyan
            'fill': const Color(0x1A00E5FF).toARGB32(), // Semi-transparent Cyan
          },
          lineWidth: 1.5,
        );
    }
  }

  Color getColor(String key, Color fallback) {
    if (colors.containsKey(key)) {
      return Color(colors[key]!);
    }
    return fallback;
  }

  void setColor(String key, Color color) {
    colors[key] = color.toARGB32();
  }

  int getInt(String key, int fallback) {
    final v = inputs[key];
    if (v is int) return v;
    if (v is double) return v.round();
    if (v is String) return int.tryParse(v) ?? fallback;
    return fallback;
  }

  double getDouble(String key, double fallback) {
    final v = inputs[key];
    if (v is double) return v;
    if (v is int) return v.toDouble();
    if (v is String) return double.tryParse(v) ?? fallback;
    return fallback;
  }

  String get titleWithParams {
    switch (type) {
      case IndicatorType.rsi:
        return 'RSI (${getInt('period', 14)})';
      case IndicatorType.macd:
        return 'MACD (${getInt('fastPeriod', 12)}, ${getInt('slowPeriod', 26)}, ${getInt('signalPeriod', 9)})';
      case IndicatorType.stochastic:
        return 'Stoch (${getInt('kPeriod', 14)}, ${getInt('dPeriod', 3)})';
      case IndicatorType.ema:
        return 'EMA (${getInt('period', 20)})';
      case IndicatorType.sma:
        return 'SMA (${getInt('period', 50)})';
      case IndicatorType.bollingerBands:
        return 'BB (${getInt('period', 20)}, ${getDouble('stdDev', 2.0).toStringAsFixed(1)})';
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'type': type.name,
        'isVisible': isVisible,
        'inputs': inputs,
        'colors': colors,
        'lineWidth': lineWidth,
      };

  factory IndicatorConfig.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final typeStr = json['type'] as String? ?? 'rsi';
    final type = IndicatorType.values.firstWhere(
      (t) => t.name == typeStr,
      orElse: () => IndicatorType.rsi,
    );

    final defaultCfg = IndicatorConfig.defaultFor(type);

    return IndicatorConfig(
      id: json['id'] as String? ?? defaultCfg.id,
      type: type,
      isVisible: json['isVisible'] as bool? ?? true,
      inputs: json['inputs'] != null ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(json['inputs'] as Map) : defaultCfg.inputs,
      colors: json['colors'] != null
          ? Map<String, int>.from(
              (json['colors'] as Map).map((k, v) => MapEntry(k.toString(), (v as num).toInt())),
            )
          : defaultCfg.colors,
      lineWidth: (json['lineWidth'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? defaultCfg.lineWidth,
    );
  }

  IndicatorConfig copyWith({
    String? id,
    IndicatorType? type,
    bool? isVisible,
    Map<String, dynamic>? inputs,
    Map<String, int>? colors,
    double? lineWidth,
  }) {
    return IndicatorConfig(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      type: type ?? this.type,
      isVisible: isVisible ?? this.isVisible,
      inputs: inputs != null ? Map.from(inputs) : Map.from(this.inputs),
      colors: colors != null ? Map.from(colors) : Map.from(this.colors),
      lineWidth: lineWidth ?? this.lineWidth,
    );
  }
}

class BiquoteTick {
  final String symbol;
  final String description;
  final double bid;
  final double ask;
  final double mid;
  final double spread;
  final double high;
  final double low;
  final String direction;
  final double dayDiffPercent;
  final DateTime timestamp;
  final String source;
  final String marketState;
  final bool stale;
  final int quoteAgeSeconds;

  BiquoteTick({
    required this.symbol,
    required this.description,
    required this.bid,
    required this.ask,
    required this.mid,
    required this.spread,
    required this.high,
    required this.low,
    required this.direction,
    required this.dayDiffPercent,
    required this.timestamp,
    required this.source,
    required this.marketState,
    required this.stale,
    required this.quoteAgeSeconds,
  });

  bool get isMarketClosed => marketState == 'closed' || stale;
  bool get isBullish => dayDiffPercent >= 0;

  int get precision {
    if (symbol.contains('JPY')) return 3;
    if (symbol.contains('BTC') || symbol.contains('ETH')) return 2;
    if (symbol.contains('XAU')) return 2;
    return 5;
  }

  factory BiquoteTick.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return BiquoteTick(
      symbol: json['symbol'] as String? ?? '',
      description: json['description'] as String? ?? '',
      bid: (json['bid'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      ask: (json['ask'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      mid: (json['mid'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      spread: (json['spread'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      high: (json['high'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      low: (json['low'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      direction: json['direction'] as String? ?? 'FLAT',
      dayDiffPercent: (json['dayDiffPercent'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      timestamp: DateTime.tryParse(json['timestamp'] as String? ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
      source: json['source'] as String? ?? '',
      marketState: json['marketState'] as String? ?? 'open',
      stale: json['stale'] as bool? ?? false,
      quoteAgeSeconds: (json['quoteAgeSeconds'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
    );
  }

  // Safe placeholder tick when awaiting live feed subscription seed
  factory BiquoteTick.placeholder({
    required String symbol,
    double price = 0.0,
  }) {
    return BiquoteTick(
      symbol: symbol,
      description: symbol,
      bid: price,
      ask: price,
      mid: price,
      spread: 0.0,
      high: price,
      low: price,
      direction: 'FLAT',
      dayDiffPercent: 0.0,
      timestamp: DateTime.now(),
      source: 'Waiting for feed...',
      marketState: 'closed',
      stale: true,
      quoteAgeSeconds: 0,
    );
  }
}

class BiquoteCandle {
  final DateTime openTime;
  final double open;
  final double high;
  final double low;
  final double close;
  final int tickVolume;
  final bool isOpen;

  BiquoteCandle({
    required this.openTime,
    required this.open,
    required this.high,
    required this.low,
    required this.close,
    required this.tickVolume,
    required this.isOpen,
  });

  bool get isBullish => close >= open;
  double get range => high - low;
  double get bodyRange => (close - open).abs();

  BiquoteCandle copyWith({
    DateTime? openTime,
    double? open,
    double? high,
    double? low,
    double? close,
    int? tickVolume,
    bool? isOpen,
  }) {
    return BiquoteCandle(
      openTime: openTime ?? this.openTime,
      open: open ?? this.open,
      high: high ?? this.high,
      low: low ?? this.low,
      close: close ?? this.close,
      tickVolume: tickVolume ?? this.tickVolume,
      isOpen: isOpen ?? this.isOpen,
    );
  }

  BiquoteCandle updateWithTick(double newPrice) {
    return copyWith(
      close: newPrice,
      high: newPrice > high ? newPrice : high,
      low: newPrice < low ? newPrice : low,
      tickVolume: tickVolume + 1,
      isOpen: true,
    );
  }

  factory BiquoteCandle.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return BiquoteCandle(
      openTime: DateTime.tryParse(json['openTime'] as String? ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
      open: (json['open'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      high: (json['high'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      low: (json['low'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      close: (json['close'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      tickVolume: (json['tickVolume'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      isOpen: json['isOpen'] as bool? ?? false,
    );
  }
}

enum AlertType {
  priceLevel('Price Level'),
  candlestickPattern('Candlestick Pattern'),
  technicalIndicator('Indicator Alert'),
  multiStepChain('Logic Chain (Multi-Step)');

  final String label;
  const AlertType(this.label);
}

enum AlertIndicatorType {
  rsi('RSI', 'Relative Strength Index'),
  macd('MACD', 'Moving Average Convergence Divergence'),
  maCross('MA Cross', 'Moving Average Cross (EMA/SMA)'),
  bollingerBands('Bollinger', 'Volatility Bands (Upper/Lower/Squeeze)'),
  stochastic('Stochastic', 'Momentum Oscillator (%K / %D)'),
  supertrend('Supertrend', 'ATR Trailing Trend Channel');

  final String label;
  final String description;
  const AlertIndicatorType(this.label, this.description);
}

class IndicatorAlertConfig {
  final AlertIndicatorType indicatorType;
  final String condition;
  final Map<String, dynamic> params;

  IndicatorAlertConfig({
    required this.indicatorType,
    required this.condition,
    this.params = const {},
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    return {
      'indicatorType': indicatorType.name,
      'condition': condition,
      'params': params,
    };
  }

  factory IndicatorAlertConfig.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    AlertIndicatorType type = AlertIndicatorType.rsi;
    for (final it in AlertIndicatorType.values) {
      if (it.name == json['indicatorType']) {
        type = it;
        break;
      }
    }
    return IndicatorAlertConfig(
      indicatorType: type,
      condition: json['condition'] as String? ?? 'crossesAbove',
      params: (json['params'] as Map<String, dynamic>?) ?? {},
    );
  }

  String get summary {
    switch (indicatorType) {
      case AlertIndicatorType.rsi:
        final period = params['period'] ?? 14;
        final level = params['level'] ?? 30;
        final signalMaType = params['signalMaType'] ?? 'EMA';
        final signalMaPeriod = params['signalMaPeriod'] ?? 9;
        final source = params['source'] ?? 'Close';
        final smoothing = params['smoothingType'] ?? 'RMA';
        final ob = params['overbought'] ?? 70;
        final os = params['oversold'] ?? 30;
        final srcStr = source != 'Close' ? ' [$source]' : '';
        final smoothStr = smoothing != 'RMA' ? ' $smoothing' : '';
        final pStr = '$period$srcStr$smoothStr';

        if (condition == 'crossesAboveSignalMa') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) crosses above $signalMaType($signalMaPeriod) of RSI';
        } else if (condition == 'crossesBelowSignalMa') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) crosses below $signalMaType($signalMaPeriod) of RSI';
        } else if (condition == 'crossesAbove' || condition == 'crossesAboveLevel') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) crosses above $level';
        } else if (condition == 'crossesBelow' || condition == 'crossesBelowLevel') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) crosses below $level';
        } else if (condition == 'crossesBelowOversold') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) crosses below Oversold ($os)';
        } else if (condition == 'crossesAboveOversold') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) recovers above Oversold ($os)';
        } else if (condition == 'crossesAboveOverbought') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) crosses above Overbought ($ob)';
        } else if (condition == 'crossesBelowOverbought') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) falls below Overbought ($ob)';
        } else if (condition == 'overboughtEnter') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) enters Overbought (>$ob)';
        } else if (condition == 'oversoldEnter') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) enters Oversold (<$os)';
        } else if (condition == 'crossesAboveCenterline') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) crosses above 50 (Bullish Momentum)';
        } else if (condition == 'crossesBelowCenterline') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) crosses below 50 (Bearish Momentum)';
        } else if (condition == 'inOversold') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) is in Oversold Zone (<$os)';
        } else if (condition == 'inOverbought') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) is in Overbought Zone (>$ob)';
        } else if (condition == 'inBandRange') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) is inside Range ($os - $ob)';
        } else if (condition == 'outsideBandRange') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) is outside Range (<$os or >$ob)';
        } else if (condition == 'rsiTurningUp') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) hooks Upward (Inflection)';
        } else if (condition == 'rsiTurningDown') {
          return 'RSI($pStr) hooks Downward (Exhaustion)';
        } else {
          return 'RSI($pStr) crosses Centerline';
        }
      case AlertIndicatorType.macd:
        final fast = params['fast'] ?? 12;
        final slow = params['slow'] ?? 26;
        final signal = params['signal'] ?? 9;
        final source = params['source'] ?? 'Close';
        final fastMaType = params['fastMaType'] ?? 'EMA';
        final slowMaType = params['slowMaType'] ?? 'EMA';
        final signalMaType = params['signalMaType'] ?? 'EMA';
        final srcStr = source != 'Close' ? ' [$source]' : '';
        final typeStr = (fastMaType != 'EMA' || slowMaType != 'EMA' || signalMaType != 'EMA')
            ? ' {$fastMaType,$slowMaType,$signalMaType}'
            : '';
        final mStr = 'MACD($fast,$slow,$signal$srcStr$typeStr)';

        if (condition == 'bullishSignalCross') {
          return '$mStr Bullish Signal Cross';
        } else if (condition == 'bearishSignalCross') {
          return '$mStr Bearish Signal Cross';
        } else if (condition == 'zeroLineCrossAbove' || condition == 'zeroCrossAbove') {
          return '$mStr crosses above 0';
        } else if (condition == 'zeroLineCrossBelow' || condition == 'zeroCrossBelow') {
          return '$mStr crosses below 0';
        } else if (condition == 'signalZeroCrossAbove') {
          return '$mStr Signal crosses above 0';
        } else if (condition == 'signalZeroCrossBelow') {
          return '$mStr Signal crosses below 0';
        } else if (condition == 'histogramFlipPositive') {
          return '$mStr Histogram flips Positive (>0)';
        } else if (condition == 'histogramFlipNegative') {
          return '$mStr Histogram flips Negative (<0)';
        } else if (condition == 'macdAboveSignal') {
          return '$mStr Line > Signal (Bullish Momentum)';
        } else if (condition == 'macdBelowSignal') {
          return '$mStr Line < Signal (Bearish Momentum)';
        } else if (condition == 'macdAboveZero') {
          return '$mStr Line > 0 (Bullish Territory)';
        } else if (condition == 'macdBelowZero') {
          return '$mStr Line < 0 (Bearish Territory)';
        } else if (condition == 'histogramPositive') {
          return '$mStr Histogram > 0';
        } else if (condition == 'histogramNegative') {
          return '$mStr Histogram < 0';
        } else if (condition == 'histogramTurningUp') {
          return '$mStr Histogram hooks Upward (Recovery)';
        } else if (condition == 'histogramTurningDown') {
          return '$mStr Histogram hooks Downward (Exhaustion)';
        } else if (condition == 'macdTurningUp') {
          return '$mStr Line hooks Upward';
        } else if (condition == 'macdTurningDown') {
          return '$mStr Line hooks Downward';
        } else {
          return '$mStr Zero Cross';
        }
      case AlertIndicatorType.maCross:
        final fastPeriod = params['fastPeriod'] ?? 50;
        final slowPeriod = params['slowPeriod'] ?? 200;
        final maType = params['maType'] ?? 'EMA';
        final fastMaType = params['fastMaType'] ?? maType;
        final slowMaType = params['slowMaType'] ?? maType;
        final source = params['source'] != null && params['source'] != 'Close' ? ' (${params['source']})' : '';

        String condLabel;
        if (condition == 'goldenCross' || condition == 'fastCrossesAboveSlow') {
          condLabel = 'Bullish Cross ($fastMaType $fastPeriod > $slowMaType $slowPeriod)';
        } else if (condition == 'deathCross' || condition == 'fastCrossesBelowSlow') {
          condLabel = 'Bearish Cross ($fastMaType $fastPeriod < $slowMaType $slowPeriod)';
        } else if (condition == 'maCross') {
          condLabel = 'MA Crossover';
        } else if (condition == 'priceCrossesAbove' || condition == 'priceCrossesAboveFast') {
          condLabel = 'Price crosses above $fastMaType $fastPeriod';
        } else if (condition == 'priceCrossesBelow' || condition == 'priceCrossesBelowFast') {
          condLabel = 'Price crosses below $fastMaType $fastPeriod';
        } else if (condition == 'priceCrossesAboveSlow') {
          condLabel = 'Price crosses above $slowMaType $slowPeriod';
        } else if (condition == 'priceCrossesBelowSlow') {
          condLabel = 'Price crosses below $slowMaType $slowPeriod';
        } else if (condition == 'fastAboveSlow') {
          condLabel = 'State: $fastMaType $fastPeriod > $slowMaType $slowPeriod';
        } else if (condition == 'fastBelowSlow') {
          condLabel = 'State: $fastMaType $fastPeriod < $slowMaType $slowPeriod';
        } else if (condition == 'priceAboveFast') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price > $fastMaType $fastPeriod';
        } else if (condition == 'priceBelowFast') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price < $fastMaType $fastPeriod';
        } else if (condition == 'priceAboveSlow') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price > $slowMaType $slowPeriod';
        } else if (condition == 'priceBelowSlow') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price < $slowMaType $slowPeriod';
        } else if (condition == 'priceAboveBoth') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price above Both MAs';
        } else if (condition == 'priceBelowBoth') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price below Both MAs';
        } else if (condition == 'priceBetweenMAs') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price between Fast & Slow MAs';
        } else if (condition == 'fastTurningUp') {
          condLabel = 'Momentum: $fastMaType $fastPeriod hooks Upward';
        } else if (condition == 'fastTurningDown') {
          condLabel = 'Momentum: $fastMaType $fastPeriod hooks Downward';
        } else if (condition == 'slowTurningUp') {
          condLabel = 'Momentum: $slowMaType $slowPeriod hooks Upward';
        } else if (condition == 'slowTurningDown') {
          condLabel = 'Momentum: $slowMaType $slowPeriod hooks Downward';
        } else {
          condLabel = condition;
        }
        return 'MA($fastMaType $fastPeriod / $slowMaType $slowPeriod$source) $condLabel';
      case AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands:
        final period = params['period'] ?? 20;
        final stdDev = params['stdDev'] ?? 2.0;
        final maType = params['maType'] ?? 'SMA';
        final source = params['source'] != null && params['source'] != 'Close' ? ' (${params['source']})' : '';

        String condLabel;
        if (condition == 'upperBandTouch' || condition == 'priceCrossesAboveUpper') {
          condLabel = 'Price crosses above Upper Band';
        } else if (condition == 'priceCrossesBelowUpper') {
          condLabel = 'Price falls back below Upper Band';
        } else if (condition == 'lowerBandTouch' || condition == 'priceCrossesBelowLower') {
          condLabel = 'Price crosses below Lower Band';
        } else if (condition == 'priceCrossesAboveLower') {
          condLabel = 'Price bounces back above Lower Band';
        } else if (condition == 'middleBandCrossAbove') {
          condLabel = 'Price crosses above Middle Basis';
        } else if (condition == 'middleBandCrossBelow') {
          condLabel = 'Price crosses below Middle Basis';
        } else if (condition == 'middleBandCross') {
          condLabel = 'Middle Basis Cross';
        } else if (condition == 'priceAboveUpper') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price > Upper Band (Overbought)';
        } else if (condition == 'priceBelowLower') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price < Lower Band (Oversold)';
        } else if (condition == 'priceInsideBands') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price inside Bands';
        } else if (condition == 'priceInUpperHalf') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price in Upper Channel (Bullish)';
        } else if (condition == 'priceInLowerHalf') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price in Lower Channel (Bearish)';
        } else if (condition == 'squeeze') {
          final sqz = params['squeezeThreshold'] ?? 0.015;
          condLabel = 'Volatility Squeeze (BW <= $sqz)';
        } else if (condition == 'squeezeBreakout') {
          condLabel = 'Squeeze Breakout / Volatility Expansion';
        } else if (condition == 'bandwidthExpanding') {
          condLabel = 'Bandwidth Expanding';
        } else if (condition == 'bandwidthContracting') {
          condLabel = 'Bandwidth Contracting';
        } else if (condition == 'percentBCrossesAbove80') {
          condLabel = '%B crosses above 0.80';
        } else if (condition == 'percentBCrossesBelow20') {
          condLabel = '%B crosses below 0.20';
        } else if (condition == 'percentBCrossesAboveCenter') {
          condLabel = '%B crosses above 0.50 (Center)';
        } else if (condition == 'percentBCrossesBelowCenter') {
          condLabel = '%B crosses below 0.50 (Center)';
        } else {
          condLabel = condition;
        }
        return 'BB($period, $stdDev, $maType$source) $condLabel';
      case AlertIndicatorType.stochastic:
        final k = params['kPeriod'] ?? 14;
        final kSlowing = params['kSlowing'] ?? 3;
        final d = params['dPeriod'] ?? 3;
        final dMaType = params['dMaType'] ?? 'SMA';
        final osLevel = params['oversoldLevel'] ?? 20;
        final obLevel = params['overboughtLevel'] ?? 80;

        String condLabel;
        if (condition == 'bullishCross' || condition == 'kCrossesAboveD') {
          condLabel = '%K crosses above %D';
        } else if (condition == 'bearishCross' || condition == 'kCrossesBelowD') {
          condLabel = '%K crosses below %D';
        } else if (condition == 'bullishOversoldCross') {
          condLabel = '%K crosses %D in Oversold (<$osLevel)';
        } else if (condition == 'bearishOverboughtCross') {
          condLabel = '%K crosses %D in Overbought (>$obLevel)';
        } else if (condition == 'kCrossesAboveOversold' || condition == 'crossesAbove20') {
          condLabel = '%K crosses above $osLevel (Exit OS)';
        } else if (condition == 'kCrossesBelowOversold') {
          condLabel = '%K crosses below $osLevel (Enter OS)';
        } else if (condition == 'kCrossesAboveOverbought') {
          condLabel = '%K crosses above $obLevel (Enter OB)';
        } else if (condition == 'kCrossesBelowOverbought' || condition == 'crossesBelow80') {
          condLabel = '%K crosses below $obLevel (Exit OB)';
        } else if (condition == 'kCrossesAbove50') {
          condLabel = '%K crosses above 50 (Centerline)';
        } else if (condition == 'kCrossesBelow50') {
          condLabel = '%K crosses below 50 (Centerline)';
        } else if (condition == 'centerlineCross') {
          condLabel = '%K Centerline 50 Cross';
        } else if (condition == 'kAboveD') {
          condLabel = 'State: %K > %D';
        } else if (condition == 'kBelowD') {
          condLabel = 'State: %K < %D';
        } else if (condition == 'inOversold') {
          condLabel = 'State: %K in Oversold (<$osLevel)';
        } else if (condition == 'inOverbought') {
          condLabel = 'State: %K in Overbought (>$obLevel)';
        } else if (condition == 'inNeutralBand') {
          condLabel = 'State: %K in Neutral ($osLevel-$obLevel)';
        } else if (condition == 'kTurningUp') {
          condLabel = 'Momentum: %K hooks Upward';
        } else if (condition == 'kTurningDown') {
          condLabel = 'Momentum: %K hooks Downward';
        } else if (condition == 'dTurningUp') {
          condLabel = 'Momentum: %D line hooks Upward';
        } else if (condition == 'dTurningDown') {
          condLabel = 'Momentum: %D line hooks Downward';
        } else {
          condLabel = condition;
        }
        return 'Stoch($k,$kSlowing,$d $dMaType) $condLabel';
      case AlertIndicatorType.supertrend:
        final period = params['period'] ?? 10;
        final mult = params['multiplier'] ?? 3.0;
        final source = params['source'] != null && params['source'] != 'HL2' ? ' [${params['source']}]' : '';
        final atrSmooth = params['atrSmoothing'] != null && params['atrSmoothing'] != 'RMA' ? ' ${params['atrSmoothing']}' : '';
        final dist = params['distanceThreshold'] ?? 1.0;

        String condLabel;
        if (condition == 'bullishFlip') {
          condLabel = 'Bullish Trend Flip (Buy Signal)';
        } else if (condition == 'bearishFlip') {
          condLabel = 'Bearish Trend Flip (Sell Signal)';
        } else if (condition == 'trendFlip') {
          condLabel = 'Trend Direction Reversal';
        } else if (condition == 'priceCrossesAboveTrail') {
          condLabel = 'Price crosses above Trailing Stop';
        } else if (condition == 'priceCrossesBelowTrail') {
          condLabel = 'Price crosses below Trailing Stop';
        } else if (condition == 'priceTouchesTrail') {
          condLabel = 'Price tests / touches Trailing Stop';
        } else if (condition == 'priceBouncesOffTrail') {
          condLabel = 'Price tests Trail & Bounces in Trend';
        } else if (condition == 'inBullishTrend') {
          condLabel = 'State: Active Bullish Trend (Green Trail)';
        } else if (condition == 'inBearishTrend') {
          condLabel = 'State: Active Bearish Trend (Red Trail)';
        } else if (condition == 'priceAboveTrail') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price > Trailing Stop';
        } else if (condition == 'priceBelowTrail') {
          condLabel = 'State: Price < Trailing Stop';
        } else if (condition == 'trailRising') {
          condLabel = 'Momentum: Trailing Stop Rising';
        } else if (condition == 'trailFalling') {
          condLabel = 'Momentum: Trailing Stop Falling';
        } else if (condition == 'trailFlat') {
          condLabel = 'State: Trailing Stop Flat';
        } else if (condition == 'priceDistanceGreaterThan') {
          condLabel = 'Overextended (Distance >= $dist%)';
        } else if (condition == 'priceDistanceLessThan') {
          condLabel = 'Near Trail / Low Risk (Distance <= $dist%)';
        } else {
          condLabel = condition;
        }
        return 'Supertrend($period,$mult$source$atrSmooth) $condLabel';
    }
  }
}

enum CandlestickPattern {
  bullishEngulfing('Bullish Engulfing', isBullish: true),
  bearishEngulfing('Bearish Engulfing', isBullish: false),
  hammer('Hammer', isBullish: true),
  hangingMan('Hanging Man', isBullish: false),
  shootingStar('Shooting Star', isBullish: false),
  invertedHammer('Inverted Hammer', isBullish: true),
  morningStar('Morning Star', isBullish: true),
  eveningStar('Evening Star', isBullish: false),
  doji('Standard Doji', isBullish: null),
  dragonflyDoji('Dragonfly Doji', isBullish: true),
  gravestoneDoji('Gravestone Doji', isBullish: false),
  piercingLine('Piercing Line', isBullish: true),
  darkCloudCover('Dark Cloud Cover', isBullish: false),
  threeWhiteSoldiers('Three White Soldiers', isBullish: true),
  threeBlackCrows('Three Black Crows', isBullish: false),
  bullishHarami('Bullish Harami', isBullish: true),
  bearishHarami('Bearish Harami', isBullish: false),
  tweezerBottom('Tweezer Bottom', isBullish: true),
  tweezerTop('Tweezer Top', isBullish: false),
  marubozu('Marubozu Full Body', isBullish: null);

  final String label;
  final bool? isBullish;
  const CandlestickPattern(this.label, {this.isBullish});
}

class ChainNode {
  final String id;
  final AlertType nodeType; // priceLevel, candlestickPattern, technicalIndicator
  final double targetPrice;
  final AlertCondition condition;
  final CandlestickPattern? candlestickPattern;
  final IndicatorAlertConfig? indicatorConfig;
  final String timeframe;
  final bool isNegated; // NOT modifier
  String operatorToPrevious; // 'AND' or 'OR' connecting to the previous alarm in the stage
  bool isSatisfied; // 0 or 1
  DateTime? satisfiedAt;

  ChainNode({
    required this.id,
    required this.nodeType,
    this.targetPrice = 0.0,
    this.condition = AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
    this.candlestickPattern,
    this.indicatorConfig,
    this.timeframe = '15m',
    this.isNegated = false,
    this.operatorToPrevious = 'AND',
    this.isSatisfied = false,
    this.satisfiedAt,
  });

  String get summary {
    final negPrefix = isNegated ? 'NOT ' : '';
    switch (nodeType) {
      case AlertType.priceLevel:
        return '$negPrefix Price ${condition.label.toLowerCase()} $targetPrice';
      case AlertType.candlestickPattern:
        return '$negPrefix Pattern: ${candlestickPattern?.label ?? "Pattern"} ($timeframe)';
      case AlertType.technicalIndicator:
        return '$negPrefix${indicatorConfig?.summary ?? "Indicator"} ($timeframe)';
      case AlertType.multiStepChain:
        return '$negPrefix Multi-Step';
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'nodeType': nodeType.name,
        'targetPrice': targetPrice,
        'condition': condition.name,
        'candlestickPattern': candlestickPattern?.name,
        'indicatorConfig': indicatorConfig?.toJson(),
        'timeframe': timeframe,
        'isNegated': isNegated,
        'operatorToPrevious': operatorToPrevious,
        'isSatisfied': isSatisfied,
        'satisfiedAt': satisfiedAt?.toIso8601String(),
      };

  factory ChainNode.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    AlertType type = AlertType.priceLevel;
    for (final t in AlertType.values) {
      if (t.name == json['nodeType']) {
        type = t;
        break;
      }
    }
    AlertCondition cond = AlertCondition.crossesAbove;
    for (final c in AlertCondition.values) {
      if (c.name == json['condition']) {
        cond = c;
        break;
      }
    }
    CandlestickPattern? pattern;
    if (json['candlestickPattern'] != null) {
      for (final p in CandlestickPattern.values) {
        if (p.name == json['candlestickPattern']) {
          pattern = p;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    IndicatorAlertConfig? indConfig;
    if (json['indicatorConfig'] != null) {
      try {
        indConfig = IndicatorAlertConfig.fromJson(json['indicatorConfig'] as Map<String, dynamic>);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    return ChainNode(
      id: json['id'] as String? ?? 'node_${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      nodeType: type,
      targetPrice: (json['targetPrice'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      condition: cond,
      candlestickPattern: pattern,
      indicatorConfig: indConfig,
      timeframe: json['timeframe'] as String? ?? '15m',
      isNegated: json['isNegated'] as bool? ?? false,
      operatorToPrevious: json['operatorToPrevious'] as String? ?? 'AND',
      isSatisfied: json['isSatisfied'] as bool? ?? false,
      satisfiedAt: json['satisfiedAt'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['satisfiedAt'] as String) : null,
    );
  }
}

class ChainStage {
  final String id;
  String name;
  String logicOperator; // 'AND' or 'OR'
  final List<ChainNode> nodes;
  bool isCompleted;
  DateTime? completedAt;

  ChainStage({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    this.logicOperator = 'AND',
    required this.nodes,
    this.isCompleted = false,
    this.completedAt,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'name': name,
        'logicOperator': logicOperator,
        'nodes': nodes.map((n) => n.toJson()).toList(),
        'isCompleted': isCompleted,
        'completedAt': completedAt?.toIso8601String(),
      };

  factory ChainStage.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final nodesList = <ChainNode>[];
    if (json['nodes'] != null) {
      for (final n in (json['nodes'] as List<dynamic>)) {
        nodesList.add(ChainNode.fromJson(n as Map<String, dynamic>));
      }
    }
    return ChainStage(
      id: json['id'] as String? ?? 'stage_${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      name: json['name'] as String? ?? 'Stage',
      logicOperator: json['logicOperator'] as String? ?? 'AND',
      nodes: nodesList,
      isCompleted: json['isCompleted'] as bool? ?? false,
      completedAt: json['completedAt'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['completedAt'] as String) : null,
    );
  }
}

class MultiStepConfig {
  final List<ChainStage> stages;
  int currentStageIndex;

  MultiStepConfig({
    required this.stages,
    this.currentStageIndex = 0,
  });

  ChainStage? get activeStage =>
      currentStageIndex < stages.length ? stages[currentStageIndex] : null;

  bool get isAllCompleted => currentStageIndex >= stages.length;

  void reset() {
    currentStageIndex = 0;
    for (final s in stages) {
      s.isCompleted = false;
      s.completedAt = null;
      for (final n in s.nodes) {
        n.isSatisfied = false;
        n.satisfiedAt = null;
      }
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'stages': stages.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList(),
        'currentStageIndex': currentStageIndex,
      };

  factory MultiStepConfig.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final stagesList = <ChainStage>[];
    if (json['stages'] != null) {
      for (final s in (json['stages'] as List<dynamic>)) {
        stagesList.add(ChainStage.fromJson(s as Map<String, dynamic>));
      }
    }
    return MultiStepConfig(
      stages: stagesList,
      currentStageIndex: (json['currentStageIndex'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
    );
  }
}

class PriceAlert {
  final String id;
  final String symbol;
  final AlertType alertType;
  double targetPrice;
  AlertCondition condition;
  final CandlestickPattern? candlestickPattern;
  final IndicatorAlertConfig? indicatorConfig;
  final MultiStepConfig? multiStepConfig;
  final String timeframe;
  final String note;
  bool isActive;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  DateTime? triggeredAt;
  final double initialPrice;
  final String ringtoneTitle;
  final String? ringtoneUri;
  String? drawingId;

  PriceAlert({
    required this.id,
    required this.symbol,
    this.alertType = AlertType.priceLevel,
    this.targetPrice = 0.0,
    this.condition = AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
    this.candlestickPattern,
    this.indicatorConfig,
    this.multiStepConfig,
    this.timeframe = '15m',
    this.note = '',
    this.isActive = true,
    required this.createdAt,
    this.triggeredAt,
    required this.initialPrice,
    this.ringtoneTitle = 'Default Alarm',
    this.ringtoneUri,
    this.drawingId,
  });

  bool get isPatternAlert => alertType == AlertType.candlestickPattern;
  bool get isIndicatorAlert => alertType == AlertType.technicalIndicator;
  bool get isMultiStepAlert => alertType == AlertType.multiStepChain && multiStepConfig != null;
  bool get isDrawingAlert => drawingId != null && drawingId!.isNotEmpty;

  bool checkTrigger(double currentPrice) {
    if (!isActive || isPatternAlert || isIndicatorAlert || isMultiStepAlert) return false;
    switch (condition) {
      case AlertCondition.crossesAbove:
        return currentPrice >= targetPrice;
      case AlertCondition.crossesBelow:
        return currentPrice <= targetPrice;
      case AlertCondition.hits:
        return (currentPrice - targetPrice).abs() <= (targetPrice * 0.0002);
    }
  }

  double pipDistance(double currentPrice) {
    if (isPatternAlert || isIndicatorAlert || isMultiStepAlert) return 0.0;
    final diff = targetPrice - currentPrice;
    final double multiplier;
    if (symbol.contains('JPY')) {
      multiplier = 100.0;
    } else if (symbol.contains('XAU')) {
      multiplier = 10.0;
    } else if (symbol.contains('BTC') || symbol.contains('ETH')) {
      multiplier = 1.0;
    } else {
      multiplier = 10000.0;
    }
    return diff * multiplier;
  }

  String formattedTarget() {
    if (isMultiStepAlert) {
      final cfg = multiStepConfig!;
      final active = cfg.activeStage;
      final cur = cfg.currentStageIndex + 1;
      final total = cfg.stages.length;
      return 'Stage $cur/$total: ${active?.name ?? "Complete"}';
    }
    if (isPatternAlert) {
      return candlestickPattern?.label ?? 'Pattern';
    }
    if (isIndicatorAlert) {
      return indicatorConfig?.summary ?? 'Indicator Alert';
    }
    final format = symbol.contains('JPY')
        ? NumberFormat('#,##0.000')
        : symbol.contains('BTC') || symbol.contains('XAU')
            ? NumberFormat('#,##0.00')
            : NumberFormat('0.00000');
    return format.format(targetPrice);
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'symbol': symbol,
      'alertType': alertType.name,
      'targetPrice': targetPrice,
      'condition': condition.name,
      'candlestickPattern': candlestickPattern?.name,
      'indicatorConfig': indicatorConfig?.toJson(),
      'multiStepConfig': multiStepConfig?.toJson(),
      'timeframe': timeframe,
      'note': note,
      'isActive': isActive,
      'createdAt': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
      'triggeredAt': triggeredAt?.toIso8601String(),
      'initialPrice': initialPrice,
      'ringtoneTitle': ringtoneTitle,
      'ringtoneUri': ringtoneUri,
      'drawingId': drawingId,
    };
  }

  factory PriceAlert.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    AlertType type = AlertType.priceLevel;
    if (json['alertType'] == 'candlestickPattern') {
      type = AlertType.candlestickPattern;
    } else if (json['alertType'] == 'technicalIndicator') {
      type = AlertType.technicalIndicator;
    } else if (json['alertType'] == 'multiStepChain') {
      type = AlertType.multiStepChain;
    }

    AlertCondition cond = AlertCondition.crossesAbove;
    for (final c in AlertCondition.values) {
      if (c.name == json['condition']) {
        cond = c;
        break;
      }
    }

    CandlestickPattern? pattern;
    if (json['candlestickPattern'] != null) {
      for (final p in CandlestickPattern.values) {
        if (p.name == json['candlestickPattern']) {
          pattern = p;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    IndicatorAlertConfig? indicatorConfig;
    if (json['indicatorConfig'] != null) {
      try {
        indicatorConfig = IndicatorAlertConfig.fromJson(json['indicatorConfig'] as Map<String, dynamic>);
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    MultiStepConfig? multiStepConfig;
    if (json['multiStepConfig'] != null) {
      try {
        multiStepConfig = MultiStepConfig.fromJson(json['multiStepConfig'] as Map<String, dynamic>);
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    return PriceAlert(
      id: json['id'] as String? ?? 'alert_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
      symbol: json['symbol'] as String? ?? 'EURUSD',
      alertType: type,
      targetPrice: (json['targetPrice'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      condition: cond,
      candlestickPattern: pattern,
      indicatorConfig: indicatorConfig,
      multiStepConfig: multiStepConfig,
      timeframe: json['timeframe'] as String? ?? '15m',
      note: json['note'] as String? ?? '',
      isActive: json['isActive'] as bool? ?? true,
      createdAt: DateTime.tryParse(json['createdAt'] as String? ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
      triggeredAt: json['triggeredAt'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['triggeredAt'] as String) : null,
      initialPrice: (json['initialPrice'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      ringtoneTitle: json['ringtoneTitle'] as String? ?? 'Default Alarm',
      ringtoneUri: json['ringtoneUri'] as String?,
      drawingId: json['drawingId'] as String?,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AlertsListSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final AlertManager alertManager;
  final Map<String, BiquoteTick> latestTicks;

  const AlertsListSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.alertManager,
    required this.latestTicks,
  });

  @override
  State<AlertsListSheet> createState() => _AlertsListSheetState();
}

class _AlertsListSheetState extends State<AlertsListSheet> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.alertManager.addListener(_onAlertsChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.alertManager.removeListener(_onAlertsChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onAlertsChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final alertManager = widget.alertManager;

    return DefaultTabController(

      child: Container(

        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),

          color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
          borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // Handle bar

              width: 44,
              height: 4,
