  Widget _buildActiveAlertsList(BuildContext context, AlertManager alertManager) {
    final alerts = alertManager.alerts;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final latestTicks = widget.latestTicks;

    if (alerts.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.notifications_none, size: 48, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text('No alerts set', style: AppTheme.sans(color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    return ListView.separated(
      itemCount: alerts.length,
      separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(height: 10),
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final alert = alerts[index];
        final tick = latestTicks[alert.symbol];
        final currentPrice = tick?.mid ?? alert.initialPrice;
        final pipDist = alert.pipDistance(currentPrice);
        
        final Color badgeColor;
        if (alert.isMultiStepAlert) {
          badgeColor = Colors.amber;
        } else if (alert.isPatternAlert) {
          final isBull = alert.candlestickPattern?.isBullish;
          if (isBull == true) {
            badgeColor = isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish;
          } else if (isBull == false) {
            badgeColor = isDark ? AppTheme.darkBearish : AppTheme.lightBearish;
          } else {
            badgeColor = Colors.amber;
          }
        } else if (alert.isIndicatorAlert) {
          badgeColor = theme.colorScheme.primary;
        } else {
          final isBullish = alert.condition == AlertCondition.crossesAbove;
          badgeColor = isBullish
              ? (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish)
              : (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBearish : AppTheme.lightBearish);
        }

        final displayPair = alert.symbol.length == 6
            ? '${alert.symbol.substring(0, 3)}/${alert.symbol.substring(3)}'
            : alert.symbol;

        return Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : AppTheme.lightSurface2,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            border: Border.all(
              color: alert.isActive
                  ? badgeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
                  : theme.dividerColor,
            ),
          ),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Row(
            children: [
              // Left: Symbol & Condition / Pattern / Indicator
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          displayPair,
                          style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: badgeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                          ),
                          child: Text(
                            alert.isMultiStepAlert
                                ? '🔗 LOGIC CHAIN • LEVEL ${alert.multiStepConfig!.currentStageIndex + 1}/${alert.multiStepConfig!.stages.length}'
                                : alert.isPatternAlert
                                    ? 'PATTERN • ${alert.timeframe.toUpperCase()}'
                                    : alert.isIndicatorAlert
                                        ? '${alert.indicatorConfig?.indicatorType.label.toUpperCase() ?? "INDICATOR"} • ${alert.timeframe.toUpperCase()}'
                                        : alert.isDrawingAlert
                                            ? '🎯 LINE • ${alert.condition.label.toUpperCase()}'
                                            : alert.condition.label.toUpperCase(),
                            style: AppTheme.sans(
                              fontSize: 9,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: badgeColor,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Wrap(
                      spacing: 8,
                      crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        if (alert.isMultiStepAlert) ...[
                          Text(
                            alert.note.isNotEmpty ? alert.note : 'Multi-Step Strategy Chain',
                            style: AppTheme.sans(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: Colors.amber,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ] else if (alert.isPatternAlert) ...[
                          Text(
                            alert.candlestickPattern?.label ?? 'Pattern',
                            style: AppTheme.sans(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: badgeColor,
                            ),
                          ),
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 1),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: theme.dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              alert.timeframe.toUpperCase(),
                              style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ] else if (alert.isIndicatorAlert) ...[
                          Text(
                            alert.indicatorConfig?.summary ?? 'Indicator Alert',
                            style: AppTheme.sans(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                            ),
                          ),
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 1),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: theme.dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              alert.timeframe.toUpperCase(),
                              style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ] else ...[
                          Text(

                            style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),

                            style: AppTheme.mono(

  Widget _buildLogicChainProgress(
    BuildContext context,
    PriceAlert alert,
    ThemeData theme,
    bool isDark,
    AlertManager alertManager,
  ) {
    final config = alert.multiStepConfig;
    if (config == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text(
                'LOGIC CHAIN PIPELINE',
                style: AppTheme.sans(
                  fontSize: 10,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: Colors.amber,
                  letterSpacing: 0.6,
                ),
              ),
              TextButton.icon(
                style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                  minimumSize: Size.zero,
                  tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                ),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh, size: 12, color: Colors.amber),
                label: Text(
                  'Reset Chain',
                  style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.amber),
                ),
                onPressed: () => alertManager.resetMultiStepAlert(alert.id),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          // Vertical Tree / Stages List
          ...config.stages.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
            final idx = entry.key;
            final stage = entry.value;
            final isCompleted = stage.isCompleted;
            final isActive = idx == config.currentStageIndex && !config.isAllCompleted;

            final statusColor = isCompleted
                ? (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish)
                : isActive
                    ? Colors.amber
                    : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.5);

            return Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 3),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                          color: statusColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                          border: Border.all(color: statusColor, width: 1.5),
                        ),
                        child: Icon(
                          isCompleted
                              ? Icons.check
                              : isActive
                                  ? Icons.play_arrow
                                  : Icons.lock_outline,
                          size: 10,
                          color: statusColor,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Text(
                        'Level ${idx + 1}: ${stage.name}',
                        style: AppTheme.sans(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                          color: isActive ? theme.colorScheme.onSurface : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 1),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: statusColor.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          isCompleted
                              ? 'COMPLETED [1]'
                              : isActive
                                  ? 'RUNNING'
                                  : 'LOCKED',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 9,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: statusColor,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  // If active or completed, show sub-alarms in this stage
                  if (isActive || isCompleted)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 20, top: 4),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: stage.nodes.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                          final nodeIdx = entry.key;
                          final n = entry.value;
                          final isSat = n.isSatisfied;
                          final nodeColor = isSat
                              ? (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish)
                              : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant;
                          return Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
                            child: Row(
                              children: [
                                if (nodeIdx > 0)
                                  Container(
                                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 4),
                                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 3, vertical: 0.5),
                                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                      color: Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                                    ),
                                    child: Text(
                                      n.operatorToPrevious,
                                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 8, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: Colors.amber),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                Text('• ', style: TextStyle(color: nodeColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                                Expanded(
                                  child: Text(
                                    n.summary,
                                    style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 10, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 1),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: nodeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3),
                                  ),
                                  child: Text(
                                    isSat ? '[ 1 ]' : '[ 0 ]',
                                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: nodeColor),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          );
                        }).toList(),
                      ),
                    ),
                  if (idx < config.stages.length - 1)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8),
                      child: SizedBox(
                        height: 10,
                        child: VerticalDivider(
                          color: isCompleted ? (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish) : theme.dividerColor,
                          thickness: 1,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTriggeredList(BuildContext context, AlertManager alertManager) {
    final history = alertManager.history;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;

    if (history.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline, size: 48, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text('No alerts triggered yet', style: AppTheme.sans(color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    return ListView.separated(
      itemCount: history.length,
      separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(height: 10),
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final alert = history[index];
        final displayPair = alert.symbol.length == 6
            ? '${alert.symbol.substring(0, 3)}/${alert.symbol.substring(3)}'
            : alert.symbol;

        return Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : AppTheme.lightSurface2,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        alert.isPatternAlert
                            ? Icons.candlestick_chart
                            : alert.isIndicatorAlert
                                ? Icons.analytics_outlined
                                : Icons.notifications_active,
                        size: 16,
                        color: Colors.amber,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Text(displayPair, style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Text(
                        alert.isPatternAlert
                            ? '${alert.candlestickPattern?.label ?? "Pattern"} (${alert.timeframe.toUpperCase()})'
                            : alert.isIndicatorAlert
                                ? '${alert.indicatorConfig?.indicatorType.label ?? "Indicator"} (${alert.timeframe.toUpperCase()})'
                                : alert.condition.label,
                        style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                  Text(
                    alert.isPatternAlert
                        ? 'Confirmed on ${alert.timeframe.toUpperCase()} candle'
                        : alert.isIndicatorAlert
                            ? alert.indicatorConfig?.summary ?? 'Indicator Confirmed'
                            : 'Target: ${alert.formattedTarget()}',
                    style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 12),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              Row(
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'TRIGGERED',
                    style: AppTheme.sans(
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: Colors.amber,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 20),
                    color: theme.colorScheme.error,
                    onPressed: () => alertManager.deleteAlert(alert.id),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_markdown/flutter_markdown.dart';
import '../models/ai_models.dart';
import '../models/market_models.dart';
import '../services/alert_manager.dart';
import '../services/analysis_orchestrator.dart';
import '../services/biquote_service.dart';
import '../services/strategy_storage.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'create_alert_sheet.dart';
import 'settings_screen.dart';

class AnalysisScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final TradingStrategy strategy;
  final String initialSymbol;
  final String initialTimeframe;
  final VoidCallback? onNavigateToChart;
  final ValueChanged<AgentSignal>? onSelectSignalForChart;
  final BiquoteService? biquoteService;
  final AlertManager? alertManager;

  const AnalysisScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.strategy,
    this.initialSymbol = 'EURUSD',
    this.initialTimeframe = '1H',
    this.onNavigateToChart,
    this.onSelectSignalForChart,
    this.biquoteService,
    this.alertManager,
  });

  @override
  State<AnalysisScreen> createState() => _AnalysisScreenState();
}

class _AnalysisScreenState extends State<AnalysisScreen> {
  final StrategyStorage _storage = StrategyStorage();
  late AnalysisOrchestrator _orchestrator;

  late TradingStrategy _selectedStrategy;
  late String _selectedSymbol;
  late List<String> _selectedTimeframes;
  List<TradingStrategy> _allStrategies = [];

  bool _isRunning = false;
  AnalysisProgress? _currentProgress;
  PipelineRunResult? _result;
  String? _errorMessage;
  StreamSubscription<AnalysisProgress>? _progressSub;

  final List<String> _popularSymbols = [
    'EURUSD',
    'GBPUSD',
    'USDJPY',
    'XAUUSD',
    'BTCUSD',
    'ETHUSD',
    'AUDUSD',
    'USDCAD',
    'USDCHF',
    'NZDUSD',
  ];

  final List<String> _timeframes = ['1M', '5M', '15M', '30M', '1H', '4H', '1D'];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedStrategy = widget.strategy;
    _selectedSymbol = widget.initialSymbol;
    _selectedTimeframes = [widget.initialTimeframe];
    _orchestrator = AnalysisOrchestrator(biquoteFallback: widget.biquoteService);

    _progressSub = _orchestrator.progressStream.listen((prog) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _currentProgress = prog;
        });
      }
    });

    _loadStrategies();
  }

  Future<void> _loadStrategies() async {
    final list = await _storage.getStrategies();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _allStrategies = list;
        if (!_allStrategies.any((s) => s.id == _selectedStrategy.id) &&
            _allStrategies.isNotEmpty) {
          _selectedStrategy = _allStrategies.first;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _progressSub?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _startAnalysis() async {
    setState(() {
      _isRunning = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
      _result = null;
    });

    try {
      final res = await _orchestrator.runPipeline(
        strategy: _selectedStrategy,
        symbol: _selectedSymbol,
        timeframes: _selectedTimeframes,
      );

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _result = res;
          _isRunning = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isRunning = false;
          _errorMessage = e.toString().replaceFirst('Exception: ', '');
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _applySignalToChart(AgentSignal signal) async {
    // Save to storage for persistence and forward directly to active chart
    await _storage.saveLastChartSignal(signal);
    widget.onSelectSignalForChart?.call(signal);
    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.of(context).popUntil((route) => route.isFirst);
    widget.onNavigateToChart?.call();
    
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      const SnackBar(
        content: Text('Signal overlaid on Chart!'),
        backgroundColor: AppColors.bullishGreen,
        duration: Duration(seconds: 2),
      ),
    );
  }

  int _getPrecision(String symbol) {
    if (symbol.contains('JPY')) return 3;
    if (symbol.contains('BTC') || symbol.contains('ETH') || symbol.contains('XAU')) return 2;
    return 5;
  }

  void _quickSetEntryAlert(AgentSignal signal) {
    if (signal.entryPrice <= 0) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Cannot set alert: No entry price specified in signal.'),
          backgroundColor: AppColors.bearishRed,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final isBuy = signal.direction == SignalDirection.buy;
    final cond = isBuy ? AlertCondition.crossesAbove : AlertCondition.crossesBelow;

    if (widget.alertManager != null) {
      widget.alertManager!.addAlert(
        symbol: _selectedSymbol,
        alertType: AlertType.priceLevel,
        targetPrice: signal.entryPrice,
        condition: cond,
        timeframe: _selectedTimeframes.isNotEmpty ? _selectedTimeframes.first : '15m',
        note: '[AI ${signal.agentName}] ${signal.direction.label.toUpperCase()} Entry Trigger',
        currentPrice: signal.entryPrice,
      );

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Entry Alert created for $_selectedSymbol @ ${signal.entryPrice.toStringAsFixed(_getPrecision(_selectedSymbol))}!'),
          backgroundColor: AppColors.bullishGreen,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
          action: SnackBarAction(
            label: 'VIEW ON CHART',
            textColor: Colors.white,
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.of(context).popUntil((r) => r.isFirst);
              widget.onNavigateToChart?.call();
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
    } else {
      _openCustomAlertSheet(signal, initialType: AlertType.priceLevel);
    }
  }

  void _quickSetPriceAlert(String label, double price, SignalDirection direction) {
    if (price <= 0) return;
    final isBuy = direction == SignalDirection.buy;
    final cond = (label.contains('STOP') ? !isBuy : isBuy)
        ? AlertCondition.crossesAbove
        : AlertCondition.crossesBelow;

    if (widget.alertManager != null) {
      widget.alertManager!.addAlert(
        symbol: _selectedSymbol,
        alertType: AlertType.priceLevel,
        targetPrice: price,
        condition: cond,
        timeframe: _selectedTimeframes.isNotEmpty ? _selectedTimeframes.first : '15m',
        note: '[AI Setup] $label @ ${price.toStringAsFixed(_getPrecision(_selectedSymbol))}',
        currentPrice: price,
      );

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('$label alert set for $_selectedSymbol @ ${price.toStringAsFixed(_getPrecision(_selectedSymbol))}!'),
          backgroundColor: AppColors.bullishGreen,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  void _openCustomAlertSheet(AgentSignal signal, {AlertType initialType = AlertType.multiStepChain}) {
    final isBuy = signal.direction == SignalDirection.buy;
    final entryCond = isBuy ? AlertCondition.crossesAbove : AlertCondition.crossesBelow;
    final tpCond = isBuy ? AlertCondition.crossesAbove : AlertCondition.crossesBelow;
    final slCond = isBuy ? AlertCondition.crossesBelow : AlertCondition.crossesAbove;

    final entryPrice = signal.entryPrice > 0 ? signal.entryPrice : 1.0;
    final tpPrice = signal.takeProfit > 0 ? signal.takeProfit : (entryPrice * (isBuy ? 1.01 : 0.99));
    final slPrice = signal.stopLoss > 0 ? signal.stopLoss : (entryPrice * (isBuy ? 0.99 : 1.01));

    final List<ChainStage> stages = [
      ChainStage(
        id: 'stage_entry',
        name: 'AI Setup: Entry Confirmation (Level 1)',
        logicOperator: 'AND',
        nodes: [
          ChainNode(
            id: 'n_entry',
            nodeType: AlertType.priceLevel,
            targetPrice: entryPrice,
            condition: entryCond,
            operatorToPrevious: 'AND',
          ),
        ],
      ),
      ChainStage(
        id: 'stage_exit',
        name: 'Target TP or SL (Level 2)',
        logicOperator: 'OR',
        nodes: [
          ChainNode(
            id: 'n_tp',
            nodeType: AlertType.priceLevel,
            targetPrice: tpPrice,
            condition: tpCond,
            operatorToPrevious: 'AND',
          ),
          ChainNode(
            id: 'n_sl',
            nodeType: AlertType.priceLevel,
            targetPrice: slPrice,
            condition: slCond,
            operatorToPrevious: 'OR',
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ];

    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => CreateAlertSheet(
        symbol: _selectedSymbol,
        currentPrice: entryPrice,
        precision: _getPrecision(_selectedSymbol),
        initialTargetPrice: entryPrice,
        initialAlertType: initialType,
        initialCondition: entryCond,
        initialNote: '[AI ${signal.agentName}] ${signal.direction.label.toUpperCase()} Strategy Setup',
        initialChainStages: stages,
        onAlertCreated: ({
          required String symbol,
          AlertType alertType = AlertType.priceLevel,
          double targetPrice = 0.0,
          AlertCondition condition = AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
          CandlestickPattern? candlestickPattern,
          IndicatorAlertConfig? indicatorConfig,
          MultiStepConfig? multiStepConfig,
          String timeframe = '15m',
          String note = '',
          String ringtoneTitle = 'Default Alarm',
          String? ringtoneUri,
          String? drawingId,
        }) {
          widget.alertManager?.addAlert(
            symbol: symbol,
            alertType: alertType,
            targetPrice: targetPrice,
            condition: condition,
            candlestickPattern: candlestickPattern,
            indicatorConfig: indicatorConfig,
            multiStepConfig: multiStepConfig,
            timeframe: timeframe,
            note: note,
            currentPrice: entryPrice,
            ringtoneTitle: ringtoneTitle,
            ringtoneUri: ringtoneUri,
            drawingId: drawingId,
          );

          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text('Logic Chain Alert created for $symbol!'),
              backgroundColor: AppColors.bullishGreen,
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: isDark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('AI Market Analysis'),
        centerTitle: true,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.settings_outlined),
            tooltip: 'LLM & API Settings',
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.push(
                context,
                MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const SettingsScreen()),
              );
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // Controls Card: Symbol, Timeframe, Strategy selector
            _buildControlsCard(isDark),

            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Prominent Run Button
            ElevatedButton.icon(
              onPressed: _isRunning ? null : _startAnalysis,
              icon: _isRunning
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 18,
                      height: 18,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white),
                    )
                  : const Icon(Icons.flash_on),
              label: Text(
                _isRunning
                    ? 'Running ${_selectedStrategy.name}...'
                    : 'Run Multi-Agent Analysis (100 Candles)',
                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 15),
              ),
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: AppColors.accentBlue,
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(50),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
              ),
            ),

            if (_isRunning && _currentProgress != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              _buildLiveProgressCard(isDark),
            ],

            if (_errorMessage != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              _buildErrorCard(isDark),
            ],

            if (_result != null && !_isRunning) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              _buildFinalSignalCard(_result!.finalSignal, isDark),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              _buildDeliberationDetails(_result!, isDark),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildControlsCard(bool isDark) {
    return Card(
      elevation: 0,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        side: BorderSide(color: isDark ? AppColors.darkDivider : AppColors.lightDivider),
      ),
      color: isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // Strategy Dropdown
            Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.psychology, color: AppColors.accentBlue, size: 20),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                const Text('Active Strategy: ', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                Expanded(
                  child: DropdownButtonHideUnderline(
                    child: DropdownButton<TradingStrategy>(
                      value: _allStrategies.any((s) => s.id == _selectedStrategy.id)
                          ? _selectedStrategy
                          : (_allStrategies.isNotEmpty ? _allStrategies.first : null),
                      isExpanded: true,
                      items: _allStrategies.map((s) {
                        return DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: s,
                          child: Text(
                            '${s.name} (${s.specialists.length} spec)',
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13),
                          ),
                        );
                      }).toList(),
                      onChanged: _isRunning
                          ? null
                          : (newStrat) {
                              if (newStrat != null) {
                                setState(() => _selectedStrategy = newStrat);
                              }
                            },
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const Divider(height: 16),

            // Instrument and Timeframe Selectors
            Row(
              children: [
                // Symbol Dropdown
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      const Text('Instrument', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey)),
                      DropdownButtonHideUnderline(
                        child: DropdownButton<String>(
                          value: _popularSymbols.contains(_selectedSymbol)
                              ? _selectedSymbol
                              : _popularSymbols.first,
                          isExpanded: true,
                          items: _popularSymbols.map((s) {
                            return DropdownMenuItem(value: s, child: Text(s));
                          }).toList(),
                          onChanged: _isRunning
                              ? null
                              : (v) {
                                  if (v != null) setState(() => _selectedSymbol = v);
                                },
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 16),

                // Timeframe Multi-Select
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      const Text('Timeframes', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Wrap(
                        spacing: 6,
                        runSpacing: 6,
                        children: _timeframes.map((tf) {
                          final isSelected = _selectedTimeframes.contains(tf);
                          return FilterChip(
                            label: Text(tf, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                            selected: isSelected,
                            onSelected: _isRunning
                                ? null
                                : (selected) {
                                    setState(() {
                                      if (selected) {
                                        _selectedTimeframes.add(tf);
                                      } else {
                                        if (_selectedTimeframes.length > 1) {
                                          _selectedTimeframes.remove(tf);
                                        }
                                      }
                                    });
                                  },
                            selectedColor: AppColors.accentBlue.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                            checkmarkColor: AppColors.accentBlue,
                            padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                          );
                        }).toList(),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLiveProgressCard(bool isDark) {
    final prog = _currentProgress!;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    
    return Card(
      elevation: 0,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        side: BorderSide(color: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
      ),
      color: theme.colorScheme.surface,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'Pipeline Execution',
                    style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface),
                  ),
                ),
                Text(
                  '${(prog.progressFraction * 100).toInt()}%',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: theme.colorScheme.primary),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            LinearProgressIndicator(
              value: prog.progressFraction,
              backgroundColor: theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
              valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(theme.colorScheme.primary),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              prog.message,
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
            ),
            if (prog.activeAgents != null && prog.activeAgents!.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Wrap(
                spacing: 8,
                runSpacing: 8,
                children: prog.activeAgents!.map((agentName) {
                  return Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      border: Border.all(color: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        SizedBox(
                          width: 12,
                          height: 12,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 1.5, color: theme.colorScheme.primary),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        Text(
                          agentName,
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: theme.colorScheme.primary),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  );
                }).toList(),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildErrorCard(bool isDark) {
    return Card(
      elevation: 0,
      color: AppColors.bearishRed.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        side: BorderSide(color: AppColors.bearishRed.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            const Icon(Icons.error_outline, color: AppColors.bearishRed, size: 28),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Text(
                    'Analysis Pipeline Error',
                    style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: AppColors.bearishRed),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(_errorMessage!, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () {
                      Navigator.push(
                        context,
                        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const SettingsScreen()),
                      );
                    },
                    child: const Text(
                      'Check LLM / RealMarket API Settings ➔',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: AppColors.accentBlue,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFinalSignalCard(AgentSignal signal, bool isDark) {
    final Color dirColor;
    final IconData dirIcon;
    switch (signal.direction) {
      case SignalDirection.buy:
        dirColor = AppColors.bullishGreen;
        dirIcon = Icons.arrow_upward;
        break;
      case SignalDirection.sell:
        dirColor = AppColors.bearishRed;
        dirIcon = Icons.arrow_downward;
        break;
      case SignalDirection.wait:
        dirColor = Colors.amber;
        dirIcon = Icons.pause_circle_outline;
        break;
    }

    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        side: BorderSide(color: dirColor.withValues(alpha: 0.6), width: 1.5),
      ),
      color: isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // Top: Origin Agent and Direction Badge
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    const Icon(Icons.verified, size: 16, color: AppColors.accentBlue),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Text(
                      signal.agentName,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, fontSize: 13),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: dirColor.withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                    border: Border.all(color: dirColor),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Icon(dirIcon, color: dirColor, size: 16),
                      const SizedBox(width: 4),
                      Text(
                        signal.direction.label,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: dirColor,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          fontSize: 14,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),

            // Confidence Bar
            Row(
              children: [
                const Text('Confidence Conviction: ', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey)),
                Text(
                  '${signal.confidence} / 10',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 13),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                    child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                      value: signal.confidence / 10.0,
                      backgroundColor: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                      valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(dirColor),
                      minHeight: 6,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const Divider(height: 24),

            // Price Levels Grid: Entry, SL, TP (Interactive: tap to alert)
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
              children: [
                _buildPriceColumn('ENTRY PRICE', signal.entryPrice, AppColors.bullishGreen, signal),
                _buildPriceColumn('STOP LOSS', signal.stopLoss, AppColors.bearishRed, signal),
                _buildPriceColumn('TAKE PROFIT', signal.takeProfit, AppColors.accentBlue, signal),
              ],
            ),

            if (signal.riskRewardRatio > 0) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    'Risk/Reward Ratio: 1 : ${signal.riskRewardRatio.toStringAsFixed(2)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],

            const SizedBox(height: 18),

            // Action 1: Overlay on Chart
            ElevatedButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => _applySignalToChart(signal),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.layers, size: 18),
              label: const Text('Overlay Entry / SL / TP on Chart'),
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: dirColor,
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(44),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),

            // Actions 2 & 3: Direct Alert Creation
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => _quickSetEntryAlert(signal),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.alarm_add, size: 16),
                    label: const Text('Set Entry Alert', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: AppColors.bullishGreen,
                      side: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.bullishGreen),
                      minimumSize: const Size(0, 42),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => _openCustomAlertSheet(signal, initialType: AlertType.multiStepChain),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.account_tree_outlined, size: 16),
                    label: const Text('Build Logic Chain', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: AppColors.accentBlue,
                      side: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.accentBlue),
                      minimumSize: const Size(0, 42),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPriceColumn(String label, double price, Color color, AgentSignal signal) {
    final formattedPrice = price > 0 ? price.toStringAsFixed(_getPrecision(_selectedSymbol)) : 'N/A';
    return Tooltip(
      message: price > 0 ? 'Tap to set alert at $formattedPrice' : '',
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: price > 0 ? () => _quickSetPriceAlert(label, price, signal.direction) : null,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
          child: Column(
            children: [
              Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: Colors.grey, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                  if (price > 0) ...[
                    const SizedBox(width: 3),
                    Icon(Icons.alarm_add, size: 11, color: color),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(
                formattedPrice,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 15,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: price > 0 ? color : Colors.grey,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDeliberationDetails(PipelineRunResult res, bool isDark) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        // Market Analysis Expansion
        Card(
          elevation: 0,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            side: BorderSide(color: isDark ? AppColors.darkDivider : AppColors.lightDivider),
          ),
          color: isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
          child: ExpansionTile(
            initiallyExpanded: true,
            leading: const Icon(Icons.analytics_outlined, color: AppColors.accentBlue),
            title: const Text('Market Structure Analysis', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
            children: [
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                child: MarkdownBody(
                  data: res.finalSignal.analysis.isNotEmpty
                      ? res.finalSignal.analysis
                      : 'No detailed text analysis provided.',
                  selectable: true,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),

        // Prediction Theory Expansion
        if (res.finalSignal.theory.isNotEmpty) ...[
          Card(
            elevation: 0,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              side: BorderSide(color: isDark ? AppColors.darkDivider : AppColors.lightDivider),
            ),
            color: isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
            child: ExpansionTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.lightbulb_outline, color: Colors.amber),
              title: const Text('Prediction Theory & Logic', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
              children: [
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                  child: MarkdownBody(
                    data: res.finalSignal.theory,
                    selectable: true,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
        ],

        // Grounding Critic Audit Report
        if (res.groundingCritique.isNotEmpty) ...[
          Card(
            elevation: 0,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              side: BorderSide(color: isDark ? AppColors.darkDivider : AppColors.lightDivider),
            ),
            color: isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
            child: ExpansionTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.gavel_outlined, color: Colors.purpleAccent),
              title: const Text('Grounding Critic Audit Report', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
              subtitle: const Text('Verified against 100 RealMarket candles', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey)),
              children: [
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                  child: MarkdownBody(
                    data: res.groundingCritique,
                    selectable: true,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
        ],

        // Individual Specialist Deliberations
        if (res.refinedSpecialistSignals.length > 1) ...[
          Card(
            elevation: 0,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              side: BorderSide(color: isDark ? AppColors.darkDivider : AppColors.lightDivider),
            ),
            color: isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
            child: ExpansionTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.people_outline, color: Colors.teal),
              title: const Text('Individual Specialist Signals', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
              subtitle: Text('${res.refinedSpecialistSignals.length} specialist agents evaluated', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey)),
              children: res.refinedSpecialistSignals.map((sig) {
                return ListTile(
                  title: Text(sig.agentName, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 13)),
                  subtitle: Text('Entry: ${sig.entryPrice} | SL: ${sig.stopLoss} | TP: ${sig.takeProfit}'),
                  trailing: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: sig.direction == SignalDirection.buy
                          ? AppColors.bullishGreen.withValues(alpha: 0.2)
                          : (sig.direction == SignalDirection.sell
                              ? AppColors.bearishRed.withValues(alpha: 0.2)
                              : Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.2)),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      sig.direction.label,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: sig.direction == SignalDirection.buy
                            ? AppColors.bullishGreen
                            : (sig.direction == SignalDirection.sell
                                ? AppColors.bearishRed
                                : Colors.grey),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}


------------------------------------------------------------

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../models/drawing_models.dart';
import '../models/market_models.dart';
import '../services/alert_manager.dart';
import '../services/biquote_service.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../widgets/candlestick_chart.dart';
import '../widgets/rate_display.dart';
import '../widgets/ticker_tape_bar.dart';
import '../widgets/timeframe_selector.dart';
import '../widgets/watchlist_card.dart';
import 'alerts_list_sheet.dart';
import 'create_alert_sheet.dart';
import 'fullscreen_chart_screen.dart';
import 'instrument_search_sheet.dart';
import '../services/favorites_service.dart';
import '../models/ai_models.dart';
import '../services/strategy_storage.dart';
import 'strategies_screen.dart';

class ChartScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final BiquoteService biquoteService;
  final AlertManager alertManager;
  final VoidCallback onToggleTheme;
  final bool isDark;

  const ChartScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.biquoteService,
    required this.alertManager,
    required this.onToggleTheme,
    required this.isDark,
  });

  @override
  State<ChartScreen> createState() => _ChartScreenState();
}

class _ChartScreenState extends State<ChartScreen> {
  final FavoritesService _favService = FavoritesService();
  final StrategyStorage _storage = StrategyStorage();
  List<String> get _symbols => _favService.favorites;
  String _selectedSymbol = 'EURUSD';
  String _selectedTimeframe = '1H';

  Map<String, BiquoteTick> _ticks = {};
  List<BiquoteCandle> _candles = [];
  bool _isLoadingCandles = false;
  StreamSubscription<BiquoteTick>? _tickSubscription;
  Timer? _slowSyncTimer;
  bool _isDndGranted = false;
  bool _isLoadingHistory = false;
  bool _hasReachedHistoryEnd = false;
  AgentSignal? _activeSignalOverlay;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _storage.getLastChartSignal().then((sig) {
      if (mounted && sig != null) {
        setState(() => _activeSignalOverlay = sig);
      }
    });
    _favService.addListener(_onFavoritesChanged);
    _favService.init().then((_) {
      if (mounted) {
        _syncSubscriptions();
        _refreshQuotes();
      }
    });

    _loadInitialData();
    _checkDndStatus();

    // Listen to network connectivity & Biquote server status
    widget.biquoteService.isOnlineNotifier.addListener(_onNetworkStatusChanged);

    // Hook up alarm trigger callback to show loud ringing alert dialog
    widget.alertManager.onAlertTriggered = _showAlarmDialog;

    // Listen to alert changes so SignalR WebSocket subscribes to newly added/modified alert symbols
    widget.alertManager.addListener(_onAlertsChanged);

    // Connect to unmetered SignalR WebSocket for instant real-time ticks
    widget.biquoteService.initSignalR(_getMonitoredSymbols());
    _tickSubscription = widget.biquoteService.tickStream.listen(_onTickReceived);

    // Infrequent slow sync (every 30s) to keep watchlist daily changes up to date
    _slowSyncTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 30), (_) => _refreshQuotes());
  }

  List<String> _getMonitoredSymbols() {
    final activeAlertSymbols = widget.alertManager.activeAlerts.map((a) => a.symbol);
    final set = <String>{..._favService.favorites, _selectedSymbol, ...activeAlertSymbols};
    return set.toList();
  }

  void _syncSubscriptions() {
    widget.biquoteService.subscribe(_getMonitoredSymbols());
  }

  void _onAlertsChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    _syncSubscriptions();
  }

  void _onFavoritesChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {});
    _syncSubscriptions();
    _refreshQuotes();
  }

  void _onNetworkStatusChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _onTickReceived(BiquoteTick tick) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _ticks[tick.symbol] = tick;
      if (tick.symbol == _selectedSymbol) {
        _updateRealtimeCandle(tick.mid);
      }
      widget.alertManager.checkTick(tick);
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.alertManager.removeListener(_onAlertsChanged);
    _favService.removeListener(_onFavoritesChanged);
    widget.biquoteService.isOnlineNotifier.removeListener(_onNetworkStatusChanged);
    _tickSubscription?.cancel();
    _slowSyncTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _checkDndStatus() async {
    final granted = await widget.alertManager.alarmService.isDndOverrideGranted();
    if (mounted) setState(() => _isDndGranted = granted);
  }

  Future<void> _loadInitialData() async {
    await _refreshQuotes();
    await _loadCandles();
  }

  int _getTimeframeSeconds(String tf) {
    switch (tf) {
      case '1M':
        return 60;
      case '5M':
        return 300;
      case '15M':
        return 900;
      case '30M':
        return 1800;
      case '1H':
        return 3600;
      case '4H':
        return 14400;
      case '1D':
        return 86400;
      default:
        return 3600;
    }
  }

  String _getIntervalCode(String tf) {
    const map = {
      '1M': '1m',
      '5M': '5m',
      '15M': '15m',
      '30M': '30m',
      '1H': '1h',
      '4H': '4h',
      '1D': '1d',
    };
    return map[tf] ?? '15m';
  }

  void _updateRealtimeCandle(double newPrice) {
    if (_candles.isEmpty) return;

    final intervalSeconds = _getTimeframeSeconds(_selectedTimeframe);
    final last = _candles.last;
    final now = DateTime.now();

    // Guard against abnormal price jumps (e.g. data source transition) so existing candles aren't stretched
    if (last.close > 0 && (newPrice - last.close).abs() / last.close > 0.02) {
      _candles.add(BiquoteCandle(
        openTime: now,
        open: newPrice,
        high: newPrice,
        low: newPrice,
        close: newPrice,
        tickVolume: 1,
        isOpen: true,
      ));
      if (_candles.length > 500) {
        _candles.removeAt(0);
      }
      return;
    }

    final interval = _getIntervalCode(_selectedTimeframe);
    if (now.difference(last.openTime).inSeconds >= intervalSeconds) {
      // Period completed: close last candle and append new forming candle
      _candles[_candles.length - 1] = last.copyWith(isOpen: false);
      _candles.add(BiquoteCandle(
        openTime: now,
        open: newPrice,
        high: newPrice,
        low: newPrice,
        close: newPrice,
        tickVolume: 1,
        isOpen: true,
      ));
      if (_candles.length > 500) {
        _candles.removeAt(0);
      }
      widget.alertManager.evaluateCandles(_selectedSymbol, interval, _candles, isIntraCandle: false);
    } else {
      // Real-time update of current forming candle's wick and body
      _candles[_candles.length - 1] = last.updateWithTick(newPrice);
      // Intra-candle evaluation for indicators and multi-step logic chains
      widget.alertManager.evaluateCandles(_selectedSymbol, interval, _candles, isIntraCandle: true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refreshQuotes() async {
    final quotes = await widget.biquoteService.getLatestQuotes(_getMonitoredSymbols());
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _ticks = quotes;
        // Evaluate price alerts across all actively monitored symbols
        for (final tick in quotes.values) {
          widget.alertManager.evaluatePrice(tick.symbol, tick.mid);
        }
        final currentTick = quotes[_selectedSymbol];
        if (currentTick != null) {
          _updateRealtimeCandle(currentTick.mid);
        }
      });
    }
    _evaluateNonActiveSymbolCandles();
  }

  Future<void> _evaluateNonActiveSymbolCandles() async {
    final nonActiveCandleAlerts = widget.alertManager.activeAlerts.where((a) =>
        a.symbol != _selectedSymbol && (a.isPatternAlert || a.isIndicatorAlert || a.isMultiStepAlert));
    if (nonActiveCandleAlerts.isEmpty) return;

    final nonActiveSymbolsWithTf = <String, Set<String>>{};
    for (final a in nonActiveCandleAlerts) {
      nonActiveSymbolsWithTf.putIfAbsent(a.symbol, () => <String>{}).add(a.timeframe);
      if (a.isMultiStepAlert && a.multiStepConfig?.activeStage != null) {
        for (final node in a.multiStepConfig!.activeStage!.nodes) {
          if (!node.isSatisfied &&
              (node.nodeType == AlertType.candlestickPattern || node.nodeType == AlertType.technicalIndicator)) {
            nonActiveSymbolsWithTf.putIfAbsent(a.symbol, () => <String>{}).add(node.timeframe);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    for (final entry in nonActiveSymbolsWithTf.entries) {
      final sym = entry.key;
      for (final tf in entry.value) {
        try {
          final candles = await widget.biquoteService.getCandles(sym, interval: tf, limit: 30);
          if (candles.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
            widget.alertManager.evaluateCandles(sym, tf, candles, isIntraCandle: false);
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadCandles() async {
    _hasReachedHistoryEnd = false;
    setState(() => _isLoadingCandles = true);
    final intervalMap = {
      '1M': '1m',
      '5M': '5m',
      '15M': '15m',
      '30M': '30m',
      '1H': '1h',
      '4H': '4h',
      '1D': '1d',
    };
    final interval = intervalMap[_selectedTimeframe] ?? '1h';
    // Fetch deep initial history from Biquote API (up to 500 genuine market bars)
    final candles = await widget.biquoteService.getCandles(_selectedSymbol, interval: interval, limit: 500);
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _candles = candles;
        _isLoadingCandles = false;
        final currentTick = _ticks[_selectedSymbol];
        if (currentTick != null) {
          _updateRealtimeCandle(currentTick.mid);
        }
      });
      widget.alertManager.evaluateCandles(_selectedSymbol, interval, candles);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadMoreHistoryCandles() async {
    if (_isLoadingHistory || _hasReachedHistoryEnd || _candles.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() => _isLoadingHistory = true);

    final intervalMap = {
      '1M': '1m',
      '5M': '5m',
      '15M': '15m',
      '30M': '30m',
      '1H': '1h',
      '4H': '4h',
      '1D': '1d',
    };
    final interval = intervalMap[_selectedTimeframe] ?? '1h';
    final oldestCandle = _candles.first;
    final oldestTime = oldestCandle.openTime;

    // Fetch genuine older bars strictly before oldestTime to avoid boundary duplicate
    final olderBars = await widget.biquoteService.getCandles(
      _selectedSymbol,
      interval: interval,
      limit: 150,
      to: oldestTime.subtract(const Duration(seconds: 1)),
    );

    List<BiquoteCandle> barsToPrepend = [];
    if (olderBars.isNotEmpty) {
      final existingTimes = _candles.map((c) => c.openTime.millisecondsSinceEpoch).toSet();
      barsToPrepend = olderBars.where((b) => !existingTimes.contains(b.openTime.millisecondsSinceEpoch)).toList();
    }

    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _isLoadingHistory = false;
        if (barsToPrepend.isNotEmpty) {
          _candles.insertAll(0, barsToPrepend);
        } else {
          // Reached the true earliest historical record from the market feed
          _hasReachedHistoryEnd = true;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  void _openFullscreenChart() {
    final currentTick = _ticks[_selectedSymbol];
    final currentPrice = currentTick?.mid ?? 1.08450;
    final precision = currentTick?.precision ?? 5;

    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => FullscreenChartScreen(
          symbol: _selectedSymbol,
          candles: _candles,
          currentPrice: currentPrice,
          precision: precision,
          interval: _selectedTimeframe,
          alertManager: widget.alertManager,
          isDark: widget.isDark,
          onSelectTimeframe: _onSelectTimeframe,
          onLoadMoreHistory: _loadMoreHistoryCandles,
          isLoadingMoreHistory: _isLoadingHistory,
          signalOverlay: _activeSignalOverlay,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _onSelectSymbol(String symbol) {
    if (_selectedSymbol != symbol) {
      setState(() {
        _selectedSymbol = symbol;
      });
      _syncSubscriptions();
      _loadCandles();
    }
  }

  void _openInstrumentPicker() {
    InstrumentSearchSheet.show(
      context,
      currentSymbol: _selectedSymbol,
      ticks: _ticks,
      onSelectSymbol: (symbol) {
        _onSelectSymbol(symbol);
      },
    );
  }

  void _onSelectTimeframe(String tf) {
    if (_selectedTimeframe != tf) {
      setState(() {
        _selectedTimeframe = tf;
      });
      _loadCandles();
    }
  }

  void _openCreateAlertSheet({double? targetPrice, ChartDrawing? fromDrawing}) {
    final currentTick = _ticks[_selectedSymbol];
    final currentPrice = currentTick?.mid ?? 1.08450;
    final precision = currentTick?.precision ?? 5;

    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => CreateAlertSheet(
        symbol: _selectedSymbol,
        currentPrice: currentPrice,
        initialTargetPrice: targetPrice,
        drawingId: fromDrawing?.id,
        precision: precision,
        alarmService: widget.alertManager.alarmService,
        onAlertCreated: ({
          required String symbol,
          AlertType alertType = AlertType.priceLevel,
          double targetPrice = 0.0,
          AlertCondition condition = AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
          CandlestickPattern? candlestickPattern,
          IndicatorAlertConfig? indicatorConfig,
          MultiStepConfig? multiStepConfig,
          String timeframe = '15m',
          String note = '',
          String ringtoneTitle = 'Default Alarm',
          String? ringtoneUri,
          String? drawingId,
        }) {
          final alert = widget.alertManager.addAlert(
            symbol: symbol,
            alertType: alertType,
            targetPrice: targetPrice,
            condition: condition,
            candlestickPattern: candlestickPattern,
            indicatorConfig: indicatorConfig,
            multiStepConfig: multiStepConfig,
            timeframe: timeframe,
            note: note,
            currentPrice: currentPrice,
            ringtoneTitle: ringtoneTitle,
            ringtoneUri: ringtoneUri,
            drawingId: drawingId,
          );
          if (fromDrawing != null) {
            fromDrawing.alertId = alert.id;
            setState(() {});
          }
          final msg = fromDrawing != null
              ? '🎯 Drawing Alert active at ${targetPrice.toStringAsFixed(precision)} ($ringtoneTitle)'
              : alertType == AlertType.candlestickPattern
                  ? 'Pattern alarm active for $symbol: ${candlestickPattern?.label} ($timeframe)'
                  : alertType == AlertType.technicalIndicator
                      ? 'Indicator alarm active for $symbol: ${indicatorConfig?.summary} ($timeframe)'
                      : 'Alert active for $symbol at ${targetPrice.toStringAsFixed(precision)} ($ringtoneTitle)';
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text(msg),
              backgroundColor: widget.isDark ? AppTheme.darkPrimary : AppTheme.lightPrimary,
              duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openAlertsManagerSheet() {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertsListSheet(
        alertManager: widget.alertManager,
        latestTicks: _ticks,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showAlarmDialog(PriceAlert alert, double triggerPrice) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) {
        final theme = Theme.of(context);
        final isBull = alert.condition == AlertCondition.crossesAbove;
        final displayPair = alert.symbol.length == 6
            ? '${alert.symbol.substring(0, 3)}/${alert.symbol.substring(3)}'
            : alert.symbol;

        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: widget.isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            side: const BorderSide(color: Colors.redAccent, width: 2),
          ),
          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 24),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              // Pulsing Alarm Icon
              Container(
                width: 72,
                height: 72,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.redAccent.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: const Center(
                  child: Icon(Icons.notifications_active, size: 42, color: Colors.redAccent),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                'ALARM RINGING!',
                style: AppTheme.sans(
                  fontSize: 18,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  color: Colors.redAccent,
                  letterSpacing: 1.0,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                '$displayPair ${alert.condition.label.toUpperCase()}',
                style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(
                'Target: ${alert.formattedTarget()} • Triggered: ${triggerPrice.toStringAsFixed(5)}',
                style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 12, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: (isBull ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.darkBearish).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const Icon(Icons.ring_volume, size: 14, color: Colors.amber),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Text(
                      'Ringtone: ${alert.ringtoneTitle}',
                      style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: Colors.amber),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              if (alert.note.isNotEmpty) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Text(
                  '"${alert.note}"',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12),
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 24),

              // Dismiss / Stop Button
              SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                height: 52,
                child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () {
                    widget.alertManager.alarmService.stopAlarm();
                    if (Navigator.of(ctx).canPop()) {
                      Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
                    }
                  },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.notifications_off, size: 22),
                  label: const Text(
                    'STOP ALARM / DISMISS',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, letterSpacing: 0.8),
                  ),
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: Colors.redAccent,
                    foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                    elevation: 4,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _showDndInfoDialog() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: widget.isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
        title: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(
              _isDndGranted ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.do_not_disturb_on_outlined,
              color: _isDndGranted ? Colors.green : Colors.amber,
              size: 24,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(
              _isDndGranted ? 'DND Override Active' : 'DND Override Setting',
              style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        content: Text(
          _isDndGranted
              ? 'Your device has granted Do Not Disturb (DND) override permission. Alarms will ring loudly even when the phone is on silent or in DND mode.'
              : 'Grant Notification Policy Access so your alerts can disrupt silent mode, wake up the locked screen, and ring at full alarm volume.',
          style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 13),
        ),
        actions: [
          if (!_isDndGranted)
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () async {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                await widget.alertManager.alarmService.requestDndOverride();
                await _checkDndStatus();
              },
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.amber, foregroundColor: Colors.black),
              child: const Text('Grant DND Override'),
            ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Close'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
