import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../models/market_models.dart';
import '../services/alarm_service.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

class CreateAlertSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final String symbol;
  final double currentPrice;
  final int precision;
  final double? initialTargetPrice;
  final String? drawingId;
  final AlarmService? alarmService;
  final AlertType? initialAlertType;
  final String? initialNote;
  final List<ChainStage>? initialChainStages;
  final AlertCondition? initialCondition;
  final void Function({
    required String symbol,
    AlertType alertType,
    double targetPrice,
    AlertCondition condition,
    CandlestickPattern? candlestickPattern,
    IndicatorAlertConfig? indicatorConfig,
    MultiStepConfig? multiStepConfig,
    String timeframe,
    String note,
    String ringtoneTitle,
    String? ringtoneUri,
    String? drawingId,
  }) onAlertCreated;

  const CreateAlertSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.symbol,
    required this.currentPrice,
    required this.precision,
    this.initialTargetPrice,
    this.drawingId,
    this.alarmService,
    this.initialAlertType,
    this.initialNote,
    this.initialChainStages,
    this.initialCondition,
    required this.onAlertCreated,
  });

  @override
  State<CreateAlertSheet> createState() => _CreateAlertSheetState();
}

class _CreateAlertSheetState extends State<CreateAlertSheet> {
  AlertType _alertType = AlertType.priceLevel;
  late AlertCondition _condition;
  late double _targetPrice;
  late TextEditingController _priceController;
  final TextEditingController _noteController = TextEditingController();
  late final AlarmService _alarmService;

  CandlestickPattern _selectedPattern = CandlestickPattern.bullishEngulfing;
  String _selectedTimeframe = '15m';
  String _patternFilter = 'All'; // 'All', 'Bullish', 'Bearish', 'Indecision'

  // Indicator Alert Configuration State
  AlertIndicatorType _selectedIndicator = AlertIndicatorType.rsi;
  int _rsiPeriod = 14;
  String _rsiSource = 'Close';
  String _rsiSmoothingType = 'RMA';
  double _rsiLevel = 30.0;
  double _rsiOverbought = 70.0;
  double _rsiOversold = 30.0;
  bool _rsiApplySignalMa = false;
  String _rsiSignalMaType = 'EMA';
  int _rsiSignalMaPeriod = 9;
  String _rsiCondition = 'crossesBelowOversold';

  int _macdFast = 12;
  int _macdSlow = 26;
  int _macdSignal = 9;
  String _macdSource = 'Close';
  String _macdFastMaType = 'EMA';
  String _macdSlowMaType = 'EMA';
  String _macdSignalMaType = 'EMA';
  String _macdCondition = 'bullishSignalCross';

  int _maFastPeriod = 50;
  int _maSlowPeriod = 200;
  String _maType = 'EMA';
  String _maFastMaType = 'EMA';
  String _maSlowMaType = 'EMA';
  String _maSource = 'Close';
  String _maCondition = 'goldenCross';

  int _bbPeriod = 20;
  double _bbStdDev = 2.0;
  double _bbSqueezeThreshold = 0.015;
  String _bbSource = 'Close';
  String _bbMaType = 'SMA';
  String _bbCondition = 'lowerBandTouch';

  int _stochK = 14;
  int _stochKSlowing = 3;
  int _stochD = 3;
  String _stochDMaType = 'SMA';
  double _stochOversold = 20.0;
  double _stochOverbought = 80.0;
  String _stochCondition = 'bullishOversoldCross';

  int _stPeriod = 10;
  double _stMultiplier = 3.0;
  String _stSource = 'HL2';
  String _stAtrSmoothing = 'RMA';
  double _stDistanceThreshold = 1.0;
  String _stCondition = 'bullishFlip';

  // Multi-Step Logic Chain State
  late List<ChainStage> _chainStages;

  bool _soundEnabled = true;
  String _selectedRingtoneTitle = 'Default Alarm';
  String? _selectedRingtoneUri;
  List<RingtoneItem> _availableRingtones = [];
  String? _previewingUri;
  bool _isDndGranted = false;

  final List<String> _timeframes = ['5m', '15m', '30m', '1h', '4h', '1d'];

  double get _pipValue {
    if (widget.symbol.contains('JPY')) return 0.01;
    if (widget.symbol.contains('BTC') || widget.symbol.contains('XAU')) return 1.0;
    return 0.0001; // Standard forex pip
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _alarmService = widget.alarmService ?? AlarmService();
    if (widget.initialAlertType != null) {
      _alertType = widget.initialAlertType!;
    }
    if (widget.initialNote != null && widget.initialNote!.isNotEmpty) {
      _noteController.text = widget.initialNote!;
    }

    if (widget.initialCondition != null) {
      _condition = widget.initialCondition!;
    } else if (widget.initialTargetPrice != null && widget.initialTargetPrice! > 0) {
      _condition = widget.initialTargetPrice! >= widget.currentPrice
          ? AlertCondition.crossesAbove
          : AlertCondition.crossesBelow;
    } else {
      _condition = AlertCondition.crossesAbove;
    }

    if (widget.initialTargetPrice != null && widget.initialTargetPrice! > 0) {
      _targetPrice = widget.initialTargetPrice!;
    } else {
      _targetPrice = widget.currentPrice + (_pipValue * 10);
    }
    _priceController = TextEditingController(text: _targetPrice.toStringAsFixed(widget.precision));

    // Initialize Logic Chain from initialChainStages if provided, else use Default
    if (widget.initialChainStages != null && widget.initialChainStages!.isNotEmpty) {
      _chainStages = List.from(widget.initialChainStages!);
    } else {
      _chainStages = [
        ChainStage(
          id: 'stage_1',
          name: 'Price Level Touch',
          logicOperator: 'AND',
          nodes: [
            ChainNode(
              id: 'node_1',
              nodeType: AlertType.priceLevel,
              targetPrice: _targetPrice,
              condition: _condition,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        ChainStage(
          id: 'stage_2',
          name: 'Momentum / Indicator Confluence',
          logicOperator: 'AND',
          nodes: [
            ChainNode(
              id: 'node_2',
              nodeType: AlertType.technicalIndicator,
              indicatorConfig: IndicatorAlertConfig(
                indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.rsi,
                condition: 'crossesBelow',
                params: {
                  'period': 14,
                  'level': 30.0,
                  'source': 'Close',
                  'smoothingType': 'RMA',
                  'overbought': 70.0,
                  'oversold': 30.0,
                },
              ),
              timeframe: '15m',
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ];
    }
    _loadAlarmData();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAlarmData() async {
    final ringtones = await _alarmService.getRingtones();
    final dndGranted = await _alarmService.isDndOverrideGranted();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _availableRingtones = ringtones;
        _isDndGranted = dndGranted;
        if (ringtones.isNotEmpty) {
          _selectedRingtoneTitle = ringtones.first.title;
          _selectedRingtoneUri = ringtones.first.uri;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _priceController.dispose();
    _noteController.dispose();
    _alarmService.stopPreview();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _adjustPips(double pips) {
    setState(() {
      _targetPrice += pips * _pipValue;
      if (_targetPrice <= 0) _targetPrice = _pipValue;
      _priceController.text = _targetPrice.toStringAsFixed(widget.precision);
      if (_targetPrice > widget.currentPrice) {
        _condition = AlertCondition.crossesAbove;
      } else {
        _condition = AlertCondition.crossesBelow;
      }
    });
  }

  void _onPriceChanged(String val) {
    final parsed = double.tryParse(val);
    if (parsed != null && parsed > 0) {
      setState(() {
        _targetPrice = parsed;
        if (_targetPrice > widget.currentPrice) {
          _condition = AlertCondition.crossesAbove;
        } else {
          _condition = AlertCondition.crossesBelow;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  void _openRingtonePicker() {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (context, setPickerState) {
            final theme = Theme.of(context);
            final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;

            return Container(
              height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.65,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
                borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
                border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
              ),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Center(
                    child: Container(
                      width: 36,
                      height: 4,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: theme.dividerColor,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        'SELECT ALARM RINGTONE',
                        style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, letterSpacing: 0.5),
                      ),
                      IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 20),
                        onPressed: () {
                          _alarmService.stopPreview();
                          Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        },
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    'Choose a tone that will play continuously until dismissed',
                    style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: ListView.separated(
                      itemCount: _availableRingtones.length,
                      separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const Divider(height: 1),
                      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                        final tone = _availableRingtones[index];
                        final isSelected = tone.title == _selectedRingtoneTitle;
                        final isPreviewing = _previewingUri == tone.uri;

                        return ListTile(
                          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 2),
                          leading: Icon(
                            isSelected ? Icons.radio_button_checked : Icons.radio_button_off,
                            color: isSelected ? theme.colorScheme.primary : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            size: 20,
                          ),
                          title: Text(
                            tone.title,
                            style: AppTheme.sans(
                              fontSize: 14,
                              fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                              color: isSelected ? theme.colorScheme.primary : theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                            ),
                          ),
                          trailing: Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: theme.dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                                ),
                                child: Text(
                                  tone.type.toUpperCase(),
                                  style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 10, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              IconButton(
                                icon: Icon(
                                  isPreviewing ? Icons.stop_circle : Icons.play_circle_fill,
                                  color: isPreviewing ? Colors.amber : theme.colorScheme.primary,
                                  size: 26,
                                ),
                                onPressed: () {
                                  if (isPreviewing) {
                                    _alarmService.stopPreview();
                                    setPickerState(() => _previewingUri = null);
                                    setState(() => _previewingUri = null);
                                  } else {
                                    _alarmService.previewRingtone(tone.uri);
                                    setPickerState(() => _previewingUri = tone.uri);
                                    setState(() => _previewingUri = tone.uri);
                                  }
                                },
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          onTap: () {
                            setState(() {
                              _selectedRingtoneTitle = tone.title;
                              _selectedRingtoneUri = tone.uri;
                            });
                            _alarmService.stopPreview();
                            Navigator.pop(ctx);
                          },
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  List<CandlestickPattern> get _filteredPatterns {
    switch (_patternFilter) {
      case 'Bullish':
        return CandlestickPattern.values.where((p) => p.isBullish == true).toList();
      case 'Bearish':
        return CandlestickPattern.values.where((p) => p.isBullish == false).toList();
      case 'Indecision':
        return CandlestickPattern.values.where((p) => p.isBullish == null).toList();
      default:
        return CandlestickPattern.values;
    }
  }

  String _getPatternDescription(CandlestickPattern pattern) {
    switch (pattern) {
      case CandlestickPattern.bullishEngulfing:
        return 'Green candle body completely engulfs prior red body. Major bullish reversal.';
      case CandlestickPattern.bearishEngulfing:
        return 'Red candle body completely engulfs prior green body. Strong bearish selloff.';
      case CandlestickPattern.hammer:
        return 'Small body at top, long lower shadow rejecting support.';
      case CandlestickPattern.hangingMan:
        return 'Small body with long lower wick forming after an uptrend, warning exhaustion.';
      case CandlestickPattern.shootingStar:
        return 'Long upper shadow rejecting resistance with small lower body.';
      case CandlestickPattern.invertedHammer:
        return 'Long upper wick at swing lows, hinting at upcoming buyer entry.';
      case CandlestickPattern.morningStar:
        return '3-candle powerhouse: Strong red, indecision star, strong green breakout.';
      case CandlestickPattern.eveningStar:
        return '3-candle reversal: Strong green, indecision star, deep red breakdown.';
      case CandlestickPattern.doji:
        return 'Open and close virtually equal. Market equilibrium and pending breakout.';
      case CandlestickPattern.dragonflyDoji:
        return 'Long lower wick with open and close at the high. Extreme low price rejection.';
      case CandlestickPattern.gravestoneDoji:
        return 'Long upper wick with open and close at the low. Extreme high price rejection.';
      case CandlestickPattern.piercingLine:
        return 'Green candle opens low and pierces above 50% midpoint of prior red candle.';
      case CandlestickPattern.darkCloudCover:
        return 'Red candle opens high and closes below 50% midpoint of prior green candle.';
      case CandlestickPattern.threeWhiteSoldiers:
        return '3 consecutive bullish candles closing near highs. Massive institutional momentum.';
      case CandlestickPattern.threeBlackCrows:
        return '3 consecutive bearish candles closing near lows. Heavy sell conviction.';
      case CandlestickPattern.bullishHarami:
        return 'Small green inside-bar contained within large red body. Momentum shift.';
      case CandlestickPattern.bearishHarami:
        return 'Small red inside-bar contained within large green body. Exhaustion warning.';
      case CandlestickPattern.tweezerBottom:
        return '2 candles matching the exact same low price before sharp bounce.';
      case CandlestickPattern.tweezerTop:
        return '2 candles hitting the exact same high resistance ceiling.';
      case CandlestickPattern.marubozu:
        return 'Full solid candle body with virtually no wicks. 90%+ pure directional power.';
    }
  }

                ),
                child: ListView.separated(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
                  itemCount: _filteredPatterns.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const Divider(height: 1),
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final pattern = _filteredPatterns[index];
                    final isSelected = _selectedPattern == pattern;
                    final isBullish = pattern.isBullish;
                    final badgeColor = isBullish == true
                        ? (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish)
                        : (isBullish == false
                            ? (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBearish : AppTheme.lightBearish)
                            : Colors.amber);

                    return ListTile(
                      dense: true,
                      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 2),
                      leading: Icon(
                        isSelected ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.circle_outlined,
                        color: isSelected ? theme.colorScheme.primary : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        size: 18,
                      ),
                      title: Row(
                        children: [
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              pattern.label,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w600,
                                fontSize: 13,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: badgeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              isBullish == true ? 'BULLISH' : (isBullish == false ? 'BEARISH' : 'NEUTRAL'),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 9,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: badgeColor,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      subtitle: Text(
                        _getPatternDescription(pattern),
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
                        maxLines: 2,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                      onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedPattern = pattern),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ] else if (_alertType == AlertType.technicalIndicator) ...[
              ..._buildIndicatorSection(theme, isDark),
            ] else ...[
              ..._buildLogicChainSection(theme, isDark),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Ringtone Selector Tile
            Text(
              'ALARM SOUND & RINGTONE',
              style: AppTheme.sans(
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                letterSpacing: 0.5,
                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : AppTheme.lightSurface2,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.ring_volume, color: theme.colorScheme.primary, size: 22),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          _selectedRingtoneTitle,
                          style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          'Plays continuously on trigger until stopped',
                          style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  OutlinedButton(
                    onPressed: _openRingtonePicker,
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                      side: BorderSide(color: theme.colorScheme.primary),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6)),
                    ),
                    child: Text('Change', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),

            // DND Override Status & Permission Button
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _isDndGranted
                    ? (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish).withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                    : Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: _isDndGranted
                      ? (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish).withValues(alpha: 0.4)
                      : Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                ),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    _isDndGranted ? Icons.volume_up : Icons.do_not_disturb_on,
                    color: _isDndGranted
                        ? (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish)
                        : Colors.amber.shade700,
                    size: 20,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      _isDndGranted
                          ? 'DND Override Active — alarm will sound even if phone is on Silent.'
                          : 'DND Override Disabled — system mute might silence the alarm.',
                      style: AppTheme.sans(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (!_isDndGranted) ...[
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: () async {
                        await _alarmService.requestDndOverride();
                        final granted = await _alarmService.isDndOverrideGranted();
                        setState(() => _isDndGranted = granted);
                      },
                      style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                        tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                      ),
                      child: Text('Grant', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: Colors.amber.shade800)),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),

            // Note (Optional)
            Text(
              'OPTIONAL NOTE',
              style: AppTheme.sans(
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                letterSpacing: 0.5,
                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            TextField(
              controller: _noteController,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: _alertType == AlertType.priceLevel ? 'e.g. Breakout retest' : 'e.g. Key support confirmation',
                hintStyle: TextStyle(color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.5), fontSize: 13),
                filled: true,
                fillColor: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : AppTheme.lightSurface2,
                contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: theme.dividerColor),
                ),
                enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: theme.dividerColor),
                ),
              ),
              style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 13),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),

            // Sound & Vibration Switch
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.volume_up, size: 18, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text('Sound & Haptic Alarm Enabled', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 13)),
                  ],
                ),
                Switch(
                  value: _soundEnabled,
                  activeThumbColor: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _soundEnabled = v),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),

            // Submit Button
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: 52,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  widget.onAlertCreated(
                    symbol: widget.symbol,
                    alertType: _alertType,
                    targetPrice: _alertType == AlertType.priceLevel ? _targetPrice : 0.0,
                    condition: _condition,
                    candlestickPattern: _alertType == AlertType.candlestickPattern ? _selectedPattern : null,
                    indicatorConfig: _alertType == AlertType.technicalIndicator ? _buildCurrentIndicatorConfig() : null,
                    multiStepConfig: _alertType == AlertType.multiStepChain ? MultiStepConfig(stages: _chainStages) : null,
                    timeframe: _selectedTimeframe,
                    note: _noteController.text.trim(),
                    ringtoneTitle: _selectedRingtoneTitle,
                    ringtoneUri: _selectedRingtoneUri,
                    drawingId: widget.drawingId,
                  );
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: _alertType == AlertType.multiStepChain ? Colors.amber.shade700 : theme.colorScheme.primary,
                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
                  elevation: 2,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      _alertType == AlertType.priceLevel
                          ? Icons.add_alert
                          : _alertType == AlertType.candlestickPattern
                              ? Icons.candlestick_chart
                              : _alertType == AlertType.technicalIndicator
                                  ? Icons.analytics_outlined
                                  : Icons.account_tree_rounded,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        _alertType == AlertType.priceLevel
                            ? 'SET PRICE ALERT'
                            : _alertType == AlertType.candlestickPattern
                                ? 'SET PATTERN ALARM: ${_selectedPattern.label.toUpperCase()}'
                                : _alertType == AlertType.technicalIndicator
                                    ? 'SET INDICATOR ALARM: ${_buildCurrentIndicatorConfig().summary.toUpperCase()}'
                                    : 'ACTIVATE MULTI-STEP CHAIN (${_chainStages.length} LEVELS)',
                        style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, letterSpacing: 0.5),
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _conditionChip({
    required String label,
    required AlertCondition condition,
    required Color activeColor,
  }) {
    final isSelected = _condition == condition;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => setState(() => _condition = condition),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected
              ? activeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.18)
              : (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : AppTheme.lightSurface2),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected ? activeColor : theme.dividerColor,
            width: isSelected ? 1.5 : 1.0,
          ),
        ),
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: AppTheme.sans(
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
              color: isSelected ? activeColor : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  IndicatorAlertConfig _buildCurrentIndicatorConfig() {
    switch (_selectedIndicator) {
      case AlertIndicatorType.rsi:
        return IndicatorAlertConfig(
          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.rsi,
          condition: _rsiCondition,
          params: {
            'period': _rsiPeriod,
            'source': _rsiSource,
            'smoothingType': _rsiSmoothingType,
            'level': _rsiLevel,
            'overbought': _rsiOverbought,
            'oversold': _rsiOversold,
            'applySignalMa': _rsiApplySignalMa,
            'signalMaType': _rsiSignalMaType,
            'signalMaPeriod': _rsiSignalMaPeriod,
          },
        );
      case AlertIndicatorType.macd:
        return IndicatorAlertConfig(
          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.macd,
          condition: _macdCondition,
          params: {
            'fast': _macdFast,
            'slow': _macdSlow,
            'signal': _macdSignal,
            'source': _macdSource,
            'fastMaType': _macdFastMaType,
            'slowMaType': _macdSlowMaType,
            'signalMaType': _macdSignalMaType,
          },
        );
      case AlertIndicatorType.maCross:
        return IndicatorAlertConfig(
          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.maCross,
          condition: _maCondition,
          params: {
            'fastPeriod': _maFastPeriod,
            'slowPeriod': _maSlowPeriod,
            'maType': _maType,
            'fastMaType': _maFastMaType,
            'slowMaType': _maSlowMaType,
            'source': _maSource,
          },
        );
      case AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands:
        return IndicatorAlertConfig(
          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands,
          condition: _bbCondition,
          params: {
            'period': _bbPeriod,
            'stdDev': _bbStdDev,
            'source': _bbSource,
            'maType': _bbMaType,
            'squeezeThreshold': _bbSqueezeThreshold,
          },
        );
      case AlertIndicatorType.stochastic:
        return IndicatorAlertConfig(
          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.stochastic,
          condition: _stochCondition,
          params: {
            'kPeriod': _stochK,
            'kSlowing': _stochKSlowing,
            'dPeriod': _stochD,
            'dMaType': _stochDMaType,
            'oversoldLevel': _stochOversold,
            'overboughtLevel': _stochOverbought,
            'oversold': _stochOversold,
            'overbought': _stochOverbought,
          },
        );
      case AlertIndicatorType.supertrend:
        return IndicatorAlertConfig(
          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.supertrend,
          condition: _stCondition,
          params: {
            'period': _stPeriod,
            'multiplier': _stMultiplier,
            'source': _stSource,
            'atrSmoothing': _stAtrSmoothing,
            'distanceThreshold': _stDistanceThreshold,
          },
        );
    }
  }

  List<Widget> _buildIndicatorSection(ThemeData theme, bool isDark) {
    return [
      Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Text(
            'TIMEFRAME',
            style: AppTheme.sans(
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              letterSpacing: 0.5,
              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
          Text(
            'Evaluates on candle close',
            style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, color: theme.colorScheme.primary),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      SizedBox(
        height: 38,
        child: ListView.separated(
          scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
          itemCount: _timeframes.length,
          separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(width: 8),
          itemBuilder: (context, idx) {
            final tf = _timeframes[idx];
            final isSelected = _selectedTimeframe.toLowerCase() == tf.toLowerCase();
            return ChoiceChip(
              label: Text(tf.toUpperCase(), style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal)),
              selected: isSelected,
              onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _selectedTimeframe = tf),
              selectedColor: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.25),
              labelStyle: TextStyle(
                color: isSelected ? theme.colorScheme.primary : theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 14),

      Text(
        'CHOOSE INDICATOR',
        style: AppTheme.sans(
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          letterSpacing: 0.5,
          color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        ),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      SizedBox(
        height: 38,
        child: ListView.separated(
          scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
          itemCount: AlertIndicatorType.values.length,
          separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(width: 8),
          itemBuilder: (context, idx) {
            final ind = AlertIndicatorType.values[idx];
            final isSelected = _selectedIndicator == ind;
            return ChoiceChip(
              label: Text(ind.label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal)),
              selected: isSelected,
              onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _selectedIndicator = ind),
              selectedColor: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.25),
              labelStyle: TextStyle(
                color: isSelected ? theme.colorScheme.primary : theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 6),
      Text(
        _selectedIndicator.description,
        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),

      Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : AppTheme.lightSurface2,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'CALCULATION VARIABLES & LOGIC:',
                    style: AppTheme.sans(
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                      letterSpacing: 0.5,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () => _openIndicatorConfigModal(
                    context: context,
                    initialConfig: _buildCurrentIndicatorConfig(),
                    initialTimeframe: _selectedTimeframe,
                    onConfigSaved: (cfg) => setState(() => _applySavedIndicatorConfig(cfg)),
                  ),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.tune, size: 12),
                  label: const Text('Open Modal Config', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                  style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                    visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 4,
              runSpacing: 4,
              children: _buildParamBadges(_buildCurrentIndicatorConfig()),
            ),
            const Divider(height: 20),
            _buildSpecificIndicatorForm(theme, isDark),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ];
  }

  Widget _buildSpecificIndicatorForm(ThemeData theme, bool isDark) {
    switch (_selectedIndicator) {
      case AlertIndicatorType.rsi:
        final isSignalCondition = _rsiCondition == 'crossesAboveSignalMa' || _rsiCondition == 'crossesBelowSignalMa';
        final isCustomLevel = _rsiCondition == 'crossesAboveLevel' || _rsiCondition == 'crossesBelowLevel' || _rsiCondition == 'crossesAbove' || _rsiCondition == 'crossesBelow';
        return Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text('RSI PARAMETERS', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            _buildNumberStepper(
              label: 'RSI Period (Length)',
              value: _rsiPeriod,
              min: 2,
              max: 200,
              step: 1,
              onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _rsiPeriod = v.toInt()),
            ),
            _buildSourceSelector(
              currentSource: _rsiSource,
              onChanged: (src) => setState(() => _rsiSource = src),
            ),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Text('Smoothing: ', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  ...['RMA', 'EMA', 'SMA', 'WMA'].map((sm) {
                    final isSel = _rsiSmoothingType == sm;
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                      child: ChoiceChip(
                        label: Text(sm, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                        selected: isSel,
                        onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _rsiSmoothingType = sm),
                        visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                      ),
                    );
                  }),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text('ALERT CONDITION (SIGNAL MIX)', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              initialValue: _rsiCondition,
              isDense: true,
              isExpanded: true,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
              ),
              items: const [
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesBelowOversold', child: Text('Crosses Below Oversold Level (< Oversold dip)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesAboveOversold', child: Text('Crosses Above Oversold Level (Recovery / Exit Oversold)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesAboveOverbought', child: Text('Crosses Above Overbought Level (> Overbought spike)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesBelowOverbought', child: Text('Crosses Below Overbought Level (Pullback / Exit Overbought)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesAboveLevel', child: Text('Crosses Above Custom Target Level', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesBelowLevel', child: Text('Crosses Below Custom Target Level', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesAboveCenterline', child: Text('Crosses Above 50 Centerline (Bullish Momentum Shift)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesBelowCenterline', child: Text('Crosses Below 50 Centerline (Bearish Momentum Shift)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'centerlineCross', child: Text('Crosses 50 Centerline (Either Direction)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesAboveSignalMa', child: Text('Crosses Above Signal MA (MA of RSI line)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesBelowSignalMa', child: Text('Crosses Below Signal MA (MA of RSI line)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'inOversold', child: Text('Is in Oversold Zone (< Oversold)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'inOverbought', child: Text('Is in Overbought Zone (> Overbought)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'inBandRange', child: Text('Is Inside Normal Range (Between Oversold & Overbought)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'outsideBandRange', child: Text('Is Outside Normal Range (Extreme Zone)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'rsiTurningUp', child: Text('RSI Hooks Upward (Bullish Momentum Reversal)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'rsiTurningDown', child: Text('RSI Hooks Downward (Bearish Momentum Exhaustion)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
              ],
              onChanged: (c) {
                if (c != null) {
                  setState(() {
                    _rsiCondition = c;
                    if (c == 'crossesAboveSignalMa' || c == 'crossesBelowSignalMa') {
                      _rsiApplySignalMa = true;
                    }
                  });
                }
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            if (isCustomLevel) ...[
              _buildNumberStepper(
                label: 'Trigger Level',
                value: _rsiLevel,
                min: 1,
                max: 99,
                step: 1,
                onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _rsiLevel = v.toDouble()),
              ),
            ],
            _buildNumberStepper(
              label: 'Oversold Threshold',
              value: _rsiOversold,
              min: 5,
              max: 50,
              step: 1,
              onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _rsiOversold = v.toDouble()),
            ),
            _buildNumberStepper(
              label: 'Overbought Threshold',
              value: _rsiOverbought,
              min: 50,
              max: 95,
              step: 1,
              onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _rsiOverbought = v.toDouble()),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                border: Border.all(color: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.15)),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.timeline, size: 16, color: theme.colorScheme.primary),
                          const SizedBox(width: 6),
                          Text(
                            'Moving Average of RSI (Signal Line)',
                            style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      Switch.adaptive(
                        value: _rsiApplySignalMa || isSignalCondition,
                        onChanged: (val) {
                          setState(() {
                            _rsiApplySignalMa = val;
                            if (!val && isSignalCondition) {

                  )),

            Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.6)),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                  Text('Price Source Basis', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface)),

            ),

              ),
              items: [
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'bullishFlip', child: Text('Bullish Trend Flip (Buy Signal)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'bearishFlip', child: Text('Bearish Trend Flip (Sell Signal)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'trendFlip', child: Text('Trend Direction Reversal (Any Flip)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'priceCrossesAboveTrail', child: Text('Price crosses above Trailing Stop', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'priceCrossesBelowTrail', child: Text('Price crosses below Trailing Stop', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),

                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'priceBouncesOffTrail', child: Text('Price tests Trail & Bounces in Trend Direction', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'inBullishTrend', child: Text('State: Active Bullish Trend (Green Trail)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'inBearishTrend', child: Text('State: Active Bearish Trend (Red Trail)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'priceAboveTrail', child: Text('State: Price > Trailing Stop', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'priceBelowTrail', child: Text('State: Price < Trailing Stop', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'trailRising', child: Text('Momentum: Trailing Stop Rising (Tightening)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'trailFalling', child: Text('Momentum: Trailing Stop Falling (Tightening)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'trailFlat', child: Text('State: Trailing Stop Flat / Holding Level', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'priceDistanceGreaterThan', child: Text('Overextended (Distance >= ${_stDistanceThreshold.toStringAsFixed(1)}%)', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DropdownMenuItem(value: 'priceDistanceLessThan', child: Text('Near Trail / Low Risk (Distance <= ${_stDistanceThreshold.toStringAsFixed(1)}%)', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
              ],
              onChanged: (c) {
                if (c != null) setState(() => _stCondition = c);
              },
            ),
          ],
        );
    }
  }

  Widget _buildNumberStepper({
    required String label,
    required num value,
    required num min,
    required num max,
    required num step,
    bool isDecimal = false,
    String? unit,
    required ValueChanged<num> onChanged,
  }) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final displayStr = isDecimal
        ? (value is double ? value.toStringAsFixed(value < 0.1 ? 3 : 1) : value.toString())
        : value.toInt().toString();

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.6)),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              label,
              style: AppTheme.sans(
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.remove, size: 16),
            padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 28, minHeight: 28),
            splashRadius: 16,
            onPressed: () {
              final next = value - step;
              if (next >= min) {
                onChanged(isDecimal ? double.parse(next.toStringAsFixed(3)) : next.toInt());
              }
            },
          ),
          InkWell(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
            onTap: () async {
              final controller = TextEditingController(text: displayStr);
              final typed = await showDialog<String>(
                context: context,
                builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
                  title: Text('Edit $label', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                  content: TextField(
                    controller: controller,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: isDecimal),
                    autofocus: true,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      hintText: 'Enter value ($min - $max)',
                      suffixText: unit,
                    ),
                  ),
                  actions: [
                    TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx), child: const Text('Cancel')),
                    ElevatedButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, controller.text), child: const Text('Set')),
                  ],
                ),
              );
              if (typed != null) {
                final parsed = num.tryParse(typed);
                if (parsed != null && parsed >= min && parsed <= max) {
                  onChanged(isDecimal ? parsed.toDouble() : parsed.toInt());
                }
              }
            },
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                border: Border.all(color: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
              ),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    displayStr + (unit != null ? ' $unit' : ''),
                    style: AppTheme.mono(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 12, color: theme.colorScheme.primary),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 16),
            padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 28, minHeight: 28),
            splashRadius: 16,
            onPressed: () {
              final next = value + step;
              if (next <= max) {
                onChanged(isDecimal ? double.parse(next.toStringAsFixed(3)) : next.toInt());
              }
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSourceSelector({required String currentSource, required ValueChanged<String> onChanged}) {
    final sources = ['Close', 'Open', 'High', 'Low', 'HL2', 'HLC3', 'OHLC4'];
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Text('Price Source:', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              child: Row(
                children: sources.map((src) {
                  final isSel = src.toLowerCase() == currentSource.toLowerCase();
                  return Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                    child: ChoiceChip(
                      label: Text(src, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: isSel ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal)),
                      selected: isSel,
                      onSelected: (_) => onChanged(src),
                      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    ),
                  );
                }).toList(),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStageCard(
    int stageIdx,
    ChainStage stage,
    ThemeData theme,
    bool isDark,
  ) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : AppTheme.lightSurface2,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(
          color: Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
          width: 1.5,
        ),
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          // Stage Header
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.amber,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  'LEVEL ${stageIdx + 1}',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    color: Colors.black,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  stage.name,
                  style: AppTheme.sans(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                  ),
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ),
              if (_chainStages.length > 1) ...[
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 18),
                  color: theme.colorScheme.error,
                  visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                  onPressed: () => _removeStage(stageIdx),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),

          // Sub-alarms in this level, chained with individual AND / OR connectors
          ...stage.nodes.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
            final nodeIdx = entry.key;
            final node = entry.value;
            return Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                if (nodeIdx > 0)
                  _buildNodeOperatorConnector(stageIdx, nodeIdx, stage, node, theme, isDark),
                _buildNodeCard(stageIdx, nodeIdx, stage, node, theme, isDark),
              ],
            );
          }),

          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          // Add Sub-Alarm to this level button
          Align(
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            child: TextButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => _addNodeToStage(stageIdx),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 14, color: Colors.amber),
              label: Text(
                '+ Add Sub-Alarm to Level ${stageIdx + 1}',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: Colors.amber),
              ),
              style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNodeCard(
    int stageIdx,
    int nodeIdx,
    ChainStage stage,
    ChainNode node,
    ThemeData theme,
    bool isDark,
  ) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        border: Border(
          left: const BorderSide(color: Colors.amber, width: 3),
          top: BorderSide(color: theme.dividerColor),
          right: BorderSide(color: theme.dividerColor),
          bottom: BorderSide(color: theme.dividerColor),
        ),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          // Node Header Row: Tree Bullet + NOT Toggle + Type Selector Chips + Delete
          Row(
            children: [
              Text(
                '├── Alarm ${nodeIdx + 1}:',
                style: AppTheme.mono(
                  context: context,
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  color: Colors.amber,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              // Negation [NOT] button
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() {
                    stage.nodes[nodeIdx] = ChainNode(
                      id: node.id,
                      nodeType: node.nodeType,
                      targetPrice: node.targetPrice,
                      condition: node.condition,
                      candlestickPattern: node.candlestickPattern,
                      indicatorConfig: node.indicatorConfig,
                      timeframe: node.timeframe,
                      isNegated: !node.isNegated,
                      operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
                    );
                  });
                },
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: node.isNegated
                        ? Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.2)
                        : theme.dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: node.isNegated ? Colors.red : theme.dividerColor,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    node.isNegated ? 'NOT (Inverted)' : '+ NOT',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: node.isNegated ? Colors.red : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              // Type Selector: Price | Pattern | Indicator
              _nodeTypeChip(stageIdx, nodeIdx, stage, node, AlertType.priceLevel, 'Price'),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              _nodeTypeChip(stageIdx, nodeIdx, stage, node, AlertType.candlestickPattern, 'Pattern'),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              _nodeTypeChip(stageIdx, nodeIdx, stage, node, AlertType.technicalIndicator, 'Indicator'),
              if (stage.nodes.length > 1) ...[
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 14),
                  padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 20, minHeight: 20),
                  onPressed: () => _removeNodeFromStage(stageIdx, nodeIdx),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),

          // Node Configuration Body based on node.nodeType
          if (node.nodeType == AlertType.priceLevel)
            _buildPriceNodeControls(stageIdx, nodeIdx, stage, node, theme, isDark)
          else if (node.nodeType == AlertType.candlestickPattern)
            _buildPatternNodeControls(stageIdx, nodeIdx, stage, node, theme, isDark)
          else
            _buildIndicatorNodeControls(stageIdx, nodeIdx, stage, node, theme, isDark),

          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          // Live Summary Pill
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.terminal, size: 12, color: Colors.amber),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'IF ${node.summary}',
                    style: AppTheme.mono(
                      context: context,
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: Colors.amber,
                    ),
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
