                ),
                items: const [
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: AlertCondition.crossesAbove, child: Text('Crosses Above', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11))),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: AlertCondition.crossesBelow, child: Text('Crosses Below', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11))),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: AlertCondition.hits, child: Text('Hits / Touches', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11))),
                ],
                onChanged: (val) {
                  if (val != null) {
                    setState(() {
                      stage.nodes[nodeIdx] = ChainNode(
                        id: node.id,
                        nodeType: AlertType.priceLevel,
                        targetPrice: node.targetPrice > 0 ? node.targetPrice : widget.currentPrice,
                        condition: val,
                        isNegated: node.isNegated,
                        operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
                      );
                    });
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            // Target Price adjustment
            Expanded(
              flex: 4,
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        (node.targetPrice > 0 ? node.targetPrice : widget.currentPrice).toStringAsFixed(widget.precision),
                        style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.remove, size: 14),
                    padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 26, minHeight: 26),
                    onPressed: () {
                      final curr = node.targetPrice > 0 ? node.targetPrice : widget.currentPrice;
                      final next = curr - (_pipValue * 5);
                      setState(() {
                        stage.nodes[nodeIdx] = ChainNode(
                          id: node.id,
                          nodeType: AlertType.priceLevel,
                          targetPrice: next,
                          condition: node.condition,
                          isNegated: node.isNegated,
                          operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
                        );
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 14),
                    padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 26, minHeight: 26),
                    onPressed: () {
                      final curr = node.targetPrice > 0 ? node.targetPrice : widget.currentPrice;
                      final next = curr + (_pipValue * 5);
                      setState(() {
                        stage.nodes[nodeIdx] = ChainNode(
                          id: node.id,
                          nodeType: AlertType.priceLevel,
                          targetPrice: next,
                          condition: node.condition,
                          isNegated: node.isNegated,
                          operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
                        );
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPatternNodeControls(
    int stageIdx,
    int nodeIdx,
    ChainStage stage,
    ChainNode node,
    ThemeData theme,
    bool isDark,
  ) {
    final curPattern = node.candlestickPattern ?? CandlestickPattern.bullishEngulfing;
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              flex: 4,
              child: DropdownButtonFormField<CandlestickPattern>(
                initialValue: curPattern,
                isDense: true,
                isExpanded: true,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Pattern',
                  labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                  contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 6),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6)),
                ),
                items: CandlestickPattern.values.map((p) {
                  return DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: p,
                    child: Text(
                      p.label,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  );
                }).toList(),
                onChanged: (p) {
                  if (p != null) {
                    setState(() {
                      stage.nodes[nodeIdx] = ChainNode(
                        id: node.id,
                        nodeType: AlertType.candlestickPattern,
                        candlestickPattern: p,
                        timeframe: node.timeframe,
                        isNegated: node.isNegated,
                        operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
                      );
                    });
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            // Timeframe
            Expanded(
              flex: 2,
              child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                initialValue: node.timeframe,
                isDense: true,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'TF',
                  labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                  contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 6),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6)),
                ),
                items: _timeframes.map((tf) {
                  return DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: tf,
                    child: Text(tf.toUpperCase(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                  );
                }).toList(),
                onChanged: (tf) {
                  if (tf != null) {
                    setState(() {
                      stage.nodes[nodeIdx] = ChainNode(
                        id: node.id,
                        nodeType: AlertType.candlestickPattern,
                        candlestickPattern: curPattern,
                        timeframe: tf,
                        isNegated: node.isNegated,
                        operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
                      );
                    });
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNodeOperatorConnector(
    int stageIdx,
    int nodeIdx,
    ChainStage stage,
    ChainNode node,
    ThemeData theme,
    bool isDark,
  ) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4, horizontal: 12),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 14,
            height: 1.5,
            color: Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
          Text(
            'JOIN LOGIC:',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 9,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              letterSpacing: 0.5,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Container(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
              border: Border.all(color: Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
            ),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => setState(() => node.operatorToPrevious = 'AND'),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 3),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: node.operatorToPrevious == 'AND' ? Colors.amber : Colors.transparent,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(5),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      'AND',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        color: node.operatorToPrevious == 'AND' ? Colors.black : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => setState(() => node.operatorToPrevious = 'OR'),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 3),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: node.operatorToPrevious == 'OR' ? Colors.amber : Colors.transparent,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(5),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      'OR',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        color: node.operatorToPrevious == 'OR' ? Colors.black : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Text(
            node.operatorToPrevious == 'AND' ? '(Both alarms required)' : '(Either alarm triggers)',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 10,
              color: Colors.amber.shade700,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIndicatorNodeControls(
    int stageIdx,
    int nodeIdx,
    ChainStage stage,
    ChainNode node,
    ThemeData theme,
    bool isDark,
  ) {
    final curConfig = node.indicatorConfig ??
        IndicatorAlertConfig(
          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.rsi,
          condition: 'crossesBelow',
          params: {
            'period': 14,
            'source': 'Close',
            'level': 30.0,
            'overbought': 70.0,
            'oversold': 30.0,
            'applySignalMa': false,
            'signalMaType': 'EMA',
            'signalMaPeriod': 9,
          },
        );

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            // Indicator Type Dropdown
            Expanded(
              flex: 3,
              child: DropdownButtonFormField<AlertIndicatorType>(
                initialValue: curConfig.indicatorType,
                isDense: true,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Indicator',
                  labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                  contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 6),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6)),
                ),
                items: AlertIndicatorType.values.map((type) {
                  return DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: type,
                    child: Text(type.label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                  );
                }).toList(),
                onChanged: (type) {
                  if (type != null) {
                    IndicatorAlertConfig newConfig;
                    switch (type) {
                      case AlertIndicatorType.rsi:
                        newConfig = IndicatorAlertConfig(
                          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.rsi,
                          condition: 'crossesBelow',
                          params: {
                            'period': 14,
                            'source': 'Close',
                            'level': 30.0,
                            'overbought': 70.0,
                            'oversold': 30.0,
                            'applySignalMa': false,
                            'signalMaType': 'EMA',
                            'signalMaPeriod': 9,
                          },
                        );
                        break;
                      case AlertIndicatorType.macd:
                        newConfig = IndicatorAlertConfig(
                          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.macd,
                          condition: 'bullishSignalCross',
                          params: {'fast': 12, 'slow': 26, 'signal': 9, 'source': 'Close', 'fastMaType': 'EMA', 'slowMaType': 'EMA', 'signalMaType': 'EMA'},
                        );
                        break;
                      case AlertIndicatorType.maCross:
                        newConfig = IndicatorAlertConfig(
                          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.maCross,
                          condition: 'goldenCross',
                          params: {'fastPeriod': 50, 'slowPeriod': 200, 'maType': 'EMA', 'fastMaType': 'EMA', 'slowMaType': 'EMA', 'source': 'Close'},
                        );
                        break;
                      case AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands:
                        newConfig = IndicatorAlertConfig(
                          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands,
                          condition: 'lowerBandTouch',
                          params: {'period': 20, 'stdDev': 2.0, 'source': 'Close', 'maType': 'SMA', 'squeezeThreshold': 0.015},
                        );
                        break;
                      case AlertIndicatorType.stochastic:
                        newConfig = IndicatorAlertConfig(
                          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.stochastic,
                          condition: 'bullishOversoldCross',
                          params: {'kPeriod': 14, 'kSlowing': 3, 'dPeriod': 3, 'dMaType': 'SMA', 'oversoldLevel': 20.0, 'overboughtLevel': 80.0},
                        );
                        break;
                      case AlertIndicatorType.supertrend:
                        newConfig = IndicatorAlertConfig(
                          indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.supertrend,
                          condition: 'bullishFlip',
                          params: {'period': 10, 'multiplier': 3.0, 'source': 'HL2', 'atrSmoothing': 'RMA', 'distanceThreshold': 1.0},
                        );
                        break;
                    }
                    setState(() {
                      stage.nodes[nodeIdx] = ChainNode(
                        id: node.id,
                        nodeType: AlertType.technicalIndicator,
                        indicatorConfig: newConfig,
                        timeframe: node.timeframe,
                        isNegated: node.isNegated,
                        operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
                      );
                    });
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            // Timeframe Dropdown
            Expanded(
              flex: 2,
              child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                initialValue: node.timeframe,
                isDense: true,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'TF',
                  labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                  contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 6),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6)),
                ),
                items: _timeframes.map((tf) {
                  return DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: tf,
                    child: Text(tf.toUpperCase(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                  );
                }).toList(),
                onChanged: (tf) {
                  if (tf != null) {
                    setState(() {
                      stage.nodes[nodeIdx] = ChainNode(
                        id: node.id,
                        nodeType: AlertType.technicalIndicator,
                        indicatorConfig: curConfig,
                        timeframe: tf,
                        isNegated: node.isNegated,
                        operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
                      );
                    });
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),

        // Pop-up Trigger Card: Opens full parametric config
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : AppTheme.lightSurface2,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            border: Border.all(color: Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
          ),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      'PARAMETERS & CALCULATION VARIABLES:',
                      style: AppTheme.sans(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        color: Colors.amber,
                        letterSpacing: 0.5,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => _openIndicatorConfigModal(
                      context: context,
                      stage: stage,
                      node: node,
                      nodeIdx: nodeIdx,
                    ),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.tune, size: 12, color: Colors.amber),
                    label: const Text('Configure Variables', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.amber)),
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                      side: const BorderSide(color: Colors.amber),
                      minimumSize: Size.zero,
                      tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              // Detailed variable chips
              Wrap(
                spacing: 4,
                runSpacing: 4,
                children: _buildParamBadges(curConfig),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  void _openIndicatorConfigModal({
    required BuildContext context,
    ChainStage? stage,
    ChainNode? node,
    int? nodeIdx,
    IndicatorAlertConfig? initialConfig,
    String? initialTimeframe,
    ValueChanged<IndicatorAlertConfig>? onConfigSaved,
  }) {
    final curConfig = node?.indicatorConfig ??
        initialConfig ??
        _buildCurrentIndicatorConfig();

    AlertIndicatorType tempType = curConfig.indicatorType;
    String tempCondition = curConfig.condition;
    String tempTimeframe = node?.timeframe ?? initialTimeframe ?? _selectedTimeframe;
    Map<String, dynamic> tempParams = Map<String, dynamic>.from(curConfig.params);

    if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.rsi) {
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('period', () => 14);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('source', () => 'Close');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('smoothingType', () => 'RMA');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('level', () => 30.0);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('overbought', () => 70.0);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('oversold', () => 30.0);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('applySignalMa', () => false);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('signalMaType', () => 'EMA');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('signalMaPeriod', () => 9);
    } else if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.macd) {
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('fast', () => 12);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('slow', () => 26);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('signal', () => 9);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('source', () => 'Close');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('fastMaType', () => 'EMA');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('slowMaType', () => 'EMA');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('signalMaType', () => 'EMA');
    } else if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.maCross) {
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('fastPeriod', () => 50);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('slowPeriod', () => 200);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('maType', () => 'EMA');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('fastMaType', () => 'EMA');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('slowMaType', () => 'EMA');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('source', () => 'Close');
    } else if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands) {
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('period', () => 20);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('stdDev', () => 2.0);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('source', () => 'Close');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('maType', () => 'SMA');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('squeezeThreshold', () => 0.015);
    } else if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.stochastic) {
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('kPeriod', () => 14);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('kSlowing', () => 3);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('dPeriod', () => 3);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('dMaType', () => 'SMA');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('oversoldLevel', () => 20.0);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('overboughtLevel', () => 80.0);
    } else if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.supertrend) {
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('period', () => 10);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('multiplier', () => 3.0);
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('source', () => 'HL2');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('atrSmoothing', () => 'RMA');
      tempParams.putIfAbsent('distanceThreshold', () => 1.0);
    }

    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;

    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (ctx) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (modalContext, setModalState) {
            return DraggableScrollableSheet(
              initialChildSize: 0.85,
              minChildSize: 0.5,
              maxChildSize: 0.95,
              expand: false,
              builder: (_, scrollController) {
                return SingleChildScrollView(
                  controller: scrollController,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 30),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      // Handle
                      Center(
                        child: Container(
                          width: 40,
                          height: 4,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: theme.dividerColor,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),

                      // Header
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              const Icon(Icons.tune, color: Colors.amber, size: 22),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Text(
                                '${tempType.label.toUpperCase()} CONFIGURATION',
                                style: AppTheme.sans(
                                  fontSize: 15,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                  color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          IconButton(
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 20),
                            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      Text(
                        'Full parametric control over calculation variables, price source, and condition logic.',
                        style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),

                      // Indicator Type Selector Tabs
                      Text(
                        'SELECT INDICATOR',
                        style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 6),
                      Wrap(
                        spacing: 6,
                        runSpacing: 6,
                        children: AlertIndicatorType.values.map((type) {
                          final isSelected = tempType == type;
                          return ChoiceChip(
                            label: Text(type.label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                            selected: isSelected,
                            onSelected: (val) {
                              if (val) {
                                setModalState(() {
                                  tempType = type;
                                  switch (type) {
                                    case AlertIndicatorType.rsi:
                                      tempCondition = 'crossesBelow';
                                      tempParams = {
                                        'period': 14,
                                        'source': 'Close',
                                        'level': 30.0,
                                        'overbought': 70.0,
                                        'oversold': 30.0,
                                        'applySignalMa': false,
                                        'signalMaType': 'EMA',
                                        'signalMaPeriod': 9,
                                      };
                                      break;
                                    case AlertIndicatorType.macd:
                                      tempCondition = 'bullishSignalCross';
                                      tempParams = {'fast': 12, 'slow': 26, 'signal': 9, 'source': 'Close', 'fastMaType': 'EMA', 'slowMaType': 'EMA', 'signalMaType': 'EMA'};
                                      break;
                                    case AlertIndicatorType.maCross:
                                      tempCondition = 'goldenCross';
                                      tempParams = {'fastPeriod': 50, 'slowPeriod': 200, 'maType': 'EMA', 'fastMaType': 'EMA', 'slowMaType': 'EMA', 'source': 'Close'};
                                      break;
                                    case AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands:
                                      tempCondition = 'lowerBandTouch';
                                      tempParams = {'period': 20, 'stdDev': 2.0, 'source': 'Close', 'maType': 'SMA', 'squeezeThreshold': 0.015};
                                      break;
                                    case AlertIndicatorType.stochastic:
                                      tempCondition = 'bullishOversoldCross';
                                      tempParams = {'kPeriod': 14, 'kSlowing': 3, 'dPeriod': 3, 'dMaType': 'SMA', 'oversoldLevel': 20.0, 'overboughtLevel': 80.0};
                                      break;
                                    case AlertIndicatorType.supertrend:
                                      tempCondition = 'bullishFlip';
                                      tempParams = {'period': 10, 'multiplier': 3.0, 'source': 'HL2', 'atrSmoothing': 'RMA', 'distanceThreshold': 1.0};
                                      break;
                                  }
                                });
                              }
                            },
                          );
                        }).toList(),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),

                      // Timeframe Selector
                      Text(
                        'EVALUATION TIMEFRAME',
                        style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 6),
                      Row(
                        children: _timeframes.map((tf) {
                          final isSel = tempTimeframe == tf;
                          return Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                            child: ChoiceChip(
                              label: Text(tf.toUpperCase(), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                              selected: isSel,
                              onSelected: (_) => setModalState(() => tempTimeframe = tf),
                            ),
                          );
                        }).toList(),
                      ),
                      const Divider(height: 28),

                      // Specific Parametric Controls for selected indicator
                      if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.rsi) ...[
                        _buildRsiParamControls(setModalState, tempParams, tempCondition, (c) => setModalState(() => tempCondition = c), theme, isDark),
                      ] else if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.macd) ...[
                        _buildMacdParamControls(setModalState, tempParams, tempCondition, (c) => setModalState(() => tempCondition = c), theme, isDark),
                      ] else if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.maCross) ...[
                        _buildMaCrossParamControls(setModalState, tempParams, tempCondition, (c) => setModalState(() => tempCondition = c), theme, isDark),
                      ] else if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands) ...[
                        _buildBollingerParamControls(setModalState, tempParams, tempCondition, (c) => setModalState(() => tempCondition = c), theme, isDark),
                      ] else if (tempType == AlertIndicatorType.stochastic) ...[
                        _buildStochParamControls(setModalState, tempParams, tempCondition, (c) => setModalState(() => tempCondition = c), theme, isDark),
                      ] else ...[
                        _buildSupertrendParamControls(setModalState, tempParams, tempCondition, (c) => setModalState(() => tempCondition = c), theme, isDark),
                      ],

                      const SizedBox(height: 24),
                      // Submit / Apply Button
                      SizedBox(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        height: 48,
                        child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                          onPressed: () {
                            final newConfig = IndicatorAlertConfig(
                              indicatorType: tempType,
                              condition: tempCondition,
                              params: tempParams,
                            );
                            if (stage != null && node != null && nodeIdx != null) {
                              setState(() {
                                stage.nodes[nodeIdx] = ChainNode(
                                  id: node.id,
                                  nodeType: AlertType.technicalIndicator,
                                  indicatorConfig: newConfig,
                                  timeframe: tempTimeframe,
                                  isNegated: node.isNegated,
                                  operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
                                );
                              });
                            } else if (onConfigSaved != null) {
                              onConfigSaved(newConfig);
                            }
                            Navigator.pop(ctx);
                          },
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle, size: 18),
                          label: const Text('APPLY & SAVE PARAMETERS', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 13)),
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade700,
                            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                );
              },
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildRsiParamControls(
    StateSetter setModalState,
    Map<String, dynamic> params,
    String condition,
    ValueChanged<String> onConditionChanged,
    ThemeData theme,
    bool isDark,
  ) {
    final bool applySignalMa = params['applySignalMa'] ?? false;
    final bool isCustomLevel = condition == 'crossesAboveLevel' || condition == 'crossesBelowLevel' || condition == 'crossesAbove' || condition == 'crossesBelow';

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        _buildModalStepper('RSI Period (Length)', params['period'] ?? 14, 2, 200, (v) => setModalState(() => params['period'] = v)),
        _buildModalSourceChips(params['source'] ?? 'Close', (s) => setModalState(() => params['source'] = s)),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),

        // Smoothing Type
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Text('Smoothing:', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface)),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              ...['RMA', 'EMA', 'SMA', 'WMA'].map((sm) {
                final isSel = (params['smoothingType'] ?? 'RMA') == sm;
                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                  child: ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(sm, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                    selected: isSel,
                    onSelected: (_) => setModalState(() => params['smoothingType'] = sm),
                    visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                  ),
                );
              }),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),

        // Trigger condition selection
        Text('TRIGGER CONDITION / SIGNAL MIX', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
          initialValue: condition,
          isDense: true,
          isExpanded: true,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
            border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
          ),
          items: const [
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesBelowOversold', child: Text('Crosses Below Oversold Level (< Oversold dip)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesAboveOversold', child: Text('Crosses Above Oversold Level (Recovery / Exit Oversold)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesAboveOverbought', child: Text('Crosses Above Overbought Level (> Overbought spike)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesBelowOverbought', child: Text('Crosses Below Overbought Level (Pullback / Exit Overbought)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesAboveLevel', child: Text('Crosses Above Custom Target Level', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesBelowLevel', child: Text('Crosses Below Custom Target Level', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesAboveCenterline', child: Text('Crosses Above 50 Centerline (Bullish Momentum Shift)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesBelowCenterline', child: Text('Crosses Below 50 Centerline (Bearish Momentum Shift)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'centerlineCross', child: Text('Crosses 50 Centerline (Either Direction)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesAboveSignalMa', child: Text('Crosses Above Signal MA (MA of RSI line)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'crossesBelowSignalMa', child: Text('Crosses Below Signal MA (MA of RSI line)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'inOversold', child: Text('Is in Oversold Zone (< Oversold)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'inOverbought', child: Text('Is in Overbought Zone (> Overbought)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'inBandRange', child: Text('Is Inside Normal Range (Between Oversold & Overbought)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'outsideBandRange', child: Text('Is Outside Normal Range (Extreme Zone)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'rsiTurningUp', child: Text('RSI Hooks Upward (Bullish Momentum Reversal)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: 'rsiTurningDown', child: Text('RSI Hooks Downward (Bearish Momentum Exhaustion)', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
          ],
          onChanged: (c) {
            if (c != null) {
              onConditionChanged(c);
              if (c == 'crossesAboveSignalMa' || c == 'crossesBelowSignalMa') {
                setModalState(() => params['applySignalMa'] = true);
              }
            }
          },
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),

        if (isCustomLevel) ...[
          _buildModalStepper('Custom Target Level', (params['level'] ?? 30.0).toDouble(), 1.0, 99.0, (v) => setModalState(() => params['level'] = v), isDecimal: true, step: 1.0),
        ],
        _buildModalStepper('Oversold Threshold', (params['oversold'] ?? 30.0).toDouble(), 5.0, 50.0, (v) => setModalState(() {
          params['oversold'] = v;
          if (!isCustomLevel) params['level'] = v;
        }), isDecimal: true, step: 1.0),
        _buildModalStepper('Overbought Threshold', (params['overbought'] ?? 70.0).toDouble(), 50.0, 95.0, (v) => setModalState(() {
          params['overbought'] = v;
        }), isDecimal: true, step: 1.0),

        const Divider(height: 20),
        // Signal MA Toggle & Controls
        Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text('Apply Moving Average on RSI (MA of RSI)', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  Text('Calculates moving average directly on RSI curve', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 10, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Switch(
              value: applySignalMa,
              activeThumbColor: Colors.amber,
              onChanged: (v) => setModalState(() => params['applySignalMa'] = v),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        if (applySignalMa) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Row(
            children: [
              Text('Signal MA Type:', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              ...['EMA', 'SMA', 'WMA'].map((t) {
                final isSel = (params['signalMaType'] ?? 'EMA') == t;
                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                  child: ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(t, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                    selected: isSel,
                    onSelected: (_) => setModalState(() => params['signalMaType'] = t),
                    visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                  ),
                );
              }),
            ],
          ),
          _buildModalStepper('Signal MA Period', params['signalMaPeriod'] ?? 9, 2, 100, (v) => setModalState(() => params['signalMaPeriod'] = v)),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

            ...['SMA', 'EMA', 'WMA'].map((t) => Padding(

  Widget _buildStochParamControls(
    StateSetter setModalState,
    Map<String, dynamic> params,
    String condition,
    ValueChanged<String> onConditionChanged,
    ThemeData theme,
    bool isDark,
  ) {
    final double osVal = (params['oversoldLevel'] ?? params['oversold'] ?? 20).toDouble();
    final double obVal = (params['overboughtLevel'] ?? params['overbought'] ?? 80).toDouble();

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        _buildModalStepper('%K Lookback Period', params['kPeriod'] ?? 14, 1, 100, (v) => setModalState(() => params['kPeriod'] = v)),
        _buildModalStepper('%K Slowing (Smoothing)', params['kSlowing'] ?? 3, 1, 50, (v) => setModalState(() => params['kSlowing'] = v)),
        _buildModalStepper('%D Signal MA Period', params['dPeriod'] ?? 3, 1, 50, (v) => setModalState(() => params['dPeriod'] = v)),
        Row(
          children: [
            Text('%D MA Type: ', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            ...['SMA', 'EMA', 'WMA'].map((t) => Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 4),
              child: ChoiceChip(
                label: Text(t, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10)),
                selected: (params['dMaType'] ?? 'SMA') == t,
                onSelected: (_) => setModalState(() => params['dMaType'] = t),
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
              ),
            )),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        _buildModalStepper('Oversold Level', osVal, 5.0, 45.0, (v) => setModalState(() {
          params['oversoldLevel'] = v;
          params['oversold'] = v;
        }), isDecimal: true, step: 1.0),
        _buildModalStepper('Overbought Level', obVal, 55.0, 95.0, (v) => setModalState(() {
          params['overboughtLevel'] = v;

  Widget _buildModalStepper(
    String label,
    num value,
    num min,
    num max,
    ValueChanged<num> onChanged, {
    bool isDecimal = false,
    double step = 1.0,
    String? unit,
  }) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              label,
              style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface),
            ),
          ),
          Row(
            children: [
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.remove_circle_outline, size: 20),
                color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                onPressed: () {
                  final next = value - step;
                  if (next >= min) {
                    onChanged(isDecimal ? double.parse(next.toStringAsFixed(3)) : next.toInt());
                  }
                },
              ),
              InkWell(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                onTap: () async {
                  final displayStr = isDecimal
                      ? (value is double ? value.toStringAsFixed(value < 0.1 ? 3 : 1) : value.toString())
                      : value.toInt().toString();
                  final controller = TextEditingController(text: displayStr);
                  final typed = await showDialog<String>(
                    context: context,
                    builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
                      title: Text('Edit $label', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                      content: TextField(
                        controller: controller,
                        keyboardType: TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: isDecimal),
                        autofocus: true,
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Enter value ($min - $max)',
                          suffixText: unit,
                        ),
                      ),
                      actions: [
                        TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx), child: const Text('Cancel')),
                        ElevatedButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, controller.text), child: const Text('Set')),
                      ],
                    ),
                  );
                  if (typed != null) {
                    final parsed = num.tryParse(typed);
                    if (parsed != null && parsed >= min && parsed <= max) {
                      onChanged(isDecimal ? parsed.toDouble() : parsed.toInt());
                    }
                  }
                },
                child: Container(
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 44),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: theme.dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    '${isDecimal ? value.toStringAsFixed(1) : value.toString()}${unit ?? ''}',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline, size: 20),
                color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                onPressed: () {
                  final next = value + step;
                  if (next <= max) {
                    onChanged(isDecimal ? double.parse(next.toStringAsFixed(3)) : next.toInt());
                  }
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildModalSourceChips(
    String currentSource,
    ValueChanged<String> onChanged,
  ) {
    final sources = ['Close', 'Open', 'High', 'Low', 'HL2', 'HLC3', 'OHLC4'];
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text('Price Source:', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface)),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          SingleChildScrollView(
            scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
            child: Row(
              children: sources.map((src) {
                final isSel = src.toLowerCase() == currentSource.toLowerCase();
                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                  child: ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(src, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: isSel ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal)),
                    selected: isSel,
                    onSelected: (_) => onChanged(src),
                    visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                  ),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _applySavedIndicatorConfig(IndicatorAlertConfig cfg) {
    _selectedIndicator = cfg.indicatorType;
    switch (cfg.indicatorType) {
      case AlertIndicatorType.rsi:
        _rsiCondition = cfg.condition;
        _rsiPeriod = (cfg.params['period'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _rsiPeriod;
        _rsiSource = (cfg.params['source'] as String?) ?? _rsiSource;
        _rsiSmoothingType = (cfg.params['smoothingType'] as String?) ?? _rsiSmoothingType;
        _rsiLevel = (cfg.params['level'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? _rsiLevel;
        _rsiOverbought = (cfg.params['overbought'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? _rsiOverbought;
        _rsiOversold = (cfg.params['oversold'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? _rsiOversold;
        _rsiApplySignalMa = (cfg.params['applySignalMa'] as bool?) ?? _rsiApplySignalMa;
        _rsiSignalMaType = (cfg.params['signalMaType'] as String?) ?? _rsiSignalMaType;
        _rsiSignalMaPeriod = (cfg.params['signalMaPeriod'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _rsiSignalMaPeriod;
        break;
      case AlertIndicatorType.macd:
        _macdCondition = cfg.condition;
        _macdFast = (cfg.params['fast'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _macdFast;
        _macdSlow = (cfg.params['slow'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _macdSlow;
        _macdSignal = (cfg.params['signal'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _macdSignal;
        _macdSource = (cfg.params['source'] as String?) ?? _macdSource;
        _macdFastMaType = (cfg.params['fastMaType'] as String?) ?? _macdFastMaType;
        _macdSlowMaType = (cfg.params['slowMaType'] as String?) ?? _macdSlowMaType;
        _macdSignalMaType = (cfg.params['signalMaType'] as String?) ?? _macdSignalMaType;
        break;
      case AlertIndicatorType.maCross:
        _maCondition = cfg.condition;
        _maFastPeriod = (cfg.params['fastPeriod'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _maFastPeriod;
        _maSlowPeriod = (cfg.params['slowPeriod'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _maSlowPeriod;
        _maType = (cfg.params['maType'] as String?) ?? _maType;
        _maFastMaType = (cfg.params['fastMaType'] as String?) ?? _maFastMaType;
        _maSlowMaType = (cfg.params['slowMaType'] as String?) ?? _maSlowMaType;
        _maSource = (cfg.params['source'] as String?) ?? _maSource;
        break;
      case AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands:
        _bbCondition = cfg.condition;
        _bbPeriod = (cfg.params['period'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _bbPeriod;
        _bbStdDev = (cfg.params['stdDev'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? _bbStdDev;
        _bbSource = (cfg.params['source'] as String?) ?? _bbSource;
        _bbMaType = (cfg.params['maType'] as String?) ?? _bbMaType;
        _bbSqueezeThreshold = (cfg.params['squeezeThreshold'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? _bbSqueezeThreshold;
        break;
      case AlertIndicatorType.stochastic:
        _stochCondition = cfg.condition;
        _stochK = (cfg.params['kPeriod'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _stochK;
        _stochKSlowing = (cfg.params['kSlowing'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _stochKSlowing;
        _stochD = (cfg.params['dPeriod'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _stochD;
        _stochDMaType = (cfg.params['dMaType'] as String?) ?? _stochDMaType;
        _stochOversold = (cfg.params['oversoldLevel'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? (cfg.params['oversold'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? _stochOversold;
        _stochOverbought = (cfg.params['overboughtLevel'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? (cfg.params['overbought'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? _stochOverbought;
        break;
      case AlertIndicatorType.supertrend:
        _stCondition = cfg.condition;
        _stPeriod = (cfg.params['period'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _stPeriod;
        _stMultiplier = (cfg.params['multiplier'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? _stMultiplier;
        _stSource = (cfg.params['source'] as String?) ?? _stSource;
        _stAtrSmoothing = (cfg.params['atrSmoothing'] as String?) ?? _stAtrSmoothing;
        _stDistanceThreshold = (cfg.params['distanceThreshold'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? _stDistanceThreshold;
        break;
    }
  }

  List<Widget> _buildParamBadges(IndicatorAlertConfig config) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final badges = <Widget>[];

    void addBadge(String label, String value, {Color? color}) {
      badges.add(
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: (color ?? theme.colorScheme.primary).withValues(alpha: 0.12),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
            border: Border.all(color: (color ?? theme.colorScheme.primary).withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Text(
                '$label: ',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
              ),
              Text(
                value,
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: color ?? (isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black)),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    switch (config.indicatorType) {
      case AlertIndicatorType.rsi:
        addBadge('Length', '${config.params['period'] ?? 14}');
        addBadge('Source', '${config.params['source'] ?? 'Close'}');
        if (config.params['smoothingType'] != null && config.params['smoothingType'] != 'RMA') {
          addBadge('Smooth', '${config.params['smoothingType']}', color: Colors.cyan);
        }
        addBadge('OS', '${config.params['oversold'] ?? 30}');
        addBadge('OB', '${config.params['overbought'] ?? 70}');
        if (config.params['level'] != null && (config.condition.contains('Level') || config.condition == 'crossesAbove' || config.condition == 'crossesBelow')) {
          addBadge('Lvl', '${config.params['level']}', color: Colors.deepOrangeAccent);
        }
        if (config.params['applySignalMa'] == true) {
          addBadge('Signal MA', '${config.params['signalMaType'] ?? "EMA"}(${config.params['signalMaPeriod'] ?? 9})', color: Colors.amber);
        }
        addBadge('Signal', config.condition, color: Colors.green);
        break;
      case AlertIndicatorType.macd:
        addBadge('Fast', '${config.params['fastMaType'] ?? "EMA"}(${config.params['fast'] ?? 12})');
        addBadge('Slow', '${config.params['slowMaType'] ?? "EMA"}(${config.params['slow'] ?? 26})');
        addBadge('Signal', '${config.params['signalMaType'] ?? "EMA"}(${config.params['signal'] ?? 9})');
        addBadge('Source', '${config.params['source'] ?? 'Close'}');
        addBadge('Signal', config.condition, color: Colors.green);
        break;
      case AlertIndicatorType.maCross:
        final fastType = config.params['fastMaType'] ?? config.params['maType'] ?? 'EMA';
        final slowType = config.params['slowMaType'] ?? config.params['maType'] ?? 'EMA';
        addBadge('Fast', '$fastType(${config.params['fastPeriod'] ?? 50})');
        addBadge('Slow', '$slowType(${config.params['slowPeriod'] ?? 200})');
        addBadge('Source', '${config.params['source'] ?? 'Close'}');
        addBadge('Signal', config.condition, color: Colors.green);
        break;
      case AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands:
        addBadge('Period', '${config.params['period'] ?? 20}');
        addBadge('StdDev', '${config.params['stdDev'] ?? 2.0}');
        if (config.params['maType'] != null && config.params['maType'] != 'SMA') {
          addBadge('Basis', '${config.params['maType']}', color: Colors.cyan);
        }
        addBadge('Source', '${config.params['source'] ?? 'Close'}');
        if (config.condition == 'squeeze' || config.condition == 'squeezeBreakout') {
          final sqz = ((config.params['squeezeThreshold'] ?? 0.015) as num).toDouble() * 100;
          addBadge('Squeeze', '${sqz.toStringAsFixed(1)}%', color: Colors.amber);
        }
        addBadge('Signal', config.condition, color: Colors.green);
        break;
      case AlertIndicatorType.stochastic:
        final k = config.params['kPeriod'] ?? 14;
        final kSlowing = config.params['kSlowing'] ?? 3;
        final d = config.params['dPeriod'] ?? 3;
        final dMaType = config.params['dMaType'] ?? 'SMA';
        addBadge('%K', '$k');
        if (kSlowing != 1) addBadge('Smooth', '$kSlowing');
        addBadge('%D', '$d($dMaType)');
        addBadge('OS', '${config.params['oversoldLevel'] ?? config.params['oversold'] ?? 20}');
        addBadge('OB', '${config.params['overboughtLevel'] ?? config.params['overbought'] ?? 80}');
        addBadge('Signal', config.condition, color: Colors.green);
        break;
      case AlertIndicatorType.supertrend:
        addBadge('ATR', '${config.params['period'] ?? 10}');
        addBadge('Mult', '${config.params['multiplier'] ?? 3.0}');
        if (config.params['atrSmoothing'] != null && config.params['atrSmoothing'] != 'RMA') {
          addBadge('Smooth', '${config.params['atrSmoothing']}', color: Colors.cyan);
        }
        if (config.params['source'] != null && config.params['source'] != 'HL2') {
          addBadge('Source', '${config.params['source']}');
        }
        if (config.condition.contains('Distance')) {
          addBadge('Dist', '${config.params['distanceThreshold'] ?? 1.0}%', color: Colors.amber);
        }
        addBadge('Signal', config.condition, color: Colors.green);
        break;
    }

    return badges;
  }

  Widget _nodeTypeChip(
    int stageIdx,
    int nodeIdx,
    ChainStage stage,
    ChainNode node,
    AlertType type,
    String label,
  ) {
    final isSelected = node.nodeType == type;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        if (!isSelected) {
          setState(() {
            ChainNode newNode;
            if (type == AlertType.priceLevel) {
              newNode = ChainNode(
                id: node.id,
                nodeType: AlertType.priceLevel,
                targetPrice: widget.currentPrice,
                condition: AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
                isNegated: node.isNegated,
                operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
              );
            } else if (type == AlertType.candlestickPattern) {
              newNode = ChainNode(
                id: node.id,
                nodeType: AlertType.candlestickPattern,
                candlestickPattern: CandlestickPattern.bullishEngulfing,
                timeframe: '15m',
                isNegated: node.isNegated,
                operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
              );
            } else {
              newNode = ChainNode(
                id: node.id,
                nodeType: AlertType.technicalIndicator,
                indicatorConfig: IndicatorAlertConfig(
                  indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.rsi,
                  condition: 'crossesBelow',
                  params: {
                    'period': 14,
                    'source': 'Close',
                    'level': 30.0,
                    'overbought': 70.0,
                    'oversold': 30.0,
                    'applySignalMa': false,
                    'signalMaType': 'EMA',
                    'signalMaPeriod': 9,
                  },
                ),
                timeframe: '15m',
                isNegated: node.isNegated,
                operatorToPrevious: node.operatorToPrevious,
              );
            }
            stage.nodes[nodeIdx] = newNode;
          });
        }
      },
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? Colors.amber : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected ? Colors.amber : theme.dividerColor,
          ),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 10,
            fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w500,
            color: isSelected ? Colors.black : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _addStage() {
    setState(() {
      final newStageIdx = _chainStages.length + 1;
      _chainStages.add(
        ChainStage(
          id: 'stage_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
          name: 'Stage $newStageIdx Confirmation',
          logicOperator: 'AND',
          nodes: [
            ChainNode(
              id: 'node_${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
              nodeType: AlertType.priceLevel,
              targetPrice: widget.currentPrice,
              condition: AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    });
  }

  void _removeStage(int stageIdx) {
    if (_chainStages.length > 1) {
      setState(() => _chainStages.removeAt(stageIdx));
    }
  }

  void _addNodeToStage(int stageIdx) {
    setState(() {
      _chainStages[stageIdx].nodes.add(
        ChainNode(
          id: 'node_${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
          nodeType: AlertType.technicalIndicator,
          indicatorConfig: IndicatorAlertConfig(
            indicatorType: AlertIndicatorType.rsi,
            condition: 'crossesBelow',
            params: {
              'period': 14,
              'source': 'Close',
              'level': 30.0,
              'overbought': 70.0,
              'oversold': 30.0,
              'applySignalMa': false,
              'signalMaType': 'EMA',
              'signalMaPeriod': 9,
            },
          ),
          timeframe: '15m',
          operatorToPrevious: 'AND',
        ),
      );
    });
  }

  void _removeNodeFromStage(int stageIdx, int nodeIdx) {
    if (_chainStages[stageIdx].nodes.length > 1) {
      setState(() => _chainStages[stageIdx].nodes.removeAt(nodeIdx));
    }
  }

  void _applyStrategyTemplate(String template) {
    setState(() {
      if (template == 'breakout_retest') {
        final breakoutLevel = widget.currentPrice + (_pipValue * 20);
        final retestLevel = widget.currentPrice + (_pipValue * 15);
        _chainStages.clear();
        _chainStages.addAll([
          ChainStage(

            nodes: [
              ChainNode(
                id: 'n_1',

                condition: AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
                operatorToPrevious: 'AND',
              ),
            ],
          ),
          ChainStage(
            id: 'stage_2',
            name: 'Pullback Retest (Level 2)',
            logicOperator: 'AND',
            nodes: [
              ChainNode(
                id: 'n_2',

                operatorToPrevious: 'AND',

          ChainStage(

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/market_data_api.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

class CurrencyMatrixScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CurrencyMatrixScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<CurrencyMatrixScreen> createState() => _CurrencyMatrixScreenState();
}

class _CurrencyMatrixScreenState extends State<CurrencyMatrixScreen> {
  final List<String> _currencies = ['EUR', 'USD', 'GBP', 'JPY', 'AUD', 'CAD', 'CHF'];
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;
  Map<String, TickData> _ticks = {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      final symbols = [
        'EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'USDJPY', 'AUDUSD', 'USDCAD', 'USDCHF',
        'EURGBP', 'EURJPY', 'GBPJPY', 'EURAUD', 'EURCHF',
      ];
      final res = await MarketDataApi.getBatchTicks(symbols);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _ticks = res;
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _loading = false;
          _error = e.toString();
        });
      }
    }
  }

  double? _getRate(String base, String quote) {
    if (base == quote) return 1.0;
    final direct = '$base$quote';
    if (_ticks.containsKey(direct)) return _ticks[direct]!.mid;
    final inverse = '$quote$base';
    if (_ticks.containsKey(inverse) && _ticks[inverse]!.mid > 0) {
      return 1.0 / _ticks[inverse]!.mid;
    }
    // Cross calculation via USD
    final baseUsd = _getRate(base, 'USD');
    final quoteUsd = _getRate(quote, 'USD');
    if (baseUsd != null && quoteUsd != null && quoteUsd > 0) {
      return baseUsd / quoteUsd;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final bg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF0F172A) : const Color(0xFFF8FAFC);
    final textPrimary = isDark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF0F172A);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: bg,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E293B) : Colors.white,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded, size: 18, color: textPrimary),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
        title: Text(
          'CURRENCY MATRIX',
          style: AppTheme.sans(
            fontSize: 14,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            letterSpacing: 1.2,
            color: textPrimary,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 20, color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)),
            onPressed: _load,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
        ],
      ),
      body: _loading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)))
          : _error != null
              ? Center(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      const Icon(Icons.cloud_off_rounded, size: 48, color: Colors.redAccent),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Text('Failed to load matrix rates', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 15, color: textPrimary)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      ElevatedButton(
                        onPressed: _load,
                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                          foregroundColor: Colors.black,
                        ),
                        child: const Text('RETRY'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                )
              : SingleChildScrollView(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      child: Table(
                        defaultColumnWidth: const FixedColumnWidth(72),
                        border: TableBorder.all(
                          color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF334155) : const Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                          width: 1,
                        ),
                        children: [
                          // Header row
                          TableRow(
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E293B) : const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                            ),
                            children: [
                              const TableCell(
                                child: Padding(
                                  padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                                  child: Center(
                                    child: Text('BASE', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 11)),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              ..._currencies.map((c) => TableCell(
                                    child: Padding(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                                      child: Center(
                                        child: Text(
                                          c,
                                          style: AppTheme.sans(
                                            fontSize: 11,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                            color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  )),
                            ],
                          ),
                          // Data rows
                          ..._currencies.map((base) {
                            return TableRow(
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF0F172A) : Colors.white,
                              ),
                              children: [
                                TableCell(
                                  child: Container(
                                    color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E293B) : const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                                    child: Center(
                                      child: Text(
                                        base,
                                        style: AppTheme.sans(
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                          color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                ..._currencies.map((quote) {
                                  final isSelf = base == quote;
                                  final rate = _getRate(base, quote);
                                  return TableCell(
                                    child: Container(
                                      color: isSelf
                                          ? (isDark ? const Color(0xFF152033) : const Color(0xFFF1F5F9))
                                          : null,
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10, horizontal: 2),
                                      child: Center(
                                        child: Text(
                                          isSelf
                                              ? '1.0000'
                                              : rate != null
                                                  ? rate.toStringAsFixed(rate > 50 ? 2 : 4)
                                                  : '--',
                                          style: AppTheme.mono(
                                            context: context,
                                            fontSize: 11,
                                            fontWeight: isSelf ? FontWeight.w500 : FontWeight.w700,
                                            color: isSelf ? Colors.grey : textPrimary,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  );
                                }),
                              ],
                            );
                          }),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../services/market_data_api.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

class EconomicCalendarScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const EconomicCalendarScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<EconomicCalendarScreen> createState() => _EconomicCalendarScreenState();
}

class _EconomicCalendarScreenState extends State<EconomicCalendarScreen> {
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;
  List<CalendarEvent> _events = [];

  String _selectedImportance = 'all';
  final List<String> _importanceOptions = ['all', 'high', 'medium', 'low'];

  String _selectedCountry = 'ALL';
  final List<String> _countryOptions = ['ALL', 'US', 'EU', 'GB', 'JP', 'CA', 'AU', 'CH'];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      final countries = _selectedCountry == 'ALL' ? 'US,EU,GB,JP,CA,AU,CH' : _selectedCountry;
      final importance = _selectedImportance == 'all' ? 'low' : _selectedImportance;
      final events = await MarketDataApi.getCalendar(
        countries: countries,
        importance: importance,
      );

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _events = events;
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      debugPrint('Calendar load error: $e\n$stack');
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _loading = false;
          _error = e.toString();
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Color _getImportanceColor(String imp) {
    switch (imp.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'high':
        return const Color(0xFFFF5252);
      case 'medium':
        return const Color(0xFFFFAB00);
      case 'low':
      default:
        return const Color(0xFF69F0AE);
    }
  }

  String _getCountryFlag(String code) {
    switch (code.toUpperCase()) {
      case 'US': return '🇺🇸';
      case 'EU': return '🇪🇺';
      case 'GB': return '🇬🇧';
      case 'JP': return '🇯🇵';
      case 'CA': return '🇨🇦';
      case 'AU': return '🇦🇺';
      case 'CH': return '🇨🇭';
      case 'DE': return '🇩🇪';
      case 'CN': return '🇨🇳';
      case 'NZ': return '🇳🇿';
      default: return '🌐';
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final bg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF0F172A) : const Color(0xFFF8FAFC);
    final cardBg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E293B) : Colors.white;
    final textPrimary = isDark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF0F172A);
    final textSecondary = isDark ? Colors.grey[400]! : Colors.grey[600]!;

    // Filter events locally by importance if 'all' is selected but user clicks high
    List<CalendarEvent> displayList = _events;
    if (_selectedImportance != 'all') {
      displayList = _events.where((e) => e.importance.toLowerCase() == _selectedImportance).toList();
    }

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: bg,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E293B) : Colors.white,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded, size: 18, color: textPrimary),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
        title: Text(
          'ECONOMIC CALENDAR',
          style: AppTheme.sans(
            fontSize: 14,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            letterSpacing: 1.2,
            color: textPrimary,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 20, color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)),
            onPressed: _load,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
        ],
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          // Filter Bar
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
            color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF152033) : const Color(0xFFEEF2F6),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                // Importance Filter
                Expanded(
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                    child: Row(
                      children: _importanceOptions.map((imp) {
                        final isSelected = _selectedImportance == imp;
                        final color = imp == 'high'
                            ? const Color(0xFFFF5252)
                            : imp == 'medium'
                                ? const Color(0xFFFFAB00)
                                : imp == 'low'
                                    ? const Color(0xFF69F0AE)
                                    : const Color(0xFF00E5FF);

                        return Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                          child: ChoiceChip(
                            label: Text(
                              imp.toUpperCase(),
                              style: AppTheme.sans(
                                fontSize: 11,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                color: isSelected ? Colors.black : (isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87),
                              ),
                            ),
                            selected: isSelected,
                            selectedColor: color,
                            backgroundColor: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E293B) : Colors.white,
                            onSelected: (val) {
                              if (val) {
                                setState(() => _selectedImportance = imp);
                              }
                            },
                          ),
                        );
                      }).toList(),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

                // Country Dropdown Filter
                PopupMenuButton<String>(
                  initialValue: _selectedCountry,
                  onSelected: (c) {
                    setState(() => _selectedCountry = c);

                  },
