                      color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E293B) : Colors.white,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          _selectedCountry == 'ALL' ? '🌐 ALL' : '${_getCountryFlag(_selectedCountry)} $_selectedCountry',
                          style: AppTheme.sans(
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 4),
                        const Icon(Icons.arrow_drop_down, size: 16, color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  itemBuilder: (_) => _countryOptions
                      .map((c) => PopupMenuItem(
                            value: c,
                            child: Text(c == 'ALL' ? '🌐 ALL' : '${_getCountryFlag(c)} $c'),

                                              color: impColor,
                                            ),
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                        // Time
                                        Text(
                                          '$dateStr $timeStr',
                                          style: AppTheme.mono(
                                            context: context,
                                            fontSize: 11,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                            color: textSecondary,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                    // Event Name
                                    Text(
                                      event.name,
                                      style: AppTheme.sans(
                                        fontSize: 14,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        color: textPrimary,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                                    // Actual / Forecast / Previous Row
                                    Row(
                                      children: [
                                        _buildMetric('ACTUAL', event.actual != null ? '${event.actual}${event.unit ?? ''}' : '--', textPrimary, textSecondary),
                                        const SizedBox(width: 20),
                                        _buildMetric('FORECAST', event.forecast != null ? '${event.forecast}${event.unit ?? ''}' : '--', textPrimary, textSecondary),
                                        const SizedBox(width: 20),
                                        _buildMetric('PREVIOUS', event.previous != null ? '${event.previous}${event.unit ?? ''}' : '--', textPrimary, textSecondary),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              );
                            },
                          ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMetric(String label, String value, Color textPrimary, Color textSecondary) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: textSecondary),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 2),
        Text(
          value,
          style: AppTheme.mono(
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
            color: textPrimary,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/market_data_api.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

class FinancialNewsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const FinancialNewsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<FinancialNewsScreen> createState() => _FinancialNewsScreenState();
}

class _FinancialNewsScreenState extends State<FinancialNewsScreen> {
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;
  List<NewsArticle> _articles = [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      final articles = await MarketDataApi.getNews(limit: 30);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _articles = articles;
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _loading = false;
          _error = e.toString();
        });
      }
    }
  }

  String _timeAgo(DateTime date) {
    final diff = DateTime.now().difference(date);
    if (diff.inMinutes < 60) {
      return '${diff.inMinutes}m ago';
    } else if (diff.inHours < 24) {
      return '${diff.inHours}h ago';
    } else {
      return '${diff.inDays}d ago';
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final bg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF0F172A) : const Color(0xFFF8FAFC);
    final cardBg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E293B) : Colors.white;
    final textPrimary = isDark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF0F172A);
    final textSecondary = isDark ? Colors.grey[400]! : Colors.grey[600]!;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: bg,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E293B) : Colors.white,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded, size: 18, color: textPrimary),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
        title: Text(
          'FINANCIAL NEWS',
          style: AppTheme.sans(
            fontSize: 14,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            letterSpacing: 1.2,
            color: textPrimary,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 20, color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)),
            onPressed: _load,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
        ],
      ),
      body: _loading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)))
          : _error != null
              ? Center(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      const Icon(Icons.cloud_off_rounded, size: 48, color: Colors.redAccent),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Text('Failed to load financial news', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 15, color: textPrimary)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      ElevatedButton(
                        onPressed: _load,
                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                          foregroundColor: Colors.black,
                        ),
                        child: const Text('RETRY'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                )
              : _articles.isEmpty
                  ? Center(
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.newspaper_rounded, size: 48, color: textSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          Text('No news articles available at this time', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 14, color: textPrimary)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          OutlinedButton.icon(
                            onPressed: _load,
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 16),
                            label: const Text('REFRESH'),
                            style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                              foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                              side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    )
                  : RefreshIndicator(
                      color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                      onRefresh: _load,
                      child: ListView.builder(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                        itemCount: _articles.length,
                        itemBuilder: (context, i) {
                          final item = _articles[i];
                          return Container(
                            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: cardBg,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              border: Border.all(
                                color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF334155) : const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                              ),
                            ),
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Row(
                                  children: [
                                    Container(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                        color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                                      ),
                                      child: Text(
                                        item.publisher.isNotEmpty ? item.publisher.toUpperCase() : 'MARKET',
                                        style: AppTheme.sans(
                                          fontSize: 10,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                          color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                                        ),

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../models/ai_models.dart';
import '../models/drawing_models.dart';
import '../models/market_models.dart';
import '../services/alert_manager.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../widgets/candlestick_chart.dart';
import '../widgets/timeframe_selector.dart';
import 'create_alert_sheet.dart';

class FullscreenChartScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String symbol;
  final List<BiquoteCandle> candles;
  final double currentPrice;
  final int precision;
  final String interval;
  final AlertManager alertManager;
  final bool isDark;
  final ValueChanged<String> onSelectTimeframe;
  final VoidCallback? onLoadMoreHistory;
  final bool isLoadingMoreHistory;
  final AgentSignal? signalOverlay;

  const FullscreenChartScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.symbol,
    required this.candles,
    required this.currentPrice,
    required this.precision,
    required this.interval,
    required this.alertManager,
    required this.isDark,
    required this.onSelectTimeframe,
    this.onLoadMoreHistory,
    this.isLoadingMoreHistory = false,
    this.signalOverlay,
  });

  @override
  State<FullscreenChartScreen> createState() => _FullscreenChartScreenState();
}

class _FullscreenChartScreenState extends State<FullscreenChartScreen> {
  late String _currentInterval;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _currentInterval = widget.interval;
  }

  void _openCreateAlertSheet({double? targetPrice, ChartDrawing? fromDrawing}) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => CreateAlertSheet(
        symbol: widget.symbol,
        currentPrice: widget.currentPrice,
        initialTargetPrice: targetPrice,
        drawingId: fromDrawing?.id,
        precision: widget.precision,
        alarmService: widget.alertManager.alarmService,
        onAlertCreated: ({
          required String symbol,
          AlertType alertType = AlertType.priceLevel,
          double targetPrice = 0.0,
          AlertCondition condition = AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
          CandlestickPattern? candlestickPattern,
          IndicatorAlertConfig? indicatorConfig,
          MultiStepConfig? multiStepConfig,
          String timeframe = '15m',
          String note = '',
          String ringtoneTitle = 'Default Alarm',
          String? ringtoneUri,
          String? drawingId,
        }) {
          final alert = widget.alertManager.addAlert(
            symbol: symbol,
            alertType: alertType,
            targetPrice: targetPrice,
            condition: condition,
            candlestickPattern: candlestickPattern,
            indicatorConfig: indicatorConfig,
            multiStepConfig: multiStepConfig,
            timeframe: timeframe,
            note: note,
            currentPrice: widget.currentPrice,
            ringtoneTitle: ringtoneTitle,
            ringtoneUri: ringtoneUri,
            drawingId: drawingId,
          );
          if (fromDrawing != null) {
            fromDrawing.alertId = alert.id;
            setState(() {});
          }
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = widget.isDark;
    final displayPair = widget.symbol.length == 6
        ? '${widget.symbol.substring(0, 3)}/${widget.symbol.substring(3)}'
        : widget.symbol;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: isDark ? AppTheme.darkCanvas : AppTheme.lightCanvas,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // Top Bar: Symbol, Timeframes, and Exit Fullscreen Button
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1,
                border: Border(
                  bottom: BorderSide(
                    color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder,
                    width: 1,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Text(
                    displayPair,
                    style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      widget.currentPrice.toStringAsFixed(widget.precision),
                      style: AppTheme.mono(
                        context: context,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  // Timeframe pills inside top bar (wrapped in Expanded for horizontal ListView)
                  Expanded(
                    child: SizedBox(
                      height: 32,
                      child: TimeframeSelector(
                        selectedTimeframe: _currentInterval,
                        onSelected: (tf) {
                          setState(() => _currentInterval = tf);
                          widget.onSelectTimeframe(tf);
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),

                  // Exit Fullscreen
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.fullscreen_exit),
                    tooltip: 'Exit Fullscreen',
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            // Fullscreen Candlestick Chart Area
            Expanded(
              child: CandlestickChart(
                symbol: widget.symbol,
                candles: widget.candles,
                currentPrice: widget.currentPrice,
                alerts: widget.alertManager.activeAlerts
                    .where((a) => a.symbol == widget.symbol)
                    .toList(),
                precision: widget.precision,
                interval: _currentInterval,
                onLoadMoreHistory: widget.onLoadMoreHistory,
                isLoadingMoreHistory: widget.isLoadingMoreHistory,
                isFullscreen: true,
                onToggleFullscreen: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                signalOverlay: widget.signalOverlay,
                onAddAlertFromDrawing: (drawing, targetPrice) {
                  _openCreateAlertSheet(targetPrice: targetPrice, fromDrawing: drawing);
                },
                onDrawingPriceUpdated: (drawingId, newPrice) {
                  widget.alertManager.updateAlertForDrawing(
                    drawingId,
                    newPrice,
                    currentPrice: widget.currentPrice,
                  );
                },
                onDrawingDeleted: (drawingId) {
                  widget.alertManager.removeAlertForDrawing(drawingId);
                },
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import 'package:flutter_markdown/flutter_markdown.dart';
import '../models/ai_models.dart';
import '../services/history_storage.dart';
import '../services/strategy_storage.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

class HistoryScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback? onNavigateToChart;
  const HistoryScreen({super.key, this.onNavigateToChart});

  @override
  State<HistoryScreen> createState() => _HistoryScreenState();
}

class _HistoryScreenState extends State<HistoryScreen> {
  final _historyStorage = HistoryStorage();
  final _strategyStorage = StrategyStorage();
  List<PipelineRunResult>? _history;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadHistory();
  }

  Future<void> _loadHistory() async {
    final history = await _historyStorage.getHistory();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _history = history;
      });
    }
  }

  void _clearHistory() async {
    await _historyStorage.clearHistory();
    _loadHistory();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text('Analysis History', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
        backgroundColor: theme.colorScheme.surface,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
            onPressed: () {
              if (_history?.isNotEmpty == true) {
                _showClearDialog(context);
              }
            },
          )
        ],
      ),
      body: _history == null
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          : _history!.isEmpty
              ? Center(
                  child: Text(
                    'No past analyses found.',
                    style: TextStyle(color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
                  ),
                )
              : ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  itemCount: _history!.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final item = _history![index];
                    return _buildHistoryCard(item, theme, isDark);
                  },
                ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHistoryCard(PipelineRunResult item, ThemeData theme, bool isDark) {
    final dateStr = DateFormat('MMM d, yyyy • HH:mm').format(item.timestamp);
    final sig = item.finalSignal;
    
    final dirColor = sig.direction == SignalDirection.buy 
        ? AppTheme.darkBullish 
        : (sig.direction == SignalDirection.sell ? AppTheme.darkBearish : Colors.amber);

    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : theme.colorScheme.surface,
      elevation: isDark ? 0 : 2,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        side: BorderSide(
          color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : theme.colorScheme.outline.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
        ),
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Text(
                  '${item.symbol} • ${item.timeframe}',
                  style: AppTheme.sans(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                  ),
                ),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: dirColor.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                    border: Border.all(color: dirColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    sig.direction.name.toUpperCase(),
                    style: AppTheme.sans(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: dirColor,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              item.strategy.name,
              style: TextStyle(color: theme.colorScheme.primary, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              children: [
                _buildPriceCol('Entry', sig.entryPrice, theme),
                _buildPriceCol('TP', sig.takeProfit, theme),
                _buildPriceCol('SL', sig.stopLoss, theme),
              ],
            ),
            const Divider(height: 24),
            ExpansionTile(
              title: Text('View Full Analysis', style: TextStyle(color: theme.colorScheme.primary, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
              tilePadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
              children: [
                MarkdownBody(
                  data: sig.analysis.isNotEmpty ? sig.analysis : 'No text analysis provided.',
                  selectable: true,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () async {
                      await _strategyStorage.saveLastChartSignal(sig);
                      widget.onNavigateToChart?.call();
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.layers, size: 18),
                    label: const Text('Overlay on Chart'),
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: dirColor,
                      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              dateStr,
              style: TextStyle(color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant, fontSize: 12),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPriceCol(String label, double val, ThemeData theme) {
    return Expanded(
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)),
          const SizedBox(height: 2),
          Text(val.toStringAsFixed(4), style: AppTheme.mono(fontSize: 13)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showClearDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Clear History?'),
        content: const Text('This will delete all past analyses.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.pop(ctx);
              _clearHistory();
            },
            child: const Text('Clear', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

File: instrument_search_sheet.dart
------------------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../models/market_models.dart';
import '../services/favorites_service.dart';
import '../services/market_data_api.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

class InstrumentSearchSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final String currentSymbol;
  final ValueChanged<String> onSelectSymbol;
  final Map<String, BiquoteTick> ticks;

  const InstrumentSearchSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.currentSymbol,
    required this.onSelectSymbol,
    this.ticks = const {},
  });

  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String currentSymbol,
    required ValueChanged<String> onSelectSymbol,
    Map<String, BiquoteTick> ticks = const {},
  }) {
    return showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => InstrumentSearchSheet(
        currentSymbol: currentSymbol,
        onSelectSymbol: onSelectSymbol,
        ticks: ticks,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<InstrumentSearchSheet> createState() => _InstrumentSearchSheetState();
}

class _InstrumentSearchSheetState extends State<InstrumentSearchSheet> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  final FavoritesService _favService = FavoritesService();

  List<BiquoteInstrument> _allInstruments = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  String _selectedCategory = 'ALL';
  String _searchQuery = '';

  final List<String> _categories = [
    'ALL',
    '⭐ FAVORITES',
    'FOREX',
    'CRYPTO',
    'COMMODITY',
    'INDEX',
    'STOCK',
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _favService.addListener(_onFavoritesChanged);
    _searchController.addListener(_onSearchChanged);
    _loadInstruments();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _favService.removeListener(_onFavoritesChanged);
    _searchController.removeListener(_onSearchChanged);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onFavoritesChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _onSearchChanged() {
    setState(() {
      _searchQuery = _searchController.text.trim().toLowerCase();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadInstruments() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);
    final list = await MarketDataApi.getAllSymbols();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _allInstruments = list;
        _loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  List<BiquoteInstrument> _getFilteredList() {
    final query = _searchQuery;
    final cat = _selectedCategory;

    return _allInstruments.where((inst) {
      // 1. Category check
      if (cat == '⭐ FAVORITES') {
        if (!_favService.isFavorite(inst.symbol)) return false;
      } else if (cat != 'ALL') {
        final t = inst.type.toUpperCase();
        if (cat == 'COMMODITY' && (t == 'COMMODITY' || t == 'METALS')) {
          // match
        } else if (cat == 'INDEX' && (t == 'INDEX' || t == 'INDICES')) {
          // match
        } else if (t != cat) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      // 2. Search query check
      if (query.isNotEmpty) {
        final symbolMatch = inst.symbol.toLowerCase().contains(query);
        final descMatch = inst.description.toLowerCase().contains(query);
        if (!symbolMatch && !descMatch) return false;
      }

      return true;
    }).toList();
  }

  Color _getCategoryColor(String type) {
    switch (type.toUpperCase()) {
      case 'FOREX':
        return const Color(0xFF00E5FF);
      case 'CRYPTO':
        return const Color(0xFFB388FF);
      case 'COMMODITY':
      case 'METALS':
        return const Color(0xFFFFD700);
      case 'INDEX':
      case 'INDICES':
        return const Color(0xFFFF9100);
      case 'STOCK':
        return const Color(0xFF69F0AE);
      default:
        return Colors.grey;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final bg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF0F172A) : Colors.white;
    final headerBg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E293B) : const Color(0xFFF1F5F9);
    final textPrimary = isDark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF0F172A);
    final textSecondary = isDark ? Colors.grey[400]! : Colors.grey[600]!;

    final filtered = _getFilteredList();
    final favCount = _allInstruments.where((i) => _favService.isFavorite(i.symbol)).length;

    return Container(
      height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.88,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bg,
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
            blurRadius: 20,
            offset: const Offset(0, -5),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          // Drag handle pill
          Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10, bottom: 6),
            width: 36,
            height: 4,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
            ),
          ),

          // Header
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'ALL INSTRUMENTS',
                      style: AppTheme.sans(
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        letterSpacing: 0.8,
                        color: textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Text(
                      _loading
                          ? 'Loading catalog...'
                          : '${_allInstruments.length} instruments available · $favCount favorites',
                      style: AppTheme.sans(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        color: textSecondary,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                IconButton(
                  icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: textSecondary),
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          // Search Field
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 6),
            child: TextField(
              controller: _searchController,
              onChanged: (val) => setState(() => _searchQuery = val.trim().toLowerCase()),
              style: AppTheme.mono(
                context: context,
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: textPrimary,
              ),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Search symbols (e.g. EUR, Gold, BTC, AAPL)...',
                hintStyle: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 13, color: textSecondary),
                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search, size: 20, color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)),
                suffixIcon: _searchQuery.isNotEmpty
                    ? IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.clear, size: 18),
                        onPressed: () => _searchController.clear(),
                      )
                    : null,
                filled: true,
                fillColor: headerBg,
                contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                ),
                focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF00E5FF), width: 1.5),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),

          // Category Chips Row
          Container(
            height: 42,
            margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
            child: ListView.separated(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
              itemCount: _categories.length,
              separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(width: 6),
              itemBuilder: (context, i) {
                final cat = _categories[i];
                final isSelected = _selectedCategory == cat;
                return ChoiceChip(
                  label: Text(
                    cat,
                    style: AppTheme.sans(
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: isSelected
                          ? Colors.black
                          : (isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87),
                    ),
                  ),
                  selected: isSelected,
                  selectedColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                  backgroundColor: headerBg,
                  onSelected: (val) {
                    if (val) setState(() => _selectedCategory = cat);
                  },
                );
              },
            ),
          ),

          const Divider(height: 1),

          // Instruments List
          Expanded(
            child: _loading
                ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)))
                : filtered.isEmpty
                    ? Center(
                        child: Column(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            const Icon(Icons.search_off_rounded, size: 48, color: Colors.grey),
                            const SizedBox(height: 12),
                            Text(
                              _selectedCategory == '⭐ FAVORITES'
                                  ? 'No favorites yet.\nTap the star on any instrument to add it!'
                                  : 'No instruments found',
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 14, color: textSecondary),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      )
                    : ListView.builder(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
                        itemCount: filtered.length,
                        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                          final inst = filtered[index];
                          final isFav = _favService.isFavorite(inst.symbol);
                          final isCurrent = inst.symbol == widget.currentSymbol;
                          final typeColor = _getCategoryColor(inst.type);

                          final tick = widget.ticks[inst.symbol];
                          final displaySymbol = inst.symbol.length == 6 &&
                                  inst.type.toUpperCase() == 'FOREX'
                              ? '${inst.symbol.substring(0, 3)}/${inst.symbol.substring(3)}'
                              : inst.symbol;

                          return Material(
                            color: isCurrent
                                ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                                : Colors.transparent,
                            child: Container(
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                border: Border(
                                  bottom: BorderSide(
                                    color: isDark
                                        ? const Color(0xFF1E293B)
                                        : const Color(0xFFEEF2F6),
                                    width: 0.8,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  // Dedicated Star Favorite Toggle Button
                                  InkWell(
                                    onTap: () async {
                                      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                                      await _favService.toggleFavorite(inst.symbol);
                                    },
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                                    child: Padding(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                                      child: Icon(
                                        isFav ? Icons.star_rounded : Icons.star_outline_rounded,
                                        color: isFav ? const Color(0xFFFFD700) : Colors.grey[600],
                                        size: 24,
                                      ),

                                  ),

                                  // Main Item Selection Area

                                    child: InkWell(

                                        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                                        widget.onSelectSymbol(inst.symbol);
                                        Navigator.of(context).pop();

                                        child: Row(
                                          children: [

                                            Expanded(
                                              child: Column(
                                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                                children: [
                                                  Row(
                                                    children: [
                                                      Text(
                                                        displaySymbol,
                                                        style: AppTheme.mono(
                                                          context: context,
                                                          fontSize: 14,
                                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                                          color: isCurrent
                                                              ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF)
                                                              : textPrimary,
                                                        ),
                                                      ),
                                                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                                      Container(
                                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                                            horizontal: 5, vertical: 1.5),
                                                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                                          color: typeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                                                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                                                          border: Border.all(
                                                              color: typeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                                                              width: 0.8),
                                                        ),
                                                        child: Text(
                                                          inst.type.toUpperCase(),
                                                          style: AppTheme.sans(
                                                            fontSize: 9,
                                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                                            color: typeColor,
                                                          ),
                                                        ),
                                                      ),
                                                    ],
                                                  ),
                                                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                                  Text(
                                                    inst.description,
                                                    style: AppTheme.sans(
                                                      fontSize: 11,
                                                      color: textSecondary,
                                                    ),
                                                    maxLines: 1,
                                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                                  ),
                                                ],
                                              ),
                                            ),

                                            // Right: Live Price & Day Diff if available
                                            if (tick != null) ...[
                                              Column(
                                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                                                children: [
                                                  Text(
                                                    tick.mid.toStringAsFixed(tick.precision),
                                                    style: AppTheme.mono(
                                                      context: context,
                                                      fontSize: 13,
                                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                                      color: textPrimary,
                                                    ),
                                                  ),
                                                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                                  Text(
                                                    '${tick.dayDiffPercent >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${tick.dayDiffPercent.toStringAsFixed(2)}%',
                                                    style: AppTheme.mono(
                                                      context: context,
                                                      fontSize: 11,
                                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                                      color: tick.dayDiffPercent >= 0
                                                          ? const Color(0xFF00E676)
                                                          : Colors.redAccent,
                                                    ),
                                                  ),
                                                ],
                                              ),
                                            ] else if (isCurrent) ...[
                                              Container(
                                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                                  color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.2),

                                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,

                                                  ),
                                                ),
                                              ),
                                            ],
                                          ],
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/biquote_service.dart';
import '../services/alert_manager.dart';
import 'chart_screen.dart';
import 'strategies_screen.dart';
import 'history_screen.dart';
import 'settings_screen.dart';

class MainNavigation extends StatefulWidget {
  final BiquoteService biquoteService;
  final AlertManager alertManager;
  final bool isDark;
  final VoidCallback onToggleTheme;

  const MainNavigation({
    super.key,
    required this.biquoteService,
    required this.alertManager,
    required this.isDark,
    required this.onToggleTheme,
  });

  @override
  State<MainNavigation> createState() => _MainNavigationState();
}

class _MainNavigationState extends State<MainNavigation> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  bool _batteryOptimizationIgnored = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _checkBatteryOptimization();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
      _checkBatteryOptimization();
      widget.alertManager.reloadAndSync();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _checkBatteryOptimization() async {
    try {
      final isIgnored = await widget.alertManager.alarmService.isBatteryOptimizationIgnored();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _batteryOptimizationIgnored = isIgnored;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _switchToChart() {
    setState(() {
      _currentIndex = 0;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    
    final screens = [
      ChartScreen(
        biquoteService: widget.biquoteService,
        alertManager: widget.alertManager,
        isDark: isDark,
        onToggleTheme: widget.onToggleTheme,
      ),
      StrategiesScreen(
        isDark: isDark,
        onNavigateToChart: _switchToChart,
        biquoteService: widget.biquoteService,
        alertManager: widget.alertManager,
      ),
      HistoryScreen(onNavigateToChart: _switchToChart),
      SettingsScreen(
        isDark: isDark,
        onToggleTheme: widget.onToggleTheme,
      ),
    ];

    return Scaffold(
      body: Column(
        children: [
          if (!_batteryOptimizationIgnored) _buildBatteryBanner(),
          Expanded(
            child: IndexedStack(
              index: _currentIndex,
              children: screens,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: NavigationBar(
        selectedIndex: _currentIndex,
        onDestinationSelected: (index) {
          setState(() {
            _currentIndex = index;
          });
        },
        backgroundColor: theme.colorScheme.surface,
        indicatorColor: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
        destinations: const [
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.show_chart_rounded),
            label: 'Market',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.psychology_rounded),
            label: 'Agents',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.history_rounded),
            label: 'History',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.settings_rounded),
            label: 'Settings',
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBatteryBanner() {
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(
        top: MediaQuery.of(context).padding.top + 6,
        bottom: 8,
        left: 14,
        right: 14,
      ),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          colors: [
            Colors.amber.shade900,
            Colors.deepOrange.shade800,
          ],
        ),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          const Icon(Icons.battery_alert_rounded, color: Colors.white, size: 20),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          const Expanded(
            child: Text(
              'Allow 24/7 background run so alarms trigger when phone sleeps.',
              style: TextStyle(
                color: Colors.white,
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: Colors.white,
              foregroundColor: Colors.black,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
              minimumSize: Size.zero,
              tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
              ),
            ),
            onPressed: () async {
              await widget.alertManager.alarmService.requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations();
              Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2), _checkBatteryOptimization);
            },
            child: const Text('ALLOW', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/market_data_api.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

class MarketMoversScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const MarketMoversScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<MarketMoversScreen> createState() => _MarketMoversScreenState();
}

class _MarketMoversScreenState extends State<MarketMoversScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final TabController _tab;
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;

  List<MarketMover> _gainers = [];
  List<MarketMover> _losers = [];
  List<MostActive> _active = [];

  String _selectedType = 'Forex';
  final _types = ['Forex', 'Crypto', 'Stock', 'Index', 'Commodity'];

  Timer? _refreshTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tab = TabController(length: 3, vsync: this);
    _load();
    _refreshTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 30), (_) => _load(silent: true));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tab.dispose();
    _refreshTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load({bool silent = false}) async {
    if (!silent && mounted) setState(() { _loading = true; _error = null; });
    try {
      final results = await Future.wait([
        MarketDataApi.getGainers(type: _selectedType),
        MarketDataApi.getLosers(type: _selectedType),
        MarketDataApi.getMostActive(type: _selectedType),
      ]);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _gainers = results[0] as List<MarketMover>;
          _losers = results[1] as List<MarketMover>;
          _active = results[2] as List<MostActive>;
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() { _loading = false; _error = e.toString(); });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0F172A),
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1E293B),
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded, size: 18, color: Colors.white),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
        title: Text('MARKET MOVERS',
            style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, letterSpacing: 1.2, color: Colors.white)),
        actions: [
          // Type filter chip
          PopupMenuButton<String>(
            icon: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
              ),
              child: Text(_selectedType,
                  style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF))),
            ),
            color: const Color(0xFF1E293B),
            onSelected: (val) {
              setState(() => _selectedType = val);
              _load();
            },
            itemBuilder: (_) => _types.map((t) => PopupMenuItem(value: t, child: Text(t))).toList(),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 20, color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)),
            onPressed: _load,
          ),
        ],
        bottom: TabBar(
          controller: _tab,
          indicatorColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
          labelColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
          unselectedLabelColor: Colors.grey,
          labelStyle: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
          tabs: const [
            Tab(icon: Icon(Icons.trending_up, size: 16), text: 'GAINERS'),
            Tab(icon: Icon(Icons.trending_down, size: 16), text: 'LOSERS'),
            Tab(icon: Icon(Icons.local_fire_department, size: 16), text: 'ACTIVE'),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      body: _loading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)))
          : _error != null
              ? _buildError()
              : TabBarView(
                  controller: _tab,
                  children: [
                    _buildMoversList(_gainers, isGainer: true),
                    _buildMoversList(_losers, isGainer: false),
                    _buildActiveList(_active),
                  ],
                ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildError() => Center(
        child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
          const Icon(Icons.wifi_off_rounded, size: 48, color: Colors.redAccent),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Text('Failed to load', style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 15, color: Colors.white)),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: _load,
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF), foregroundColor: Colors.black),
            child: const Text('RETRY'),
          ),
        ]),
      );

  Widget _buildMoversList(List<MarketMover> items, {required bool isGainer}) {
    if (items.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.trending_up_rounded, size: 48, color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.35)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              'No $_selectedType ${isGainer ? 'Gainers' : 'Losers'} Reported',
              style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: Colors.white70),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              'Market may be closed for weekend or awaiting session open.',
              style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            OutlinedButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => _load(),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 16),
              label: const Text('REFRESH'),
              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }
    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
      itemCount: items.length,
      itemBuilder: (_, i) {
        final m = items[i];
        final color = isGainer ? const Color(0xFF00E676) : Colors.redAccent;
        final sign = isGainer ? '+' : '';
        return Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: const Color(0xFF1E293B),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.25)),
          ),
          child: Row(children: [
            // Rank badge
            Container(
              width: 28, height: 28,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.15), shape: BoxShape.circle),
              child: Center(child: Text('${i + 1}',
                  style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: color))),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
                Text(m.symbol, style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: Colors.white)),
                Text(m.description, style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey), maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
              ]),
            ),
            Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end, children: [
              Text(m.lastPrice.toStringAsFixed(m.lastPrice > 100 ? 2 : 5),
                  style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: Colors.white)),
              Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 3),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.15), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6)),
                child: Text('$sign${m.changePercent.toStringAsFixed(2)}%',
                    style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: color)),
              ),
            ]),
          ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildActiveList(List<MostActive> items) {
    if (items.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.local_fire_department_rounded, size: 48, color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.35)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              'No $_selectedType Activity Reported',
              style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: Colors.white70),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              'Market may be closed for weekend or awaiting session open.',
              style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            OutlinedButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => _load(),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 16),
              label: const Text('REFRESH'),
              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF00E5FF)),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }
    final maxRange = items.isNotEmpty ? items.first.rangePercent : 1.0;
    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
      itemCount: items.length,
      itemBuilder: (_, i) {
        final m = items[i];
        final barFraction = maxRange > 0 ? (m.rangePercent / maxRange).clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
        return Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: const Color(0xFF1E293B),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(color: Colors.orangeAccent.withValues(alpha: 0.25)),
          ),
          child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
            Row(children: [
              Expanded(child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
                Text(m.symbol, style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: Colors.white)),
                Text(m.description, style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey), maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
              ])),
              Text('${m.rangePercent.toStringAsFixed(2)}% range',
                  style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: Colors.orangeAccent)),
            ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            // Range bar
            ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
              child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                value: barFraction,
                backgroundColor: Colors.orangeAccent.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                color: Colors.orangeAccent,
                minHeight: 4,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Row(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween, children: [
              Text('L: ${m.low.toStringAsFixed(m.low > 100 ? 2 : 5)}',
                  style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 10, color: Colors.grey)),
              Text('H: ${m.high.toStringAsFixed(m.high > 100 ? 2 : 5)}',
                  style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 10, color: Colors.grey)),
            ]),
          ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../models/ai_models.dart';

import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

class SettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool? isDark;
  final VoidCallback? onToggleTheme;

  const SettingsScreen({
    super.key,
    this.isDark,
    this.onToggleTheme,
  });

  @override
  State<SettingsScreen> createState() => _SettingsScreenState();
}

class _SettingsScreenState extends State<SettingsScreen> {
  final StrategyStorage _storage = StrategyStorage();
  final AiService _aiService = AiService();
  final RealMarketService _realMarketService = RealMarketService();
  final AlarmService _alarmService = AlarmService();

  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  late TextEditingController _baseUrlController;
  late TextEditingController _apiKeyController;
  late TextEditingController _modelController;
  late TextEditingController _rmApiKeyController;
  late TextEditingController _rmBaseUrlController;

  bool _obscureApiKey = true;
  bool _isTesting = false;
  bool _isTestingRm = false;
  bool _isSaving = false;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _batteryIgnored = false;
  bool _dndGranted = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _baseUrlController = TextEditingController();
    _apiKeyController = TextEditingController();
    _modelController = TextEditingController();
    _rmApiKeyController = TextEditingController();
    _rmBaseUrlController = TextEditingController();
    _loadSettings();
  }

  Future<void> _loadSettings() async {
    final llm = await _storage.getLlmConfig();
    final rm = await _storage.getRealMarketConfig();
    final battery = await _alarmService.isBatteryOptimizationIgnored();
    final dnd = await _alarmService.isDndOverrideGranted();
    setState(() {
      _baseUrlController.text = llm.baseUrl;
      _apiKeyController.text = llm.apiKey;
      _modelController.text = llm.modelName;
      _rmApiKeyController.text = rm.apiKey;
      _rmBaseUrlController.text = rm.baseUrl;
      _batteryIgnored = battery;
      _dndGranted = dnd;
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _baseUrlController.dispose();
    _apiKeyController.dispose();
    _modelController.dispose();
    _rmApiKeyController.dispose();
    _rmBaseUrlController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _saveSettings() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    final newLlm = LlmConfig(
      baseUrl: _baseUrlController.text.trim(),
      apiKey: _apiKeyController.text.trim(),
      modelName: _modelController.text.trim(),
    );
    final newRm = RealMarketConfig(
      baseUrl: _rmBaseUrlController.text.trim(),
      apiKey: _rmApiKeyController.text.trim(),
    );

    await _storage.saveLlmConfig(newLlm);
    await _storage.saveRealMarketConfig(newRm);

    setState(() => _isSaving = false);
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Configuration saved successfully!'),
          backgroundColor: AppColors.bullishGreen,
          duration: Duration(seconds: 2),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _testLlmConnection() async {
    setState(() => _isTesting = true);
    _aiService.config = LlmConfig(
      baseUrl: _baseUrlController.text.trim(),
      apiKey: _apiKeyController.text.trim(),
      modelName: _modelController.text.trim(),
    );

    final success = await _aiService.testConnection();
    setState(() => _isTesting = false);

    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Row(
            children: [
              Icon(
                success ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.error_outline,
                color: Colors.white,
                size: 20,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  success
                      ? 'Connection verified! LLM endpoint is active.'
                      : 'Connection failed. Please verify Base URL, API Key & Model.',
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          backgroundColor: success ? AppColors.bullishGreen : AppColors.bearishRed,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _testRealMarketConnection() async {
    setState(() => _isTestingRm = true);
    _realMarketService.config = RealMarketConfig(
      baseUrl: _rmBaseUrlController.text.trim(),
      apiKey: _rmApiKeyController.text.trim(),
    );

    final res = await _realMarketService.testConnection();
    setState(() => _isTestingRm = false);

    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Row(
            children: [
              Icon(
                res.success ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.error_outline,
                color: Colors.white,
                size: 20,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(res.message),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          backgroundColor: res.success ? AppColors.bullishGreen : AppColors.bearishRed,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Scaffold(

          : SingleChildScrollView(

                        subtitle: 'Customize color mode and visual terminal styling',
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Card(
                        elevation: 0,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          side: BorderSide(
                            color: isDark ? AppColors.darkDivider : AppColors.lightDivider,

                        ),
                        color: isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,

                    // --- LLM Section ---

                      subtitle: 'Connect any OpenAI-compatible inference API (DeepSeek, Groq, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM)',
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Card(

        Text(
          subtitle,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey),
        ),
      ],
    );

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/alert_manager.dart';
import '../services/biquote_service.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../widgets/tenx_logo.dart';
import 'main_navigation.dart';

class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final BiquoteService biquoteService;
  final AlertManager alertManager;
  final bool isDark;
  final VoidCallback onToggleTheme;

  const SplashScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.biquoteService,
    required this.alertManager,
    required this.isDark,
    required this.onToggleTheme,
  });

  @override
  State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _animController;
  late Animation<double> _fadeAnim;
  late Animation<double> _scaleAnim;

  Timer? _navTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _animController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1400),
    );

    _fadeAnim = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _animController,
      curve: const Interval(0.0, 0.75, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
    );

    _scaleAnim = Tween<double>(begin: 0.85, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(
        parent: _animController,
        curve: const Interval(0.0, 0.75, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
      ),
    );

    _animController.forward();

    // Auto-navigate to ChartScreen after 2.4 seconds with a smooth fade
    _navTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 2400), () {
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(
        PageRouteBuilder(
          transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 600),
          pageBuilder: (_, animation, secondaryAnimation) {
            return FadeTransition(
              opacity: animation,
              child: MainNavigation(
                biquoteService: widget.biquoteService,
                alertManager: widget.alertManager,
                isDark: widget.isDark,
                onToggleTheme: widget.onToggleTheme,
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
      );
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _navTimer?.cancel();
    _animController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: theme.colorScheme.surface,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            // Ambient background glow
            Center(
              child: Container(
                width: 320,
                height: 320,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  gradient: RadialGradient(
                    colors: [
                      const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                      const Color(0xFF7C3AED).withValues(alpha: 0.04),
                      Colors.transparent,
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),

            // Center Content: Abstract Logo + Brand Name
            Center(
              child: FadeTransition(
                opacity: _fadeAnim,
                child: ScaleTransition(
                  scale: _scaleAnim,
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      // Abstract TenX App Icon
                      const TenXLogo(size: 88, showGlow: true),
                      const SizedBox(height: 24),

                      // Brand Name
                      Text(
                        'TenX',
                        style: AppTheme.sans(
                          fontSize: 34,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                          letterSpacing: 2.0,
                          color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),

                      // Quantitative subtitle
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 4),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                            width: 1,
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          'MULTI-AGENT INTELLIGENCE & ALERTS',
                          style: AppTheme.mono(
                            context: context,
                            fontSize: 10,
                            letterSpacing: 1.5,
                            color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),

            // Bottom Section: Tagline "made by Gifted Braimah"
            Positioned(
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              bottom: 36,
              child: FadeTransition(
                opacity: _fadeAnim,
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    // Subtle Divider
                    Container(
                      width: 48,
                      height: 1.5,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        gradient: LinearGradient(
                          colors: [
                            Colors.transparent,
                            const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                            Colors.transparent,
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),

                    // Tagline: made by Gifted Braimah
                    Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'made by ',
                          style: AppTheme.sans(
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                            letterSpacing: 0.8,
                            color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          'Gifted Braimah',
                          style: AppTheme.sans(
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            letterSpacing: 0.8,
                            color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],

      ),
