import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../models/ai_models.dart';
import '../services/alert_manager.dart';
import '../services/biquote_service.dart';
import '../services/strategy_storage.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'analysis_screen.dart';

class StrategiesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool isDark;
  final VoidCallback? onNavigateToChart;
  final String? activeSymbol;
  final String? activeTimeframe;
  final ValueChanged<AgentSignal>? onSelectSignalForChart;
  final BiquoteService? biquoteService;
  final AlertManager? alertManager;

  const StrategiesScreen({
    super.key,
    this.isDark = true,
    this.onNavigateToChart,
    this.activeSymbol,
    this.activeTimeframe,
    this.onSelectSignalForChart,
    this.biquoteService,
    this.alertManager,
  });

  @override
  State<StrategiesScreen> createState() => _StrategiesScreenState();
}

class _StrategiesScreenState extends State<StrategiesScreen> {
  final StrategyStorage _storage = StrategyStorage();
  List<TradingStrategy> _strategies = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadStrategies();
  }

  Future<void> _loadStrategies() async {
    final list = await _storage.getStrategies();
    setState(() {
      _strategies = list;
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  void _openStrategyEditor({TradingStrategy? existing}) async {
    final result = await showModalBottomSheet<TradingStrategy>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => _StrategyEditorSheet(existing: existing),
    );

    if (result != null) {
      await _storage.saveStrategy(result);
      await _loadStrategies();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _duplicateStrategy(TradingStrategy s) async {
    final dup = s.copyWith(
      id: 'strat_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
      name: '${s.name} (Copy)',
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
    );
    await _storage.saveStrategy(dup);
    await _loadStrategies();
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Duplicated "${s.name}"')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deleteStrategy(TradingStrategy s) async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Delete Strategy?'),
        content: Text('Are you sure you want to delete "${s.name}"?'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: TextButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: AppColors.bearishRed),
            child: const Text('Delete'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirmed == true) {
      await _storage.deleteStrategy(s.id);
      await _loadStrategies();
    }
  }

  void _runStrategy(TradingStrategy s) {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => AnalysisScreen(
          strategy: s,
          initialSymbol: widget.activeSymbol ?? 'EURUSD',
          initialTimeframe: widget.activeTimeframe ?? (s.timeframes.isNotEmpty ? s.timeframes.first : '1H'),
          onNavigateToChart: widget.onNavigateToChart,
          onSelectSignalForChart: widget.onSelectSignalForChart,
          biquoteService: widget.biquoteService,
          alertManager: widget.alertManager,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: isDark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('AI Trading Strategies'),
        centerTitle: true,
      ),
      body: _isLoading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          : _strategies.isEmpty
              ? _buildEmptyState()
              : ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  itemCount: _strategies.length,
                  itemBuilder: (ctx, index) {
                    final strat = _strategies[index];
                    return _buildStrategyCard(strat, isDark);
                  },
                ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
        onPressed: () => _openStrategyEditor(),
        backgroundColor: AppColors.accentBlue,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
        label: const Text('New Strategy'),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildEmptyState() {
    return Center(
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Icon(Icons.psychology_alt, size: 64, color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const Text(
            'No AI Strategies Created',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          const Text(
            'Tap "+ New Strategy" to define your initial specialist prompts.',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.grey),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStrategyCard(TradingStrategy s, bool isDark) {
    final isMulti = s.isMultiAgent;
    final specCount = s.specialists.length;

    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      elevation: 0,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        side: BorderSide(
          color: isDark ? AppColors.darkDivider : AppColors.lightDivider,
        ),
      ),
      color: isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    s.name,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 17,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isMulti
                        ? AppColors.accentBlue.withValues(alpha: 0.15)

                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  ),
                  child: Text(

                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      color: isMulti ? AppColors.accentBlue : Colors.purpleAccent,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (s.description.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              Text(
                s.description,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.grey),
              ),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // Pipeline flow banner
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E222D) : const Color(0xFFF1F3F5),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.account_tree_outlined, size: 16, color: Colors.grey),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      isMulti
                          ? 'Specialists ($specCount) ➔ Critic ➔ Specialists ➔ Consolidator'
                          : 'Specialist (1) ➔ Critic ➔ Specialist Refinement',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        letterSpacing: 0.2,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),

              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // Specialist Names List
            Wrap(

              runSpacing: 4,

                  visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,

/// Dynamic Strategy Editor Modal Sheet
class _StrategyEditorSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final TradingStrategy? existing;

  const _StrategyEditorSheet({this.existing});

  @override
  State<_StrategyEditorSheet> createState() => _StrategyEditorSheetState();
}

class _StrategyEditorSheetState extends State<_StrategyEditorSheet> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  late TextEditingController _nameController;
  late TextEditingController _descController;
  late List<SpecialistAgentConfig> _specialists;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final e = widget.existing;
    _nameController = TextEditingController(text: e?.name ?? '');
    _descController = TextEditingController(text: e?.description ?? '');

    if (e != null && e.specialists.isNotEmpty) {
      _specialists = e.specialists.map((s) => s.copyWith()).toList();
    } else {
      // Start with 1 default specialist
      _specialists = [
        SpecialistAgentConfig(
          id: 'spec_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_1',
          name: 'SMC Structure Specialist',
          systemPrompt: '''Role: You are an expert technical analyst focusing on Smart Money Concepts (SMC).
Analyze the last 100 candles to identify BOS, CHoCH, unmitigated Order Blocks, and Liquidity Sweeps.
Formulate a precise trade setup with single-number entry, stop loss, and take profit.''',
        ),
      ];
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _descController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _addSpecialist() {
    setState(() {
      final idx = _specialists.length + 1;
      _specialists.add(
        SpecialistAgentConfig(
          id: 'spec_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$idx',
          name: 'Specialist #$idx',
          systemPrompt: 'Role: You are a specialized technical analysis agent analyzing market trends and candle patterns on the supplied 100 candles.',
        ),
      );
    });
  }

  void _removeSpecialist(int index) {
    if (_specialists.length <= 1) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('A strategy must have at least 1 specialist agent.')),
      );
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _specialists.removeAt(index);
    });
  }

  void _insertTemplate(int index, String templateType) {
    setState(() {
      if (templateType == 'SMC') {
        _specialists[index].name = 'SMC Order Flow Specialist';
        _specialists[index].systemPrompt = '''Role: You are an expert in Smart Money Concepts (SMC).
Analyze the 100-candle dataset to pinpoint:
1. Market Structure Shifts: BOS (Break of Structure) and CHoCH (Change of Character).
2. Unmitigated Order Blocks (OB) and Fair Value Gaps (FVG) / Imbalances.
3. Liquidity Sweeps: Buy-side liquidity (BSL) and Sell-side liquidity (SSL) purged.
4. Issue single exact price levels for entry, stop loss, and take profit.''';
      } else if (templateType == 'Wyckoff') {
        _specialists[index].name = 'Wyckoff Phase Specialist';
        _specialists[index].systemPrompt = '''Role: You are an expert Wyckoff Market Cycle Analyst.
Evaluate the 100-candle dataset to determine:
1. The dominant Wyckoff Phase: Accumulation, Markup, Distribution, or Markdown.
2. Signposts: Selling/Buying Climax, Secondary Tests, Springs, Upthrusts (UTAD), and Signs of Strength/Weakness.
3. Cause-and-effect projections for continuation or reversal with exact single-price levels.''';
      } else if (templateType == 'PriceAction') {
        _specialists[index].name = 'Price Action & Key Levels Specialist';
        _specialists[index].systemPrompt = '''Role: You are an elite Price Action and Support/Resistance Specialist.
Analyze the 100-candle history to determine:
1. Significant multi-tested horizontal swing highs and lows.
2. Candlestick patterns (pin bars, engulfing bars, rejections).
3. Momentum and trend exhaustion to determine optimal risk-reward entry, stop loss, and take profit.''';
      }
    });
  }

  void _save() {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    final strategy = TradingStrategy(
      id: widget.existing?.id ?? 'strat_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
      name: _nameController.text.trim(),
      description: _descController.text.trim(),
      specialists: _specialists,
      createdAt: widget.existing?.createdAt ?? DateTime.now(),
    );

    Navigator.pop(context, strategy);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final isMulti = _specialists.length > 1;

    return DraggableScrollableSheet(
      initialChildSize: 0.90,
      maxChildSize: 0.95,
      minChildSize: 0.5,
      builder: (ctx, scrollController) {
        return Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isDark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
          ),
          child: Form(
            key: _formKey,
            child: ListView(
              controller: scrollController,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              children: [
                // Handle bar
                Center(
                  child: Container(
                    width: 40,
                    height: 4,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        widget.existing != null ? 'Edit Strategy' : 'Create Strategy',
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Strategy Name
                TextFormField(
                  controller: _nameController,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Strategy Name',
                    hintText: 'e.g. Aureus SMC + Wyckoff Matrix',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                  validator: (v) =>
                      v == null || v.trim().isEmpty ? 'Please enter a strategy name' : null,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),

                // Description
                TextFormField(
                  controller: _descController,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Description (Optional)',
                    hintText: 'e.g. Dual-analyst confluence for high-volatility pairs',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                  maxLines: 2,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),

                // Dynamic Pipeline Indicator Banner
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isMulti
                        ? AppColors.accentBlue.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                        : Colors.purple.withValues(alpha: 0.12),

                    border: Border.all(

                    ),

                  child: Column(

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import '../models/ai_models.dart';

class AiService {
  final http.Client _client;
  LlmConfig config;

  AiService({
    http.Client? client,
    this.config = LlmConfig.defaultSettings,
  }) : _client = client ?? http.Client();

  /// Tests the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with a minimal completion request
  Future<bool> testConnection() async {
    try {
      final res = await complete(
        systemPrompt: 'You are a health-check responder. Reply with standard JSON: {"status": "ok"}',
        userPrompt: 'Ping',
        temperature: 0.1,
      );
      return res.isNotEmpty;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('AiService testConnection failed: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Performs an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions call without function calling.
  Future<String> complete({
    required String systemPrompt,
    required String userPrompt,
    double temperature = 0.3,
    int maxTokens = 4096,
  }) async {
    final cleanBase = config.baseUrl.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'/+$'), '');
    final endpoint = cleanBase.endsWith('/v1')
        ? '$cleanBase/chat/completions'
        : '$cleanBase/v1/chat/completions';

    final uri = Uri.parse(endpoint);
    final headers = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': 'true',
    };
    if (config.apiKey.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ${config.apiKey.trim()}';
    }

    final body = jsonEncode({
      'model': config.modelName.trim().isNotEmpty ? config.modelName.trim() : 'deepseek-chat',
      'messages': [
        {'role': 'system', 'content': systemPrompt},
        {'role': 'user', 'content': userPrompt},
      ],
      'temperature': temperature,
      'max_tokens': maxTokens,
    });

    final response = await _client.post(uri, headers: headers, body: body).timeout(
      const Duration(seconds: 45),
    );

    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(response.bodyBytes));
      if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        final choices = decoded['choices'] as List<dynamic>?;
        if (choices != null && choices.isNotEmpty) {
          final firstChoice = choices[0] as Map<String, dynamic>;
          final message = firstChoice['message'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
          final content = message?['content']?.toString() ?? '';
          return content;
        }
      }
      throw Exception('Malformed chat completion response: ${response.body}');
    } else {
      throw Exception('LLM HTTP ${response.statusCode}: ${response.body}');
    }
  }

  /// Sends a structured prompt and parses the returned JSON into an AgentSignal
  Future<AgentSignal> completeStructuredSignal({
    required String agentName,
    required String systemPrompt,
    required String userPrompt,
    double currentPrice = 0.0,
    double temperature = 0.3,
  }) async {
    final structuredInstruction = '''
$systemPrompt

CRITICAL MANDATORY INSTRUCTIONS:
You MUST respond with a single, valid JSON object inside a ```json ``` code block.
DO NOT use markdown formatting outside the JSON block.
DO NOT use function/tool calling.
Your JSON object MUST contain exactly these fields:
{
  "direction": "buy" | "sell" | "wait",
  "analysis": "detailed text analysis of current market structure, imbalances, and order flow",
  "theory": "text explanation of the theory and prediction rationale",
  "entry_price": <a single exact numeric price, e.g. 1.15450, NOT a range>,
  "stop_loss": <a single exact numeric price for invalidation, e.g. 1.15120, NOT a range>,
  "take_profit": <a single exact numeric target price, e.g. 1.16100, NOT a range>,
  "confidence": <integer from 1 to 10 rating your conviction>
}
NOTE: If there is a price range or buffer you advise, explain it inside "analysis" and "theory". "entry_price", "stop_loss", and "take_profit" MUST be single clean numbers. If direction is "wait", set entry_price, stop_loss, and take_profit to $currentPrice.
''';

    final rawContent = await complete(
      systemPrompt: structuredInstruction,
      userPrompt: userPrompt,
      temperature: temperature,
    );

    return extractSignalFromJson(rawContent, agentName: agentName, fallbackPrice: currentPrice);
  }

  /// Extracts the AgentSignal from a completion string containing JSON
  static AgentSignal extractSignalFromJson(
    String content, {
    required String agentName,
    double fallbackPrice = 0.0,
  }) {
    Map<String, dynamic>? parsedJson;

    // 1. Try markdown code block regex ```json ... ```
    final codeBlockRegex = RegExp(r'```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```', caseSensitive: false);
    final match = codeBlockRegex.firstMatch(content);
    if (match != null) {
      try {
        final block = match.group(1)!.trim();
        parsedJson = jsonDecode(block) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 2. Try raw substring between first '{' and last '}'
    if (parsedJson == null) {
      final start = content.indexOf('{');
      final end = content.lastIndexOf('}');
      if (start != -1 && end != -1 && end > start) {
        try {
          final candidate = content.substring(start, end + 1);
          parsedJson = jsonDecode(candidate) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback if JSON parsing totally fails: build safe AgentSignal from text
    if (parsedJson == null) {
      debugPrint('AiService: Could not parse pure JSON from agent output. Using text heuristic fallback.');
      final lower = content.toLowerCase();
      final dir = lower.contains('buy') || lower.contains('bullish')
          ? SignalDirection.buy
          : (lower.contains('sell') || lower.contains('bearish')
              ? SignalDirection.sell
              : SignalDirection.wait);

      return AgentSignal(
        direction: dir,
        analysis: content,
        theory: 'Parsed from free-form agent analysis.',
        entryPrice: fallbackPrice,
        stopLoss: dir == SignalDirection.buy ? fallbackPrice * 0.995 : fallbackPrice * 1.005,
        takeProfit: dir == SignalDirection.buy ? fallbackPrice * 1.010 : fallbackPrice * 0.990,
        confidence: 5,
        agentName: agentName,
        timestamp: DateTime.now(),
        rawJson: content,
      );
    }

    return AgentSignal.fromJson(parsedJson, defaultAgentName: agentName);
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

class RingtoneItem {
  final String title;
  final String uri;
  final String type; // 'alarm' or 'ringtone'

  const RingtoneItem({
    required this.title,
    required this.uri,
    this.type = 'alarm',
  });

  factory RingtoneItem.fromMap(Map<dynamic, dynamic> map) {
    return RingtoneItem(
      title: map['title']?.toString() ?? 'Unknown Tone',
      uri: map['uri']?.toString() ?? '',
      type: map['type']?.toString() ?? 'alarm',
    );
  }
}

class AlarmService {
  static const MethodChannel _channel = MethodChannel('com.example.alert_app/alarm');
  bool _isPlaying = false;
  bool get isPlaying => _isPlaying;

  /// Fetch all system alarm sounds and ringtones
  Future<List<RingtoneItem>> getRingtones() async {
    try {
      final List<dynamic>? list = await _channel.invokeMethod<List<dynamic>>('getRingtones');
      if (list != null && list.isNotEmpty) {
        return list
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((item) => RingtoneItem.fromMap(item))
            .toList();
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Fallback for non-Android / testing environments
    }
    return [
      const RingtoneItem(title: 'Default Alarm', uri: 'default_alarm', type: 'alarm'),
      const RingtoneItem(title: 'Classic Bell', uri: 'classic_bell', type: 'alarm'),
      const RingtoneItem(title: 'Radar Pulse', uri: 'radar_pulse', type: 'alarm'),
      const RingtoneItem(title: 'Chime Alert', uri: 'chime_alert', type: 'ringtone'),
    ];
  }

  /// Start playing the alarm continuously with screen wakeup & vibration
  Future<void> playAlarm({String? ringtoneUri, bool looping = true}) async {
    _isPlaying = true;
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('playAlarm', {
        'uri': ringtoneUri,
        'looping': looping,
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Stop playing the alarm
  Future<void> stopAlarm() async {
    _isPlaying = false;
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('stopAlarm');
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Preview a ringtone for 3 seconds
  Future<void> previewRingtone(String uri) async {
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('previewRingtone', {'uri': uri});
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Stop current preview
  Future<void> stopPreview() async {
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('stopPreview');
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Start the perpetual Android Foreground Service
  Future<void> startForegroundService() async {
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('startForegroundService');
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Stop the perpetual Android Foreground Service
  Future<void> stopForegroundService() async {
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('stopForegroundService');
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Check whether Do Not Disturb (DND) override permission is granted
  Future<bool> isDndOverrideGranted() async {
    try {
      final bool? granted = await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('isDndOverrideGranted');
      return granted ?? false;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Open Android Notification Policy Access Settings to grant DND override
  Future<void> requestDndOverride() async {
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('requestDndOverride');
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Check whether battery optimization is already disabled/ignored for TenX
  Future<bool> isBatteryOptimizationIgnored() async {
    try {
      final bool? isIgnored = await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('isBatteryOptimizationIgnored');
      return isIgnored ?? true;
    } catch (_) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  /// Request battery optimization exemption so OS doesn't kill monitoring
  Future<void> requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations() async {
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations');
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Sync active alerts with Android native background foreground service
  Future<void> syncActiveAlerts(String alertsJson) async {
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('syncActiveAlerts', {'alerts': alertsJson});
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import '../models/market_models.dart';
import 'alarm_service.dart';
import 'candlestick_detector.dart';
import 'indicator_calculator.dart';
import 'storage_service.dart';

class AlertManager extends ChangeNotifier {
  static const String _keyAlerts = 'saved_alerts';
  static const String _keyHistory = 'saved_history';

  final AlarmService alarmService;
  final List<PriceAlert> _alerts = [];
  final List<PriceAlert> _history = [];
  bool _isLoaded = false;
  bool get isLoaded => _isLoaded;

  void Function(PriceAlert alert, double triggerPrice)? onAlertTriggered;

  List<PriceAlert> get alerts => List.unmodifiable(_alerts);
  List<PriceAlert> get activeAlerts => _alerts.where((a) => a.isActive).toList();
  List<PriceAlert> get history => List.unmodifiable(_history);

  AlertManager({AlarmService? alarmService}) : alarmService = alarmService ?? AlarmService() {
    _initAndLoad();
  }

  Future<void> _initAndLoad() async {
    await _loadFromStorage();
    // Start perpetual background monitoring service
    await alarmService.startForegroundService();
    // Sync current active alerts with Android native service
    _syncWithNativeService();
  }

  Future<void> _loadFromStorage() async {
    try {
      final alertsJson = await StorageService.getString(_keyAlerts);
      final historyJson = await StorageService.getString(_keyHistory);

      _alerts.clear();
      _history.clear();

      if (alertsJson != null && alertsJson.isNotEmpty) {
        final List<dynamic> list = jsonDecode(alertsJson);
        for (final item in list) {
          _alerts.add(PriceAlert.fromJson(item as Map<String, dynamic>));
        }
      } else {
        _seedDefaultAlerts();
        await _saveToStorage();
      }

      if (historyJson != null && historyJson.isNotEmpty) {
        final List<dynamic> list = jsonDecode(historyJson);
        for (final item in list) {
          _history.add(PriceAlert.fromJson(item as Map<String, dynamic>));
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (_alerts.isEmpty) {
        _seedDefaultAlerts();
      }
    }

    _isLoaded = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _saveToStorage() async {
    try {
      final alertsData = jsonEncode(_alerts.map((a) => a.toJson()).toList());
      final historyData = jsonEncode(_history.map((a) => a.toJson()).toList());

      await StorageService.setString(_keyAlerts, alertsData);
      await StorageService.setString(_keyHistory, historyData);
    } catch (_) {}

    _syncWithNativeService();
  }

  void _syncWithNativeService() {
    try {
      final activeList = activeAlerts.map((a) => a.toJson()).toList();
      final activeJson = jsonEncode(activeList);
      alarmService.syncActiveAlerts(activeJson);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _seedDefaultAlerts() {
    _alerts.addAll([
      PriceAlert(
        id: 'alert_1',
        symbol: 'EURUSD',
        targetPrice: 1.15200,
        condition: AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
        note: 'Breakout above resistance',
        createdAt: DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(hours: 2)),
        initialPrice: 1.14860,
      ),
      PriceAlert(
        id: 'alert_2',
        symbol: 'EURUSD',
        targetPrice: 1.14500,
        condition: AlertCondition.crossesBelow,
        note: 'Support breakdown monitor',
        createdAt: DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(hours: 1)),
        initialPrice: 1.14860,
      ),
      PriceAlert(
        id: 'alert_3',
        symbol: 'GBPUSD',
        targetPrice: 1.34200,
        condition: AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
        note: 'Major swing high breakout',
        createdAt: DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(hours: 5)),
        initialPrice: 1.33730,
      ),
    ]);
  }

  PriceAlert addAlert({
    required String symbol,
    AlertType alertType = AlertType.priceLevel,
    double targetPrice = 0.0,
    AlertCondition condition = AlertCondition.crossesAbove,
    CandlestickPattern? candlestickPattern,
    IndicatorAlertConfig? indicatorConfig,
    MultiStepConfig? multiStepConfig,
    String timeframe = '15m',
    String note = '',
    required double currentPrice,
    String ringtoneTitle = 'Default Alarm',
    String? ringtoneUri,
    String? drawingId,
  }) {
    final alert = PriceAlert(
      id: 'alert_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
      symbol: symbol,
      alertType: alertType,
      targetPrice: targetPrice,
      condition: condition,
      candlestickPattern: candlestickPattern,
      indicatorConfig: indicatorConfig,
      multiStepConfig: multiStepConfig,
      timeframe: timeframe,
      note: note,
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
      initialPrice: currentPrice,
      ringtoneTitle: ringtoneTitle,
      ringtoneUri: ringtoneUri,
      drawingId: drawingId,
    );
    _alerts.insert(0, alert);
    notifyListeners();
    _saveToStorage();
    return alert;
  }

  /// Finds an active alert linked to a chart drawing ID.
  PriceAlert? getAlertForDrawing(String drawingId) {
    try {
      return _alerts.firstWhere((a) => a.drawingId == drawingId && a.isActive);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /// Dynamically updates the alert target price when a user moves a drawing line on the chart.
  bool updateAlertForDrawing(String drawingId, double newTargetPrice, {double? currentPrice}) {
    final idx = _alerts.indexWhere((a) => a.drawingId == drawingId && a.isActive);
    if (idx != -1) {
      final alert = _alerts[idx];
      alert.targetPrice = newTargetPrice;
      if (currentPrice != null && currentPrice > 0) {
        alert.condition = newTargetPrice >= currentPrice
            ? AlertCondition.crossesAbove
            : AlertCondition.crossesBelow;
      }
      notifyListeners();
      _saveToStorage();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /// Removes alerts linked to a deleted drawing.
  void removeAlertForDrawing(String drawingId) {
    _alerts.removeWhere((a) => a.drawingId == drawingId);
    _history.removeWhere((a) => a.drawingId == drawingId);
    notifyListeners();
    _saveToStorage();
  }

  void toggleAlert(String id) {
    final idx = _alerts.indexWhere((a) => a.id == id);
    if (idx != -1) {
      _alerts[idx].isActive = !_alerts[idx].isActive;
      notifyListeners();
      _saveToStorage();
    }
  }

  void deleteAlert(String id) {
    _alerts.removeWhere((a) => a.id == id);
    _history.removeWhere((a) => a.id == id);
    notifyListeners();
    _saveToStorage();
  }

  /// Evaluates incoming ticks against active alerts.
  void checkTick(BiquoteTick tick) {
    evaluatePrice(tick.symbol, tick.mid);
  }

  /// Evaluates price against active alerts
  void evaluatePrice(String symbol, double currentPrice) {
    final matchingAlerts = _alerts
        .where((a) => a.isActive && !a.isPatternAlert && !a.isIndicatorAlert && !a.isMultiStepAlert && a.symbol == symbol)
        .toList();

    for (final alert in matchingAlerts) {
      if (alert.checkTrigger(currentPrice)) {
        alert.isActive = false;
        alert.triggeredAt = DateTime.now();
        _history.insert(0, alert);
        notifyListeners();
        _saveToStorage();

        // 1. Play continuous alarm via AlarmService (wakes screen, bypasses DND)
        alarmService.playAlarm(ringtoneUri: alert.ringtoneUri);

        // 2. Notify UI callback
        onAlertTriggered?.call(alert, currentPrice);
      }
    }

    // Evaluate active multi-step logic chains on price tick
    evaluateMultiStepAlerts(symbol, currentPrice: currentPrice);
  }

  /// Evaluates completed candles against active candlestick pattern alerts and indicators
  void evaluateCandles(String symbol, String timeframe, List<BiquoteCandle> candles, {bool isIntraCandle = false}) {
    if (candles.length < 3) return;

    // Pattern alerts only evaluate on closed/completed candles (never intra-candle)
    if (!isIntraCandle) {
      final matchingAlerts = _alerts
          .where((a) =>
              a.isActive &&
              a.isPatternAlert &&
              a.symbol == symbol &&
              a.timeframe.toLowerCase() == timeframe.toLowerCase() &&
              a.candlestickPattern != null)
          .toList();

      for (final alert in matchingAlerts) {
        final isDetected = CandlestickDetector.matches(alert.candlestickPattern!, candles);
        if (isDetected) {
          alert.isActive = false;
          alert.triggeredAt = DateTime.now();
          _history.insert(0, alert);
          notifyListeners();
          _saveToStorage();

          // 1. Play continuous alarm via AlarmService
          alarmService.playAlarm(ringtoneUri: alert.ringtoneUri);

          // 2. Notify UI callback with the candle close price
          onAlertTriggered?.call(alert, candles.last.close);
        }
      }
    }

    // Evaluate active technical indicator alerts
    final matchingIndicatorAlerts = _alerts
        .where((a) =>
            a.isActive &&
            a.isIndicatorAlert &&
            a.symbol == symbol &&
            a.timeframe.toLowerCase() == timeframe.toLowerCase() &&
            a.indicatorConfig != null)
        .toList();

    for (final alert in matchingIndicatorAlerts) {
      final isDetected = IndicatorCalculator.checkTrigger(alert, candles);
      if (isDetected) {
        alert.isActive = false;
        alert.triggeredAt = DateTime.now();
        _history.insert(0, alert);
        notifyListeners();
        _saveToStorage();

        // 1. Play continuous alarm via AlarmService
        alarmService.playAlarm(ringtoneUri: alert.ringtoneUri);

        // 2. Notify UI callback with the candle close price
        onAlertTriggered?.call(alert, candles.last.close);
      }
    }

    // Evaluate active multi-step logic chains on candle update with exact timeframe context
    evaluateMultiStepAlerts(
      symbol,
      timeframe: timeframe,
      currentPrice: candles.last.close,
      candles: candles,
      isIntraCandle: isIntraCandle,
    );
  }

  /// Evaluates active multi-step logic chain alerts.
  /// Each multi-step alarm stays on with the alarms on the current level in the chain running.
  /// If that level completes, we move down the chain and the alarms in that next level become active,
  /// until the root rings or is cancelled by the human.
  void evaluateMultiStepAlerts(
    String symbol, {
    String? timeframe,
    double? currentPrice,
    List<BiquoteCandle>? candles,
    bool isIntraCandle = false,
  }) {
    final matchingChains = _alerts
        .where((a) => a.isActive && a.isMultiStepAlert && a.symbol == symbol)
        .toList();

    for (final alert in matchingChains) {
      final config = alert.multiStepConfig;
      if (config == null || config.isAllCompleted) continue;

      final currentStage = config.activeStage;
      if (currentStage == null || currentStage.isCompleted) continue;

      bool stageUpdated = false;

      // Evaluate ONLY the alarms in the current level of the chain
      for (final node in currentStage.nodes) {
        if (node.isSatisfied) continue; // Already satisfied in this stage

        bool rawSatisfied = false;
        switch (node.nodeType) {
          case AlertType.priceLevel:
            if (currentPrice != null && currentPrice > 0 && node.targetPrice > 0) {
              switch (node.condition) {
                case AlertCondition.crossesAbove:
                  rawSatisfied = currentPrice >= node.targetPrice;
                  break;
                case AlertCondition.crossesBelow:
                  rawSatisfied = currentPrice <= node.targetPrice;
                  break;
                case AlertCondition.hits:
                  rawSatisfied = (currentPrice - node.targetPrice).abs() <= (node.targetPrice * 0.0002);
                  break;
              }
            }
            break;

          case AlertType.candlestickPattern:
            // Ensure candle timeframe matches node timeframe and bar is completed
            if (!isIntraCandle &&
                timeframe != null &&
                node.timeframe.toLowerCase() == timeframe.toLowerCase() &&
                candles != null &&
                candles.length >= 3 &&
                node.candlestickPattern != null) {
              rawSatisfied = CandlestickDetector.matches(node.candlestickPattern!, candles);
            }
            break;

          case AlertType.technicalIndicator:
            // Ensure candle timeframe matches node timeframe
            if (timeframe != null &&
                node.timeframe.toLowerCase() == timeframe.toLowerCase() &&
                candles != null &&
                candles.length >= 15 &&
                node.indicatorConfig != null) {
              final tempAlert = PriceAlert(
                id: 'temp_${node.id}',
                symbol: symbol,
                alertType: AlertType.technicalIndicator,
                indicatorConfig: node.indicatorConfig,
                timeframe: node.timeframe,
                createdAt: DateTime.now(),
                initialPrice: currentPrice ?? (candles.isNotEmpty ? candles.last.close : 0.0),
              );
              rawSatisfied = IndicatorCalculator.checkTrigger(tempAlert, candles);
            }
            break;

          case AlertType.multiStepChain:
            break;
        }

        final isNodeSatisfied = node.isNegated ? !rawSatisfied : rawSatisfied;
        if (isNodeSatisfied) {
          node.isSatisfied = true;
          node.satisfiedAt = DateTime.now();
          stageUpdated = true;
        }
      }

      // Check if current stage condition is met by evaluating chained sub-alarms
      bool isStageCompleted = false;
      if (currentStage.nodes.isNotEmpty) {
        isStageCompleted = currentStage.nodes.first.isSatisfied;
        for (int i = 1; i < currentStage.nodes.length; i++) {
          final n = currentStage.nodes[i];
          if (n.operatorToPrevious == 'OR') {
            isStageCompleted = isStageCompleted || n.isSatisfied;
          } else {
            isStageCompleted = isStageCompleted && n.isSatisfied;
          }
        }
      }

      if (isStageCompleted) {
        currentStage.isCompleted = true;
        currentStage.completedAt = DateTime.now();
        config.currentStageIndex++;
        stageUpdated = true;

        if (config.isAllCompleted) {
          // ALL LEVELS COMPLETED: ROOT ALARM RINGS!
          alert.isActive = false;
          alert.triggeredAt = DateTime.now();
          _history.insert(0, alert);
          notifyListeners();
          _saveToStorage();

          final triggerP = currentPrice ?? (candles != null && candles.isNotEmpty ? candles.last.close : alert.initialPrice);
          alarmService.playAlarm(ringtoneUri: alert.ringtoneUri);
          onAlertTriggered?.call(alert, triggerP);
          continue;
        }
      }

      if (stageUpdated) {
        notifyListeners();
        _saveToStorage();
      }
    }
  }

  /// Resets a multi-step logic chain alert so it can be re-run from Level 1
  void resetMultiStepAlert(String id) {
    final idx = _alerts.indexWhere((a) => a.id == id);
    if (idx != -1) {
      final alert = _alerts[idx];
      alert.multiStepConfig?.reset();
      alert.isActive = true;
      alert.triggeredAt = null;
      _history.removeWhere((a) => a.id == id);
      notifyListeners();
      _saveToStorage();
    }
  }

  /// Reloads alerts and history from shared storage and re-synchronizes state with native service.
  /// Called when the app returns to foreground from background.
  Future<void> reloadAndSync() async {
    await _loadFromStorage();
  }
}

File: analysis_orchestrator.dart

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import '../models/ai_models.dart';
import '../models/market_models.dart';
import 'ai_service.dart';
import 'biquote_service.dart';
import 'history_storage.dart';
import 'realmarket_service.dart';
import 'strategy_storage.dart';

class AnalysisOrchestrator {
  final AiService _aiService;
  final RealMarketService _realMarketService;
  final StrategyStorage _storage;

  final StreamController<AnalysisProgress> _progressController =
      StreamController<AnalysisProgress>.broadcast();
  Stream<AnalysisProgress> get progressStream => _progressController.stream;

  AnalysisOrchestrator({
    AiService? aiService,
    RealMarketService? realMarketService,
    StrategyStorage? storage,
    BiquoteService? biquoteFallback,
  })  : _aiService = aiService ?? AiService(),
        _realMarketService = realMarketService ??
            RealMarketService(biquoteFallback: biquoteFallback),
        _storage = storage ?? StrategyStorage();

  void _emitProgress({
    required PipelineStage stage,
    required String message,
    List<String>? activeAgents,
    required double progressFraction,
    Map<String, AgentSignal>? currentSignals,
    String? groundingCritique,
  }) {
    if (!_progressController.isClosed) {
      _progressController.add(AnalysisProgress(
        stage: stage,
        message: message,
        activeAgents: activeAgents,
        progressFraction: progressFraction,
        currentSignals: currentSignals,
        groundingCritique: groundingCritique,
      ));
    }
  }

  /// Formats the candles and technical market structure matching tradde.py and agent_orchestrator.py
  String _formatCandlesForPrompt(
    List<BiquoteCandle> candles,
    String symbol,
    String timeframe,
    MarketStructureAnalysis? structure,
  ) {
    if (candles.isEmpty) return 'No market data available.';

    final lastPrice = candles.last.close;
    final highAll = candles.map((c) => c.high).reduce(max);
    final lowAll = candles.map((c) => c.low).reduce(min);

    final sb = StringBuffer();
    sb.writeln('=== REALMARKET HISTORICAL CANDLE DATA ===');
    sb.writeln('INSTRUMENT: $symbol');
    sb.writeln('TIMEFRAME: $timeframe');
    sb.writeln('TOTAL CANDLES SUPPLIED: ${candles.length}');
    sb.writeln('CURRENT CLOSE PRICE: $lastPrice');
    sb.writeln('RANGE HIGH: $highAll | RANGE LOW: $lowAll\n');

    if (structure != null) {
      sb.writeln('=== TECHNICAL MARKET STRUCTURE & INDICATORS ===');
      sb.writeln('EMA 50: ${structure.ema50.toStringAsFixed(5)}');
      sb.writeln('EMA 200: ${structure.ema200.toStringAsFixed(5)}');
      sb.writeln('OVERALL TREND: ${structure.trend}');
      sb.writeln('14-PERIOD ATR VOLATILITY: ${structure.atr.toStringAsFixed(5)}');
      sb.writeln('BOLLINGER BAND WIDTH: ${(structure.bollingerWidth * 100).toStringAsFixed(2)}%');
      sb.writeln('MARKET CONSOLIDATION STATE: ${structure.isConsolidating ? "YES (Consolidating / Rangebound)" : "NO (Trending / Volatile)"}\n');

      if (structure.swingHighs.isNotEmpty) {
        sb.writeln('KEY SWING HIGHS (Resistance Levels):');
        for (final s in structure.swingHighs.take(6)) {
          sb.writeln('  • Price: ${s['price']} at ${s['time']}');
        }
        sb.writeln();
      }

      if (structure.swingLows.isNotEmpty) {
        sb.writeln('KEY SWING LOWS (Support Levels):');
        for (final s in structure.swingLows.take(6)) {
          sb.writeln('  • Price: ${s['price']} at ${s['time']}');
        }
        sb.writeln();
      }
    }

    sb.writeln('=== CANDLESTICK HISTORY (Matching Chart Range - ${candles.length} Candles) ===');
    final recordsList = candles.map((c) => {
      'time': c.openTime.toIso8601String(),
      'open': c.open,
      'high': c.high,
      'low': c.low,
      'close': c.close,
      'volume': c.tickVolume,
    }).toList();
    sb.writeln(const JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ').convert(recordsList));

    return sb.toString();
  }

  /// Executes the multi-agent or single-agent trading pipeline
  Future<PipelineRunResult> runPipeline({
    required TradingStrategy strategy,
    required String symbol,
    required List<String> timeframes,
  }) async {
    // 0. Ensure configurations are active
    final llmCfg = await _storage.getLlmConfig();
    _aiService.config = llmCfg;
    final rmCfg = await _storage.getRealMarketConfig();
    _realMarketService.config = rmCfg;

    if (strategy.specialists.isEmpty) {
      throw Exception('Strategy "${strategy.name}" contains no specialist agents.');
    }
    if (timeframes.isEmpty) {
      throw Exception('Must select at least one timeframe.');
    }

    final isMulti = strategy.isMultiAgent;
    final Map<String, AgentSignal> signalsMap = {};

    // 1. Fetch market data (100 candles from RealMarketAPI concurrently for all timeframes)
    final timeframesStr = timeframes.join(', ');
    _emitProgress(
      stage: PipelineStage.fetchingMarketData,
      message: 'Fetching last 100 genuine candles from RealMarket API for $symbol ($timeframesStr)...',
      progressFraction: 0.10,
    );

    final futures = timeframes.map((tf) => _realMarketService.fetchMarketCandles(symbol, tf)).toList();
    final fetchResults = await Future.wait(futures);
    
    final marketDataSummary = StringBuffer();
    double currentPrice = 0.0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < fetchResults.length; i++) {
      final fetchRes = fetchResults[i];
      final tf = timeframes[i];
      if (!fetchRes.isSuccess || fetchRes.candles.isEmpty) {
        final errorMsg = fetchRes.errorMessage ?? 'Could not fetch candles for $symbol ($tf).';
        _emitProgress(
          stage: PipelineStage.failed,
          message: 'Failed to retrieve market candles: $errorMsg',
          progressFraction: 0.0,
        );
        throw Exception(errorMsg);
      }
      
      final candles = fetchRes.candles;
      currentPrice = candles.last.close; // Will be the close of the last timeframe in the list
      marketDataSummary.writeln(_formatCandlesForPrompt(candles, symbol, tf, fetchRes.structure));
      marketDataSummary.writeln('\n----------------------------------------\n');
    }

    // 2. Stage: Initial Specialists
    _emitProgress(
      stage: PipelineStage.initialSpecialists,
      message: isMulti
          ? 'Running ${strategy.specialists.length} specialist agents in parallel...'
          : 'Running ${strategy.specialists.first.name}...',
      progressFraction: 0.25,
    );

    final initialSignals = <AgentSignal>[];

    if (isMulti) {
      // Parallel execution of all specialists
      final agentNames = strategy.specialists.map((s) => s.name).toList();
      _emitProgress(
        stage: PipelineStage.initialSpecialists,
        message: 'Agents analyzing market data concurrently...',
        activeAgents: agentNames,
        progressFraction: 0.30,
      );
      
      final futures = strategy.specialists.map((spec) async {

        final userPrompt = '''
=== RAW MARKET DATA (LAST 100 CANDLES) ===
$marketDataSummary

Perform technical analysis according to your methodology. Identify structure, key zones, and calculate your exact trade setup (entry, stop loss, take profit, confidence).
''';

        final signal = await _aiService.completeStructuredSignal(
          agentName: spec.name,
          systemPrompt: spec.systemPrompt,
          userPrompt: userPrompt,
          currentPrice: currentPrice,
        );
        signalsMap[spec.id] = signal;
        return signal;
      }).toList();

      final results = await Future.wait(futures);
      initialSignals.addAll(results);
    } else {
      // Single specialist
      final spec = strategy.specialists.first;
      final userPrompt = '''
=== RAW MARKET DATA (LAST 100 CANDLES) ===
$marketDataSummary

Analyze the market data and provide your technical structure analysis with exact trade setup levels.
''';
      final signal = await _aiService.completeStructuredSignal(
        agentName: spec.name,
        systemPrompt: spec.systemPrompt,
        userPrompt: userPrompt,
        currentPrice: currentPrice,
      );
      signalsMap[spec.id] = signal;
      initialSignals.add(signal);
    }

    // 3. Stage: Grounding Critic
    _emitProgress(
      stage: PipelineStage.groundingCritic,
      message: 'Grounding Critic cross-verifying specialist findings against raw 100 candles...',
      activeAgents: ['Grounding Critic'],
      progressFraction: 0.50,
      currentSignals: Map.from(signalsMap),
    );

    final groundingPrompt = _buildGroundingCriticSystemPrompt();
    final groundingUserContent = StringBuffer();
    groundingUserContent.writeln('=== RAW MARKET DATA (100 CANDLES GROUND TRUTH) ===');
    groundingUserContent.writeln(marketDataSummary);
    groundingUserContent.writeln('\n=== SPECIALIST ANALYSES TO AUDIT ===');
    for (int i = 0; i < initialSignals.length; i++) {
      final s = initialSignals[i];
      groundingUserContent.writeln('--- Specialist [${i + 1}]: ${s.agentName} ---');
      groundingUserContent.writeln('Direction: ${s.direction.label}');
      groundingUserContent.writeln('Entry: ${s.entryPrice} | SL: ${s.stopLoss} | TP: ${s.takeProfit} | Confidence: ${s.confidence}/10');
      groundingUserContent.writeln('Analysis: ${s.analysis}');
      groundingUserContent.writeln('Theory: ${s.theory}\n');
    }
    groundingUserContent.writeln('Perform an uncompromising audit. Point out discrepancies with the actual candlestick high/low numbers, false breakout claims, or logical errors.');

    final groundingCritique = await _aiService.complete(
      systemPrompt: groundingPrompt,
      userPrompt: groundingUserContent.toString(),
      temperature: 0.2,
    );

    // 4. Stage: Refinement (Specialists re-evaluate with Grounding feedback)
    final agentNames = strategy.specialists.map((s) => '${s.name} (Refining)').toList();
    _emitProgress(
      stage: PipelineStage.refinedSpecialists,
      message: 'Specialists refining analyses using Grounding Critic feedback...',
      activeAgents: isMulti ? agentNames : null,
      progressFraction: 0.70,
      groundingCritique: groundingCritique,
      currentSignals: Map.from(signalsMap),
    );

    final refinedSignals = <AgentSignal>[];

    if (isMulti) {
      final futures = strategy.specialists.map((spec) async {
        final initSig = signalsMap[spec.id]!;
        final refinePrompt = '''
=== RAW MARKET DATA ===
$marketDataSummary

=== YOUR INITIAL ANALYSIS ===
Direction: ${initSig.direction.label}
Entry: ${initSig.entryPrice} | SL: ${initSig.stopLoss} | TP: ${initSig.takeProfit}
Analysis: ${initSig.analysis}
Theory: ${initSig.theory}

=== GROUNDING CRITIC AUDIT ===
$groundingCritique

Re-evaluate your analysis. Correct any false levels or observations highlighted by the Grounding Critic. Produce your FINAL refined structured signal.
''';

        final refined = await _aiService.completeStructuredSignal(
          agentName: spec.name,
          systemPrompt: spec.systemPrompt,
          userPrompt: refinePrompt,
          currentPrice: currentPrice,
        );
        signalsMap[spec.id] = refined;
        return refined;
      }).toList();

      final results = await Future.wait(futures);
      refinedSignals.addAll(results);
    } else {
      final spec = strategy.specialists.first;
      final initSig = initialSignals.first;
      final refinePrompt = '''
=== RAW MARKET DATA ===
$marketDataSummary

=== YOUR INITIAL ANALYSIS ===
Direction: ${initSig.direction.label}
Entry: ${initSig.entryPrice} | SL: ${initSig.stopLoss} | TP: ${initSig.takeProfit}
Analysis: ${initSig.analysis}
Theory: ${initSig.theory}

=== GROUNDING CRITIC AUDIT ===
$groundingCritique

Re-evaluate your analysis. Correct any inaccuracies or issues noted by the Grounding Critic. Produce your FINAL refined structured signal.
''';
      final refined = await _aiService.completeStructuredSignal(
        agentName: spec.name,
        systemPrompt: spec.systemPrompt,
        userPrompt: refinePrompt,
        currentPrice: currentPrice,
      );
      signalsMap[spec.id] = refined;
      refinedSignals.add(refined);
    }

    AgentSignal? consolidatedSignal;

    // 5. Stage: Metareasoning Consolidator (if specialists > 1)
    if (isMulti) {
      _emitProgress(
        stage: PipelineStage.metareasoningConsolidator,
        message: 'Metareasoning Consolidator synthesizing final consensus signal...',
        activeAgents: ['Metareasoning Consolidator'],
        progressFraction: 0.90,
        groundingCritique: groundingCritique,
        currentSignals: Map.from(signalsMap),
      );

      final metaPrompt = _buildMetareasoningSystemPrompt();
      final metaUserContent = StringBuffer();
      metaUserContent.writeln('=== RAW MARKET DATA (100 CANDLES) ===');
      metaUserContent.writeln(marketDataSummary);
      metaUserContent.writeln('\n=== REFINED SPECIALIST ANALYSES ===');
      for (final s in refinedSignals) {
        metaUserContent.writeln('--- Specialist: ${s.agentName} ---');
        metaUserContent.writeln('Direction: ${s.direction.label}');
        metaUserContent.writeln('Entry: ${s.entryPrice} | SL: ${s.stopLoss} | TP: ${s.takeProfit} | Confidence: ${s.confidence}/10');
        metaUserContent.writeln('Analysis: ${s.analysis}');
        metaUserContent.writeln('Theory: ${s.theory}\n');
      }
      metaUserContent.writeln('=== GROUNDING CRITIC FINDINGS ===\n$groundingCritique\n');
      metaUserContent.writeln('Synthesize these perspectives and output the final consolidated trade signal.');

      consolidatedSignal = await _aiService.completeStructuredSignal(
        agentName: 'Metareasoning Consolidator',
        systemPrompt: metaPrompt,
        userPrompt: metaUserContent.toString(),
        currentPrice: currentPrice,
        temperature: 0.3,
      );
    }

    // 6. Complete
    final result = PipelineRunResult(
      strategy: strategy,
      symbol: symbol,
      timeframe: timeframesStr,
      initialSpecialistSignals: initialSignals,
      groundingCritique: groundingCritique,
      refinedSpecialistSignals: refinedSignals,
      consolidatedSignal: consolidatedSignal,
      timestamp: DateTime.now(),
    );

    // Save active signal for instant chart overlay
    await _storage.saveLastChartSignal(result.finalSignal);
    
    // Save to history store
    await HistoryStorage().saveAnalysis(result);

    _emitProgress(
      stage: PipelineStage.completed,
      message: 'Analysis complete! Final trade setup ready.',
      progressFraction: 1.0,
      groundingCritique: groundingCritique,
      currentSignals: Map.from(signalsMap),
    );

    return result;
  }

  /// System prompt for the generic Grounding Critic
  String _buildGroundingCriticSystemPrompt() {
    return '''Role: You are an elite Technical Analysis Validator and Grounding Critic.
Your mission is to audit and cross-examine the specialist trading analyses against the actual raw 100-candle dataset provided.

STRICT VALIDATION RULES:
1. Ground Truth Verification: Verify that mentioned swing highs, swing lows, prices, and candle times actually exist in the 100 candles.
2. Structure Accuracy: Flag any fabricated Break of Structure (BOS), Change of Character (CHoCH), or phase misinterpretations that do not match the real price action.
3. Level Sanity Check: Ensure entry, stop loss, and take profit prices are logically arranged (for BUY: SL < Entry < TP; for SELL: TP < Entry < SL).
4. Discrepancies & Hallucinations: Explicitly state any discrepancies or hallucinations without sugarcoating. Be rigorous, objective, and precise.''';
  }

  /// System prompt for the generic Metareasoning Consolidator
  String _buildMetareasoningSystemPrompt() {
    return '''Role: You are the Master Metareasoning Portfolio Manager and Chief Investment Officer.
You are given:
1. The raw 100-candle market data.
2. The refined analyses and trade parameters from multiple specialist agents.
3. The Grounding Critic evaluation.

Your responsibility is to synthesize these distinct specialist perspectives into a single unified high-conviction trade signal.

STRICT CONSOLIDATION RULES:
1. Directional Consensus:
   - If specialists agree on direction (e.g. all BUY or all SELL), consolidate their optimal entry, stop loss, and take profit into the best unified setup.
   - If specialists directly conflict (e.g. one BUY and one SELL), or if the evidence is ambiguous, you MUST select direction: "wait", explain the conflict in your analysis, and set entry_price, stop_loss, and take_profit to the current market price.
2. Single Exact Numbers:
   - Output single exact numbers for entry_price, stop_loss, and take_profit (no price ranges in the numeric fields; ranges belong in analysis/theory).
3. Confidence:
   - Set confidence from 1 to 10 based on the degree of alignment and clarity of structure.''';
  }
}


------------------------------------------------------------

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import '../models/market_models.dart';

class BiquoteService {
  static const String baseUrl = 'https://biquote.io';
  static const String directIp = '142.132.248.240';
  static const String directBaseUrl = 'https://142.132.248.240';
  static const String signalRUrl = 'wss://biquote.io/hubs/tick';
  static const String directSignalRUrl = 'wss://142.132.248.240/hubs/tick';

  final http.Client _client;
  late final HttpClient _ioClient;

  WebSocket? _ws;
  final StreamController<BiquoteTick> _tickController = StreamController<BiquoteTick>.broadcast();
  Stream<BiquoteTick> get tickStream => _tickController.stream;

  final Set<String> _subscribedSymbols = {};
  bool _isConnected = false;
  bool get isConnected => _isConnected;
  bool _isConnecting = false;
  bool _isDisposed = false;
  Timer? _reconnectTimer;
  Timer? _pingTimer;

  final Map<String, double> _livePrices = {};

  final ValueNotifier<bool> isOnlineNotifier = ValueNotifier<bool>(true);
  bool get isOnline => isOnlineNotifier.value;

  BiquoteService({http.Client? client}) : _client = client ?? http.Client() {
    _ioClient = HttpClient();
    _ioClient.badCertificateCallback = (cert, host, port) => true;
    _ioClient.connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 4);
  }

  void _onNetworkSuccess() {
    if (!isOnlineNotifier.value) {
      isOnlineNotifier.value = true;
    }
  }

  void _onNetworkFailure() {
    if (isOnlineNotifier.value) {
      isOnlineNotifier.value = false;
    }
  }

  /// Manually retry connection when user taps retry
  Future<void> retryConnection() async {
    if (_subscribedSymbols.isNotEmpty) {
      await getLatestQuotes(_subscribedSymbols.toList());
    }
    await _connectSignalR();
  }

  /// Helper to fetch JSON from Biquote API with resilient DNS fallback to direct IP
  Future<dynamic> _fetchJson(String pathAndQuery) async {
    // 1. Try primary domain first
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('$baseUrl$pathAndQuery');
      final response = await _client.get(uri).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        _onNetworkSuccess();
        return jsonDecode(response.body);
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // 2. Resilient Fallback: Direct IP with Host header for environments with broken DNS (e.g. Android emulators)
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('$directBaseUrl$pathAndQuery');
      final req = await _ioClient.getUrl(uri).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
      req.headers.set('Host', 'biquote.io');
      final resp = await req.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
      if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
        _onNetworkSuccess();
        final body = await resp.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
        return jsonDecode(body);
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    _onNetworkFailure();
    return null;
  }

  /// Initializes real-time SignalR WebSocket connection to https://biquote.io/hubs/tick
  Future<void> initSignalR(List<String> initialSymbols) async {
    _subscribedSymbols.addAll(initialSymbols);
    await _connectSignalR();
  }

  Future<void> _connectSignalR() async {
    if (_isDisposed || _isConnecting || _isConnected) return;
    _isConnecting = true;

    try {
      try {
        // Try domain first
        _ws = await WebSocket.connect(signalRUrl).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
      } catch (_) {
        // Fallback to direct IP with Host header
        _ws = await WebSocket.connect(
          directSignalRUrl,
          headers: {'Host': 'biquote.io'},
          customClient: _ioClient,
        ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
      }

      _isConnected = true;
      _isConnecting = false;

      // 1. Send ASP.NET Core SignalR JSON protocol handshake
      _ws!.add('{"protocol":"json","version":1}\x1e');

      // 2. Start ping interval (SignalR expects periodic heartbeat)
      _pingTimer?.cancel();
      _pingTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 15), (_) {
        if (_isConnected && _ws != null) {
          try {
            _ws!.add('{"type":6}\x1e'); // SignalR Ping
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      });

      // 3. Listen to incoming messages
      _ws!.listen(
        (data) => _handleIncomingData(data.toString()),
        onError: (err) {
          _handleDisconnect();
        },
        onDone: () {
          _handleDisconnect();
        },
        cancelOnError: true,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      _isConnecting = false;
      _handleDisconnect();
    }
  }

  void _handleIncomingData(String rawData) {
    // SignalR messages are separated by ASCII 30 (Record Separator \x1e)
    final messages = rawData.split('\x1e');
    for (final msg in messages) {
      final trimmed = msg.trim();
      if (trimmed.isEmpty) continue;

      if (trimmed == '{}') {
        // Handshake acknowledged! Resubscribe to tracked symbols
        _isConnected = true;
        _onNetworkSuccess();
        if (_subscribedSymbols.isNotEmpty) {
          _sendSubscription(_subscribedSymbols.toList());
        }
        continue;
      }

      try {
        final Map<String, dynamic> json = jsonDecode(trimmed);
        final int type = json['type'] as int? ?? 0;

        if (type == 1) {
          // Invocation message
          final String target = json['target'] as String? ?? '';
          final List<dynamic>? args = json['arguments'] as List<dynamic>?;

          if (target == 'ReceiveTick' && args != null && args.isNotEmpty) {
            _onNetworkSuccess();
            final tickData = args[0] as Map<String, dynamic>;
            final tick = BiquoteTick.fromJson(tickData);
            _livePrices[tick.symbol] = tick.mid;
            if (!_tickController.isClosed) {
              _tickController.add(tick);
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  void _sendSubscription(List<String> symbols) {
    if (_ws != null && _isConnected) {
      try {
        final payload = jsonEncode({
          'type': 1,
          'target': 'Subscribe',
          'arguments': [symbols],
        });
        _ws!.add('$payload\x1e');
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  /// Subscribe to new symbols live
  void subscribe(List<String> symbols) {
    _subscribedSymbols.addAll(symbols);
    if (_isConnected) {
      _sendSubscription(symbols);
    } else {
      _connectSignalR();
    }
  }

  /// Unsubscribe from symbols
  void unsubscribe(List<String> symbols) {
    _subscribedSymbols.removeAll(symbols);
    if (_ws != null && _isConnected) {
      try {
        final payload = jsonEncode({
          'type': 1,
          'target': 'Unsubscribe',
          'arguments': [symbols],
        });
        _ws!.add('$payload\x1e');
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  void _handleDisconnect() {
    _isConnected = false;
    _isConnecting = false;
    if (isOnlineNotifier.value) {
      isOnlineNotifier.value = false;
    }
    _pingTimer?.cancel();
    try {
      _ws?.close();
    } catch (_) {}
    _ws = null;

    if (!_isDisposed) {
      _reconnectTimer?.cancel();
      _reconnectTimer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 3), () {
        _connectSignalR();
      });
    }
  }

  /// Fetch batch quotes for multiple symbols using repeated query params
  Future<Map<String, BiquoteTick>> getLatestQuotes(
    List<String> symbols, {
    bool allowStale = true,
  }) async {
    if (symbols.isEmpty) return {};

    final queryParams = symbols.map((s) => 'symbols=$s').join('&');
    final path = '/api/latest?$queryParams&allowStale=$allowStale';

    final data = await _fetchJson(path);
    if (data is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      final result = <String, BiquoteTick>{};
      data.forEach((key, value) {
        if (value is Map<String, dynamic>) {
          final tick = BiquoteTick.fromJson(value);
          result[key] = tick;
          _livePrices[key] = tick.mid;
        }
      });
      return result;
    }

    return {};
  }

  /// Fetch single quote
  Future<BiquoteTick?> getSingleQuote(String symbol, {bool allowStale = true}) async {
    final path = '/api/$symbol?allowStale=$allowStale';
    final data = await _fetchJson(path);
    if (data is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      final tick = BiquoteTick.fromJson(data);
      _livePrices[symbol] = tick.mid;
      return tick;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /// Fetch OHLC candles.
  /// Anti-pattern 5 averted: Reverses Biquote newest-first order to chronological (oldest to newest).
  /// Valid intervals according to Biquote docs: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d.
  Future<List<BiquoteCandle>> getCandles(
    String symbol, {
    String interval = '1h',
    int limit = 60,
    DateTime? to,
  }) async {
    final sanitizedInterval = _sanitizeInterval(interval);
    final toParam = to != null ? '&to=${Uri.encodeComponent(to.toUtc().toIso8601String())}' : '';
    final path = '/api/$symbol/ohlc?interval=$sanitizedInterval&limit=$limit$toParam';

    final data = await _fetchJson(path);
    if (data is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      final List<dynamic> barsJson = data['bars'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [];
      if (barsJson.isNotEmpty) {
        final candles = barsJson
            .map((b) => BiquoteCandle.fromJson(b as Map<String, dynamic>))
            .toList();
        final chronological = candles.reversed.toList();
        if (chronological.isNotEmpty) {
          _livePrices[symbol] = chronological.last.close;
        }
        return chronological;
      }
    }

    return [];
  }

  String _sanitizeInterval(String tf) {
    final lower = tf.toLowerCase();
    switch (lower) {
      case '1m':
        return '1m';
      case '5m':
        return '5m';
      case '15m':
        return '15m';
      case '30m':
        return '30m';
      case '1h':
        return '1h';
      case '4h':
        return '4h';
      case '1d':
      case '1w':
        return '1d';
      default:
        return '1h';
    }
  }

  void dispose() {
    _isDisposed = true;
    _pingTimer?.cancel();
    _reconnectTimer?.cancel();
    try {
      _ws?.close();
    } catch (_) {}
    _tickController.close();
    _ioClient.close(force: true);
  }
}
