import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../screens/economic_calendar_screen.dart';
import '../screens/market_movers_screen.dart';
import '../screens/financial_news_screen.dart';
import '../screens/currency_matrix_screen.dart';

/// Opens genuine Biquote market features as native Flutter screens.
/// Powered directly by Biquote REST & SignalR WebSocket APIs.
class BiquoteWidgetService {
  static Future<void> openEconomicCalendar(BuildContext context) {
    return Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const EconomicCalendarScreen()),
    );
  }

  static Future<void> openMarketMovers(BuildContext context) {
    return Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const MarketMoversScreen()),
    );
  }

  static Future<void> openFinancialNews(BuildContext context) {
    return Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const FinancialNewsScreen()),
    );
  }

  static Future<void> openCurrencyMatrix(BuildContext context) {
    return Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const CurrencyMatrixScreen()),
    );
  }
}


------------------------------------------------------------
File: candlestick_detector.dart
------------------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:math';
import '../models/market_models.dart';

class CandlestickDetector {
  /// Evaluates whether the given candlestick pattern is formed on the latest completed candles.
  /// [candles] must be provided in chronological order (oldest to newest).
  static bool matches(CandlestickPattern pattern, List<BiquoteCandle> candles) {
    if (candles.length < 3) return false;

    // Filter out active in-progress candle if needed, or use the latest closed candles
    // The last candle in chronological list is typically index = length - 1
    final c0 = candles[candles.length - 1]; // Latest candle
    final c1 = candles[candles.length - 2]; // 1 candle ago
    final c2 = candles.length >= 3 ? candles[candles.length - 3] : null; // 2 candles ago

    switch (pattern) {
      case CandlestickPattern.bullishEngulfing:
        return _isBullishEngulfing(c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.bearishEngulfing:
        return _isBearishEngulfing(c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.hammer:
        return _isHammer(c0, c1);
      case CandlestickPattern.hangingMan:
        return _isHangingMan(c0, c1);
      case CandlestickPattern.shootingStar:
        return _isShootingStar(c0, c1);
      case CandlestickPattern.invertedHammer:
        return _isInvertedHammer(c0, c1);
      case CandlestickPattern.morningStar:
        return c2 != null && _isMorningStar(c2, c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.eveningStar:
        return c2 != null && _isEveningStar(c2, c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.doji:
        return _isDoji(c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.dragonflyDoji:
        return _isDragonflyDoji(c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.gravestoneDoji:
        return _isGravestoneDoji(c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.piercingLine:
        return _isPiercingLine(c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.darkCloudCover:
        return _isDarkCloudCover(c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.threeWhiteSoldiers:
        return c2 != null && _isThreeWhiteSoldiers(c2, c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.threeBlackCrows:
        return c2 != null && _isThreeBlackCrows(c2, c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.bullishHarami:
        return _isBullishHarami(c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.bearishHarami:
        return _isBearishHarami(c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.tweezerBottom:
        return _isTweezerBottom(c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.tweezerTop:
        return _isTweezerTop(c1, c0);
      case CandlestickPattern.marubozu:
        return _isMarubozu(c0);
    }
  }

  // --- Candle Metric Helpers ---
  static double _body(BiquoteCandle c) => (c.close - c.open).abs();
  static double _range(BiquoteCandle c) => max(0.000001, c.high - c.low);
  static double _upperShadow(BiquoteCandle c) => c.high - max(c.open, c.close);
  static double _lowerShadow(BiquoteCandle c) => min(c.open, c.close) - c.low;

  // 1. Engulfing
  static bool _isBullishEngulfing(BiquoteCandle prev, BiquoteCandle curr) {
    if (prev.close >= prev.open) return false; // prev must be red
    if (curr.close <= curr.open) return false; // curr must be green
    final prevBody = _body(prev);
    final currBody = _body(curr);
    return currBody > prevBody &&
        curr.open <= prev.close &&
        curr.close >= prev.open;
  }

  static bool _isBearishEngulfing(BiquoteCandle prev, BiquoteCandle curr) {
    if (prev.close <= prev.open) return false; // prev must be green
    if (curr.close >= curr.open) return false; // curr must be red
    final prevBody = _body(prev);
    final currBody = _body(curr);
    return currBody > prevBody &&
        curr.open >= prev.close &&
        curr.close <= prev.open;
  }

  // 2. Hammer & Hanging Man
  static bool _isHammer(BiquoteCandle curr, BiquoteCandle prev) {
    final body = _body(curr);
    final range = _range(curr);
    final lower = _lowerShadow(curr);
    final upper = _upperShadow(curr);

    final isPinBar = body <= 0.35 * range &&
        lower >= 2.0 * body &&
        upper <= 0.15 * range;
    final isDowntrend = prev.close < prev.open || curr.low < prev.low;
    return isPinBar && isDowntrend;
  }

  static bool _isHangingMan(BiquoteCandle curr, BiquoteCandle prev) {
    final body = _body(curr);
    final range = _range(curr);
    final lower = _lowerShadow(curr);
    final upper = _upperShadow(curr);

    final isPinBar = body <= 0.35 * range &&
        lower >= 2.0 * body &&
        upper <= 0.15 * range;
    final isUptrend = prev.close > prev.open || curr.high > prev.high;
    return isPinBar && isUptrend;
  }

  // 3. Shooting Star & Inverted Hammer
  static bool _isShootingStar(BiquoteCandle curr, BiquoteCandle prev) {
    final body = _body(curr);
    final range = _range(curr);
    final lower = _lowerShadow(curr);
    final upper = _upperShadow(curr);

    final isInvertedPin = body <= 0.35 * range &&
        upper >= 2.0 * body &&
        lower <= 0.15 * range;
    final isUptrend = prev.close > prev.open || curr.high > prev.high;
    return isInvertedPin && isUptrend;
  }

  static bool _isInvertedHammer(BiquoteCandle curr, BiquoteCandle prev) {
    final body = _body(curr);
    final range = _range(curr);
    final lower = _lowerShadow(curr);
    final upper = _upperShadow(curr);

    final isInvertedPin = body <= 0.35 * range &&
        upper >= 2.0 * body &&
        lower <= 0.15 * range;
    final isDowntrend = prev.close < prev.open || curr.low < prev.low;
    return isInvertedPin && isDowntrend;
  }

  // 4. Morning Star & Evening Star
  static bool _isMorningStar(BiquoteCandle c1, BiquoteCandle c2, BiquoteCandle c3) {
    // c1: Strong red
    if (c1.close >= c1.open || _body(c1) < 0.45 * _range(c1)) return false;
    // c2: Small star
    if (_body(c2) > 0.35 * _body(c1)) return false;
    // c3: Strong green closing above 50% midpoint of c1
    if (c3.close <= c3.open) return false;
    final midpoint = c1.close + (_body(c1) * 0.5);
    return c3.close >= midpoint;
  }

  static bool _isEveningStar(BiquoteCandle c1, BiquoteCandle c2, BiquoteCandle c3) {
    // c1: Strong green
    if (c1.close <= c1.open || _body(c1) < 0.45 * _range(c1)) return false;
    // c2: Small star
    if (_body(c2) > 0.35 * _body(c1)) return false;
    // c3: Strong red closing below 50% midpoint of c1
    if (c3.close >= c3.open) return false;
    final midpoint = c1.open + (_body(c1) * 0.5);
    return c3.close <= midpoint;
  }

  // 5. Doji variations
  static bool _isDoji(BiquoteCandle c) {
    return _body(c) <= 0.08 * _range(c);
  }

  static bool _isDragonflyDoji(BiquoteCandle c) {
    final range = _range(c);
    return _body(c) <= 0.08 * range &&
        _upperShadow(c) <= 0.12 * range &&
        _lowerShadow(c) >= 0.65 * range;
  }

  static bool _isGravestoneDoji(BiquoteCandle c) {
    final range = _range(c);
    return _body(c) <= 0.08 * range &&
        _lowerShadow(c) <= 0.12 * range &&
        _upperShadow(c) >= 0.65 * range;
  }

  // 6. Piercing Line & Dark Cloud Cover
  static bool _isPiercingLine(BiquoteCandle prev, BiquoteCandle curr) {
    if (prev.close >= prev.open) return false; // prev must be red
    if (curr.close <= curr.open) return false; // curr must be green
    final prevMidpoint = prev.close + (_body(prev) * 0.5);
    return curr.open <= prev.low &&
        curr.close >= prevMidpoint &&
        curr.close <= prev.open;
  }

  static bool _isDarkCloudCover(BiquoteCandle prev, BiquoteCandle curr) {
    if (prev.close <= prev.open) return false; // prev must be green
    if (curr.close >= curr.open) return false; // curr must be red
    final prevMidpoint = prev.open + (_body(prev) * 0.5);
    return curr.open >= prev.high &&
        curr.close <= prevMidpoint &&
        curr.close >= prev.open;
  }

  // 7. Three White Soldiers & Three Black Crows
  static bool _isThreeWhiteSoldiers(BiquoteCandle c1, BiquoteCandle c2, BiquoteCandle c3) {
    return (c1.close > c1.open) &&
        (c2.close > c2.open) &&
        (c3.close > c3.open) &&
        (c2.close > c1.close) &&
        (c3.close > c2.close) &&
        (c2.open > c1.open && c2.open < c1.close) &&
        (c3.open > c2.open && c3.open < c2.close) &&
        (_upperShadow(c3) <= 0.25 * _range(c3));
  }

  static bool _isThreeBlackCrows(BiquoteCandle c1, BiquoteCandle c2, BiquoteCandle c3) {
    return (c1.close < c1.open) &&
        (c2.close < c2.open) &&
        (c3.close < c3.open) &&
        (c2.close < c1.close) &&
        (c3.close < c2.close) &&
        (c2.open < c1.open && c2.open > c1.close) &&
        (c3.open < c2.open && c3.open > c2.close) &&
        (_lowerShadow(c3) <= 0.25 * _range(c3));
  }

  // 8. Harami
  static bool _isBullishHarami(BiquoteCandle prev, BiquoteCandle curr) {
    if (prev.close >= prev.open) return false; // prev must be red
    if (curr.close <= curr.open) return false; // curr must be green
    return curr.open >= prev.close &&
        curr.close <= prev.open &&
        _body(curr) < _body(prev) * 0.7;
  }

  static bool _isBearishHarami(BiquoteCandle prev, BiquoteCandle curr) {
    if (prev.close <= prev.open) return false; // prev must be green
    if (curr.close >= curr.open) return false; // curr must be red
    return curr.open <= prev.close &&
        curr.close >= prev.open &&
        _body(curr) < _body(prev) * 0.7;
  }

  // 9. Tweezers
  static bool _isTweezerBottom(BiquoteCandle prev, BiquoteCandle curr) {
    if (prev.close >= prev.open) return false; // prev red
    if (curr.close <= curr.open) return false; // curr green
    final diff = (prev.low - curr.low).abs();
    return diff <= (prev.low * 0.00015) && _lowerShadow(curr) >= 0.3 * _range(curr);
  }

  static bool _isTweezerTop(BiquoteCandle prev, BiquoteCandle curr) {
    if (prev.close <= prev.open) return false; // prev green
    if (curr.close >= curr.open) return false; // curr red
    final diff = (prev.high - curr.high).abs();
    return diff <= (prev.high * 0.00015) && _upperShadow(curr) >= 0.3 * _range(curr);
  }

  // 10. Marubozu
  static bool _isMarubozu(BiquoteCandle c) {
    final body = _body(c);
    final range = _range(c);
    return body >= 0.88 * range;
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import '../models/drawing_models.dart';
import 'storage_service.dart';

class DrawingStorageService {
  static final DrawingStorageService _instance = DrawingStorageService._internal();
  factory DrawingStorageService() => _instance;
  DrawingStorageService._internal();

  final Map<String, List<ChartDrawing>> _cache = {};

  Future<void> init() async {}

  Future<List<ChartDrawing>> loadDrawings(String symbol) async {
    if (_cache.containsKey(symbol)) {
      return List.from(_cache[symbol]!);
    }

    try {
      final key = 'drawings_$symbol';
      final content = await StorageService.getString(key);
      if (content != null && content.isNotEmpty) {
        final List<dynamic> jsonList = jsonDecode(content);
        final drawings = jsonList
            .map((item) => ChartDrawing.fromJson(item as Map<String, dynamic>))
            .toList();
        _cache[symbol] = drawings;
        return drawings;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error loading drawings for $symbol: $e');
    }

    _cache[symbol] = [];
    return [];
  }

  Future<void> saveDrawings(String symbol, List<ChartDrawing> drawings) async {
    _cache[symbol] = List.from(drawings);
    try {
      final key = 'drawings_$symbol';
      final jsonString = jsonEncode(drawings.map((d) => d.toJson()).toList());
      await StorageService.setString(key, jsonString);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error saving drawings for $symbol: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> clearDrawings(String symbol) async {
    _cache[symbol] = [];
    try {
      final key = 'drawings_$symbol';
      await StorageService.remove(key);
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'storage_service.dart';

class FavoritesService extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final FavoritesService _instance = FavoritesService._internal();
  factory FavoritesService() => _instance;
  FavoritesService._internal();

  static const String _storageKey = 'favorite_symbols';
  static const List<String> defaultFavorites = [
    'EURUSD',
    'GBPUSD',
    'USDJPY',
    'XAUUSD',
    'BTCUSD',
  ];

  List<String> _favorites = List.from(defaultFavorites);
  bool _isLoaded = false;

  List<String> get favorites => List.unmodifiable(_favorites);
  bool get isLoaded => _isLoaded;

  Future<void> init() async {
    if (_isLoaded) return;
    try {
      final raw = await StorageService.getString(_storageKey);
      if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
        final List<dynamic> decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
        final loaded = decoded.map((e) => e.toString().toUpperCase()).toList();
        if (loaded.isNotEmpty) {
          _favorites = loaded;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('FavoritesService load error: $e');
    }
    _isLoaded = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  bool isFavorite(String symbol) {
    return _favorites.contains(symbol.toUpperCase());
  }

  Future<bool> toggleFavorite(String symbol) async {
    final clean = symbol.toUpperCase();
    final bool nowFavorited;
    if (_favorites.contains(clean)) {
      _favorites.remove(clean);
      nowFavorited = false;
    } else {
      _favorites.add(clean);
      nowFavorited = true;
    }
    notifyListeners();
    await _persist();
    return nowFavorited;
  }

  Future<void> addFavorite(String symbol) async {
    final clean = symbol.toUpperCase();
    if (!_favorites.contains(clean)) {
      _favorites.add(clean);
      notifyListeners();
      await _persist();
    }
  }

  Future<void> removeFavorite(String symbol) async {
    final clean = symbol.toUpperCase();
    if (_favorites.remove(clean)) {
      notifyListeners();
      await _persist();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _persist() async {
    try {
      final encoded = jsonEncode(_favorites);
      await StorageService.setString(_storageKey, encoded);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('FavoritesService persist error: $e');
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import '../models/ai_models.dart';
import 'storage_service.dart';

class HistoryStorage {
  static const String _historyKey = 'ai_analysis_history';
  static final HistoryStorage _instance = HistoryStorage._internal();

  factory HistoryStorage() => _instance;
  HistoryStorage._internal();

  List<PipelineRunResult>? _cachedHistory;

  Future<List<PipelineRunResult>> getHistory() async {
    if (_cachedHistory != null) return _cachedHistory!;

    try {
      final raw = await StorageService.getString(_historyKey);
      if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
        final List<dynamic> decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
        final list = decoded
            .map((e) => PipelineRunResult.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>))
            .toList();
        
        // Sort newest first
        list.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp.compareTo(a.timestamp));
        _cachedHistory = list;
        return list;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('HistoryStorage load error: $e');
    }

    _cachedHistory = [];
    return _cachedHistory!;
  }

  Future<void> saveAnalysis(PipelineRunResult result) async {
    final history = await getHistory();
    history.insert(0, result);
    
    // Keep last 100 analyses max to prevent bloat
    if (history.length > 100) {
      history.removeLast();
    }
    
    _cachedHistory = history;
    await _persistHistory(history);
  }

  Future<void> clearHistory() async {
    _cachedHistory = [];
    await StorageService.remove(_historyKey);
  }

  Future<void> _persistHistory(List<PipelineRunResult> history) async {
    try {
      final encoded = jsonEncode(history.map((e) => e.toJson()).toList());
      await StorageService.setString(_historyKey, encoded);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('HistoryStorage save error: $e');
    }
  }
}

File: indicator_calculator.dart
------------------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:math';
import '../models/market_models.dart';

class IndicatorCalculator {
  /// Evaluates whether the given indicator alert condition is triggered on the latest candle.
  /// [candles] must be provided in chronological order (oldest to newest).
  static bool checkTrigger(PriceAlert alert, List<BiquoteCandle> candles) {
    final config = alert.indicatorConfig;
    if (config == null || candles.length < 5) return false;

    switch (config.indicatorType) {
      case AlertIndicatorType.rsi:
        return _checkRsi(config, candles);
      case AlertIndicatorType.macd:
        return _checkMacd(config, candles);
      case AlertIndicatorType.maCross:
        return _checkMaCross(config, candles);
      case AlertIndicatorType.bollingerBands:
        return _checkBollinger(config, candles);
      case AlertIndicatorType.stochastic:
        return _checkStochastic(config, candles);
      case AlertIndicatorType.supertrend:
        return _checkSupertrend(config, candles);
    }
  }

  // ==========================================
  // Helper: Price Source Extractor
  // ==========================================
  static List<double> _extractPrices(List<BiquoteCandle> candles, String source) {
    switch (source.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'open':
        return candles.map((c) => c.open).toList();
      case 'high':
        return candles.map((c) => c.high).toList();
      case 'low':
        return candles.map((c) => c.low).toList();
      case 'hl2':
        return candles.map((c) => (c.high + c.low) / 2.0).toList();
      case 'hlc3':
        return candles.map((c) => (c.high + c.low + c.close) / 3.0).toList();
      case 'ohlc4':
        return candles.map((c) => (c.open + c.high + c.low + c.close) / 4.0).toList();
      case 'close':
      default:
        return candles.map((c) => c.close).toList();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 1. RSI (Relative Strength Index) + Signal MA of RSI
  // ==========================================
  static bool _checkRsi(IndicatorAlertConfig config, List<BiquoteCandle> candles) {
    final period = (config.params['period'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 14;
    final level = (config.params['level'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 30.0;
    final source = (config.params['source'] as String?) ?? 'Close';
    final smoothingType = (config.params['smoothingType'] as String?) ?? 'RMA';
    final obLevel = (config.params['overbought'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 70.0;
    final osLevel = (config.params['oversold'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 30.0;

    if (candles.length <= period + 2) return false;

    final prices = _extractPrices(candles, source);
    final rsiSeries = calculateRsiSeriesFromPrices(prices, period, smoothingType: smoothingType);
    if (rsiSeries.length < 2) return false;

    final curr = rsiSeries[rsiSeries.length - 1];
    final prev = rsiSeries[rsiSeries.length - 2];

    // Indicator on Indicator: RSI crossing its own Signal Moving Average (MA of RSI)
    if (config.condition == 'crossesAboveSignalMa' || config.condition == 'crossesBelowSignalMa') {
      final signalMaPeriod = (config.params['signalMaPeriod'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 9;
      final signalMaType = (config.params['signalMaType'] as String?) ?? 'EMA';
      if (rsiSeries.length < signalMaPeriod + 2) return false;

      final maSeries = _calculateMaSeries(rsiSeries, signalMaPeriod, signalMaType);

      if (maSeries.length < 2) return false;

      final currMa = maSeries.last;
      final prevMa = maSeries[maSeries.length - 2];
      final currRsi = rsiSeries.last;
      final prevRsi = rsiSeries[rsiSeries.length - 2];

      if (config.condition == 'crossesAboveSignalMa') {
        return prevRsi <= prevMa && currRsi > currMa;
      } else {
        return prevRsi >= prevMa && currRsi < currMa;
      }
    }

    switch (config.condition) {
      case 'crossesAbove':
      case 'crossesAboveLevel':
        return prev < level && curr >= level;
      case 'crossesBelow':
      case 'crossesBelowLevel':
        return prev > level && curr <= level;
      case 'crossesBelowOversold':
        return prev >= osLevel && curr < osLevel;
      case 'crossesAboveOversold': // exit oversold / recovery
        return prev <= osLevel && curr > osLevel;
      case 'crossesAboveOverbought':
        return prev <= obLevel && curr > obLevel;
      case 'crossesBelowOverbought': // exit overbought / pullback
        return prev >= obLevel && curr < obLevel;
      case 'overboughtEnter':
        return prev <= obLevel && curr > obLevel;
      case 'oversoldEnter':
        return prev >= osLevel && curr < osLevel;
      case 'crossesAboveCenterline':
        return prev <= 50.0 && curr > 50.0;
      case 'crossesBelowCenterline':
        return prev >= 50.0 && curr < 50.0;
      case 'centerlineCross':
        return (prev < 50.0 && curr >= 50.0) || (prev > 50.0 && curr <= 50.0);
      case 'inOversold':
        return curr < osLevel;
      case 'inOverbought':
        return curr > obLevel;
      case 'inBandRange':
        return curr >= osLevel && curr <= obLevel;
      case 'outsideBandRange':
        return curr < osLevel || curr > obLevel;
      case 'rsiTurningUp':
        if (rsiSeries.length < 3) return false;
        final pprev = rsiSeries[rsiSeries.length - 3];
        return prev <= pprev && curr > prev;
      case 'rsiTurningDown':
        if (rsiSeries.length < 3) return false;
        final pprev = rsiSeries[rsiSeries.length - 3];
        return prev >= pprev && curr < prev;
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  static List<double> calculateRsiSeries(List<BiquoteCandle> candles, int period, {String smoothingType = 'RMA'}) {
    final closes = candles.map((c) => c.close).toList();
    return calculateRsiSeriesFromPrices(closes, period, smoothingType: smoothingType);
  }

  static List<double> calculateRsiSeriesFromPrices(
    List<double> prices,
    int period, {
    String smoothingType = 'RMA',
  }) {
    if (prices.length <= period) return [];
    final rsi = <double>[];

    double gainSum = 0.0;
    double lossSum = 0.0;

    for (int i = 1; i <= period; i++) {
      final change = prices[i] - prices[i - 1];
      if (change > 0) gainSum += change;
      if (change < 0) lossSum += change.abs();
    }

    double avgGain = gainSum / period;
    double avgLoss = lossSum / period;

    double rs = avgLoss == 0 ? 100 : avgGain / avgLoss;
    rsi.add(100 - (100 / (1 + rs)));

    final k = 2.0 / (period + 1);

    for (int i = period + 1; i < prices.length; i++) {
      final change = prices[i] - prices[i - 1];
      final gain = change > 0 ? change : 0.0;
      final loss = change < 0 ? change.abs() : 0.0;

      if (smoothingType == 'EMA') {
        avgGain = (gain * k) + (avgGain * (1.0 - k));
        avgLoss = (loss * k) + (avgLoss * (1.0 - k));
      } else if (smoothingType == 'SMA') {
        // Rolling sum over past period
        double gSum = 0.0;
        double lSum = 0.0;
        for (int j = i - period + 1; j <= i; j++) {
          final ch = prices[j] - prices[j - 1];
          if (ch > 0) gSum += ch;
          if (ch < 0) lSum += ch.abs();
        }
        avgGain = gSum / period;
        avgLoss = lSum / period;
      } else if (smoothingType == 'WMA') {
        // Linear weighted moving average over past period
        double gSum = 0.0;
        double lSum = 0.0;
        final denom = (period * (period + 1)) / 2.0;
        for (int j = 0; j < period; j++) {
          final idx = i - period + 1 + j;
          final ch = prices[idx] - prices[idx - 1];
          final weight = j + 1;
          if (ch > 0) gSum += ch * weight;
          if (ch < 0) lSum += ch.abs() * weight;
        }
        avgGain = gSum / denom;
        avgLoss = lSum / denom;
      } else {
        // Standard Wilder RMA
        avgGain = (avgGain * (period - 1) + gain) / period;
        avgLoss = (avgLoss * (period - 1) + loss) / period;
      }

      rs = avgLoss == 0 ? 100 : avgGain / avgLoss;
      rsi.add(100 - (100 / (1 + rs)));
    }

    return rsi;
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 2. MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence)
  // ==========================================
  static bool _checkMacd(IndicatorAlertConfig config, List<BiquoteCandle> candles) {
    final fast = (config.params['fast'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 12;
    final slow = (config.params['slow'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 26;
    final signal = (config.params['signal'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 9;
    final source = (config.params['source'] as String?) ?? 'Close';
    final fastMaType = (config.params['fastMaType'] as String?) ?? 'EMA';
    final slowMaType = (config.params['slowMaType'] as String?) ?? 'EMA';
    final signalMaType = (config.params['signalMaType'] as String?) ?? 'EMA';

    if (candles.length < slow + signal + 2) return false;

    final macdData = calculateMacd(
      candles,
      fast,
      slow,
      signal,
      source: source,
      fastMaType: fastMaType,
      slowMaType: slowMaType,
      signalMaType: signalMaType,
    );
    final macdLine = macdData['macd']!;
    final signalLine = macdData['signal']!;
    final hist = macdData['histogram']!;

    if (macdLine.length < 2 || signalLine.length < 2) return false;

    final currM = macdLine[macdLine.length - 1];
    final prevM = macdLine[macdLine.length - 2];
    final currS = signalLine[signalLine.length - 1];
    final prevS = signalLine[signalLine.length - 2];
    final currH = hist.isNotEmpty ? hist[hist.length - 1] : 0.0;
    final prevH = hist.length >= 2 ? hist[hist.length - 2] : 0.0;

    switch (config.condition) {
      case 'bullishSignalCross':
        return prevM <= prevS && currM > currS;
      case 'bearishSignalCross':
        return prevM >= prevS && currM < currS;
      case 'zeroLineCrossAbove':
      case 'zeroCrossAbove':
        return prevM <= 0 && currM > 0;
      case 'zeroLineCrossBelow':
      case 'zeroCrossBelow':
        return prevM >= 0 && currM < 0;
      case 'zeroLineCross':
        return (prevM <= 0 && currM > 0) || (prevM >= 0 && currM < 0);
      case 'signalZeroCrossAbove':
        return prevS <= 0 && currS > 0;
      case 'signalZeroCrossBelow':
        return prevS >= 0 && currS < 0;
      case 'histogramFlipPositive':
        return prevH <= 0 && currH > 0;
      case 'histogramFlipNegative':
        return prevH >= 0 && currH < 0;
      case 'macdAboveSignal':
        return currM > currS;
      case 'macdBelowSignal':
        return currM < currS;
      case 'macdAboveZero':
        return currM > 0;
      case 'macdBelowZero':
        return currM < 0;
      case 'histogramPositive':
        return currH > 0;
      case 'histogramNegative':
        return currH < 0;
      case 'histogramTurningUp':
        if (hist.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevH = hist[hist.length - 3];
        return prevH <= pprevH && currH > prevH;
      case 'histogramTurningDown':
        if (hist.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevH = hist[hist.length - 3];
        return prevH >= pprevH && currH < prevH;
      case 'macdTurningUp':
        if (macdLine.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevM = macdLine[macdLine.length - 3];
        return prevM <= pprevM && currM > prevM;
      case 'macdTurningDown':
        if (macdLine.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevM = macdLine[macdLine.length - 3];
        return prevM >= pprevM && currM < prevM;
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  static Map<String, List<double>> calculateMacd(
    List<BiquoteCandle> candles,
    int fastPeriod,
    int slowPeriod,
    int signalPeriod, {
    String source = 'Close',
    String fastMaType = 'EMA',
    String slowMaType = 'EMA',
    String signalMaType = 'EMA',
  }) {
    final prices = _extractPrices(candles, source);
    final fastMa = _calculateMaSeries(prices, fastPeriod, fastMaType);
    final slowMa = _calculateMaSeries(prices, slowPeriod, slowMaType);

    if (fastMa.isEmpty || slowMa.isEmpty) {
      return {'macd': [], 'signal': [], 'histogram': []};
    }

    final offset = fastMa.length - slowMa.length;
    if (offset < 0) return {'macd': [], 'signal': [], 'histogram': []};

    final macdLine = <double>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < slowMa.length; i++) {
      macdLine.add(fastMa[i + offset] - slowMa[i]);
    }

    final signalLine = _calculateMaSeries(macdLine, signalPeriod, signalMaType);
    final sigOffset = macdLine.length - signalLine.length;
    if (sigOffset < 0) return {'macd': [], 'signal': [], 'histogram': []};

    final trimmedMacd = macdLine.sublist(sigOffset);

    final histogram = <double>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < signalLine.length; i++) {
      histogram.add(trimmedMacd[i] - signalLine[i]);
    }

    return {
      'macd': trimmedMacd,
      'signal': signalLine,
      'histogram': histogram,
    };
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 3. Moving Average Crossover (EMA / SMA)
  // ==========================================
  static bool _checkMaCross(IndicatorAlertConfig config, List<BiquoteCandle> candles) {
    final fastPeriod = (config.params['fastPeriod'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 50;
    final slowPeriod = (config.params['slowPeriod'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 200;
    final maType = (config.params['maType'] as String?) ?? 'EMA';
    final fastMaType = (config.params['fastMaType'] as String?) ?? maType;
    final slowMaType = (config.params['slowMaType'] as String?) ?? maType;
    final source = (config.params['source'] as String?) ?? 'Close';

    final maxPeriod = max(fastPeriod, slowPeriod);
    if (candles.length < maxPeriod + 3) return false;
    final prices = _extractPrices(candles, source);

    final fastMa = _calculateMaSeries(prices, fastPeriod, fastMaType);
    final slowMa = _calculateMaSeries(prices, slowPeriod, slowMaType);

    if (fastMa.length < 2 || slowMa.length < 2) return false;

    final currFast = fastMa.last;
    final prevFast = fastMa[fastMa.length - 2];
    final currSlow = slowMa.last;
    final prevSlow = slowMa[slowMa.length - 2];

    final currPrice = prices.last;
    final prevPrice = prices[prices.length - 2];

    switch (config.condition) {
      // 1. Crosses: Fast vs Slow
      case 'goldenCross':
      case 'fastCrossesAboveSlow':
        return prevFast <= prevSlow && currFast > currSlow;
      case 'deathCross':
      case 'fastCrossesBelowSlow':
        return prevFast >= prevSlow && currFast < currSlow;
      case 'maCross':
        return (prevFast <= prevSlow && currFast > currSlow) || (prevFast >= prevSlow && currFast < currSlow);

      // 2. Crosses: Price vs Fast MA
      case 'priceCrossesAbove':
      case 'priceCrossesAboveFast':
        return prevPrice <= prevFast && currPrice > currFast;
      case 'priceCrossesBelow':
      case 'priceCrossesBelowFast':
        return prevPrice >= prevFast && currPrice < currFast;

      // 3. Crosses: Price vs Slow MA
      case 'priceCrossesAboveSlow':
        return prevPrice <= prevSlow && currPrice > currSlow;
      case 'priceCrossesBelowSlow':
        return prevPrice >= prevSlow && currPrice < currSlow;

      // 4. Continuous States: Alignment & Regime
      case 'fastAboveSlow':
        return currFast > currSlow;
      case 'fastBelowSlow':
        return currFast < currSlow;
      case 'priceAboveFast':
        return currPrice > currFast;
      case 'priceBelowFast':
        return currPrice < currFast;
      case 'priceAboveSlow':
        return currPrice > currSlow;
      case 'priceBelowSlow':
        return currPrice < currSlow;
      case 'priceAboveBoth':
        return currPrice > currFast && currPrice > currSlow;
      case 'priceBelowBoth':
        return currPrice < currFast && currPrice < currSlow;
      case 'priceBetweenMAs':
        return (currPrice > min(currFast, currSlow)) && (currPrice < max(currFast, currSlow));

      // 5. Slope / Directional Turning Points
      case 'fastTurningUp':
        if (fastMa.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevFast = fastMa[fastMa.length - 3];
        return prevFast <= pprevFast && currFast > prevFast;
      case 'fastTurningDown':
        if (fastMa.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevFast = fastMa[fastMa.length - 3];
        return prevFast >= pprevFast && currFast < prevFast;
      case 'slowTurningUp':
        if (slowMa.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevSlow = slowMa[slowMa.length - 3];
        return prevSlow <= pprevSlow && currSlow > prevSlow;
      case 'slowTurningDown':
        if (slowMa.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevSlow = slowMa[slowMa.length - 3];
        return prevSlow >= pprevSlow && currSlow < prevSlow;

      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  static List<double> calculateMovingAverageSeries(
    List<BiquoteCandle> candles,
    int period, {
    String maType = 'EMA',
    String source = 'Close',
  }) {
    final prices = _extractPrices(candles, source);
    return _calculateMaSeries(prices, period, maType);
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 4. Bollinger Bands
  // ==========================================
  static bool _checkBollinger(IndicatorAlertConfig config, List<BiquoteCandle> candles) {
    final period = (config.params['period'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 20;
    final stdDevMult = (config.params['stdDev'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 2.0;
    final source = (config.params['source'] as String?) ?? 'Close';
    final maType = (config.params['maType'] as String?) ?? 'SMA';
    final squeezeThresh = (config.params['squeezeThreshold'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.015;

    if (candles.length < period + 3) return false;

    final bb = calculateBollingerBands(
      candles,
      period,
      stdDevMult,
      source: source,
      maType: maType,
    );
    final upper = bb['upper']!;
    final middle = bb['middle']!;
    final lower = bb['lower']!;
    final bandwidth = bb['bandwidth']!;
    final percentB = bb['percentB']!;

    if (upper.length < 2) return false;

    final prices = _extractPrices(candles, source);
    final currPrice = prices.last;
    final prevPrice = prices[prices.length - 2];

    final currUpper = upper.last;
    final prevUpper = upper[upper.length - 2];
    final currLower = lower.last;
    final prevLower = lower[lower.length - 2];
    final currMid = middle.last;
    final prevMid = middle[middle.length - 2];

    final currBw = bandwidth.last;
    final prevBw = bandwidth[bandwidth.length - 2];

    final currPb = percentB.last;
    final prevPb = percentB[percentB.length - 2];

    switch (config.condition) {
      // 1. Band Touches / Crosses
      case 'upperBandTouch':
      case 'priceCrossesAboveUpper':
        return prevPrice <= prevUpper && currPrice > currUpper;
      case 'priceCrossesBelowUpper':
        return prevPrice >= prevUpper && currPrice < currUpper;
      case 'lowerBandTouch':
      case 'priceCrossesBelowLower':
        return prevPrice >= prevLower && currPrice < currLower;
      case 'priceCrossesAboveLower':
        return prevPrice <= prevLower && currPrice > currLower;
      case 'middleBandCrossAbove':
        return prevPrice <= prevMid && currPrice > currMid;
      case 'middleBandCrossBelow':
        return prevPrice >= prevMid && currPrice < currMid;
      case 'middleBandCross':
        return (prevPrice <= prevMid && currPrice > currMid) || (prevPrice >= prevMid && currPrice < currMid);

      // 2. Continuous States / Regimes
      case 'priceAboveUpper':
        return currPrice > currUpper;
      case 'priceBelowLower':
        return currPrice < currLower;
      case 'priceInsideBands':
        return currPrice >= currLower && currPrice <= currUpper;
      case 'priceInUpperHalf':
        return currPrice > currMid && currPrice <= currUpper;
      case 'priceInLowerHalf':
        return currPrice < currMid && currPrice >= currLower;

      // 3. Volatility Squeeze & Expansion
      case 'squeeze':
        return currBw <= squeezeThresh;
      case 'squeezeBreakout':
        return prevBw <= squeezeThresh && currBw > squeezeThresh;
      case 'bandwidthExpanding':
        return currBw > prevBw;
      case 'bandwidthContracting':
        return currBw < prevBw;

      // 4. %B Conditions
      case 'percentBCrossesAbove80':
        return prevPb <= 0.8 && currPb > 0.8;
      case 'percentBCrossesBelow20':
        return prevPb >= 0.2 && currPb < 0.2;
      case 'percentBCrossesAboveCenter':
        return prevPb <= 0.5 && currPb > 0.5;
      case 'percentBCrossesBelowCenter':
        return prevPb >= 0.5 && currPb < 0.5;

      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  static Map<String, List<double>> calculateBollingerBands(
    List<BiquoteCandle> candles,
    int period,
    double stdDevMultiplier, {
    String source = 'Close',
    String maType = 'SMA',
  }) {
    final prices = _extractPrices(candles, source);
    if (prices.length < period) {
      return {'upper': [], 'middle': [], 'lower': [], 'bandwidth': [], 'percentB': []};
    }

    final middleMa = _calculateMaSeries(prices, period, maType);
    final upper = <double>[];
    final middle = <double>[];
    final lower = <double>[];
    final bandwidth = <double>[];
    final percentB = <double>[];

    final offset = prices.length - middleMa.length;

    for (int i = 0; i < middleMa.length; i++) {
      final priceIdx = i + offset;
      final slice = prices.sublist(priceIdx - period + 1, priceIdx + 1);
      final mean = middleMa[i];

      double varianceSum = 0.0;
      for (final p in slice) {
        varianceSum += pow(p - mean, 2);
      }
      final stdDev = sqrt(varianceSum / period);

      final up = mean + (stdDev * stdDevMultiplier);
      final low = mean - (stdDev * stdDevMultiplier);
      final bw = mean != 0 ? (up - low) / mean : 0.0;
      final bandWidthDiff = up - low;
      final pb = bandWidthDiff != 0 ? (prices[priceIdx] - low) / bandWidthDiff : 0.5;

      upper.add(up);
      middle.add(mean);
      lower.add(low);
      bandwidth.add(bw);
      percentB.add(pb);
    }

    return {
      'upper': upper,
      'middle': middle,
      'lower': lower,
      'bandwidth': bandwidth,
      'percentB': percentB,
    };
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 5. Stochastic Oscillator
  // ==========================================
  static bool _checkStochastic(IndicatorAlertConfig config, List<BiquoteCandle> candles) {
    final kPeriod = (config.params['kPeriod'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 14;
    final kSlowing = (config.params['kSlowing'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 3;
    final dPeriod = (config.params['dPeriod'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 3;
    final dMaType = (config.params['dMaType'] as String?) ?? 'SMA';

    if (candles.length < kPeriod + kSlowing + dPeriod + 2) return false;

    final stoch = calculateStochastic(
      candles,
      kPeriod,
      dPeriod,
      kSlowing: kSlowing,
      dMaType: dMaType,
    );
    final kSeries = stoch['k']!;
    final dSeries = stoch['d']!;

    if (kSeries.length < 2 || dSeries.length < 2) return false;

    final currK = kSeries.last;
    final prevK = kSeries[kSeries.length - 2];
    final currD = dSeries.last;
    final prevD = dSeries[dSeries.length - 2];

    final osLevel = (config.params['oversoldLevel'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 20.0;
    final obLevel = (config.params['overboughtLevel'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 80.0;

    switch (config.condition) {
      // 1. %K / %D Crossovers
      case 'bullishCross':
      case 'kCrossesAboveD':
        return prevK <= prevD && currK > currD;
      case 'bearishCross':
      case 'kCrossesBelowD':
        return prevK >= prevD && currK < currD;
      case 'bullishOversoldCross':
        return prevK <= prevD && currK > currD && currK <= osLevel;
      case 'bearishOverboughtCross':
        return prevK >= prevD && currK < currD && currK >= obLevel;

      // 2. Threshold / Level Crossings
      case 'kCrossesAboveOversold':
      case 'crossesAbove20':
        return prevK <= osLevel && currK > osLevel;
      case 'kCrossesBelowOversold':
        return prevK >= osLevel && currK < osLevel;
      case 'kCrossesAboveOverbought':
        return prevK <= obLevel && currK > obLevel;
      case 'kCrossesBelowOverbought':
      case 'crossesBelow80':
        return prevK >= obLevel && currK < obLevel;
      case 'kCrossesAbove50':
        return prevK <= 50.0 && currK > 50.0;
      case 'kCrossesBelow50':
        return prevK >= 50.0 && currK < 50.0;
      case 'centerlineCross':
        return (prevK <= 50.0 && currK > 50.0) || (prevK >= 50.0 && currK < 50.0);

      // 3. Continuous States
      case 'kAboveD':
        return currK > currD;
      case 'kBelowD':
        return currK < currD;
      case 'inOversold':
        return currK < osLevel;
      case 'inOverbought':
        return currK > obLevel;
      case 'inNeutralBand':
        return currK >= osLevel && currK <= obLevel;

      // 4. Slope / Turning Points
      case 'kTurningUp':
        if (kSeries.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevK = kSeries[kSeries.length - 3];
        return prevK <= pprevK && currK > prevK;
      case 'kTurningDown':
        if (kSeries.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevK = kSeries[kSeries.length - 3];
        return prevK >= pprevK && currK < prevK;
      case 'dTurningUp':
        if (dSeries.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevD = dSeries[dSeries.length - 3];
        return prevD <= pprevD && currD > prevD;
      case 'dTurningDown':
        if (dSeries.length < 3) return false;
        final pprevD = dSeries[dSeries.length - 3];
        return prevD >= pprevD && currD < prevD;

      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  static Map<String, List<double>> calculateStochastic(
    List<BiquoteCandle> candles,
    int kPeriod,
    int dPeriod, {
    int kSlowing = 3,
    String dMaType = 'SMA',
  }) {
    if (candles.length < kPeriod) {
      return {'k': [], 'd': []};
    }
    final rawK = <double>[];

    for (int i = kPeriod - 1; i < candles.length; i++) {
      final slice = candles.sublist(i - kPeriod + 1, i + 1);
      final highest = slice.map((c) => c.high).reduce(max);
      final lowest = slice.map((c) => c.low).reduce(min);
      final currentClose = candles[i].close;

      final range = highest - lowest;
      final k = range == 0 ? 50.0 : ((currentClose - lowest) / range) * 100.0;
      rawK.add(k);
    }

    final smoothedK = kSlowing > 1 ? _calculateMaSeries(rawK, kSlowing, 'SMA') : rawK;
    if (smoothedK.isEmpty) return {'k': [], 'd': []};

    final dSeries = _calculateMaSeries(smoothedK, dPeriod, dMaType);
    final offset = smoothedK.length - dSeries.length;
    if (offset < 0) return {'k': [], 'd': []};

    final trimmedK = smoothedK.sublist(offset);

    return {
      'k': trimmedK,
      'd': dSeries,
    };
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 6. Supertrend
  // ==========================================
  static bool _checkSupertrend(IndicatorAlertConfig config, List<BiquoteCandle> candles) {
    final period = (config.params['period'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 10;
    final multiplier = (config.params['multiplier'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 3.0;
    final source = (config.params['source'] as String?) ?? 'HL2';
    final atrSmoothing = (config.params['atrSmoothing'] as String?) ?? 'RMA';
    final distThreshold = ((config.params['distanceThreshold'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 1.0) / 100.0;

    if (candles.length < period + 5) return false;

    final result = calculateSupertrend(
      candles,
      period,
      multiplier,
      source: source,
      atrSmoothing: atrSmoothing,
    );
    final trends = (result['trend'] as List<int>?) ?? [];
    final trails = (result['supertrend'] as List<double>?) ?? [];
    if (trends.length < 2 || trails.length < 2) return false;

    final currTrend = trends.last; // 1 = Bullish, -1 = Bearish
    final prevTrend = trends[trends.length - 2];
    final currTrail = trails.last;
    final prevTrail = trails[trails.length - 2];

    final currCandle = candles.last;
    final prevCandle = candles[candles.length - 2];

    final currClose = currCandle.close;
    final prevClose = prevCandle.close;

    final currDistanceRatio = (currClose - currTrail).abs() / (currClose == 0 ? 1.0 : currClose);

    switch (config.condition) {
      // 1. Trend Reversals / Flips
      case 'bullishFlip':
        return prevTrend == -1 && currTrend == 1;
      case 'bearishFlip':
        return prevTrend == 1 && currTrend == -1;
      case 'trendFlip':
        return prevTrend != currTrend;

      // 2. Trailing Stop Crosses
      case 'priceCrossesAboveTrail':
        return (prevClose <= prevTrail && currClose > currTrail) || (prevTrend == -1 && currTrend == 1);
      case 'priceCrossesBelowTrail':
        return (prevClose >= prevTrail && currClose < currTrail) || (prevTrend == 1 && currTrend == -1);

      // 3. Support / Resistance Touches & Bounces
      case 'priceTouchesTrail':
        return currCandle.low <= currTrail && currCandle.high >= currTrail;
      case 'priceBouncesOffTrail':
        if (currTrend == 1) {
          return (currCandle.low <= currTrail || prevCandle.low <= prevTrail) &&
              currClose > currTrail &&
              currClose >= currCandle.open;
        } else {
          return (currCandle.high >= currTrail || prevCandle.high >= prevTrail) &&
              currClose < currTrail &&
              currClose <= currCandle.open;
        }

      // 4. Continuous Trend Regimes
      case 'inBullishTrend':
        return currTrend == 1;
      case 'inBearishTrend':
        return currTrend == -1;
      case 'priceAboveTrail':
        return currClose > currTrail;
      case 'priceBelowTrail':
        return currClose < currTrail;

      // 5. Trailing Stop Momentum
      case 'trailRising':
        return currTrail > prevTrail;
      case 'trailFalling':
        return currTrail < prevTrail;
      case 'trailFlat':
        return currTrail == prevTrail;

      // 6. Distance / Proximity to Trail
      case 'priceDistanceGreaterThan':
        return currDistanceRatio >= distThreshold;
      case 'priceDistanceLessThan':
        return currDistanceRatio <= distThreshold;

      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  static Map<String, dynamic> calculateSupertrend(
    List<BiquoteCandle> candles,
    int period,
    double multiplier, {
    String source = 'HL2',
    String atrSmoothing = 'RMA',
  }) {
    final n = candles.length;
    final atr = _calculateAtr(candles, period, smoothing: atrSmoothing);
    if (atr.length < n) {
      return {
        'trend': <int>[],
        'supertrend': <double>[],
        'upperBand': <double>[],
        'lowerBand': <double>[],
      };
    }

    final trends = <int>[];
    final supertrendSeries = <double>[];
    final upperBands = <double>[];
    final lowerBands = <double>[];
    double upperBand = 0.0;
    double lowerBand = 0.0;
    int trend = 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      final c = candles[i];
      double basePrice;
      switch (source.toLowerCase()) {
        case 'close':
          basePrice = c.close;
          break;
        case 'open':
          basePrice = c.open;
          break;
        case 'high':
          basePrice = c.high;
          break;
        case 'low':
          basePrice = c.low;
          break;
        case 'hlc3':
          basePrice = (c.high + c.low + c.close) / 3.0;
          break;
        case 'ohlc4':
          basePrice = (c.open + c.high + c.low + c.close) / 4.0;
          break;
        case 'hl2':
        default:
          basePrice = (c.high + c.low) / 2.0;
          break;
      }
      final curAtr = atr[i];

      final basicUpper = basePrice + (multiplier * curAtr);
      final basicLower = basePrice - (multiplier * curAtr);

      if (i == 0) {
        upperBand = basicUpper;
        lowerBand = basicLower;
        trend = 1;
      } else {
        final prevClose = candles[i - 1].close;
        lowerBand = (basicLower > lowerBand || prevClose < lowerBand) ? basicLower : lowerBand;
        upperBand = (basicUpper < upperBand || prevClose > upperBand) ? basicUpper : upperBand;

        if (trend == 1 && c.close < lowerBand) {
          trend = -1;
        } else if (trend == -1 && c.close > upperBand) {
          trend = 1;
        }
      }
      trends.add(trend);
      upperBands.add(upperBand);
      lowerBands.add(lowerBand);
      supertrendSeries.add(trend == 1 ? lowerBand : upperBand);
    }

    return {
      'trend': trends,
      'supertrend': supertrendSeries,
      'upperBand': upperBands,
      'lowerBand': lowerBands,
    };
  }

  // ==========================================
  // Helper Math: EMA, SMA, ATR
  // ==========================================
  static List<double> _calculateSmaSeries(List<double> values, int period) {
    if (values.length < period) return [];
    final sma = <double>[];
    double sum = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < period; i++) {
      sum += values[i];
    }
    sma.add(sum / period);

    for (int i = period; i < values.length; i++) {
      sum += values[i] - values[i - period];
      sma.add(sum / period);
    }
    return sma;
  }

  static List<double> _calculateEmaSeries(List<double> values, int period) {
    if (values.length < period) return [];
    final ema = <double>[];
    final k = 2.0 / (period + 1);

    double sum = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < period; i++) {
      sum += values[i];
    }
    double currentEma = sum / period;
    ema.add(currentEma);

    for (int i = period; i < values.length; i++) {
      currentEma = (values[i] * k) + (currentEma * (1 - k));
      ema.add(currentEma);
    }
    return ema;
  }

  static List<double> _calculateWmaSeries(List<double> values, int period) {
    if (values.length < period) return [];
    final wma = <double>[];
    final denominator = (period * (period + 1)) / 2.0;

    for (int i = period - 1; i < values.length; i++) {
      double sum = 0.0;
      for (int j = 0; j < period; j++) {
        sum += values[i - period + 1 + j] * (j + 1);
      }
      wma.add(sum / denominator);
    }
    return wma;
  }

  static List<double> _calculateMaSeries(List<double> values, int period, String maType) {
    if (maType == 'SMA') return _calculateSmaSeries(values, period);
    if (maType == 'WMA') return _calculateWmaSeries(values, period);
    return _calculateEmaSeries(values, period);
  }

  static List<double> _calculateAtr(List<BiquoteCandle> candles, int period, {String smoothing = 'RMA'}) {
    final tr = <double>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      if (i == 0) {
        tr.add(candles[i].high - candles[i].low);
      } else {
        final hl = candles[i].high - candles[i].low;
        final hc = (candles[i].high - candles[i - 1].close).abs();
        final lc = (candles[i].low - candles[i - 1].close).abs();
        tr.add(max(hl, max(hc, lc)));
      }
    }

    if (smoothing == 'SMA') {
      final sma = _calculateSmaSeries(tr, period);
      final pad = List.filled(candles.length - sma.length, sma.isNotEmpty ? sma.first : 0.0);
      return [...pad, ...sma];
    } else if (smoothing == 'EMA') {
      final ema = _calculateEmaSeries(tr, period);
      final pad = List.filled(candles.length - ema.length, ema.isNotEmpty ? ema.first : 0.0);
      return [...pad, ...ema];
    } else if (smoothing == 'WMA') {
      final wma = _calculateWmaSeries(tr, period);
      final pad = List.filled(candles.length - wma.length, wma.isNotEmpty ? wma.first : 0.0);
      return [...pad, ...wma];
    }

    // Default RMA (Wilder's smoothing)
    final atr = <double>[];
    double sum = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      if (i < period) {
        sum += tr[i];
        atr.add(sum / (i + 1));
      } else {
        final cur = (atr[i - 1] * (period - 1) + tr[i]) / period;
        atr.add(cur);
      }
    }
    return atr;
  }
}


------------------------------------------------------------

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import '../models/indicator_models.dart';
import '../models/market_models.dart';
import 'storage_service.dart';

class IndicatorCalculationResult {
  final IndicatorConfig config;
  // Overlay indicators or primary line
  final List<double?> primary;
  // Secondary lines (e.g. BB lower/upper, MACD signal, Stoch %D)
  final List<double?>? secondary;
  final List<double?>? tertiary;
  // Histogram (e.g. MACD)
  final List<double?>? histogram;

  IndicatorCalculationResult({
    required this.config,
    required this.primary,
    this.secondary,
    this.tertiary,
    this.histogram,
  });
}

class IndicatorService {
  static final IndicatorService _instance = IndicatorService._internal();
  factory IndicatorService() => _instance;
  IndicatorService._internal();

  static const String _storageKey = 'chart_active_indicators_v1';
  List<IndicatorConfig>? _cachedIndicators;

  /// Load persisted indicators, or provide defaults if first run
  Future<List<IndicatorConfig>> loadActiveIndicators() async {
    if (_cachedIndicators != null) {
      return List.from(_cachedIndicators!);
    }

    try {
      final jsonStr = await StorageService.getString(_storageKey);
      if (jsonStr != null && jsonStr.isNotEmpty) {
        final List<dynamic> decoded = jsonDecode(jsonStr);
        final list = decoded.map((e) => IndicatorConfig.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList();
        _cachedIndicators = list;
        return List.from(list);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error loading active indicators: $e');
    }

    // Default indicators on fresh install
    final defaults = [
      IndicatorConfig.defaultFor(IndicatorType.ema)..inputs['period'] = 20,
      IndicatorConfig.defaultFor(IndicatorType.rsi)..inputs['period'] = 14,
    ];
    _cachedIndicators = defaults;
    await saveActiveIndicators(defaults);
    return List.from(defaults);
  }

  /// Save indicators to disk
  Future<void> saveActiveIndicators(List<IndicatorConfig> indicators) async {
    _cachedIndicators = List.from(indicators);
    try {
      final jsonStr = jsonEncode(indicators.map((i) => i.toJson()).toList());
      await StorageService.setString(_storageKey, jsonStr);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error saving indicators: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Calculates indicator values across the full list of candles
  IndicatorCalculationResult? calculate(IndicatorConfig config, List<BiquoteCandle> candles) {
    if (candles.isEmpty) return null;

    switch (config.type) {
      case IndicatorType.sma:
        final period = config.getInt('period', 20);
        final values = calculateSMA(candles, period);
        return IndicatorCalculationResult(config: config, primary: values);

      case IndicatorType.ema:
        final period = config.getInt('period', 20);
        final values = calculateEMA(candles, period);
        return IndicatorCalculationResult(config: config, primary: values);

      case IndicatorType.bollingerBands:
        final period = config.getInt('period', 20);
        final stdDev = config.getDouble('stdDev', 2.0);
        final bb = calculateBollingerBands(candles, period, stdDev);
        return IndicatorCalculationResult(
          config: config,
          primary: bb.basis,
          secondary: bb.upper,
          tertiary: bb.lower,
        );

      case IndicatorType.rsi:
        final period = config.getInt('period', 14);
        final rsi = calculateRSI(candles, period);
        return IndicatorCalculationResult(config: config, primary: rsi);

      case IndicatorType.macd:
        final fast = config.getInt('fastPeriod', 12);
        final slow = config.getInt('slowPeriod', 26);
        final signal = config.getInt('signalPeriod', 9);
        final macd = calculateMACD(candles, fast, slow, signal);
        return IndicatorCalculationResult(
          config: config,
          primary: macd.macd,
          secondary: macd.signal,
          histogram: macd.histogram,
        );

      case IndicatorType.stochastic:
        final kPeriod = config.getInt('kPeriod', 14);
        final dPeriod = config.getInt('dPeriod', 3);
        final smooth = config.getInt('smooth', 3);
        final stoch = calculateStochastic(candles, kPeriod, dPeriod, smooth);
        return IndicatorCalculationResult(
          config: config,
          primary: stoch.k,
          secondary: stoch.d,
        );
    }
  }

  // --- Mathematics & Algorithms ---

  /// Simple Moving Average
  static List<double?> calculateSMA(List<BiquoteCandle> candles, int period) {
    final result = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);
    if (candles.length < period || period <= 0) return result;

    double sum = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < period; i++) {
      sum += candles[i].close;
    }
    result[period - 1] = sum / period;

    for (int i = period; i < candles.length; i++) {
      sum += candles[i].close - candles[i - period].close;
      result[i] = sum / period;
    }
    return result;
  }

  /// Exponential Moving Average
  static List<double?> calculateEMA(List<BiquoteCandle> candles, int period) {
    final result = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);
    if (candles.length < period || period <= 0) return result;

    final multiplier = 2.0 / (period + 1);

    // Initial SMA for first EMA seed
    double sum = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < period; i++) {
      sum += candles[i].close;
    }
    double prevEma = sum / period;
    result[period - 1] = prevEma;

    for (int i = period; i < candles.length; i++) {
      final currentEma = (candles[i].close - prevEma) * multiplier + prevEma;
      result[i] = currentEma;
      prevEma = currentEma;
    }
    return result;
  }

  /// Bollinger Bands (Basis, Upper, Lower)
  static ({List<double?> basis, List<double?> upper, List<double?> lower}) calculateBollingerBands(
    List<BiquoteCandle> candles,
    int period,
    double stdDevMultiplier,
  ) {
    final basis = calculateSMA(candles, period);
    final upper = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);
    final lower = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);

    if (candles.length < period || period <= 0) {
      return (basis: basis, upper: upper, lower: lower);
    }

    for (int i = period - 1; i < candles.length; i++) {
      final sma = basis[i];
      if (sma == null) continue;

      double varianceSum = 0.0;
      for (int j = i - period + 1; j <= i; j++) {
        varianceSum += pow(candles[j].close - sma, 2);
      }
      final dev = sqrt(varianceSum / period);
      upper[i] = sma + (dev * stdDevMultiplier);
      lower[i] = sma - (dev * stdDevMultiplier);
    }

    return (basis: basis, upper: upper, lower: lower);
  }

  /// Wilder's Relative Strength Index (Standard TradingView RSI formula)
  static List<double?> calculateRSI(List<BiquoteCandle> candles, int period) {
    final result = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);
    if (candles.length <= period || period <= 0) return result;

    double gainSum = 0.0;
    double lossSum = 0.0;

    for (int i = 1; i <= period; i++) {
      final diff = candles[i].close - candles[i - 1].close;
      if (diff > 0) {
        gainSum += diff;
      } else {
        lossSum += diff.abs();
      }
    }

    double avgGain = gainSum / period;
    double avgLoss = lossSum / period;

    if (avgLoss == 0) {
      result[period] = 100.0;
    } else {
      final rs = avgGain / avgLoss;
      result[period] = 100.0 - (100.0 / (1.0 + rs));
    }

    for (int i = period + 1; i < candles.length; i++) {
      final diff = candles[i].close - candles[i - 1].close;
      final gain = diff > 0 ? diff : 0.0;
      final loss = diff < 0 ? diff.abs() : 0.0;

      avgGain = (avgGain * (period - 1) + gain) / period;
      avgLoss = (avgLoss * (period - 1) + loss) / period;

      if (avgLoss == 0) {
        result[i] = 100.0;
      } else {
        final rs = avgGain / avgLoss;
        result[i] = (100.0 - (100.0 / (1.0 + rs))).clamp(0.0, 100.0);
      }
    }

    return result;
  }

  /// MACD (MACD Line, Signal Line, Histogram)
  static ({List<double?> macd, List<double?> signal, List<double?> histogram}) calculateMACD(
    List<BiquoteCandle> candles,
    int fastPeriod,
    int slowPeriod,
    int signalPeriod,
  ) {
    final macd = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);
    final signal = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);
    final histogram = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);

    if (candles.length < slowPeriod) {
      return (macd: macd, signal: signal, histogram: histogram);
    }

    final fastEma = calculateEMA(candles, fastPeriod);
    final slowEma = calculateEMA(candles, slowPeriod);

    for (int i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      if (fastEma[i] != null && slowEma[i] != null) {
        macd[i] = fastEma[i]! - slowEma[i]!;
      }
    }

    // Now calculate EMA of the MACD series for the Signal line
    int firstMacdIndex = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < macd.length; i++) {
      if (macd[i] != null) {
        firstMacdIndex = i;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (firstMacdIndex != -1 && (macd.length - firstMacdIndex) >= signalPeriod) {
      final signalMult = 2.0 / (signalPeriod + 1);
      double sum = 0.0;
      for (int i = 0; i < signalPeriod; i++) {
        sum += macd[firstMacdIndex + i]!;
      }
      double prevSignal = sum / signalPeriod;
      final seedIdx = firstMacdIndex + signalPeriod - 1;
      signal[seedIdx] = prevSignal;
      histogram[seedIdx] = macd[seedIdx]! - prevSignal;

      for (int i = seedIdx + 1; i < macd.length; i++) {
        final val = macd[i]!;
        final curSignal = (val - prevSignal) * signalMult + prevSignal;
        signal[i] = curSignal;
        histogram[i] = val - curSignal;
        prevSignal = curSignal;
      }
    }

    return (macd: macd, signal: signal, histogram: histogram);
  }

  /// Stochastic Oscillator (%K and %D)
  static ({List<double?> k, List<double?> d}) calculateStochastic(
    List<BiquoteCandle> candles,
    int kPeriod,
    int dPeriod,
    int smooth,
  ) {
    final rawK = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);
    final k = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);
    final d = List<double?>.filled(candles.length, null);

    if (candles.length < kPeriod) {
      return (k: k, d: d);
    }

    for (int i = kPeriod - 1; i < candles.length; i++) {
      double minLow = double.infinity;
      double maxHigh = double.negativeInfinity;
      for (int j = i - kPeriod + 1; j <= i; j++) {
        if (candles[j].low < minLow) minLow = candles[j].low;
        if (candles[j].high > maxHigh) maxHigh = candles[j].high;
      }
      final range = maxHigh - minLow;
      if (range > 0) {
        rawK[i] = ((candles[i].close - minLow) / range) * 100.0;
      } else {
        rawK[i] = 50.0;
      }
    }

    // Smoothing raw %K
    for (int i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      if (rawK[i] == null) continue;
      if (i < smooth - 1) continue;

      double sum = 0.0;
      int count = 0;
      for (int j = i - smooth + 1; j <= i; j++) {
        if (j >= 0 && rawK[j] != null) {
          sum += rawK[j]!;
          count++;
        }
      }
      if (count == smooth) {
        k[i] = sum / count;
      }
    }

    // %D is SMA of %K
    for (int i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      if (k[i] == null) continue;
      if (i < dPeriod - 1) continue;

      double sum = 0.0;
      int count = 0;
      for (int j = i - dPeriod + 1; j <= i; j++) {
        if (j >= 0 && k[j] != null) {
          sum += k[j]!;
          count++;
        }
      }
      if (count == dPeriod) {
        d[i] = sum / count;
      }
    }

    return (k: k, d: d);
  }
}

class CalendarEvent {
  final String id;
  final String name;
  final DateTime time;
  final String countryCode;
  final String currency;
  final String importance;
  final String type;
  final double? actual;
  final double? forecast;
  final double? previous;
  final String? unit;
  final String? multiplier;
  final String timeMode;

  CalendarEvent({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.time,
    required this.countryCode,
    required this.currency,
    required this.importance,
    required this.type,
    this.actual,
    this.forecast,
    this.previous,
    this.unit,
    this.multiplier,
    required this.timeMode,
  });

  static double? _safeDouble(dynamic val) {
    if (val == null) return null;
    if (val is num) return val.toDouble();
    if (val is String) return double.tryParse(val.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9.-]'), ''));
    return null;
  }

  factory CalendarEvent.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) => CalendarEvent(
        id: j['id']?.toString() ?? '',
        name: j['name']?.toString() ?? '',
        time: DateTime.tryParse(j['time']?.toString() ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
        countryCode: j['countryCode']?.toString() ?? '',
        currency: j['currency']?.toString() ?? '',
        importance: j['importance']?.toString() ?? 'low',
        type: j['type']?.toString() ?? 'event',
        actual: _safeDouble(j['actual']),
        forecast: _safeDouble(j['forecast']),
        previous: _safeDouble(j['previous']),
        unit: j['unit']?.toString(),
        multiplier: j['multiplier']?.toString(),
        timeMode: j['timeMode']?.toString() ?? 'exact',
      );
}

// ── API Service ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class MarketDataApi {
  static const String _base = 'https://biquote.io';
  static const String _directBase = 'https://142.132.248.240';

  static final http.Client _client = http.Client();
  static final HttpClient _ioClient = () {
    final client = HttpClient();
    client.badCertificateCallback = (cert, host, port) => true;
    client.connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 4);
    return client;
  }();

  /// Resilient JSON fetcher: queries Biquote API with fallback to direct IP
  /// for networks/emulators with DNS resolution bottlenecks.
  static Future<dynamic> _fetchJson(String pathAndQuery) async {
    // 1. Try primary domain first
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('$_base$pathAndQuery');
      final response = await _client.get(uri).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        return jsonDecode(response.body);
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // 2. Direct-IP Fallback with Host header for environments with DNS timeouts
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('$_directBase$pathAndQuery');
      final req = await _ioClient.getUrl(uri).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
      req.headers.set('Host', 'biquote.io');
      final resp = await req.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
      if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
        final body = await resp.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
        return jsonDecode(body);
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    return null;
  }

  static Future<List<MarketMover>> getGainers({String type = 'Forex', int limit = 15}) async {
    final decoded = await _fetchJson('/api/market/gainers?limit=$limit&type=$type');
    if (decoded != null) {
      final list = decoded is List ? decoded : (decoded['data'] as List? ?? []);
      return list.map((e) => MarketMover.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList();
    }
    return [];
  }

  static Future<List<MarketMover>> getLosers({String type = 'Forex', int limit = 15}) async {
    final decoded = await _fetchJson('/api/market/losers?limit=$limit&type=$type');
    if (decoded != null) {
      final list = decoded is List ? decoded : (decoded['data'] as List? ?? []);
      return list.map((e) => MarketMover.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList();
    }
    return [];
  }

  static Future<List<MostActive>> getMostActive({String type = 'Forex', int limit = 15}) async {
    final decoded = await _fetchJson('/api/market/most-active?limit=$limit&type=$type');
    if (decoded != null) {
      final list = decoded is List ? decoded : (decoded['data'] as List? ?? []);
      return list.map((e) => MostActive.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList();
    }
    return [];
  }

  static Future<List<CalendarEvent>> getCalendar({
    String countries = 'US,EU,GB,JP',
    String importance = 'medium',
  }) async {
    final path = '/api/calendar/upcoming?limit=50&countries=${Uri.encodeComponent(countries)}&importance=$importance';
    final decoded = await _fetchJson(path);
    if (decoded != null) {
      final list = decoded is List ? decoded : (decoded['value'] as List? ?? decoded['data'] as List? ?? []);
      final events = <CalendarEvent>[];
      for (final e in list) {
        try {
          events.add(CalendarEvent.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>));
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      return events;
    }
    return [];
  }

  static Future<List<NewsArticle>> getNews({int limit = 20}) async {
    final decoded = await _fetchJson('/api/news/market?maxResults=$limit&language=en');
    if (decoded != null) {
      final list = decoded is List ? decoded : (decoded['value'] as List? ?? decoded['data'] as List? ?? []);
      return list.map((e) => NewsArticle.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList();
    }
    return [];
  }

  /// Batch tick data for a list of symbols from Biquote API.
  static Future<Map<String, TickData>> getBatchTicks(List<String> symbols) async {
    final query = symbols.map((s) => 'symbols=$s').join('&');
    final decoded = await _fetchJson('/api/latest?$query');
    if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      return decoded.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, TickData.fromJson(v as Map<String, dynamic>)));
    }
    return {};
  }

  static List<BiquoteInstrument>? _cachedInstruments;

  /// Fetches all active instruments from Biquote (Forex, Crypto, Metals, Stocks, Indices).
  static Future<List<BiquoteInstrument>> getAllSymbols({bool forceRefresh = false, int quotedWithinDays = 7}) async {
    if (!forceRefresh && _cachedInstruments != null && _cachedInstruments!.isNotEmpty) {
      return _cachedInstruments!;
    }
    try {
      final decoded = await _fetchJson('/api/symbols?quotedWithinDays=$quotedWithinDays');
      if (decoded != null) {
        final list = decoded is List ? decoded : (decoded['value'] as List? ?? decoded['data'] as List? ?? []);
        final instruments = <BiquoteInstrument>[];
        for (final item in list) {
          try {
            if (item is Map<String, dynamic>) {
              final inst = BiquoteInstrument.fromJson(item);
              if (inst.symbol.isNotEmpty) {
                instruments.add(inst);
              }
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (instruments.isNotEmpty) {
          _cachedInstruments = instruments;
          return instruments;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[MarketDataApi] getAllSymbols error: $e');
    }
    return _cachedInstruments ?? _fallbackInstruments;
  }

class BiquoteInstrument {
  final String symbol;
  final String description;
  final String exchange;
  final String type; // 'Forex', 'Crypto', 'Commodity', 'Stock', 'Index'
  final int digits;
  final bool isActive;
  final bool hasData;

  BiquoteInstrument({
    required this.symbol,
    required this.description,
    required this.exchange,
    required this.type,
    required this.digits,
    required this.isActive,
    required this.hasData,
  });

  factory BiquoteInstrument.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) => BiquoteInstrument(
        symbol: j['name']?.toString() ?? j['symbol']?.toString() ?? '',
        description: j['description']?.toString() ?? '',
        exchange: j['exchange']?.toString() ?? '',
        type: j['type']?.toString() ?? 'Forex',
        digits: (j['digits'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 5,
        isActive: j['isActive'] == true,
        hasData: j['hasData'] == true,
      );
}
