class RealMarketFetchResult {
  final List<BiquoteCandle> candles;
  final bool isSuccess;
  final String source;
  final String? errorMessage;
  final MarketStructureAnalysis? structure;

  const RealMarketFetchResult({
    required this.candles,
    required this.isSuccess,
    required this.source,
    this.errorMessage,
    this.structure,
  });
}

class RealMarketTestResult {
  final bool success;
  final String message;
  final int candleCount;
  final double? latestPrice;

  const RealMarketTestResult({
    required this.success,
    required this.message,
    this.candleCount = 0,
    this.latestPrice,
  });
}

/// Market structure and indicator analytics matching tradde.py and agent_orchestrator.py
class MarketStructureAnalysis {
  final double currentPrice;
  final double ema50;
  final double ema200;
  final String trend; // "Uptrend", "Downtrend", "Sideways"
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> swingHighs;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> swingLows;
  final double atr;
  final double bollingerWidth;
  final bool isConsolidating;

  const MarketStructureAnalysis({
    required this.currentPrice,
    required this.ema50,
    required this.ema200,
    required this.trend,
    required this.swingHighs,
    required this.swingLows,
    required this.atr,
    required this.bollingerWidth,
    required this.isConsolidating,
  });
}

class RealMarketService {
  final http.Client _client;
  RealMarketConfig config;
  final BiquoteService? biquoteFallback;

  RealMarketService({
    http.Client? client,
    this.config = const RealMarketConfig(),
    this.biquoteFallback,
  }) : _client = client ?? http.Client();

  // Exactly matching SYMBOL_MAP from trade.py in the reference project
  static const Map<String, String> _symbolMap = {
    'EUR/USD': 'EURUSD',   'USD/JPY': 'USDJPY',   'GBP/USD': 'GBPUSD',
    'USD/CHF': 'USDCHF',   'USD/CAD': 'USDCAD',   'AUD/USD': 'AUDUSD',
    'NZD/USD': 'NZDUSD',   'GBP/JPY': 'GBPJPY',   'EUR/JPY': 'EURJPY',
    'EUR/GBP': 'EURGBP',   'AUD/JPY': 'AUDJPY',   'CAD/JPY': 'CADJPY',
    'GOLD': 'XAUUSD',      'XAU/USD': 'XAUUSD',   'SILVER': 'XAGUSD',
    'XAG/USD': 'XAGUSD',   'OIL (WTI)': 'USOIL',  'BTC/USD': 'BTCUSD',
    'ETH/USD': 'ETHUSD',   'XRP/USD': 'XRPUSD',   'SOL/USD': 'SOLUSD',
    'BNB/USD': 'BNBUSD',   'S&P 500': 'US500',    'NASDAQ': 'USTEC',
    'DOW JONES': 'US30',
  };

  // Exactly matching TIMEFRAME_MAP from trade.py in the reference project
  static const Map<String, String> _timeframeMap = {
    '1m': 'M1',   '1M': 'M1',   'M1': 'M1',
    '5m': 'M5',   '5M': 'M5',   'M5': 'M5',
    '15m': 'M15', '15M': 'M15', 'M15': 'M15',
    '30m': 'M30', '30M': 'M30', 'M30': 'M30',
    '1h': 'H1',   '1H': 'H1',   'H1': 'H1',
    '4h': 'H4',   '4H': 'H4',   'H4': 'H4',
    '1d': 'D1',   '1D': 'D1',   'D1': 'D1',
    '1wk': 'D1',  '1W': 'D1',   'W1': 'D1',
  };

  String resolveSymbolCode(String raw) {
    final trimmed = raw.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (_symbolMap.containsKey(trimmed)) {
      return _symbolMap[trimmed]!;
    }

    if (trimmed == 'GC=F' || trimmed.contains('GOLD')) return 'XAUUSD';
    if (trimmed == 'SI=F' || trimmed.contains('SILVER')) return 'XAGUSD';

    final cleaned = trimmed
        .replaceAll('=X', '')
        .replaceAll('=F', '')
        .replaceAll('-', '')
        .replaceAll('/', '')
        .replaceAll(' ', '');

    return _symbolMap[cleaned] ?? cleaned;
  }

  String resolveTimeFrame(String raw) {
    final trimmed = raw.trim();
    return _timeframeMap[trimmed] ?? _timeframeMap[trimmed.toLowerCase()] ?? 'H1';
  }

  /// Tests the RealMarket API endpoint directly with current configuration
  Future<RealMarketTestResult> testConnection() async {
    final apiKey = config.apiKey.trim();
    if (apiKey.isEmpty) {
      return const RealMarketTestResult(
        success: false,
        message: 'RealMarket API Key is missing. Please enter your API key.',
      );
    }

    final base = config.baseUrl.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'/+$'), '');
    final uri = Uri.parse(base).replace(
      path: '/api/v1/candle',
      queryParameters: {
        'apiKey': apiKey,
        'symbolCode': 'EURUSD',
        'timeFrame': 'H1',
      },
    );

    try {
      final response = await _client.get(
        uri,
        headers: {
          'User-Agent': 'TenX-TradingBot/2.0',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
        },
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
        List<dynamic> list = [];
        if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic> && decoded['data'] is List) {
          list = decoded['data'] as List<dynamic>;
        } else if (decoded is List) {
          list = decoded;
        }

        if (list.isNotEmpty) {
          final first = list.first as Map<String, dynamic>;
          final price = double.tryParse(
                  first['closePrice']?.toString() ?? first['close']?.toString() ?? '0') ??
              0.0;
          return RealMarketTestResult(
            success: true,
            message: 'Connected to RealMarket API! Received ${list.length} candles (EURUSD: $price).',
            candleCount: list.length,
            latestPrice: price,
          );
        } else {
          return const RealMarketTestResult(
            success: false,
            message: 'RealMarket API responded 200 OK, but returned empty candle array.',
          );
        }
      } else {
        return RealMarketTestResult(
          success: false,
          message: 'RealMarket API returned HTTP ${response.statusCode}: ${response.body}',
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      return RealMarketTestResult(
        success: false,
        message: 'RealMarket API request failed: $e',
      );
    }
  }

  /// Fetches candles using the 3-tier fallback matching trade.py in the reference project:
  /// 1. /api/v1/candle (100 rolling dataset)
  /// 2. /api/v1/history (30-day historical range query)
  /// 3. /api/v1/price (snapshot fallback)
  /// 4. BiquoteService (in-app fallback)
  Future<RealMarketFetchResult> fetchMarketCandles(
    String symbol,
    String timeframe,
  ) async {
    final symbolCode = resolveSymbolCode(symbol);
    final tfCode = resolveTimeFrame(timeframe);
    final apiKey = config.apiKey.trim();
    final cleanBase = config.baseUrl.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'/+$'), '');

    String lastError = '';

    // ==========================================
    // 1. Primary Endpoint: /api/v1/candle
    // ==========================================
    try {
      final candleUri = Uri.parse(cleanBase).replace(
        path: '/api/v1/candle',
        queryParameters: {
          'apiKey': apiKey,
          'symbolCode': symbolCode,
          'timeFrame': tfCode,
        },
      );

      final response = await _client.get(
        candleUri,
        headers: {
          'User-Agent': 'TenX-TradingBot/2.0',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
        },
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
        final candles = _parseCandleList(decoded);
        if (candles.isNotEmpty) {
          final chronological = candles.reversed.toList();
          final structure = computeMarketStructure(chronological);
          return RealMarketFetchResult(
            candles: chronological,
            isSuccess: true,
            source: 'realmarket_candle',
            structure: structure,
          );
        }
      } else {
        lastError = 'RealMarket /api/v1/candle HTTP ${response.statusCode}: ${response.body}';
        debugPrint(lastError);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      lastError = 'RealMarket /api/v1/candle failed: $e';
      debugPrint(lastError);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 2. Secondary Endpoint: /api/v1/history
    // ==========================================
    try {
      final now = DateTime.now().toUtc();
      final start = now.subtract(const Duration(days: 30));
      final historyUri = Uri.parse(cleanBase).replace(
        path: '/api/v1/history',
        queryParameters: {
          'apiKey': apiKey,
          'symbolCode': symbolCode,
          'timeFrame': tfCode,
          'startTime': '${start.toIso8601String().split('.').first}Z',
          'endTime': '${now.toIso8601String().split('.').first}Z',
          'limit': '100',
        },
      );

      final response = await _client.get(
        historyUri,
        headers: {
          'User-Agent': 'TenX-TradingBot/2.0',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
        },
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
        final candles = _parseCandleList(decoded);
        if (candles.isNotEmpty) {
          final chronological = candles.reversed.toList();
          final structure = computeMarketStructure(chronological);
          return RealMarketFetchResult(
            candles: chronological,
            isSuccess: true,
            source: 'realmarket_history',
            structure: structure,
          );
        }
      } else {
        lastError = 'RealMarket /api/v1/history HTTP ${response.statusCode}: ${response.body}';
        debugPrint(lastError);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      lastError = 'RealMarket /api/v1/history failed: $e';
      debugPrint(lastError);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 3. Fallback Endpoint: /api/v1/price
    // ==========================================
    try {
      final priceUri = Uri.parse(cleanBase).replace(
        path: '/api/v1/price',
        queryParameters: {
          'apiKey': apiKey,
          'symbolCode': symbolCode,
          'timeFrame': tfCode,
        },
      );

      final response = await _client.get(
        priceUri,
        headers: {
          'User-Agent': 'TenX-TradingBot/2.0',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
        },
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
        final candles = _parseCandleList(decoded);
        if (candles.isNotEmpty) {
          final chronological = candles.reversed.toList();
          final structure = computeMarketStructure(chronological);
          return RealMarketFetchResult(
            candles: chronological,
            isSuccess: true,
            source: 'realmarket_price',
            structure: structure,
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('RealMarket /api/v1/price fallback failed: $e');
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 4. In-App Biquote Fallback
    // ==========================================
    if (biquoteFallback != null) {
      try {
        debugPrint('Falling back to live BiquoteService for $symbol...');
        final candles = await biquoteFallback!.getCandles(
          symbol,
          interval: timeframe.toLowerCase(),
          limit: 100,
        );
        if (candles.isNotEmpty) {
          final structure = computeMarketStructure(candles);
          return RealMarketFetchResult(
            candles: candles,
            isSuccess: true,
            source: 'biquote_fallback',
            structure: structure,
          );
        }
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Biquote fallback also failed: $e');
      }
    }

    return RealMarketFetchResult(
      candles: [],
      isSuccess: false,
      source: 'none',
      errorMessage: lastError.isNotEmpty ? lastError : 'Failed to retrieve candles for $symbolCode.',
    );
  }

  /// Backward-compatible alias for fetchMarketCandles returning `List<BiquoteCandle>`
  Future<List<BiquoteCandle>> fetch100Candles(String symbol, String timeframe) async {
    final res = await fetchMarketCandles(symbol, timeframe);
    return res.candles;
  }

  /// Normalizes candle schema matching trade.py field_map
  List<BiquoteCandle> _parseCandleList(dynamic decoded) {
    List<dynamic> rawList = [];
    if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      if (decoded['data'] is List) {
        rawList = decoded['data'] as List<dynamic>;
      } else if (decoded['candles'] is List) {
        rawList = decoded['candles'] as List<dynamic>;
      } else if (decoded.containsKey('openPrice') || decoded.containsKey('open')) {
        rawList = [decoded];
      }
    } else if (decoded is List) {
      rawList = decoded;
    }

    final List<BiquoteCandle> candles = [];
    for (final c in rawList) {
      if (c is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        final timeStr = c['openTime']?.toString() ??
            c['OpenTime']?.toString() ??
            c['timestamp']?.toString() ??
            c['time']?.toString() ??
            c['Date']?.toString() ??
            '';
        final openTime = DateTime.tryParse(timeStr) ?? DateTime.now();

        final open = _toDouble(c['openPrice'] ?? c['OpenPrice'] ?? c['open'] ?? c['Open']);
        final high = _toDouble(c['highPrice'] ?? c['HighPrice'] ?? c['high'] ?? c['High']);
        final low = _toDouble(c['lowPrice'] ?? c['LowPrice'] ?? c['low'] ?? c['Low']);
        final close = _toDouble(c['closePrice'] ?? c['ClosePrice'] ?? c['close'] ?? c['Close']);
        final volume = _toInt(c['volume'] ?? c['Volume'] ?? c['tickVolume'] ?? 0);

        if (open > 0 || high > 0 || low > 0 || close > 0) {
          candles.add(BiquoteCandle(
            openTime: openTime,
            open: open,
            high: high,
            low: low,
            close: close,
            tickVolume: volume,
            isOpen: false,
          ));
        }
      }
    }

    return candles;
  }

  double _toDouble(dynamic val) {
    if (val == null) return 0.0;
    if (val is num) return val.toDouble();
    return double.tryParse(val.toString()) ?? 0.0;
  }

  int _toInt(dynamic val) {
    if (val == null) return 0;
    if (val is num) return val.toInt();
    return int.tryParse(val.toString()) ?? 0;
  }

  /// Computes EMA, Swing Highs/Lows, ATR, and Bollinger Bands matching tradde.py
  MarketStructureAnalysis computeMarketStructure(List<BiquoteCandle> candles) {
    if (candles.isEmpty) {
      return const MarketStructureAnalysis(
        currentPrice: 0,
        ema50: 0,
        ema200: 0,
        trend: 'Sideways',
        swingHighs: [],
        swingLows: [],
        atr: 0,
        bollingerWidth: 0,
        isConsolidating: false,
      );
    }

    final currentPrice = candles.last.close;

    // EMA calculation
    double calcEma(int period) {
      if (candles.isEmpty) return 0;
      final k = 2 / (period + 1);
      double ema = candles.first.close;
      for (int i = 1; i < candles.length; i++) {
        ema = (candles[i].close * k) + (ema * (1 - k));
      }
      return ema;
    }

    final ema50 = calcEma(50);
    final ema200 = calcEma(200);

    String trend = 'Sideways';
    if (ema50 > ema200) {
      trend = 'Uptrend';
    } else if (ema50 < ema200) {
      trend = 'Downtrend';
    }

    // Local Extrema Swing Highs & Lows (order = 3)
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> swingHighs = [];
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> swingLows = [];

    const order = 3;
    for (int i = order; i < candles.length - order; i++) {
      final curHigh = candles[i].high;
      final curLow = candles[i].low;

      bool isHigh = true;
      bool isLow = true;
      for (int j = 1; j <= order; j++) {
        if (candles[i - j].high >= curHigh || candles[i + j].high >= curHigh) {
          isHigh = false;
        }
        if (candles[i - j].low <= curLow || candles[i + j].low <= curLow) {
          isLow = false;
        }
      }

      if (isHigh) {
        swingHighs.add({
          'time': candles[i].openTime.toIso8601String(),
          'price': curHigh,
          'index': i,
        });
      }
      if (isLow) {
        swingLows.add({
          'time': candles[i].openTime.toIso8601String(),
          'price': curLow,
          'index': i,
        });
      }
    }

    // ATR (period 14)
    double atr = 0;
    if (candles.length > 1) {
      final trList = <double>[];
      for (int i = 1; i < candles.length; i++) {
        final h = candles[i].high;
        final l = candles[i].low;
        final prevC = candles[i - 1].close;
        final tr = max(h - l, max((h - prevC).abs(), (l - prevC).abs()));
        trList.add(tr);
      }
      final recentTr = trList.length > 14 ? trList.sublist(trList.length - 14) : trList;
      atr = recentTr.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / recentTr.length;
    }

    // Bollinger Bands (period 20)
    double bollingerWidth = 0;
    bool isConsolidating = false;
    if (candles.length >= 20) {
      final subset = candles.sublist(candles.length - 20);
      final mean = subset.map((c) => c.close).reduce((a, b) => a + b) / 20;
      final variance = subset.map((c) => pow(c.close - mean, 2)).reduce((a, b) => a + b) / 20;
      final stdDev = sqrt(variance);
      final upper = mean + (2 * stdDev);
      final lower = mean - (2 * stdDev);
      bollingerWidth = (upper - lower) / (mean > 0 ? mean : 1);
      isConsolidating = bollingerWidth < 0.05;
    }

    return MarketStructureAnalysis(
      currentPrice: currentPrice,
      ema50: ema50,
      ema200: ema200,
      trend: trend,
      swingHighs: swingHighs,
      swingLows: swingLows,
      atr: atr,
      bollingerWidth: bollingerWidth,
      isConsolidating: isConsolidating,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

class StorageService {
  static const MethodChannel _channel = MethodChannel('com.example.alert_app/alarm');
  static final Map<String, String> _memoryFallback = {};

  static Future<void> setString(String key, String value) async {
    _memoryFallback[key] = value;
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('saveStorage', {'key': key, 'value': value});
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  static Future<String?> getString(String key) async {
    try {
      final val = await _channel.invokeMethod<String>('loadStorage', {'key': key});
      if (val != null) {
        _memoryFallback[key] = val;
        return val;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return _memoryFallback[key];
  }

  static Future<void> remove(String key) async {
    _memoryFallback.remove(key);
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('removeStorage', {'key': key});
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import '../models/ai_models.dart';
import 'storage_service.dart';

class StrategyStorage {
  static const String _strategiesKey = 'ai_trading_strategies';
  static const String _llmConfigKey = 'ai_llm_config';
  static const String _realMarketConfigKey = 'ai_realmarket_config';
  static const String _lastSignalKey = 'ai_last_chart_signal';

  static final StrategyStorage _instance = StrategyStorage._internal();
  factory StrategyStorage() => _instance;
  StrategyStorage._internal();

  List<TradingStrategy>? _cachedStrategies;
  LlmConfig? _cachedLlmConfig;
  RealMarketConfig? _cachedRealMarketConfig;

  /// Loads all strategies, populating defaults if none exist
  Future<List<TradingStrategy>> getStrategies() async {
    if (_cachedStrategies != null) return _cachedStrategies!;

    try {
      final raw = await StorageService.getString(_strategiesKey);
      if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
        final List<dynamic> decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
        final list = decoded
            .map((e) => TradingStrategy.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>))
            .toList();
        if (list.isNotEmpty) {
          _cachedStrategies = list;
          return list;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('StrategyStorage load strategies error: $e');
    }

    // Default presets matching the Aureus multi-agent architecture and single specialist
    final defaults = [
      TradingStrategy.aureusDefault(),
      TradingStrategy.singleAnalystDefault(),
    ];
    _cachedStrategies = defaults;
    await _persistStrategies(defaults);
    return defaults;
  }

  Future<void> saveStrategy(TradingStrategy strategy) async {
    final list = await getStrategies();
    final index = list.indexWhere((s) => s.id == strategy.id);
    if (index != -1) {
      list[index] = strategy;
    } else {
      list.add(strategy);
    }
    _cachedStrategies = list;
    await _persistStrategies(list);
  }

  Future<void> deleteStrategy(String id) async {
    final list = await getStrategies();
    list.removeWhere((s) => s.id == id);
    _cachedStrategies = list;
    await _persistStrategies(list);
  }

  Future<void> _persistStrategies(List<TradingStrategy> list) async {
    try {
      final encoded = jsonEncode(list.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList());
      await StorageService.setString(_strategiesKey, encoded);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('StrategyStorage persist strategies error: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Loads LLM configuration
  Future<LlmConfig> getLlmConfig() async {
    if (_cachedLlmConfig != null) return _cachedLlmConfig!;

    try {
      final raw = await StorageService.getString(_llmConfigKey);
      if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        _cachedLlmConfig = LlmConfig.fromJson(decoded);
        return _cachedLlmConfig!;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('StrategyStorage load LLM config error: $e');
    }

    _cachedLlmConfig = LlmConfig.defaultSettings;
    return _cachedLlmConfig!;
  }

  Future<void> saveLlmConfig(LlmConfig config) async {
    _cachedLlmConfig = config;
    try {
      final encoded = jsonEncode(config.toJson());
      await StorageService.setString(_llmConfigKey, encoded);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('StrategyStorage save LLM config error: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Loads RealMarket configuration
  Future<RealMarketConfig> getRealMarketConfig() async {
    if (_cachedRealMarketConfig != null) return _cachedRealMarketConfig!;

    try {
      final raw = await StorageService.getString(_realMarketConfigKey);
      if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        _cachedRealMarketConfig = RealMarketConfig.fromJson(decoded);
        return _cachedRealMarketConfig!;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('StrategyStorage load RealMarket config error: $e');
    }

    _cachedRealMarketConfig = const RealMarketConfig();
    return _cachedRealMarketConfig!;
  }

  Future<void> saveRealMarketConfig(RealMarketConfig config) async {
    _cachedRealMarketConfig = config;
    try {
      final encoded = jsonEncode(config.toJson());
      await StorageService.setString(_realMarketConfigKey, encoded);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('StrategyStorage save RealMarket config error: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Saves the active signal that will be overlaid on the chart
  Future<void> saveLastChartSignal(AgentSignal? signal) async {
    try {
      if (signal == null) {
        await StorageService.remove(_lastSignalKey);
      } else {
        final encoded = jsonEncode(signal.toJson());
        await StorageService.setString(_lastSignalKey, encoded);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('StrategyStorage save last signal error: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<AgentSignal?> getLastChartSignal() async {
    try {
      final raw = await StorageService.getString(_lastSignalKey);
      if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        return AgentSignal.fromJson(decoded);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('StrategyStorage get last signal error: $e');
    }
    return null;
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class CandlestickChart extends StatefulWidget {
  final String symbol;
  final List<BiquoteCandle> candles;
  final double currentPrice;
  final List<PriceAlert> alerts;
  final int precision;
  final String interval;
  final VoidCallback? onLoadMoreHistory;
  final bool isLoadingMoreHistory;
  final bool isFullscreen;

  final void Function(String drawingId)? onDrawingDeleted;

  const CandlestickChart({
    super.key,
    required this.symbol,
    required this.candles,
    required this.currentPrice,
    this.alerts = const [],
    this.precision = 5,
    this.interval = '1H',
    this.onLoadMoreHistory,
    this.isLoadingMoreHistory = false,
    this.isFullscreen = false,
    this.onToggleFullscreen,
    this.signalOverlay,

  @override

class _CandlestickChartState extends State<CandlestickChart> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {

  double _candleWidth = 9.0;
  final double _minCandleWidth = 3.0;
  final double _maxCandleWidth = 42.0;
  double _scrollOffset = 0.0; // Index of the rightmost edge visible
  bool _isPinnedToRight = true;

  // Manual Price Scale (Vertical stretch/compress)
  double _manualPriceScale = 1.0;
  double _pricePanOffset = 0.0;

  // Interactive Crosshair & Inspection
  Offset? _crosshairPosition;
  BiquoteCandle? _hoverCandle;
  double? _hoverPrice;
  bool _isCrosshairActive = false;

  Timer? _longPressCrosshairTimer;
  Offset _touchStartPos = Offset.zero;
  Offset _lastTouchPos = Offset.zero;

  // Touch Gesture tracking
  double _baseCandleWidth = 9.0;
  double _basePriceScale = 1.0;
  double _baseScrollOffset = 0.0;
  double _basePricePanOffset = 0.0;
  double _dragStartX = 0.0;
  double _dragStartY = 0.0;
  bool _isDraggingPriceScale = false;

  // Drawing move & resize state
  bool _isDraggingDrawing = false;
  double _drawingDragStartPrice = 0.0;
  double _drawingDragStartIndex = 0.0;
  int _drawingDragHandleIndex = -1; // -1: move whole drawing, 0: handle 0, 1: handle 1
  List<ChartPoint>? _drawingDragOriginalPoints;

  // Drawing Tools Engine
  DrawingTool _activeTool = DrawingTool.none;
  List<ChartDrawing> _drawings = [];
  ChartDrawing? _inProgressDrawing;
  ChartDrawing? _selectedDrawing;
  Color _activeDrawingColor = const Color(0xFF00E5FF);

  // Technical Indicators Engine
  List<IndicatorConfig> _indicators = [];
  Map<String, IndicatorCalculationResult> _calculatedIndicators = {};

  // Drawing panel visibility — hidden by default so chart panning works immediately
  bool _isDrawingPanelVisible = false;

  // Chart tools (panning icons & fx) panel visibility — hidden by default
  bool _isToolsPanelVisible = false;

  // Animation controller for live candle pulse beacon
  late AnimationController _pulseController;
  late Animation<double> _pulseAnimation;

  // History Lazy Load Sentinel Guard
  bool _hasRequestedHistoryForThisScroll = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _pulseController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1400),
    )..repeat(reverse: true);
    _pulseAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.3, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _pulseController, curve: Curves.easeInOut),
    );

    _scrollOffset = widget.candles.length.toDouble();
    _loadDrawings();
    _loadIndicators();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant CandlestickChart oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.symbol != oldWidget.symbol) {
      _loadDrawings();
      _hasRequestedHistoryForThisScroll = false;
      _scrollOffset = widget.candles.length.toDouble();
      _isPinnedToRight = true;
    }
    // If candles updated, recalculate indicators
    if (widget.candles != oldWidget.candles || widget.candles.length != oldWidget.candles.length) {
      _recalculateIndicators();
    }
    // If historical candles were prepended: shift scrollOffset by added count
    if (widget.candles.length > oldWidget.candles.length) {
      final diff = widget.candles.length - oldWidget.candles.length;
      if (oldWidget.candles.isNotEmpty &&
          widget.candles.first.openTime.isBefore(oldWidget.candles.first.openTime)) {
        _scrollOffset += diff;
        _hasRequestedHistoryForThisScroll = false;
      } else if (_isPinnedToRight) {
        _scrollOffset = widget.candles.length.toDouble();
      }
    } else if (_isPinnedToRight) {
      _scrollOffset = widget.candles.length.toDouble();
    }

    // When background history loading completes, clear guard for subsequent scrolls
    if (oldWidget.isLoadingMoreHistory && !widget.isLoadingMoreHistory) {
      _hasRequestedHistoryForThisScroll = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadIndicators() async {
    final list = await IndicatorService().loadActiveIndicators();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _indicators = list;
        _recalculateIndicators();
      });
    }
  }

  void _recalculateIndicators() {
    final map = <String, IndicatorCalculationResult>{};
    for (final ind in _indicators) {
      if (ind.isVisible) {
        final res = IndicatorService().calculate(ind, widget.candles);
        if (res != null) {
          map[ind.id] = res;
        }
      }
    }
    _calculatedIndicators = map;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _longPressCrosshairTimer?.cancel();
    _pulseController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadDrawings() async {
    final list = await DrawingStorageService().loadDrawings(widget.symbol);
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _drawings = list;
        _selectedDrawing = null;
        _inProgressDrawing = null;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveDrawings() async {
    await DrawingStorageService().saveDrawings(widget.symbol, _drawings);
  }

  void _resetPriceScale() {
    setState(() {
      _manualPriceScale = 1.0;
      _pricePanOffset = 0.0;
    });
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
  }

  void _jumpToLatest() {
    setState(() {
      _scrollOffset = widget.candles.length.toDouble();
      _pricePanOffset = 0.0;
      _isPinnedToRight = true;
      _crosshairPosition = null;
      _hoverCandle = null;
      _hoverPrice = null;
    });
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
  }

  // Projection math
  double get _candleSpacing => _candleWidth * 0.22;
  double get _candleStep => _candleWidth + _candleSpacing;

  double _indexToX(double index, double chartWidth) {
    return chartWidth - (_scrollOffset - index) * _candleStep;
  }

  double _xToIndex(double x, double chartWidth) {
    return _scrollOffset - (chartWidth - x) / _candleStep;
  }

  int _findNearestCandleIndex(DateTime time) {
    if (widget.candles.isEmpty) return 0;
    int closestIdx = 0;
    int minDiff = 9007199254740992; // Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER — web-safe
    for (int i = 0; i < widget.candles.length; i++) {
      final diff = (widget.candles[i].openTime.millisecondsSinceEpoch - time.millisecondsSinceEpoch).abs();
      if (diff < minDiff) {
        minDiff = diff;
        closestIdx = i;
      }
    }
    return closestIdx;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (widget.candles.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
    }

    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    const double priceScaleWidth = 65.0;
    const double timeScaleHeight = 24.0;

    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        // Guard against unbounded/infinite constraints (e.g. when inside scrollable)
        final totalWidth = constraints.maxWidth.isFinite ? constraints.maxWidth : 400.0;
        final totalHeight = constraints.maxHeight.isFinite ? constraints.maxHeight : 300.0;
        final chartWidth = max(50.0, totalWidth - priceScaleWidth);

        // Dynamic stacked sub-panes: if oscillators (RSI, MACD, Stoch) are active, stack each on top of each other
        final visibleSubPaneIndicators = _indicators
            .where((ind) => ind.isVisible && ind.type.placement == IndicatorPlacement.subPane)
            .toList();
        final int subPaneCount = visibleSubPaneIndicators.length;
        final bool hasSubPane = subPaneCount > 0;

        const double subPaneSeparatorHeight = 1.0;
        final double totalMainHeight = max(60.0, totalHeight - timeScaleHeight);

        // TradingView-style progressive vertical allocation
        double totalSubPanesRatio = 0.0;
        if (subPaneCount == 1) {
          totalSubPanesRatio = 0.28;
        } else if (subPaneCount == 2) {
          totalSubPanesRatio = 0.40;
        } else if (subPaneCount >= 3) {
          totalSubPanesRatio = (0.16 * subPaneCount).clamp(0.40, 0.52);
        }

        final double totalSeparators = subPaneCount * subPaneSeparatorHeight;
        final double availableHeight = max(50.0, totalMainHeight - totalSeparators);

        final double mainChartHeight = hasSubPane
            ? max(80.0, availableHeight * (1.0 - totalSubPanesRatio))
            : totalMainHeight;
        final double totalSubPanesHeight = hasSubPane
            ? max(35.0 * subPaneCount, availableHeight - mainChartHeight)
            : 0.0;
        final double subPaneHeight = hasSubPane ? totalSubPanesHeight / subPaneCount : 0.0;
        final double chartHeight = mainChartHeight;
        final chartArea = Rect.fromLTWH(0, 0, chartWidth, chartHeight);

        // Clamp scrollOffset
        if (_scrollOffset < 5.0) _scrollOffset = 5.0;
        if (_scrollOffset > widget.candles.length + 10.0) {
          _scrollOffset = widget.candles.length + 10.0;
        }

        // Calculate visible candle slice bounds
        final double visibleCount = chartWidth / _candleStep;
        final int startIndex = max(0, (_scrollOffset - visibleCount - 2).floor());
        final int endIndex = min(widget.candles.length, (_scrollOffset + 2).ceil());

        // Sentinel check for lazy historical loading
        if (startIndex < 20 &&
            !_hasRequestedHistoryForThisScroll &&
            !widget.isLoadingMoreHistory &&
            widget.onLoadMoreHistory != null) {
          _hasRequestedHistoryForThisScroll = true;
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            widget.onLoadMoreHistory?.call();
          });
        } else if (startIndex >= 30) {
          _hasRequestedHistoryForThisScroll = false;
        }

        // Calculate min & max price in visible window
        double minPrice = double.infinity;
        double maxPrice = double.negativeInfinity;

        for (int i = max(0, startIndex); i < min(widget.candles.length, endIndex); i++) {
          final c = widget.candles[i];
          if (c.low < minPrice) minPrice = c.low;
          if (c.high > maxPrice) maxPrice = c.high;
        }

        if (widget.currentPrice > 0 && _isPinnedToRight) {
          minPrice = min(minPrice, widget.currentPrice);
          maxPrice = max(maxPrice, widget.currentPrice);
        }

        // Auto-scale purely to visible candles and live price so bars are beautifully proportioned

        if (minPrice == double.infinity || maxPrice == double.negativeInfinity) {
          minPrice = widget.currentPrice * 0.99;
          maxPrice = widget.currentPrice * 1.01;
        }

        final double rawRange = (maxPrice - minPrice > 0) ? maxPrice - minPrice : 1.0;
        final double padding = rawRange * 0.08;
        double baseMin = minPrice - padding;
        double baseMax = maxPrice + padding;
        final double baseCenter = (baseMin + baseMax) / 2.0;
        final double scaledSpan = (baseMax - baseMin) / _manualPriceScale;

        final double finalMinPrice = (baseCenter - scaledSpan / 2.0) + _pricePanOffset;
        final double finalMaxPrice = (baseCenter + scaledSpan / 2.0) + _pricePanOffset;
        final double effectiveRange = max(0.000001, finalMaxPrice - finalMinPrice);


        return Stack(
          children: [
            // Gesture Arena with 1-Second Long Press Crosshair & Chart Lock
            Listener(
              onPointerDown: (event) {
                _touchStartPos = event.localPosition;
                _lastTouchPos = event.localPosition;
                _longPressCrosshairTimer?.cancel();

                // Start 950ms timer: crosshair only activates after holding for ~1 sec
                _longPressCrosshairTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 950), () {
                  HapticFeedback.heavyImpact();
                  setState(() {
                    _isCrosshairActive = true;
                    _isDraggingCrosshair = true;
                    _updateCrosshair(_lastTouchPos, chartArea, chartWidth, finalMinPrice, effectiveRange);
                  });
                });
              },
              onPointerMove: (event) {
                _lastTouchPos = event.localPosition;
                if (!_isDraggingCrosshair) {
                  // If finger moved before timer, cancel timer so user can pan chart normally
                  if ((event.localPosition - _touchStartPos).distance > 8.0) {
                    _longPressCrosshairTimer?.cancel();
                  }
                } else {
                  // Crosshair is active! Moving finger moves crosshair across chart without moving the chart
                  setState(() {
                    _updateCrosshair(event.localPosition, chartArea, chartWidth, finalMinPrice, effectiveRange);
                  });
                }
              },
              onPointerUp: (event) {
                _longPressCrosshairTimer?.cancel();
                if (_isDraggingCrosshair) {
                  _justFinishedCrosshairTouch = true;
                  setState(() {
                    _isDraggingCrosshair = false;
                  });
                }
              },
              onPointerCancel: (event) {
                _longPressCrosshairTimer?.cancel();
                _isDraggingCrosshair = false;
              },
              child: GestureDetector(
                behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                onDoubleTapDown: (details) {
                  _resetPriceScale();
                },
                onScaleStart: (details) {
                  _longPressCrosshairTimer?.cancel();
                  if (_isDraggingCrosshair) return;

                  _baseCandleWidth = _candleWidth;
                  _basePriceScale = _manualPriceScale;
                  _baseScrollOffset = _scrollOffset;
                  _basePricePanOffset = _pricePanOffset;
                  _dragStartX = details.localFocalPoint.dx;
                  _dragStartY = details.localFocalPoint.dy;
                  _isDraggingPriceScale = details.localFocalPoint.dx >= chartWidth;
                  _isDraggingDrawing = false;
                  _drawingDragHandleIndex = -1;

                  // Check if dragging a drawing or its handles (cursor mode)
                  if (!_isDraggingPriceScale && _activeTool == DrawingTool.none) {
                    final hit = _hitTestDrawing(details.localFocalPoint, chartArea, finalMinPrice, effectiveRange);
                    if (hit != null) {
                      setState(() => _selectedDrawing = hit);
                      _isDraggingDrawing = true;
                      _drawingDragStartPrice = finalMinPrice +
                          ((chartArea.bottom - details.localFocalPoint.dy.clamp(0.0, chartHeight)) /
                              chartHeight) *
                              effectiveRange;
                      _drawingDragStartIndex = _xToIndex(details.localFocalPoint.dx.clamp(0.0, chartWidth), chartWidth);
                      _drawingDragOriginalPoints = List.from(hit.points);

                      // Check if touched near endpoint 0 or endpoint 1 handles
                      if (hit.points.length >= 2) {
                        double pToY(double price) =>
                            chartArea.bottom - ((price - finalMinPrice) / effectiveRange) * chartHeight;
                        final idx0 = _findNearestCandleIndex(hit.points[0].time);
                        final x0 = _indexToX(idx0.toDouble(), chartWidth);
                        final y0 = pToY(hit.points[0].price);

                        final idx1 = _findNearestCandleIndex(hit.points[1].time);
                        final x1 = _indexToX(idx1.toDouble(), chartWidth);
                        final y1 = pToY(hit.points[1].price);

                        if ((details.localFocalPoint - Offset(x0, y0)).distance < 36.0) {
                          _drawingDragHandleIndex = 0;
                        } else if ((details.localFocalPoint - Offset(x1, y1)).distance < 36.0) {
                          _drawingDragHandleIndex = 1;
                        }
                      }
                    } else {
                      // Touched blank space: deselect so user can pan normally
                      setState(() => _selectedDrawing = null);
                    }
                  } else if (!_isDraggingPriceScale && _activeTool != DrawingTool.none) {
                    _handleDrawingStart(details.localFocalPoint, chartArea, finalMinPrice, effectiveRange);
                  }
                },
                onScaleUpdate: (details) {
                  // When crosshair is active & dragging, chart panning is locked!
                  if (_isDraggingCrosshair) {
                    return;
                  }

                  // Pinch to Zoom: horizontal scale → candle width, vertical scale → price scale
                  if (details.pointerCount >= 2) {
                    final newWidth = (_baseCandleWidth * details.horizontalScale).clamp(_minCandleWidth, _maxCandleWidth);
                    final focalX = details.localFocalPoint.dx.clamp(0.0, chartWidth);
                    final candleUnderFocal = _scrollOffset - (chartWidth - focalX) / (_candleWidth + _candleSpacing);

                    // Vertical pinch scale adjusts price scale (relative to gesture start)
                    final newPriceScale = (_basePriceScale * details.verticalScale).clamp(0.1, 30.0);

                    setState(() {
                      _candleWidth = newWidth;
                      _manualPriceScale = newPriceScale;
                      _scrollOffset = candleUnderFocal + (chartWidth - focalX) / (_candleWidth + _candleSpacing);
                      if (_scrollOffset >= widget.candles.length) {
                        _isPinnedToRight = true;
                      } else {
                        _isPinnedToRight = false;
                      }
                    });
                    return;
                  }

                  // 1-Finger vertical drag on price scale area → stretch/compress price scale vertically
                  if (_isDraggingPriceScale) {
                    final dy = details.localFocalPoint.dy - _dragStartY;
                    _dragStartY = details.localFocalPoint.dy;
                    final factor = 1.0 - (dy / 100.0);
                    setState(() {
                      _manualPriceScale = (_manualPriceScale * factor).clamp(0.1, 30.0);
                    });
                    return;
                  }

                  // Active Drawing Drag (in-progress drawing creation)
                  if (_activeTool != DrawingTool.none && _inProgressDrawing != null) {
                    _handleDrawingUpdate(details.localFocalPoint, chartArea, finalMinPrice, effectiveRange);
                    return;
                  }

                  // Move or Resize Selected Drawing
                  if (_isDraggingDrawing && _selectedDrawing != null && _drawingDragOriginalPoints != null) {
                    final currentPrice = finalMinPrice +
                        ((chartArea.bottom - details.localFocalPoint.dy.clamp(0.0, chartHeight)) /
                            chartHeight) *
                            effectiveRange;
                    final currentIndex = _xToIndex(details.localFocalPoint.dx.clamp(0.0, chartWidth), chartWidth);
                    final priceDelta = currentPrice - _drawingDragStartPrice;
                    final indexDelta = currentIndex - _drawingDragStartIndex;
                    final intervalMs = widget.candles.length > 1
                        ? widget.candles[1].openTime.millisecondsSinceEpoch -
                            widget.candles[0].openTime.millisecondsSinceEpoch
                        : 3600000;

                    setState(() {
                      if (_drawingDragHandleIndex == 0 && _selectedDrawing!.points.isNotEmpty) {
                        // Resize endpoint 0
                        final originalPt0 = _drawingDragOriginalPoints![0];
                        final newTime = originalPt0.time.add(
                            Duration(milliseconds: (indexDelta * intervalMs).round()));
                        final newPts = List<ChartPoint>.from(_selectedDrawing!.points);
                        newPts[0] = ChartPoint(time: newTime, price: originalPt0.price + priceDelta);
                        final idx = _drawings.indexOf(_selectedDrawing!);
                        if (idx != -1) {
                          _drawings[idx] = _selectedDrawing!.copyWith(points: newPts);
                          _selectedDrawing = _drawings[idx];
                        }
                      } else if (_drawingDragHandleIndex == 1 && _selectedDrawing!.points.length >= 2) {
                        // Resize endpoint 1
                        final originalPt1 = _drawingDragOriginalPoints![1];
                        final newTime = originalPt1.time.add(
                            Duration(milliseconds: (indexDelta * intervalMs).round()));
                        final newPts = List<ChartPoint>.from(_selectedDrawing!.points);
                        newPts[1] = ChartPoint(time: newTime, price: originalPt1.price + priceDelta);
                        final idx = _drawings.indexOf(_selectedDrawing!);
                        if (idx != -1) {
                          _drawings[idx] = _selectedDrawing!.copyWith(points: newPts);
                          _selectedDrawing = _drawings[idx];
                        }
                      } else {
                        // Move entire drawing
                        final movedPoints = _drawingDragOriginalPoints!.map((pt) {
                          final newTime = pt.time.add(
                              Duration(milliseconds: (indexDelta * intervalMs).round()));
                          return ChartPoint(time: newTime, price: pt.price + priceDelta);
                        }).toList();
                        final idx = _drawings.indexOf(_selectedDrawing!);
                        if (idx != -1) {
                          _drawings[idx] = _selectedDrawing!.copyWith(points: movedPoints);
                          _selectedDrawing = _drawings[idx];
                        }
                      }
                    });
                    return;
                  }

                  // Normal Chart Panning (2D: any direction!)
                  final dx = details.localFocalPoint.dx - _dragStartX;
                  final dy = details.localFocalPoint.dy - _dragStartY;
                  final indexDelta = dx / _candleStep;
                  final newOffset = _baseScrollOffset - indexDelta;

                  // Vertical pan: dragging down (dy > 0) pulls chart content down (showing higher prices above)
                  final priceDelta = (dy / chartHeight) * effectiveRange;
                  final newPricePanOffset = _basePricePanOffset + priceDelta;

                  setState(() {
                    _scrollOffset = newOffset;
                    _pricePanOffset = newPricePanOffset;
                    if (_scrollOffset >= widget.candles.length - 0.5) {
                      _isPinnedToRight = true;
                    } else {
                      _isPinnedToRight = false;
                    }
                  });
                },
                onScaleEnd: (details) {
                  _longPressCrosshairTimer?.cancel();
                  _isDraggingCrosshair = false;
                  _isDraggingPriceScale = false;
                  if (_isDraggingDrawing && _selectedDrawing != null) {
                    final d = _selectedDrawing!;
                    _isDraggingDrawing = false;
                    _drawingDragOriginalPoints = null;
                    _drawingDragHandleIndex = -1;
                    _saveDrawings();

                    final hasAlert = d.hasAlert ||
                        widget.alerts.any((a) => a.drawingId == d.id && a.isActive);
                    if (hasAlert && d.points.isNotEmpty) {
                      widget.onDrawingPriceUpdated?.call(d.id, d.points.first.price);
                    }
                  }
                  if (_activeTool != DrawingTool.none && _inProgressDrawing != null) {
                    _handleDrawingEnd();
                  }
                },
                onTapUp: (details) {
                  if (_justFinishedCrosshairTouch) {
                    _justFinishedCrosshairTouch = false;
                    return;
                  }

                  if (_activeTool == DrawingTool.horizontalLine) {
                    _handleDrawingStart(details.localPosition, chartArea, finalMinPrice, effectiveRange);
                    return;
                  } else if (_activeTool != DrawingTool.none) {
                    _handleTapToDraw(details.localPosition, chartArea, finalMinPrice, effectiveRange);
                    return;
                  }

                  // Tap on chart dismisses crosshair cleanly
                  if (_isCrosshairActive) {
                    setState(() {
                      _isCrosshairActive = false;
                      _isDraggingCrosshair = false;
                      _crosshairPosition = null;
                      _hoverCandle = null;
                      _hoverPrice = null;
                    });
                    return;
                  }

                  // Hit test existing drawings
                  final hit = _hitTestDrawing(details.localPosition, chartArea, finalMinPrice, effectiveRange);
                  setState(() {
                    _selectedDrawing = hit;
                  });
                },
                child: AnimatedBuilder(
                  animation: _pulseAnimation,
                  builder: (context, _) {
                    return CustomPaint(
                      size: Size(totalWidth, totalHeight),
                      painter: _FullblownChartPainter(
                        candles: widget.candles,
                        currentPrice: widget.currentPrice,
                        alerts: widget.alerts,
                        precision: widget.precision,
                        isDark: isDark,
                        scrollOffset: _scrollOffset,
                        candleWidth: _candleWidth,
                        candleSpacing: _candleSpacing,
                        minPrice: finalMinPrice,
                        maxPrice: finalMaxPrice,
                        priceRange: effectiveRange,
                        chartArea: chartArea,
                        drawings: _drawings,
                        inProgressDrawing: _inProgressDrawing,
                        selectedDrawing: _selectedDrawing,
                        crosshairPosition: _crosshairPosition,
                        hoverCandle: _hoverCandle,
                        hoverPrice: _hoverPrice,
                        isCrosshairActive: _isCrosshairActive,
                        pulseValue: _pulseAnimation.value,
                        isPinnedToRight: _isPinnedToRight,
                        interval: widget.interval,
                        signalOverlay: widget.signalOverlay,
                        indicatorResults: _calculatedIndicators,
                        hasSubPane: hasSubPane,
                        subPaneHeight: subPaneHeight,
                        subPaneIndicators: hasSubPane
                            ? _indicators
                                .where((ind) =>
                                    ind.isVisible &&
                                    ind.type.placement == IndicatorPlacement.subPane)
                                .toList()
                            : [],
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ),

            // Top Floating Inspection HUD Bar (When crosshair is active or hovering)
            if (_hoverCandle != null)
              Positioned(
                top: 8,
                left: 12,
                right: priceScaleWidth + 92,
                child: _buildInspectionHud(isDark, theme),
              ),

            // Indicator Legend HUD (top-left, below inspection hud)
            if (_indicators.isNotEmpty && _hoverCandle == null)
              Positioned(
                top: 8,
                left: 12,
                child: _buildIndicatorLegend(isDark, theme),
              ),

            // Floating "Jump to Latest" live price chip when user is scrolled into history
            if (!_isPinnedToRight && _scrollOffset < widget.candles.length - 4)
              Positioned(
                bottom: timeScaleHeight + 56,
                right: priceScaleWidth + 12,
                child: _buildJumpToLatestButton(isDark, theme),
              ),

            // Bottom Left Controls Dock: Drawing Tools & Collapsible Chart Tools (Panning, Zoom, FX)
            Positioned(
              left: 12,
              bottom: timeScaleHeight + 12,
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  // Drawing Tools Palette (shown only when pencil is toggled on)
                  if (_isDrawingPanelVisible) ...[
                    _buildDrawingToolsPalette(isDark, theme),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  ],

                  // Bottom Dock Row: [ Pencil Icon ] + [ Collapsible Chart Tools Form (Panning & FX) ]
                  Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      // 1. Drawing Tools Toggle Button (Pencil)
                      GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () {
                          setState(() {
                            _isDrawingPanelVisible = !_isDrawingPanelVisible;
                            if (!_isDrawingPanelVisible) {
                              _activeTool = DrawingTool.none;
                            }
                          });
                          HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                        },
                        child: Container(
                          width: 32,
                          height: 32,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: _isDrawingPanelVisible
                                ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.2)
                                : (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1).withValues(alpha: 0.88),
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: _isDrawingPanelVisible
                                  ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF)
                                  : (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder),
                              width: 1.2,
                            ),
                            boxShadow: [
                              BoxShadow(
                                color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                                blurRadius: 6,
                                offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          child: Icon(
                            Icons.edit_outlined,
                            size: 16,
                            color: _isDrawingPanelVisible
                                ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF)
                                : theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),

                      // 2. Collapsible Chart Tools Form (Panning icons and FX button, hidden by default)
                      _buildCollapsibleToolsForm(isDark, theme, chartWidth),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            // Selected Drawing Context Menu Toolbar
            if (_selectedDrawing != null)
              Positioned(
                top: 48,
                left: 16,
                right: priceScaleWidth + 16,
                child: _buildDrawingContextMenu(isDark, theme),
              ),

            // History Loading Indicator Badge
            if (widget.isLoadingMoreHistory)
              Positioned(
                top: 10,
                left: 12,
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : AppTheme.lightSurface2).withValues(alpha: 0.9),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                    border: Border.all(color: AppTheme.darkPrimary.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      const SizedBox(
                        width: 12,
                        height: 12,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Text(
                        'Loading history...',
                        style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 10),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),

            // AI Signal Floating Banner
            if (widget.signalOverlay != null && widget.signalOverlay!.hasValidTradeSetup)
              Positioned(
                top: 48,
                left: 12,
                child: _buildSignalBanner(isDark, theme),
              ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // Crosshair calculation
  void _updateCrosshair(
    Offset pos,
    Rect chartArea,
    double chartWidth,
    double minPrice,
    double priceRange,
  ) {
    if (widget.candles.isEmpty) return;
    final clampedX = pos.dx.clamp(0.0, chartWidth);
    final clampedY = pos.dy.clamp(0.0, chartArea.height);

    final rawIndex = _xToIndex(clampedX, chartWidth);
    final candleIndex = rawIndex.round().clamp(0, widget.candles.length - 1);
    final candle = widget.candles[candleIndex];

    final snappedX = _indexToX(candleIndex.toDouble(), chartWidth);
    final price = minPrice + ((chartArea.bottom - clampedY) / chartArea.height) * priceRange;

    _crosshairPosition = Offset(snappedX, clampedY);
    _hoverCandle = candle;
    _hoverPrice = price;
  }

  // Drawing Handlers
  void _handleDrawingStart(Offset localPos, Rect chartArea, double minPrice, double priceRange) {
    final chartWidth = chartArea.width;
    final rawIndex = _xToIndex(localPos.dx.clamp(0.0, chartWidth), chartWidth);
    final candleIndex = rawIndex.round().clamp(0, widget.candles.length - 1);
    final time = widget.candles[candleIndex].openTime;
    final price = minPrice + ((chartArea.bottom - localPos.dy) / chartArea.height) * priceRange;

    final pt = ChartPoint(time: time, price: price);

    if (_activeTool == DrawingTool.horizontalLine) {
      final drawing = ChartDrawing(
        id: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
        tool: DrawingTool.horizontalLine,
        points: [pt],
        color: _activeDrawingColor,
      );
      setState(() {
        _drawings.add(drawing);
        _selectedDrawing = drawing;
        _activeTool = DrawingTool.none;
      });
      _saveDrawings();
      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _inProgressDrawing = ChartDrawing(
        id: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
        tool: _activeTool,
        points: [pt, pt], // initial start and end point
        color: _activeDrawingColor,
      );
    });
  }

  void _handleDrawingUpdate(Offset localPos, Rect chartArea, double minPrice, double priceRange) {
    if (_inProgressDrawing == null) return;
    final chartWidth = chartArea.width;
    final rawIndex = _xToIndex(localPos.dx.clamp(0.0, chartWidth), chartWidth);
    final candleIndex = rawIndex.round().clamp(0, widget.candles.length - 1);
    final time = widget.candles[candleIndex].openTime;
    final price = minPrice + ((chartArea.bottom - localPos.dy) / chartArea.height) * priceRange;

    setState(() {
      final pts = List<ChartPoint>.from(_inProgressDrawing!.points);
      if (pts.length >= 2) {
        pts[1] = ChartPoint(time: time, price: price);
      }
      _inProgressDrawing = _inProgressDrawing!.copyWith(points: pts);
    });
  }

  void _handleDrawingEnd() {
    if (_inProgressDrawing != null) {
      setState(() {
        _drawings.add(_inProgressDrawing!);
        _selectedDrawing = _inProgressDrawing;
        _inProgressDrawing = null;
        _activeTool = DrawingTool.none;
      });
      _saveDrawings();
      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    }
  }

  void _handleTapToDraw(Offset localPos, Rect chartArea, double minPrice, double priceRange) {
    final chartWidth = chartArea.width;
    final rawIndex = _xToIndex(localPos.dx.clamp(0.0, chartWidth), chartWidth);
    final candleIndex = rawIndex.round().clamp(0, widget.candles.length - 1);
    final time1 = widget.candles[candleIndex].openTime;
    final price1 = minPrice + ((chartArea.bottom - localPos.dy) / chartArea.height) * priceRange;
    final pt1 = ChartPoint(time: time1, price: price1);

    final secondIndex = min(widget.candles.length - 1, candleIndex + 8);
    final time2 = widget.candles[secondIndex].openTime;
    final price2 = price1 + (_activeTool == DrawingTool.rectangle || _activeTool == DrawingTool.fibonacci
        ? (priceRange * 0.15)
        : (priceRange * 0.05));
    final pt2 = ChartPoint(time: time2, price: price2);

    final drawing = ChartDrawing(
      id: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
      tool: _activeTool,
      points: [pt1, pt2],
      color: _activeDrawingColor,
    );

    setState(() {
      _drawings.add(drawing);
      _selectedDrawing = drawing;
      _activeTool = DrawingTool.none;
    });
    _saveDrawings();
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
  }

  ChartDrawing? _hitTestDrawing(Offset localPos, Rect chartArea, double minPrice, double priceRange) {
    final chartWidth = chartArea.width;
    double priceToY(double price) {
      return chartArea.bottom - ((price - minPrice) / priceRange) * chartArea.height;
    }

    for (final d in _drawings.reversed) {
      if (d.points.isEmpty) continue;
      if (d.tool == DrawingTool.horizontalLine) {
        final lineY = priceToY(d.points.first.price);
        if ((localPos.dy - lineY).abs() < 28.0) return d;
      } else if (d.points.length >= 2) {
        final idx1 = _findNearestCandleIndex(d.points[0].time);
        final idx2 = _findNearestCandleIndex(d.points[1].time);
        final x1 = _indexToX(idx1.toDouble(), chartWidth);
        final y1 = priceToY(d.points[0].price);
        final x2 = _indexToX(idx2.toDouble(), chartWidth);
        final y2 = priceToY(d.points[1].price);

        if (d.tool == DrawingTool.rectangle) {
          final rect = Rect.fromPoints(Offset(x1, y1), Offset(x2, y2));
          // Hit test inside or within 28px margin of rectangle
          if (rect.inflate(28.0).contains(localPos)) return d;
        } else if (d.tool == DrawingTool.fibonacci) {
          final minY = min(y1, y2);
          final maxY = max(y1, y2);
          final minX = min(x1, x2) - 28.0;
          final maxX = max(x1, x2) + 50.0;
          if (localPos.dx >= minX && localPos.dx <= maxX &&
              localPos.dy >= minY - 28.0 && localPos.dy <= maxY + 28.0) {
            return d;
          }
        } else {
          // Trendline or Ruler: distance to line segment
          final dist = _distanceToSegment(localPos, Offset(x1, y1), Offset(x2, y2));
          if (dist < 28.0) return d;
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  double _distanceToSegment(Offset p, Offset a, Offset b) {
    final l2 = (b.dx - a.dx) * (b.dx - a.dx) + (b.dy - a.dy) * (b.dy - a.dy);
    if (l2 == 0) return (p - a).distance;
    final t = max(0.0, min(1.0, ((p.dx - a.dx) * (b.dx - a.dx) + (p.dy - a.dy) * (b.dy - a.dy)) / l2));
    final projection = Offset(a.dx + t * (b.dx - a.dx), a.dy + t * (b.dy - a.dy));
    return (p - projection).distance;
  }

  // Floating Inspection HUD
  Widget _buildInspectionHud(bool isDark, ThemeData theme) {
    final c = _hoverCandle!;
    final isBull = c.isBullish;
    final diff = c.close - c.open;
    final diffPct = (diff / c.open) * 100.0;
    final trendColor = isBull ? (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish) : (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBearish : AppTheme.lightBearish);

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1).withValues(alpha: 0.95),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        border: Border.all(color: (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder).withValues(alpha: 0.8)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
            blurRadius: 6,
            offset: const Offset(0, 2),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        child: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Text(
              DateFormat('MM/dd HH:mm').format(c.openTime),
              style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(
              'O: ${c.open.toStringAsFixed(widget.precision)}',
              style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 9),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(
              'H: ${c.high.toStringAsFixed(widget.precision)}',
              style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 9, color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(
              'L: ${c.low.toStringAsFixed(widget.precision)}',
              style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 9, color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkBearish : AppTheme.lightBearish),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(
              'C: ${c.close.toStringAsFixed(widget.precision)}',
              style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(
              '${diff >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${diffPct.toStringAsFixed(2)}%',
              style: AppTheme.mono(context: context, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: trendColor),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Drawing Tools Dock Palette
  Widget _buildDrawingToolsPalette(bool isDark, ThemeData theme) {
    final tools = [
      DrawingTool.none,
      DrawingTool.trendline,
      DrawingTool.horizontalLine,
      DrawingTool.fibonacci,
      DrawingTool.rectangle,
      DrawingTool.ruler,
    ];

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1).withValues(alpha: 0.92),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
        border: Border.all(color: (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder).withValues(alpha: 0.8)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.25),
            blurRadius: 8,
            offset: const Offset(0, 2),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          ...tools.map((t) {
            final isSelected = _activeTool == t;
            return IconButton(
              icon: Icon(t.icon, size: 18),
              color: isSelected ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF) : theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
              tooltip: t.label,
              style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: isSelected ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.2) : Colors.transparent,
                shape: const CircleBorder(),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                minimumSize: const Size(32, 32),
              ),
              onPressed: () {
                setState(() {
                  _activeTool = isSelected ? DrawingTool.none : t;
                  _selectedDrawing = null;
                });
                HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
              },
            );
          }),
          if (_drawings.isNotEmpty) ...[
            Container(width: 1, height: 20, color: theme.dividerColor, margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2)),
            IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_sweep, size: 18, color: Colors.redAccent),
              tooltip: 'Clear All Drawings',
              style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                shape: const CircleBorder(),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                minimumSize: const Size(32, 32),
              ),
              onPressed: () {
                for (final d in _drawings) {
                  widget.onDrawingDeleted?.call(d.id);
                }
                setState(() {
                  _drawings.clear();
                  _selectedDrawing = null;
                  _inProgressDrawing = null;
                });
                DrawingStorageService().clearDrawings(widget.symbol);
                HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
              },
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // Selected Drawing Context Menu
  Widget _buildDrawingContextMenu(bool isDark, ThemeData theme) {
    final colors = [
      const Color(0xFF00E5FF), // Cyan
      const Color(0xFFFFD700), // Gold
      const Color(0xFFFF5252), // Red
      const Color(0xFF69F0AE), // Green
      const Color(0xFFE040FB), // Purple
    ];

    final hasAlert = _selectedDrawing!.hasAlert ||
        widget.alerts.any((a) => a.drawingId == _selectedDrawing!.id && a.isActive);

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : AppTheme.lightSurface2).withValues(alpha: 0.95),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF), width: 1.2),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Text(
            _selectedDrawing!.tool.label,
            style: AppTheme.sans(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          ...colors.map((c) {
            final isCurrent = _selectedDrawing!.color == c;
            return GestureDetector(
              onTap: () {
                setState(() {
                  _selectedDrawing!.color = c;
                  _activeDrawingColor = c;
                });
                _saveDrawings();
              },
              child: Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 3),
                width: 18,
                height: 18,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: c,
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  border: isCurrent ? Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: 2) : null,
                ),
              ),
            );
          }),
          // Set Alert Action Button
          InkWell(
            onTap: () {
              final d = _selectedDrawing!;
              double targetPrice = d.points.first.price;
              if (d.tool == DrawingTool.rectangle && d.points.length >= 2) {
                targetPrice = max(d.points[0].price, d.points[1].price);
              }
              widget.onAddAlertFromDrawing?.call(d, targetPrice);
            },
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            child: Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: hasAlert
                    ? const Color(0xFFFF9100).withValues(alpha: 0.22)
                    : theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: hasAlert ? const Color(0xFFFF9100) : theme.colorScheme.primary,
                  width: 1.2,
                ),
              ),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    hasAlert ? Icons.notifications_active : Icons.add_alert_outlined,
                    size: 14,
                    color: hasAlert ? const Color(0xFFFF9100) : theme.colorScheme.primary,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Text(
                    hasAlert ? 'ALERT ACTIVE' : 'SET ALERT',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      letterSpacing: 0.4,
                      color: hasAlert ? const Color(0xFFFF9100) : theme.colorScheme.primary,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 18, color: Colors.redAccent),
            tooltip: 'Delete Drawing',
            onPressed: () {
              final drawingId = _selectedDrawing!.id;
              setState(() {
                _drawings.remove(_selectedDrawing);
                _selectedDrawing = null;
              });
              _saveDrawings();
              widget.onDrawingDeleted?.call(drawingId);
              HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
            },
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 18),
            tooltip: 'Deselect',
            onPressed: () {
              setState(() => _selectedDrawing = null);
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // Collapsible Chart Tools Form (Panning, Zoom, FX, Crosshair, Fullscreen)
  Widget _buildCollapsibleToolsForm(bool isDark, ThemeData theme, double maxAvailableWidth) {
    if (!_isToolsPanelVisible) {
      // Collapsed form: single compact button next to the pencil icon
      return GestureDetector(
        onTap: () {
          setState(() => _isToolsPanelVisible = true);
          HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
        },
        child: Container(
          width: 32,
          height: 32,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1).withValues(alpha: 0.88),
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
