              color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder,
              width: 1.2,
            ),
            boxShadow: [
              BoxShadow(
                color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                blurRadius: 6,
                offset: const Offset(0, 2),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          child: Icon(
            Icons.tune_rounded,
            size: 16,
            color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.65),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    // Expanded form: horizontal pill toolbar containing FX, Crosshair, Zoom In/Out, Reset, Fullscreen & Collapse Button
    return Container(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: max(180.0, maxAvailableWidth - 60)),
      height: 36,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 2),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1).withValues(alpha: 0.94),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(
          color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
          width: 1.2,
        ),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.25),
            blurRadius: 8,
            offset: const Offset(0, 2),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        child: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            // Collapse button (closes the tools form)
            GestureDetector(
              onTap: () {
                setState(() => _isToolsPanelVisible = false);
                HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
              },
              child: Container(
                width: 28,
                height: 28,
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: (isDark ? Colors.white10 : Colors.black12),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  Icons.chevron_left_rounded,
                  size: 18,
                  color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),

            // fx Indicators Button
            _buildFxIndicatorButton(isDark),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),

            // Crosshair Toggle
            _buildIconButton(
              icon: Icons.filter_center_focus,
              tooltip: 'Toggle Crosshair',
              isActive: _isCrosshairActive,
              isDark: isDark,
              onPressed: () {
                setState(() {
                  _isCrosshairActive = !_isCrosshairActive;
                  if (!_isCrosshairActive) {
                    _crosshairPosition = null;
                    _hoverCandle = null;
                    _hoverPrice = null;
                  }
                });
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),

            // Vertical Price Expansion (+)
            _buildIconButton(
              icon: Icons.unfold_more,
              tooltip: 'Expand Vertically',
              isDark: isDark,
              onPressed: () {
                setState(() {
                  _manualPriceScale = (_manualPriceScale * 1.35).clamp(0.1, 30.0);
                });
                HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),

            // Vertical Price Compression (-)
            _buildIconButton(
              icon: Icons.unfold_less,
              tooltip: 'Compress Vertically',
              isDark: isDark,
              onPressed: () {
                setState(() {
                  _manualPriceScale = (_manualPriceScale / 1.35).clamp(0.1, 30.0);
                });
                HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
              },
            ),

            // Reset Price Scale button (shows if zoomed/panned)
            if (_manualPriceScale != 1.0 || _pricePanOffset != 0.0) ...[
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              _buildIconButton(
                icon: Icons.restart_alt,
                tooltip: 'Reset Scale (100%)',
                isDark: isDark,
                onPressed: _resetPriceScale,
              ),
            ],

            // Fullscreen toggle button
            if (widget.onToggleFullscreen != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              _buildIconButton(
                icon: widget.isFullscreen ? Icons.fullscreen_exit : Icons.fullscreen,
                tooltip: widget.isFullscreen ? 'Exit Fullscreen' : 'Fullscreen Chart',
                isDark: isDark,
                onPressed: widget.onToggleFullscreen!,
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIconButton({
    required IconData icon,
    required String tooltip,
    required VoidCallback onPressed,
    required bool isDark,
    bool isActive = false,
  }) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1).withValues(alpha: 0.85),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        border: Border.all(color: isActive ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF) : (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder)),
      ),
      child: IconButton(
        icon: Icon(icon, size: 18),
        color: isActive ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF) : null,
        tooltip: tooltip,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 32, minHeight: 32),
        onPressed: onPressed,
      ),
    );
  }

  // fx Indicators Button — TradingView style with active indicator count badge
  Widget _buildFxIndicatorButton(bool isDark) {
    final activeCount = _indicators.where((i) => i.isVisible).length;

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
        IndicatorCatalogSheet.show(
          context,
          activeIndicators: _indicators,
          onIndicatorsChanged: (updatedList) {
            setState(() {
              _indicators = updatedList;
              _recalculateIndicators();
            });
            IndicatorService().saveActiveIndicators(updatedList);
          },
        );
      },
      child: Container(
        height: 32,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: activeCount > 0
              ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.15)
              : (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1).withValues(alpha: 0.85),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
          border: Border.all(
            color: activeCount > 0 ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF) : (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder),
          ),
        ),
        child: Stack(
          clipBehavior: Clip.none,
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          children: [
            Text(
              'fx',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                fontSize: 13,
                color: activeCount > 0
                    ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF)
                    : (isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black54),
              ),
            ),
            if (activeCount > 0)
              Positioned(
                top: -6,
                right: -6,
                child: Container(
                  width: 15,
                  height: 15,
                  alignment: Alignment.center,
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                    color: Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    '$activeCount',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.black,
                      fontSize: 9,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Indicator Legend HUD — TradingView style top-left floating legend
  Widget _buildIndicatorLegend(bool isDark, ThemeData theme) {
    if (_indicators.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    // Calculate the candle index under hoverCandle or the rightmost visible candle
    int snapshotIndex = widget.candles.length - 1;
    if (_hoverCandle != null) {
      for (int i = widget.candles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (widget.candles[i].openTime == _hoverCandle!.openTime) {
          snapshotIndex = i;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    final bg = (isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : AppTheme.lightSurface1).withValues(alpha: 0.90);
    final borderColor = (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder).withValues(alpha: 0.6);
    final textSecondary = isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black45;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 5),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        border: Border.all(color: borderColor),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
            blurRadius: 6,
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: _indicators.map((ind) {
          final result = _calculatedIndicators[ind.id];
          Color dotColor;
          if (ind.colors.containsKey('main')) {
            dotColor = Color(ind.colors['main']!);
          } else if (ind.colors.containsKey('macd')) {
            dotColor = Color(ind.colors['macd']!);
          } else if (ind.colors.containsKey('k')) {
            dotColor = Color(ind.colors['k']!);
          } else if (ind.colors.containsKey('upper')) {
            dotColor = Color(ind.colors['upper']!);
          } else {
            dotColor = const Color(0xFF00E5FF);
          }

          String valueStr = '—';
          if (result != null && snapshotIndex < result.primary.length) {
            final v = result.primary[snapshotIndex];
            if (v != null) {
              if (ind.type.placement == IndicatorPlacement.overlay) {
                valueStr = v.toStringAsFixed(widget.precision);
              } else {
                valueStr = v.toStringAsFixed(2);
              }
            }
          }

          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 8,
                  height: 8,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: ind.isVisible ? dotColor : dotColor.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 5),
                Text(
                  ind.titleWithParams,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: ind.isVisible ? (isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87) : textSecondary,
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text(
                  valueStr,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: ind.isVisible ? dotColor : dotColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                // Eye icon
                InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    setState(() {
                      ind.isVisible = !ind.isVisible;
                      _recalculateIndicators();
                    });
                    IndicatorService().saveActiveIndicators(_indicators);
                  },
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                    child: Icon(
                      ind.isVisible ? Icons.visibility : Icons.visibility_off,
                      size: 12,
                      color: textSecondary,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 2),
                // Settings icon
                InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    IndicatorSettingsSheet.show(
                      context,
                      config: ind,
                      onSave: (updated) {
                        setState(() {
                          final idx = _indicators.indexWhere((i) => i.id == updated.id);
                          if (idx != -1) _indicators[idx] = updated;
                          _recalculateIndicators();
                        });
                        IndicatorService().saveActiveIndicators(_indicators);
                      },
                    );
                  },
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                    child: Icon(Icons.settings, size: 12, color: textSecondary),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 2),
                // Remove icon
                InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    setState(() {
                      _indicators.removeWhere((i) => i.id == ind.id);
                      _recalculateIndicators();
                    });
                    IndicatorService().saveActiveIndicators(_indicators);
                  },
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                  child: const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(2),
                    child: Icon(Icons.close, size: 12, color: Colors.redAccent),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }).toList(),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _FullblownChartPainter extends CustomPainter {
  final List<BiquoteCandle> candles;
  final double currentPrice;
  final List<PriceAlert> alerts;
  final int precision;
  final bool isDark;
  final double scrollOffset;
  final double candleWidth;
  final double candleSpacing;
  final double minPrice;
  final double maxPrice;
  final double priceRange;
  final Rect chartArea;
  final List<ChartDrawing> drawings;
  final ChartDrawing? inProgressDrawing;
  final ChartDrawing? selectedDrawing;
  final Offset? crosshairPosition;
  final BiquoteCandle? hoverCandle;
  final double? hoverPrice;
  final bool isCrosshairActive;
  final double pulseValue;
  final bool isPinnedToRight;
  final String interval;
  final AgentSignal? signalOverlay;
  // Technical Indicators
  final Map<String, IndicatorCalculationResult> indicatorResults;
  final bool hasSubPane;
  final double subPaneHeight;
  final List<IndicatorConfig> subPaneIndicators;

  _FullblownChartPainter({
    required this.candles,
    required this.currentPrice,
    required this.alerts,
    required this.precision,
    required this.isDark,
    required this.scrollOffset,
    required this.candleWidth,
    required this.candleSpacing,
    required this.minPrice,
    required this.maxPrice,
    required this.priceRange,
    required this.chartArea,
    required this.drawings,
    required this.inProgressDrawing,
    required this.selectedDrawing,
    required this.crosshairPosition,
    required this.hoverCandle,
    required this.hoverPrice,
    required this.isCrosshairActive,
    required this.pulseValue,
    required this.isPinnedToRight,
    required this.interval,
    this.signalOverlay,
    this.indicatorResults = const {},
    this.hasSubPane = false,
    this.subPaneHeight = 0.0,
    this.subPaneIndicators = const [],
  });

  double get candleStep => candleWidth + candleSpacing;

  double indexToX(double index) {
    return chartArea.width - (scrollOffset - index) * candleStep;
  }

  double priceToY(double p) {
    return chartArea.bottom - ((p - minPrice) / priceRange) * chartArea.height;
  }

  int findNearestCandleIndex(DateTime time) {
    if (candles.isEmpty) return 0;
    int closestIdx = 0;
    int minDiff = 9007199254740992; // Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER — web-safe
    for (int i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      final diff = (candles[i].openTime.millisecondsSinceEpoch - time.millisecondsSinceEpoch).abs();
      if (diff < minDiff) {
        minDiff = diff;
        closestIdx = i;
      }
    }
    return closestIdx;
  }

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    // 1. Draw Subtle Grid Lines & Price Axis
    _drawGridAndAxes(canvas, size);

    // 2. Clip to Chart Canvas Area for Candles & Drawings
    canvas.save();
    canvas.clipRect(chartArea);

    // 3. Draw Candlesticks in visible viewport slice
    _drawCandlesticks(canvas);

    // 4. Draw Indicator Overlays (EMA, SMA, Bollinger Bands) on top of candles
    _drawIndicatorOverlays(canvas);

    // 5. Draw User Technical Drawings (Trendlines, Fibs, Zones, Ruler)
    _drawAllUserDrawings(canvas);

    // 6. Draw Alert Lines
    _drawAlertLines(canvas);

    // 6.5 Draw AI Signal Overlay (Entry / SL / TP)
    if (signalOverlay != null && signalOverlay!.hasValidTradeSetup) {
      _drawSignalOverlay(canvas);
    }

    // 7. Draw Real-time Pulsing Beacon on rightmost forming candle
    _drawRealtimeBeacon(canvas);

    canvas.restore();

    // 8. Draw Right Price Scale Axis Labels & Price Tags
    _drawPriceScaleLabels(canvas, size);

    // 9. Draw Bottom Time Axis Date/Time Labels
    _drawTimeAxisLabels(canvas, size);

    // 10. Draw Oscillator Sub-Pane (RSI / MACD / Stoch)
    if (hasSubPane && subPaneHeight > 0 && subPaneIndicators.isNotEmpty) {
      _drawSubPane(canvas, size);
    }

    // 11. Draw Interactive Crosshair & Snap Badges
    if (isCrosshairActive && crosshairPosition != null) {
      _drawCrosshair(canvas, size);
      if (hasSubPane && subPaneHeight > 0) {
        _drawSubPaneCrosshair(canvas, size);
      }
    }
  }

  void _drawGridAndAxes(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final gridPaint = Paint()
      ..color = (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder).withValues(alpha: 0.35)
      ..strokeWidth = 1;

    // 5 Horizontal Price Grid Lines
    for (int i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      final y = chartArea.top + (chartArea.height / 4) * i;
      canvas.drawLine(Offset(0, y), Offset(chartArea.right, y), gridPaint);
    }

    // Vertical Time Grid Lines (every ~80px)
    final double vStep = max(60.0, 80.0);
    final int vCount = (chartArea.width / vStep).floor();
    for (int i = 1; i <= vCount; i++) {
      final x = i * (chartArea.width / (vCount + 1));
      canvas.drawLine(Offset(x, 0), Offset(x, chartArea.bottom), gridPaint);
    }
  }

  void _drawCandlesticks(Canvas canvas) {
    final bullColor = isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish;
    final bearColor = isDark ? AppTheme.darkBearish : AppTheme.lightBearish;

    final bullPaint = Paint()
      ..color = bullColor
      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;

    final bearPaint = Paint()
      ..color = bearColor
      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;

    final wickPaint = Paint()
      ..strokeWidth = max(1.0, candleWidth * 0.15)
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke;

    // Viewport visible indices
    final visibleCount = chartArea.width / candleStep;
    final startIndex = max(0, (scrollOffset - visibleCount - 2).floor());
    final endIndex = min(candles.length, (scrollOffset + 2).ceil());

    for (int i = startIndex; i < endIndex; i++) {
      final c = candles[i];
      final x = indexToX(i.toDouble());
      final isBull = c.isBullish;
      final paint = isBull ? bullPaint : bearPaint;
      wickPaint.color = paint.color;

      final openY = priceToY(c.open);
      final closeY = priceToY(c.close);
      final highY = priceToY(c.high);
      final lowY = priceToY(c.low);

      // Wick
      canvas.drawLine(Offset(x, highY), Offset(x, lowY), wickPaint);

      // Candle Body (ensure minimum 1px height for flat candles)
      final topY = min(openY, closeY);
      final bodyHeight = max(1.5, (openY - closeY).abs());
      final bodyRect = Rect.fromCenter(
        center: Offset(x, topY + bodyHeight / 2),
        width: candleWidth,
        height: bodyHeight,
      );

      canvas.drawRRect(RRect.fromRectAndRadius(bodyRect, const Radius.circular(1.5)), paint);
    }
  }

  void _drawRealtimeBeacon(Canvas canvas) {
    if (candles.isEmpty || currentPrice <= 0) return;
    final lastIdx = candles.length - 1;
    final x = indexToX(lastIdx.toDouble());
    final y = priceToY(candles[lastIdx].close);

    if (x < 0 || x > chartArea.right + 50) return;

    final bullColor = isDark ? AppTheme.darkBullish : AppTheme.lightBullish;
    final bearColor = isDark ? AppTheme.darkBearish : AppTheme.lightBearish;
    final color = candles[lastIdx].isBullish ? bullColor : bearColor;

    // Outer pulsating halo
    final haloPaint = Paint()
      ..color = color.withValues(alpha: 0.35 * pulseValue)
      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;
    canvas.drawCircle(Offset(x, y), 8.0 * pulseValue + 4.0, haloPaint);

    // Inner glowing core
    final corePaint = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;
    canvas.drawCircle(Offset(x, y), 3.5, corePaint);

    // Live horizontal price line across canvas to price scale
    final linePaint = Paint()
      ..color = (isDark ? AppTheme.darkPrimary : AppTheme.lightPrimary).withValues(alpha: 0.7)
      ..strokeWidth = 1.0;
    canvas.drawLine(Offset(x, y), Offset(chartArea.right, y), linePaint);
  }

  void _drawAlertLines(Canvas canvas) {
    for (final a in alerts) {
      if (!a.isActive) continue;
      final y = priceToY(a.targetPrice);
      if (y < 0 || y > chartArea.bottom) continue;

      final alertPaint = Paint()
        ..color = Colors.redAccent.withValues(alpha: 0.85)
        ..strokeWidth = 1.2
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke;

      // Dashed horizontal alert line
      const dashWidth = 5.0;
      const dashSpace = 4.0;
      double startX = 0;
      while (startX < chartArea.right) {
        canvas.drawLine(Offset(startX, y), Offset(startX + dashWidth, y), alertPaint);
        startX += dashWidth + dashSpace;
      }

      // Small "ALERT" tag badge
      final badgeRect = Rect.fromLTWH(chartArea.right - 54, y - 9, 50, 18);
      canvas.drawRRect(
        RRect.fromRectAndRadius(badgeRect, const Radius.circular(4)),
        Paint()..color = Colors.redAccent,
      );
      final textPainter = TextPainter(
        text: const TextSpan(
          text: 'ALERT',
          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, letterSpacing: 0.5),
        ),
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      )..layout();
      textPainter.paint(canvas, Offset(badgeRect.left + 8, badgeRect.top + 2.5));
    }
  }

  void _drawSignalOverlay(Canvas canvas) {
    if (signalOverlay == null) return;
    final sig = signalOverlay!;

    // 1. Entry Price Line (Emerald Green)
    if (sig.entryPrice > 0) {
      _drawDashedSignalLine(
        canvas: canvas,
        price: sig.entryPrice,
        color: const Color(0xFF00E676),
        label: 'ENTRY',
      );
    }

    // 2. Stop Loss Line (Crimson Red)
    if (sig.stopLoss > 0) {
      _drawDashedSignalLine(
        canvas: canvas,
        price: sig.stopLoss,
        color: const Color(0xFFFF5252),
        label: 'SL',
      );
    }

    // 3. Take Profit Line (Accent Blue)
    if (sig.takeProfit > 0) {
      _drawDashedSignalLine(
        canvas: canvas,
        price: sig.takeProfit,
        color: const Color(0xFF448AFF),
        label: 'TP',
      );
    }
  }

  void _drawDashedSignalLine({
    required Canvas canvas,
    required double price,
    required Color color,
    required String label,
  }) {
    final y = priceToY(price);
    if (y < 0 || y > chartArea.bottom) return;

    final linePaint = Paint()
      ..color = color.withValues(alpha: 0.92)
      ..strokeWidth = 1.3
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke;

    const dashWidth = 6.0;
    const dashSpace = 4.0;
    double startX = 0;
    while (startX < chartArea.right) {
      canvas.drawLine(Offset(startX, y), Offset(startX + dashWidth, y), linePaint);
      startX += dashWidth + dashSpace;
    }

    // Pill badge on the right edge of chart area
    final badgeRect = Rect.fromLTWH(chartArea.right - 58, y - 9, 54, 18);
    canvas.drawRRect(
      RRect.fromRectAndRadius(badgeRect, const Radius.circular(4)),
      Paint()..color = color,
    );
    final textPainter = TextPainter(
      text: TextSpan(
        text: label,
        style: const TextStyle(
          color: Colors.white,
          fontSize: 9,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
          letterSpacing: 0.5,
        ),
      ),
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
    )..layout();
    textPainter.paint(
      canvas,
      Offset(badgeRect.left + (badgeRect.width - textPainter.width) / 2, badgeRect.top + 2.5),
    );
  }

  void _drawAllUserDrawings(Canvas canvas) {
    for (final d in drawings) {
      _drawSingleDrawing(canvas, d, isSelected: d == selectedDrawing);
    }
    if (inProgressDrawing != null) {
      _drawSingleDrawing(canvas, inProgressDrawing!, isSelected: true);
    }
  }

  void _drawSingleDrawing(Canvas canvas, ChartDrawing d, {bool isSelected = false}) {
    if (d.points.isEmpty) return;

    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = d.color
      ..strokeWidth = d.strokeWidth
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke;

    switch (d.tool) {
      case DrawingTool.horizontalLine:
        final y = priceToY(d.points.first.price);
        final hasActiveAlert = d.hasAlert || alerts.any((a) => a.drawingId == d.id && a.isActive);

        // If alert is attached, paint a subtle golden alert halo
        if (hasActiveAlert) {
          final glowPaint = Paint()
            ..color = const Color(0xFFFF9100).withValues(alpha: 0.35)
            ..strokeWidth = d.strokeWidth + 3.5
            ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke;
          canvas.drawLine(Offset(0, y), Offset(chartArea.right, y), glowPaint);
        }

        canvas.drawLine(Offset(0, y), Offset(chartArea.right, y), paint);
        if (isSelected) {
          _drawHandle(canvas, Offset(chartArea.width * 0.5, y), d.color);
        }

        // Draw the price scale badge for horizontal lines
        final badgeWidth = hasActiveAlert ? 76.0 : 54.0;
        final badgeRect = Rect.fromLTWH(chartArea.right - (badgeWidth + 4), y - 9, badgeWidth, 18);
        canvas.drawRRect(
          RRect.fromRectAndRadius(badgeRect, const Radius.circular(4)),
          Paint()..color = hasActiveAlert ? const Color(0xFFFF9100) : d.color,
        );
        final labelText = hasActiveAlert
            ? '🔔 ${d.points.first.price.toStringAsFixed(precision)}'
            : d.points.first.price.toStringAsFixed(precision);
        final tp = TextPainter(
          text: TextSpan(
            text: labelText,
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: Colors.white,
              fontSize: 9,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
              fontFamily: 'monospace',
            ),
          ),
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        )..layout();
        tp.paint(
          canvas,
          Offset(badgeRect.left + (badgeRect.width - tp.width) / 2, badgeRect.top + 2.5),
        );
        break;

      case DrawingTool.trendline:
        if (d.points.length < 2) return;
        final p1 = _projectPoint(d.points[0]);
        final p2 = _projectPoint(d.points[1]);
        canvas.drawLine(p1, p2, paint);
        if (isSelected) {
          _drawHandle(canvas, p1, d.color);
          _drawHandle(canvas, p2, d.color);
        }
        break;

      case DrawingTool.rectangle:
        if (d.points.length < 2) return;
        final p1 = _projectPoint(d.points[0]);
        final p2 = _projectPoint(d.points[1]);
        final rect = Rect.fromPoints(p1, p2);

        // Shaded fill
        final fillPaint = Paint()
          ..color = d.color.withValues(alpha: 0.18)
          ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;
        canvas.drawRect(rect, fillPaint);
        canvas.drawRect(rect, paint);

        if (isSelected) {
          _drawHandle(canvas, rect.topLeft, d.color);
          _drawHandle(canvas, rect.bottomRight, d.color);
        }
        break;

      case DrawingTool.fibonacci:
        if (d.points.length < 2) return;
        final p1 = _projectPoint(d.points[0]);
        final p2 = _projectPoint(d.points[1]);
        final highPrice = max(d.points[0].price, d.points[1].price);
        final lowPrice = min(d.points[0].price, d.points[1].price);
        final span = highPrice - lowPrice;

        final levels = [0.0, 0.236, 0.382, 0.5, 0.618, 0.786, 1.0];
        final leftX = min(p1.dx, p2.dx) - 20;
        final rightX = max(p1.dx, p2.dx) + 40;

        // Golden pocket shading (0.382 - 0.618)
        final y382 = priceToY(highPrice - span * 0.382);
        final y618 = priceToY(highPrice - span * 0.618);
        canvas.drawRect(
          Rect.fromLTRB(leftX, min(y382, y618), rightX, max(y382, y618)),
          Paint()..color = const Color(0xFFFFD700).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
        );

        for (final lvl in levels) {
          final levelPrice = highPrice - span * lvl;
          final y = priceToY(levelPrice);
          final isGolden = lvl == 0.5 || lvl == 0.618;

          final fibLinePaint = Paint()
            ..color = isGolden ? const Color(0xFFFFD700) : d.color.withValues(alpha: 0.7)
            ..strokeWidth = isGolden ? 1.5 : 1.0;

          canvas.drawLine(Offset(leftX, y), Offset(rightX, y), fibLinePaint);

          final tp = TextPainter(
            text: TextSpan(
              text: '${(lvl * 100).toStringAsFixed(1)}% (${levelPrice.toStringAsFixed(precision)})',
              style: TextStyle(
                color: isGolden ? const Color(0xFFFFD700) : d.color,
                fontSize: 9,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
          )..layout();
          tp.paint(canvas, Offset(leftX + 4, y - 12));
        }

        if (isSelected) {
          _drawHandle(canvas, p1, d.color);
          _drawHandle(canvas, p2, d.color);
        }
        break;

      case DrawingTool.ruler:
        if (d.points.length < 2) return;
        final p1 = _projectPoint(d.points[0]);
        final p2 = _projectPoint(d.points[1]);

        final rect = Rect.fromPoints(p1, p2);
        canvas.drawRect(
          rect,
          Paint()..color = (d.points[1].price >= d.points[0].price ? Colors.green : Colors.red).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
        );
        canvas.drawLine(p1, p2, paint..strokeWidth = 1.5);

        // Pip calculation
        final priceDiff = d.points[1].price - d.points[0].price;
        final double multiplier = precision == 3 ? 100.0 : (precision == 2 ? 10.0 : 10000.0);
        final pips = (priceDiff * multiplier).abs();
        final pct = (priceDiff / d.points[0].price) * 100.0;
        final idx1 = findNearestCandleIndex(d.points[0].time);
        final idx2 = findNearestCandleIndex(d.points[1].time);
        final bars = (idx2 - idx1).abs();

        final label = '${priceDiff >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${pips.toStringAsFixed(1)} pips (${pct.toStringAsFixed(2)}%) • $bars bars';
        final tp = TextPainter(
          text: TextSpan(
            text: label,
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
          ),
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        )..layout();

        final badgeRect = Rect.fromLTWH(p2.dx - 10, p2.dy - 22, tp.width + 12, 20);
        canvas.drawRRect(
          RRect.fromRectAndRadius(badgeRect, const Radius.circular(4)),
          Paint()..color = Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
        );
        tp.paint(canvas, Offset(badgeRect.left + 6, badgeRect.top + 3));

        if (isSelected) {
          _drawHandle(canvas, p1, d.color);
          _drawHandle(canvas, p2, d.color);
        }
        break;

      case DrawingTool.none:
        break;
    }
  }

  Offset _projectPoint(ChartPoint pt) {
    final idx = findNearestCandleIndex(pt.time);
    final x = indexToX(idx.toDouble());
    final y = priceToY(pt.price);
    return Offset(x, y);
  }

  void _drawHandle(Canvas canvas, Offset pos, Color color) {
    canvas.drawCircle(pos, 6.0, Paint()..color = Colors.white);
    canvas.drawCircle(pos, 4.5, Paint()..color = color);
  }

  void _drawPriceScaleLabels(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final textColor = (isDark ? AppTheme.darkTextSecondary : AppTheme.lightTextSecondary);
    final textStyle = TextStyle(color: textColor, fontSize: 10, fontFamily: 'monospace');

    // 5 Price labels on right scale
    for (int i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      final y = chartArea.top + (chartArea.height / 4) * i;
      final price = minPrice + ((chartArea.bottom - y) / chartArea.height) * priceRange;

      final tp = TextPainter(
        text: TextSpan(text: price.toStringAsFixed(precision), style: textStyle),
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      )..layout();
      tp.paint(canvas, Offset(chartArea.right + 8, y - 6));
    }

    // Live Price Banner in Price Scale
    if (currentPrice > 0) {
      final y = priceToY(currentPrice);
      if (y >= chartArea.top && y <= chartArea.bottom) {
        final badgeRect = Rect.fromLTWH(chartArea.right + 2, y - 10, size.width - chartArea.right - 4, 20);
        final liveColor = isDark ? AppTheme.darkPrimary : AppTheme.lightPrimary;

        canvas.drawRRect(
          RRect.fromRectAndRadius(badgeRect, const Radius.circular(4)),
          Paint()..color = liveColor,
        );

        final tp = TextPainter(
          text: TextSpan(
            text: currentPrice.toStringAsFixed(precision),
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontFamily: 'monospace'),
          ),
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        )..layout();
        tp.paint(canvas, Offset(badgeRect.left + 5, badgeRect.top + 3));
      }
    }

    // AI Signal Price Scale Badges (Entry / SL / TP)
    if (signalOverlay != null && signalOverlay!.hasValidTradeSetup) {
      _drawSignalPriceScaleBadges(canvas, size);
    }
  }

  void _drawScaleBadge(Canvas canvas, Size size, double price, Color color, String prefix) {
    if (price <= 0) return;
    final y = priceToY(price);
    if (y < chartArea.top || y > chartArea.bottom) return;

    final badgeRect = Rect.fromLTWH(chartArea.right + 2, y - 10, size.width - chartArea.right - 4, 20);
    canvas.drawRRect(
      RRect.fromRectAndRadius(badgeRect, const Radius.circular(4)),
      Paint()..color = color,
    );

    final text = prefix.isNotEmpty ? '$prefix ${price.toStringAsFixed(precision)}' : price.toStringAsFixed(precision);

    final tp = TextPainter(
      text: TextSpan(
        text: text,
        style: const TextStyle(
          color: Colors.white,
          fontSize: 9,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
          fontFamily: 'monospace',
        ),
      ),
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
    )..layout();
    tp.paint(canvas, Offset(badgeRect.left + 3, badgeRect.top + 3.5));
  }

  void _drawSignalPriceScaleBadges(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    if (signalOverlay == null) return;
    final sig = signalOverlay!;

    _drawScaleBadge(canvas, size, sig.entryPrice, const Color(0xFF00E676), 'E');
    _drawScaleBadge(canvas, size, sig.stopLoss, const Color(0xFFFF5252), 'SL');
    _drawScaleBadge(canvas, size, sig.takeProfit, const Color(0xFF448AFF), 'TP');
  }

  void _drawTimeAxisLabels(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final textStyle = TextStyle(
      color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkTextSecondary : AppTheme.lightTextSecondary,
      fontSize: 9,
      fontFamily: 'monospace',
    );

    final double vStep = 90.0;
    final int count = (chartArea.width / vStep).floor();
    for (int i = 1; i <= count; i++) {
      final x = i * (chartArea.width / (count + 1));
      final rawIndex = scrollOffset - (chartArea.width - x) / candleStep;
      final idx = rawIndex.round().clamp(0, candles.length - 1);
      final date = candles[idx].openTime;
      final text = interval == '1D' || interval == '1W'
          ? DateFormat('MM/dd').format(date)
          : DateFormat('HH:mm').format(date);

      final tp = TextPainter(
        text: TextSpan(text: text, style: textStyle),
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      )..layout();
      tp.paint(canvas, Offset(x - tp.width / 2, chartArea.bottom + 6));
    }
  }

  void _drawCrosshair(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final pos = crosshairPosition!;
    final crossPaint = Paint()
      ..color = const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.8)
      ..strokeWidth = 1.0;

    // Horizontal dashed crosshair line
    double startX = 0;
    while (startX < chartArea.right) {
      canvas.drawLine(Offset(startX, pos.dy), Offset(startX + 4, pos.dy), crossPaint);
      startX += 8;
    }

    // Vertical dashed crosshair line
    double startY = 0;
    while (startY < chartArea.bottom) {
      canvas.drawLine(Offset(pos.dx, startY), Offset(pos.dx, startY + 4), crossPaint);
      startY += 8;
    }

    // Price tag on right scale
    if (hoverPrice != null) {
      final priceRect = Rect.fromLTWH(chartArea.right + 2, pos.dy - 10, size.width - chartArea.right - 4, 20);
      canvas.drawRRect(
        RRect.fromRectAndRadius(priceRect, const Radius.circular(4)),
        Paint()..color = const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
      );
      final tp = TextPainter(
        text: TextSpan(
          text: hoverPrice!.toStringAsFixed(precision),
          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.black, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontFamily: 'monospace'),
        ),
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      )..layout();
      tp.paint(canvas, Offset(priceRect.left + 5, priceRect.top + 3));
    }

    // Time tag on bottom scale
    if (hoverCandle != null) {
      final dateText = DateFormat('MM/dd HH:mm').format(hoverCandle!.openTime);
      final tp = TextPainter(
        text: TextSpan(
          text: dateText,
          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.black, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontFamily: 'monospace'),
        ),
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      )..layout();

      final timeRect = Rect.fromCenter(
        center: Offset(pos.dx, chartArea.bottom + 12),
        width: tp.width + 12,
        height: 18,
      );
      canvas.drawRRect(
        RRect.fromRectAndRadius(timeRect, const Radius.circular(4)),
        Paint()..color = const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
      );
      tp.paint(canvas, Offset(timeRect.left + 6, timeRect.top + 2.5));
    }
  }

  // ─── INDICATOR OVERLAY RENDERING ───────────────────────────────────────────

  /// Draws EMA, SMA, and Bollinger Bands overlaid on the candlestick price chart.
  void _drawIndicatorOverlays(Canvas canvas) {
    final visibleCount = chartArea.width / candleStep;
    final startIndex = max(0, (scrollOffset - visibleCount - 2).floor());
    final endIndex = min(candles.length, (scrollOffset + 2).ceil());

    for (final entry in indicatorResults.entries) {
      final result = entry.value;
      final config = result.config;
      if (config.type.placement != IndicatorPlacement.overlay) continue;
      if (!config.isVisible) continue;

      switch (config.type) {
        case IndicatorType.ema:
        case IndicatorType.sma:
          _drawLineSeries(
            canvas,
            result.primary,
            config.getColor('main', const Color(0xFF00E5FF)),
            config.lineWidth,
            startIndex,
            endIndex,
          );
          break;

        case IndicatorType.bollingerBands:
          final upperColor = config.getColor('upper', const Color(0xFF00E5FF));
          final lowerColor = config.getColor('lower', const Color(0xFF00E5FF));
          final basisColor = config.getColor('basis', const Color(0xFFFF9800));
          final fillColor = config.getColor('fill', const Color(0x1A00E5FF));

          // Draw fill between upper and lower
          _drawBandFill(canvas, result.secondary, result.tertiary, fillColor, startIndex, endIndex);
          // Upper band
          if (result.secondary != null) {
            _drawLineSeries(canvas, result.secondary!, upperColor, config.lineWidth, startIndex, endIndex);
          }
          // Lower band
          if (result.tertiary != null) {
            _drawLineSeries(canvas, result.tertiary!, lowerColor, config.lineWidth, startIndex, endIndex);
          }
          // Basis (SMA)
          _drawLineSeries(canvas, result.primary, basisColor, config.lineWidth, startIndex, endIndex);
          break;

        default:
          break;
      }
    }
  }

  /// Draw a price series line (connecting non-null data points)
  void _drawLineSeries(
    Canvas canvas,
    List<double?> values,
    Color color,
    double strokeWidth,
    int startIndex,
    int endIndex,
  ) {
    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..strokeWidth = strokeWidth
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round;

    final path = Path();
    bool started = false;

    for (int i = max(0, startIndex - 1); i <= min(candles.length - 1, endIndex + 1); i++) {
      if (i >= values.length) break;
      final v = values[i];
      if (v == null) {
        started = false;
        continue;
      }
      final x = indexToX(i.toDouble());
      final y = priceToY(v);
      if (!started) {
        path.moveTo(x, y);
        started = true;
      } else {
        path.lineTo(x, y);
      }
    }
    canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
  }

  /// Draw filled band between upper and lower series
  void _drawBandFill(
    Canvas canvas,
    List<double?>? upper,
    List<double?>? lower,
    Color fillColor,
    int startIndex,
    int endIndex,
  ) {
    if (upper == null || lower == null) return;

    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = fillColor
      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;

    final path = Path();
    bool started = false;

    final idxFrom = max(0, startIndex - 1);
    final idxTo = min(candles.length - 1, endIndex + 1);

    // Build upper path forward
    for (int i = idxFrom; i <= idxTo; i++) {
      if (i >= upper.length || i >= lower.length) break;
      final u = upper[i];
      if (u == null) { started = false; continue; }
      final x = indexToX(i.toDouble());
      final y = priceToY(u);
      if (!started) { path.moveTo(x, y); started = true; }
      else { path.lineTo(x, y); }
    }

    // Close backward along lower band
    for (int i = idxTo; i >= idxFrom; i--) {
      if (i >= lower.length) continue;
      final l = lower[i];
      if (l == null) continue;
      path.lineTo(indexToX(i.toDouble()), priceToY(l));
    }
    path.close();
    canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
  }

  // ─── OSCILLATOR SUB-PANE RENDERING ─────────────────────────────────────────

  void _drawSubPane(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    const double sep = 1.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < subPaneIndicators.length; i++) {
      final config = subPaneIndicators[i];
      final result = indicatorResults[config.id];
      if (result == null) continue;

      // Each sub-pane starts below the previous ones stacked vertically like TradingView
      final currentSubPaneTop = chartArea.bottom + (i * (subPaneHeight + sep)) + sep;
      final subPaneRect = Rect.fromLTWH(0, currentSubPaneTop, chartArea.width, subPaneHeight);

      // Background
      final bgPaint = Paint()
        ..color = (isDark ? const Color(0xFF0D1117) : const Color(0xFFF5F5F5));
      canvas.drawRect(subPaneRect, bgPaint);

      // Separator line
      canvas.drawLine(
        Offset(0, currentSubPaneTop),
        Offset(chartArea.width, currentSubPaneTop),
        Paint()..color = (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder).withValues(alpha: 0.6)..strokeWidth = 1,
      );

      _drawSubPaneGrid(canvas, subPaneRect, config);

      switch (config.type) {
        case IndicatorType.rsi:
        case IndicatorType.stochastic:
          _drawSubPaneOscillatorLines(canvas, subPaneRect, result, config);
          _drawSubPaneLabels(canvas, subPaneRect, size, config, result);
          break;
        case IndicatorType.macd:
          _drawSubPaneMacd(canvas, subPaneRect, result, config);
          _drawSubPaneLabels(canvas, subPaneRect, size, config, result);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    }
  }

  void _drawSubPaneGrid(Canvas canvas, Rect subPaneRect, IndicatorConfig config) {
    final gridPaint = Paint()
      ..color = (isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder).withValues(alpha: 0.25)
      ..strokeWidth = 1;

    // Horizontal guide lines at overbought / midpoint / oversold
    final double high = (config.type == IndicatorType.stochastic)
        ? config.getDouble('overbought', 80.0)
        : (config.type == IndicatorType.rsi ? config.getDouble('overbought', 70.0) : 0.0);
    final double low = (config.type == IndicatorType.stochastic)
        ? config.getDouble('oversold', 20.0)
        : (config.type == IndicatorType.rsi ? config.getDouble('oversold', 30.0) : 0.0);
    final double range = config.type == IndicatorType.macd ? 1.0 : 100.0;

    if (config.type != IndicatorType.macd) {
      // Overbought line
      final yHigh = subPaneRect.bottom - (high / range) * subPaneRect.height;
      final yLow = subPaneRect.bottom - (low / range) * subPaneRect.height;
      final yMid = subPaneRect.bottom - 0.5 * subPaneRect.height;

      // Shaded band between oversold and overbought
      final upperColor = config.getColor('upper', const Color(0xFFEF5350));
      final lowerColor = config.getColor('lower', const Color(0xFF26A69A));
      final bandFill = config.getColor('bandFill', const Color(0x1F7E57C2));

      canvas.drawRect(
        Rect.fromLTRB(0, yHigh, subPaneRect.width, yLow),
        Paint()..color = bandFill,
      );

      // Overbought dashed line
      _drawDashedLine(canvas, Offset(0, yHigh), Offset(subPaneRect.width, yHigh),
          upperColor.withValues(alpha: 0.7), 1.2);

      // Oversold dashed line
      _drawDashedLine(canvas, Offset(0, yLow), Offset(subPaneRect.width, yLow),
          lowerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.7), 1.2);

      // Midpoint guide
      _drawDashedLine(canvas, Offset(0, yMid), Offset(subPaneRect.width, yMid),
          gridPaint.color, 1.0);
    } else {
      // Zero line for MACD
      final y = subPaneRect.bottom - 0.5 * subPaneRect.height;
      _drawDashedLine(canvas, Offset(0, y), Offset(subPaneRect.width, y),
          (isDark ? Colors.white24 : Colors.black26), 1.0);
    }

    // Outer border
    canvas.drawLine(Offset(0, subPaneRect.top), Offset(subPaneRect.width, subPaneRect.top), gridPaint);
    canvas.drawLine(Offset(0, subPaneRect.bottom), Offset(subPaneRect.width, subPaneRect.bottom), gridPaint);
  }

  void _drawDashedLine(Canvas canvas, Offset start, Offset end, Color color, double width) {
    final paint = Paint()..color = color..strokeWidth = width;
    double dist = 0;
    final total = (end - start).distance;
    final dir = (end - start) / total;
    while (dist < total) {
      final from = start + dir * dist;
      final to = start + dir * (dist + 4).clamp(0, total);
      canvas.drawLine(from, to, paint);
      dist += 8;
    }
  }

  void _drawSubPaneOscillatorLines(Canvas canvas, Rect subPaneRect, IndicatorCalculationResult result, IndicatorConfig config) {
    canvas.save();
    canvas.clipRect(subPaneRect);

    final visibleCount = chartArea.width / candleStep;
    final startIndex = max(0, (scrollOffset - visibleCount - 2).floor());
    final endIndex = min(candles.length, (scrollOffset + 2).ceil());

    // Normalise value (0-100) → Y in sub-pane
    double toSubY(double v) => subPaneRect.bottom - (v.clamp(0, 100) / 100.0) * subPaneRect.height;

    void drawSeries(List<double?> values, Color color, double sw) {
      final paint = Paint()
        ..color = color..strokeWidth = sw..style = PaintingStyle.stroke..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round;
      final path = Path();
      bool started = false;
      for (int i = max(0, startIndex - 1); i <= min(candles.length - 1, endIndex + 1); i++) {
        if (i >= values.length) break;
        final v = values[i];
        if (v == null) { started = false; continue; }
        final x = indexToX(i.toDouble());
        final y = toSubY(v);
        if (!started) { path.moveTo(x, y); started = true; }
        else { path.lineTo(x, y); }
      }
      canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
    }

    final primaryColor = config.type == IndicatorType.stochastic
        ? config.getColor('k', const Color(0xFF2196F3))
        : config.getColor('main', const Color(0xFFAB47BC));
    drawSeries(result.primary, primaryColor, config.lineWidth);

    // Secondary line (Stoch %D)
    if (result.secondary != null) {
      final dColor = config.getColor('d', const Color(0xFFFF9800));
      drawSeries(result.secondary!, dColor, config.lineWidth * 0.85);
    }

    canvas.restore();
  }

  void _drawSubPaneMacd(Canvas canvas, Rect subPaneRect, IndicatorCalculationResult result, IndicatorConfig config) {
    canvas.save();
    canvas.clipRect(subPaneRect);

    final visibleCount = chartArea.width / candleStep;
    final startIndex = max(0, (scrollOffset - visibleCount - 2).floor());
    final endIndex = min(candles.length, (scrollOffset + 2).ceil());

    // Auto-scale MACD to visible range
    double macdMin = 0, macdMax = 0;
    for (int i = max(0, startIndex); i < min(candles.length, endIndex); i++) {
      if (result.histogram != null && i < result.histogram!.length && result.histogram![i] != null) {
        final h = result.histogram![i]!;
        if (h < macdMin) macdMin = h;
        if (h > macdMax) macdMax = h;
      }
      if (i < result.primary.length && result.primary[i] != null) {
        final m = result.primary[i]!;
        if (m < macdMin) macdMin = m;
        if (m > macdMax) macdMax = m;
      }
    }
    final macdRange = (macdMax - macdMin).abs();
    final paddedRange = macdRange == 0 ? 0.001 : macdRange * 1.2;
    final macdCenter = (macdMin + macdMax) / 2;

    double toSubY(double v) {
      final ratio = (v - (macdCenter - paddedRange / 2)) / paddedRange;
      return subPaneRect.bottom - ratio.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * subPaneRect.height;
    }

    final histUpColor = config.getColor('histUp', const Color(0xFF26A69A));
    final histDownColor = config.getColor('histDown', const Color(0xFFEF5350));
    final macdColor = config.getColor('macd', const Color(0xFF2962FF));
    final signalColor = config.getColor('signal', const Color(0xFFFF6D00));

    // Zero line y
    final zeroY = toSubY(0);

    // Draw histogram bars
    if (result.histogram != null) {
      for (int i = max(0, startIndex); i < min(candles.length, endIndex + 1); i++) {
        if (i >= result.histogram!.length) break;
        final h = result.histogram![i];
        if (h == null) continue;
        final x = indexToX(i.toDouble());
        final y = toSubY(h);

        // Determine bar color based on expansion/contraction
        Color barColor;
        if (h >= 0) {
          final prev = i > 0 && i - 1 < result.histogram!.length ? result.histogram![i - 1] : null;
          barColor = (prev != null && h >= prev) ? histUpColor : histUpColor.withValues(alpha: 0.55);
        } else {
          final prev = i > 0 && i - 1 < result.histogram!.length ? result.histogram![i - 1] : null;
          barColor = (prev != null && h <= prev) ? histDownColor : histDownColor.withValues(alpha: 0.55);
        }

        final barWidth = max(1.0, candleWidth * 0.8);
        canvas.drawRect(
          Rect.fromLTRB(x - barWidth / 2, min(y, zeroY), x + barWidth / 2, max(y, zeroY)),
          Paint()..color = barColor,
        );
      }
    }

    // MACD line
    void drawLine(List<double?> vals, Color color, double sw) {
      final paint = Paint()..color = color..strokeWidth = sw..style = PaintingStyle.stroke..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
      final path = Path();
      bool started = false;
      for (int i = max(0, startIndex - 1); i <= min(candles.length - 1, endIndex + 1); i++) {
        if (i >= vals.length) break;
        final v = vals[i];
        if (v == null) { started = false; continue; }
        final x = indexToX(i.toDouble());
        final y = toSubY(v);
        if (!started) { path.moveTo(x, y); started = true; }
        else { path.lineTo(x, y); }
      }
      canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
    }

    drawLine(result.primary, macdColor, config.lineWidth);
    if (result.secondary != null) {
      drawLine(result.secondary!, signalColor, config.lineWidth * 0.85);
    }

    canvas.restore();
  }

  void _drawSubPaneLabels(Canvas canvas, Rect subPaneRect, Size size, IndicatorConfig config, IndicatorCalculationResult result) {
    final textColor = (isDark ? AppTheme.darkTextSecondary : AppTheme.lightTextSecondary);
    final textStyle = TextStyle(color: textColor, fontSize: 9, fontFamily: 'monospace');

    // Draw indicator name label in sub-pane
    final labelTp = TextPainter(
      text: TextSpan(text: config.titleWithParams, style: textStyle),
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
    )..layout();
    labelTp.paint(canvas, Offset(4, subPaneRect.top + 4));

    if (config.type == IndicatorType.rsi || config.type == IndicatorType.stochastic) {
      final high = config.type == IndicatorType.stochastic
          ? config.getDouble('overbought', 80.0)
          : config.getDouble('overbought', 70.0);
      final low = config.type == IndicatorType.stochastic
          ? config.getDouble('oversold', 20.0)
          : config.getDouble('oversold', 30.0);

      // Label the levels on the right price scale
      for (final level in [high, 50.0, low]) {
        final y = subPaneRect.bottom - (level / 100.0) * subPaneRect.height;
        final tp = TextPainter(
          text: TextSpan(text: level.toStringAsFixed(0), style: textStyle),
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        )..layout();
        tp.paint(canvas, Offset(chartArea.width + 4, y - 6));
      }
    }
  }

  void _drawSubPaneCrosshair(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    if (crosshairPosition == null || subPaneIndicators.isEmpty) return;
    final pos = crosshairPosition!;
    const double sep = 1.0;
    final crossPaint = Paint()..color = const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.8)..strokeWidth = 1.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < subPaneIndicators.length; i++) {
      final config = subPaneIndicators[i];
      final currentSubPaneTop = chartArea.bottom + (i * (subPaneHeight + sep)) + sep;
      final subPaneRect = Rect.fromLTWH(0, currentSubPaneTop, chartArea.width, subPaneHeight);

      // Vertical line through this sub-pane
      double sy = currentSubPaneTop;
      while (sy < subPaneRect.bottom) {
        canvas.drawLine(Offset(pos.dx, sy), Offset(pos.dx, sy + 4), crossPaint);
        sy += 8;
      }

      // Show current sub-pane indicator value at crosshair on right axis
      if (hoverCandle != null) {
        final result = indicatorResults[config.id];
        if (result != null) {
          int idx = 0;
          for (int c = 0; c < candles.length; c++) {
            if (candles[c].openTime == hoverCandle!.openTime) { idx = c; break; }
          }
          final v = idx < result.primary.length ? result.primary[idx] : null;
          if (v != null) {
            final label = '${config.type.shortName}: ${v.toStringAsFixed(2)}';
            final tp = TextPainter(
              text: TextSpan(
                text: label,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.black, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontFamily: 'monospace'),
              ),
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            )..layout();
            final badgeRect = Rect.fromLTWH(chartArea.width + 2, subPaneRect.top + 2, tp.width + 8, 16);
            canvas.drawRRect(
              RRect.fromRectAndRadius(badgeRect, const Radius.circular(4)),
              Paint()..color = const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
            );
            tp.paint(canvas, Offset(badgeRect.left + 4, badgeRect.top + 2));
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _FullblownChartPainter oldDelegate) {
    return true; // Live ticks, panning, zooming, and animations require active repaints
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../models/indicator_models.dart';

import 'indicator_settings_sheet.dart';

class IndicatorCatalogSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<IndicatorConfig> activeIndicators;
  final ValueChanged<List<IndicatorConfig>> onIndicatorsChanged;

  const IndicatorCatalogSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.activeIndicators,
    required this.onIndicatorsChanged,
  });

  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required List<IndicatorConfig> activeIndicators,
    required ValueChanged<List<IndicatorConfig>> onIndicatorsChanged,
  }) {
    return showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => IndicatorCatalogSheet(
        activeIndicators: activeIndicators,
        onIndicatorsChanged: onIndicatorsChanged,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<IndicatorCatalogSheet> createState() => _IndicatorCatalogSheetState();
}

class _IndicatorCatalogSheetState extends State<IndicatorCatalogSheet> {
  late List<IndicatorConfig> _active;
  String _searchQuery = '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _active = List.from(widget.activeIndicators);
  }

  void _notifyChanges() {
    widget.onIndicatorsChanged(List.from(_active));
  }

  void _addIndicator(IndicatorType type) {
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
    setState(() {
      _active.add(IndicatorConfig.defaultFor(type));
    });
    _notifyChanges();
  }

  void _removeIndicator(String id) {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    setState(() {
      _active.removeWhere((item) => item.id == id);
    });
    _notifyChanges();
  }

  void _toggleVisibility(String id) {
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() {
      final idx = _active.indexWhere((item) => item.id == id);
      if (idx != -1) {
        _active[idx].isVisible = !_active[idx].isVisible;
      }
    });
    _notifyChanges();
  }

  void _editSettings(IndicatorConfig config) {
    IndicatorSettingsSheet.show(
      context,
      config: config,
      onSave: (updated) {
        setState(() {
          final idx = _active.indexWhere((item) => item.id == updated.id);
          if (idx != -1) {
            _active[idx] = updated;
          }
        });
        _notifyChanges();
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;

    final bg = isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface1 : Colors.white;
    final textPrimary = isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87;
    final textSecondary = isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black54;
    final borderColor = isDark ? AppTheme.darkBorder : AppTheme.lightBorder;

    final filteredTypes = IndicatorType.values.where((t) {
      if (_searchQuery.isEmpty) return true;
      final q = _searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      return t.shortName.toLowerCase().contains(q) || t.fullName.toLowerCase().contains(q);
    }).toList();

    return Container(
      height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.8,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bg,
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
            blurRadius: 24,
            offset: const Offset(0, -4),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          // Drag handle
          Center(
            child: Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10, bottom: 6),
              width: 38,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: textSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
              ),
            ),
          ),

          // Header
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  ),
                  child: const Text(
                    'fx',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontSize: 16,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        'Indicators & Strategies',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: textPrimary,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          fontSize: 17,
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        'TradingView technical indicators',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: textSecondary,
                          fontSize: 12,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 20),
                  color: textSecondary,
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          // Search Field
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 6),
            child: TextField(

              style: TextStyle(color: textPrimary, fontSize: 14),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Search indicator (e.g. RSI, EMA, Bollinger)',
                hintStyle: TextStyle(color: textSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.6), fontSize: 13),
                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search, color: textSecondary, size: 20),
                suffixIcon: _searchQuery.isNotEmpty
                    ? IconButton(

                      )
                    : null,
                filled: true,
                fillColor: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : const Color(0xFFF3F3F5),

          Expanded(

                      ),
                      TextButton(

                          setState(() => _active.clear());
                          _notifyChanges();
                        },

                          'Clear All',
                          style: TextStyle(color: textSecondary, fontSize: 12),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  ..._active.map((item) => _buildActiveIndicatorTile(item, isDark, textPrimary, textSecondary, borderColor)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 18),
                  Divider(height: 1, color: borderColor),

                  Padding(

                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                else
                  ...filteredTypes.map(
                    (type) => _buildCatalogTile(type, isDark, textPrimary, textSecondary, borderColor),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),

  Widget _buildActiveIndicatorTile(
    IndicatorConfig item,
    bool isDark,
    Color textPrimary,
    Color textSecondary,
    Color borderColor,
  ) {
    Color indicatorPrimaryColor;
    if (item.colors.containsKey('main')) {
      indicatorPrimaryColor = Color(item.colors['main']!);
    } else if (item.colors.containsKey('macd')) {
      indicatorPrimaryColor = Color(item.colors['macd']!);
    } else if (item.colors.containsKey('upper')) {
      indicatorPrimaryColor = Color(item.colors['upper']!);
    } else {
      indicatorPrimaryColor = const Color(0xFF00E5FF);
    }

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : const Color(0xFFF9F9FB),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(
          color: item.isVisible ? indicatorPrimaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4) : borderColor,
        ),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 10,
            height: 10,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: indicatorPrimaryColor,
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  item.titleWithParams,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: item.isVisible ? textPrimary : textSecondary,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    fontSize: 13,
                  ),
                ),
                Text(
                  item.type.fullName,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: textSecondary,
                    fontSize: 11,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          // Visibility toggle
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(
              item.isVisible ? Icons.visibility : Icons.visibility_off,
              size: 18,
              color: item.isVisible ? const Color(0xFF00E5FF) : textSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
            ),
            tooltip: item.isVisible ? 'Hide' : 'Show',
            onPressed: () => _toggleVisibility(item.id),
          ),
          // Settings button
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.settings, size: 18, color: textSecondary),
            tooltip: 'Indicator Settings',
            onPressed: () => _editSettings(item),
          ),
          // Remove button
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 18, color: Color(0xFFEF5350)),
            tooltip: 'Remove',
            onPressed: () => _removeIndicator(item.id),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCatalogTile(
    IndicatorType type,
    bool isDark,
    Color textPrimary,
    Color textSecondary,
    Color borderColor,
  ) {
    final activeCount = _active.where((a) => a.type == type).length;
    final isSubPane = type.placement == IndicatorPlacement.subPane;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? AppTheme.darkSurface2 : const Color(0xFFFAFAFA),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(color: borderColor),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: isSubPane
                  ? const Color(0xFFAB47BC).withValues(alpha: 0.15)
                  : const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
              border: Border.all(
                color: isSubPane
                    ? const Color(0xFFAB47BC).withValues(alpha: 0.4)
                    : const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
              ),
            ),
            child: Text(
              type.shortName,
              style: TextStyle(
                color: isSubPane ? const Color(0xFFCE93D8) : const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                fontSize: 12,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        type.fullName,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: textPrimary,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          fontSize: 13,
                        ),
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (activeCount > 0) ...[
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5, vertical: 1),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: const Color(0xFF26A69A).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          '$activeCount active',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Color(0xFF26A69A),
                            fontSize: 10,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  isSubPane ? 'Oscillator (Sub-pane below)' : 'Overlay (Main price chart)',
                  style: TextStyle(color: textSecondary, fontSize: 11),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          ElevatedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => _addIndicator(type),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 14),
            label: const Text('Add'),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.18),
              foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
              elevation: 0,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
              minimumSize: const Size(64, 32),
              textStyle: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12),
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF00E5FF), width: 1),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class IndicatorSettingsSheet extends StatefulWidget {

  final ValueChanged<IndicatorConfig> onSave;

  const IndicatorSettingsSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.config,
    required this.onSave,
  });

  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required IndicatorConfig config,
    required ValueChanged<IndicatorConfig> onSave,
  }) {
    return showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => IndicatorSettingsSheet(config: config, onSave: onSave),
    );

  State<IndicatorSettingsSheet> createState() => _IndicatorSettingsSheetState();
}

class _IndicatorSettingsSheetState extends State<IndicatorSettingsSheet> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late TabController _tabController;
  late IndicatorConfig _editingConfig;

  // Preset vibrant palette colors for trading charts

    Color(0xFF00E5FF), // Electric Cyan
    Color(0xFF26A69A), // Teal / Green

    Color(0xFFFF9800), // Amber / Orange
    Color(0xFFAB47BC), // Purple
    Color(0xFFEF5350), // Coral Red
    Color(0xFF2962FF), // Royal Blue
    Color(0xFFFFFFFF), // Crisp White
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tabController = TabController(length: 2, vsync: this);
    _editingConfig = widget.config.copyWith();

    _tabController.dispose();

  }

    return Container(

          ),

        children: [
